papers.title: Effective Ionic Valence and Local Magnetic Moment in Kagome Superconductors
papers.abstract: In order to understand the unexpected similarity and the correlated behavior in kagome superconductor families AV$_3$Sb$_5$ (A = K, Rb, Cs) and ATi$_3$Bi$_5$ (A = Rb, Cs), we investigate the Hartree-scale local electronic structure of these systems. Our result indicates that V and Ti ions are both of 2+ valence such that the corresponding itinerant carrier densities are similar, and the difference in electron count is instead reflected in their quantum fluctuating ionic magnetic moments. However, due to the frustrated lattice geometry of these materials, such local moments are difficult to experimentally observe via standard probes. For verification, we systematically introduce nonmagnetic Sn impurities to locally relieve the geometric frustration and experimentally demonstrate the existence of well-defined local magnetic moments via magnetic susceptibility and muon spin rotation or relaxation ($μ$SR) measurements. All experiments discover a systematic increase of magnetic susceptibility upon increasing nonmagnetic impurity level. Our discovered ionic moments suggest a paradigm shift from the existing itinerant carrier-only picture to one incorporating strong correlation from local ionic spins. The associated interatomic and local-itinerant correlations offer a solid ground for the emergence of the observed rich correlated behavior in this new family of superconducting materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：摘要中既有 Hartree 尺度的局域电子结构计算/理论分析，也有非磁性 Sn 杂质引入、磁化率测量和 μSR 实验验证。；研究对象：Kagome 超导体家族 AV₃Sb₅（A = K, Rb, Cs）和 ATi₃Bi₅（A = Rb, Cs），关注其局域电子结构、离子价态、局域磁矩以及这些体系之间出乎意料的相似性与关联行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: V 和 Ti 离子均为 2+ 价，因此对应的巡游载流子密度相似，而电子数差异体现在量子涨落的离子磁矩上；由于阻挫晶格几何，这些局域磁矩难以用常规手段观测，但通过引入非磁性 Sn 杂质局部解除几何阻挫后，实验证实了明确局域磁矩的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：V 和 Ti 离子均为 2+ 价，因此对应的巡游载流子密度相似，而电子数差异体现在量子涨落的离子磁矩上；由于阻挫晶格几何，这些局域磁矩难以用常规手段观测，但通过引入非磁性 Sn 杂质局部解除几何阻挫后，实验证实了明确局域磁矩的存在。；创新点：提出从现有仅考虑巡游载流子的图像，转向包含局域离子自旋强关联的图像；发现离子磁矩的存在，并指出其相关的原子间关联和局域-巡游关联为理解该超导材料家族中丰富的关联行为提供了基础。
papers.method_zh: Hartree 尺度的局域电子结构计算；系统性引入非磁性 Sn 杂质以局部解除几何阻挫；磁化率测量；μ子自旋旋转/弛豫（μSR）测量。

papers.title: Low temperature thermodynamics of $S_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2$ triangular lattice quantum spin liquid candidate TlYbS$_2$
papers.abstract: Geometrically frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnets exhibit a delicate competition between magnetic order and quantum spin liquid (QSL) behavior, with the Yb-based delafossite family $A$Yb$X_2$ providing a structurally clean platform for exploring this physics. Here, we report a comprehensive study of single-crystal TlYbS$_2$ using DC magnetization, AC susceptibility, electron spin resonance (ESR), and specific heat measurements extending from room temperature to the millikelvin regime. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms a trigonal $R\bar{3}m$ structure comprising well-separated triangular layers of Yb$^{3+}$ ions with no detectable site disorder. At zero field, a weak thermodynamic anomaly is observed near $530$ mK, which may indicate the onset of a weakly ordered state similar to that reported in KYbSe$_2$. Below $300$ mK, the zero-field magnetic specific heat follows $C_{\rm m}\propto T^{1.8}$, close to a quadratic temperature dependence, in contrast to the linear temperature dependence reported for the sister compound TlYbSe$_2$, which has been described in terms of the interplay between spinons and thermally excited gauge-flux excitations. Magnetization and ESR measurements establish pronounced easy-plane magnetic anisotropy, with $g_\perp/g_\parallel \approx 6.9$. The anomaly near $530$ mK exhibits a strongly anisotropic response to magnetic field. For $H\perp c$, it remains visible up to approximately $2$ T and continuously evolves toward a field-induced ordered phase above approximately $2.5$ T, followed by a sequence of field-induced phases that includes a $1/3$ magnetization plateau between approximately $5$ and $8$ T and full polarization near $17$ T. In contrast, for $H\parallel c$, the anomaly weakens and is suppressed near $3$ T, consistent with the recently reported confinement--deconfinement transition from an ordered state to a field-induced QSL.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中明确使用“DC magnetization, AC susceptibility, electron spin resonance (ESR), and specific heat measurements”以及“Single-crystal X-ray diffraction confirms”，属于以实验测量为主的综合研究。；研究对象：三角晶格量子自旋液体候选材料 TlYbS$_2$ 单晶，属于 Yb 基 delafossite 家族 $A$Yb$X_2$。研究关注其低温热力学性质、磁各向异性、磁场诱导的相变及可能存在的量子自旋液体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TlYbS$_2$ 在零场下约 530 mK 出现弱热力学异常，可能对应类似 KYbSe$_2$ 的弱有序态；低于 300 mK 时零场磁比热遵循 $C_{\rm m}\propto T^{1.8}$，接近二次温度依赖，不同于同族化合物 TlYbSe$_2$ 的线性温度依赖。材料表现出强易面磁各向异性（$g_\perp/g_\parallel \approx 6.9$），且 530 mK 异常对磁场方向高度敏感：$H\perp c$ 时该异常可持续至约 2 T 并演化为场诱导有序相，随后出现包括约 5–8 T 的 1/3 磁化平台和约 17 T 完全极化在内的系列场诱导相；$H\parallel c$ 时异常减弱并在约 3 T 附近被抑制，与近期报道的从有序态到场诱导 QSL 的禁闭–去禁闭转变一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TlYbS$_2$ 在零场下约 530 mK 出现弱热力学异常，可能对应类似 KYbSe$_2$ 的弱有序态；低于 300 mK 时零场磁比热遵循 $C_{\rm m}\propto T^{1.8}$，接近二次温度依赖，不同于同族化合物 TlYbSe$_2$ 的线性温度依赖。材料表现出强易面磁各向异性（$g_\perp/g_\parallel \approx 6.9$），且 530 mK 异常对磁场方向高度敏感：$H\perp c$ 时该异常可持续至约 2 T 并演化为场诱导有序相，随后出现包括约 5–8 T 的 1/3 磁化平台和约 17 T 完全极化在内的系列场诱导相；$H\parallel c$ 时异常减弱并在约 3 T 附近被抑制，与近期报道的从有序态到场诱导 QSL 的禁闭–去禁闭转变一致。；创新点：首次对 TlYbS$_2$ 单晶进行从室温到毫开尔文温区的综合低温热力学与磁学表征，揭示了其弱有序异常、接近 $T^{1.8}$ 的磁比热行为、强易面各向异性以及丰富的场诱导相图；并指出其与同族 TlYbSe$_2$ 在低温比热行为上的差异，以及与 KYbSe$_2$ 在弱有序态上的相似性。
papers.method_zh: 单晶 X 射线衍射确认晶体结构；直流磁化率、交流磁化率、电子自旋共振（ESR）和比热测量，温度范围从室温延伸至毫开尔文温区；并在不同磁场方向和强度下测量磁场响应。

papers.title: Sparse data limit what a mechanistic corrosion model can predict
papers.abstract: Mechanistic corrosion models are routinely fitted with four to six parameters to a few measurements and extrapolated across service lifetimes, yet whether the data determine them is rarely tested. We identify a reduced point defect model for the duplex oxide on Nb-stabilized AISI 347 in simulated boiling-water-reactor water from published depth profiles at three exposure times, by differentiable inversion graded against a closed-form reference. Profile likelihood, a 1000-member bootstrap and a prior-relaxation test agree that one of the five parameters is undetermined and a second only weakly so, and that 95% of the fit statistic rests on three chromium points. The kinetics track an empirical power law over the calibration window but diverge from it by a factor of 3.5 to 6.3 at ten years, outside the propagated uncertainty band. That separation, not the thickness it brackets, is what these data determine; an exposure near 3000 hours would resolve it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（混合了模型反演与统计推断）。关键依据：摘要中无任何实验测量描述，而是“从已发表的深度剖面中识别约化点缺陷模型”“可微反演”“剖面似然、bootstrap、先验松弛检验”等建模与统计方法关键词。；研究对象：Nb 稳定的 AISI 347 不锈钢在模拟沸水堆水环境中形成的双相（duplex）氧化膜，以及其中的点缺陷腐蚀动力学（氧化膜生长/厚度随暴露时间的演化）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在五参数约化点缺陷模型中，有一个参数无法由数据确定、另一个仅弱确定，且拟合统计量的 95% 仅由三个铬浓度数据点支撑；模型动力学在标定窗口内符合经验幂律，但在十年处偏离幂律 3.5–6.3 倍，超出传播不确定度带——数据真正确定的是这一偏离，而非其所夹的厚度范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在五参数约化点缺陷模型中，有一个参数无法由数据确定、另一个仅弱确定，且拟合统计量的 95% 仅由三个铬浓度数据点支撑；模型动力学在标定窗口内符合经验幂律，但在十年处偏离幂律 3.5–6.3 倍，超出传播不确定度带——数据真正确定的是这一偏离，而非其所夹的厚度范围。；创新点：不是提出新腐蚀机理，而是对“稀疏数据能否确定机理模型参数”这一常被忽略的问题做可辨识性检验，指出常规拟合-外推的不可靠性，并给出可分辨该偏离的暴露时间（约 3000 小时）。
papers.method_zh: 从三个暴露时间的已发表深度剖面出发，用可微反演（以闭式参考解为标尺进行分级）识别约化点缺陷模型；用剖面似然、1000 成员 bootstrap 和先验松弛检验评估参数可辨识性；并将模型动力学与经验幂律外推比较。

papers.title: High-Temperature ferromagnetism from site-selective filling in (Fe,Ni)$_{6-δ}$GeTe$_2$
papers.abstract: The discovery of high-temperature ferromagnetism in the metallic van der Waals (vdW) system Fe$_N$GeTe$_2$ has brought two-dimensional (2D) magnets into technologically relevant temperature scales. Specifically at N = 5, dilution of magnetic moments by nickel substitution counterintuitively achieves a record high Curie temperature of 478~K. Unraveling the origin of this nickel-substitution-induced enhancement is complicated by the compound's structural complexity, coexistent itinerant and local magnetic contributions, and mesoscopic compositional domains. Through coordinated structural and electronic characterization, we identify that the high-T$_C$ magnetic phase arises from a strain-stabilized Fe$_6$GeTe$_2$ nano-precipitate. Combining first-principles calculations and spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), we uncover a site-specific electronic landscape in which interior iron atoms primarily host localized moments while the outer iron atoms neighboring the tellurium layers produce spin-polarized itinerant carriers that cross the vdW gap. The large energy cost associated with homogeneous nickel substitution is found to favor the spontaneous precipitation of the crystallographically and electronically ``clean'' high-T$_C$ phase. Finally, we compare metal-rich vdW magnets with binary magnetic alloys, and discuss the unifying roles of nano-precipitates in stabilizing otherwise unattainable bulk phases. Our work provides mechanistic insights into the record-high T$_C$ ferromagnetism in (Fe,Ni)$_{5+δ}$GeTe$_2$, establishing a rigorous foundation for the atomic engineering of vdW magnetic metals informed by direct electronic signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据的关键词：coordinated structural and electronic characterization、first-principles calculations、spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES)。；研究对象：金属性范德瓦尔斯磁性体系 Fe_NGeTe_2（具体为 (Fe,Ni)_{5+δ}GeTe_2，即 Ni 替代的 Fe_5GeTe_2），关注其中 Ni 替代诱导的高温铁磁性（T_C 高达 478 K）的起源，以及应变稳定的 Fe_6GeTe_2 纳米析出相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高温铁磁相来源于应变稳定的 Fe_6GeTe_2 纳米析出相，而非均匀的 Ni 替代；该相具有位点选择性的电子结构——内部 Fe 原子主要承载局域磁矩，而邻近 Te 层的外部 Fe 原子产生自旋极化的巡游载流子并跨越范德瓦尔斯间隙。均匀 Ni 替代的高能量代价驱动了这种“干净”高温相的自发析出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高温铁磁相来源于应变稳定的 Fe_6GeTe_2 纳米析出相，而非均匀的 Ni 替代；该相具有位点选择性的电子结构——内部 Fe 原子主要承载局域磁矩，而邻近 Te 层的外部 Fe 原子产生自旋极化的巡游载流子并跨越范德瓦尔斯间隙。均匀 Ni 替代的高能量代价驱动了这种“干净”高温相的自发析出。；创新点：揭示了 Ni 替代增强 T_C 的微观机制并非源于均匀替代本身，而是由应变稳定的 Fe_6GeTe_2 纳米析出相所致；提出了位点特异性电子结构图像（内部 Fe 局域磁矩 vs. 外部 Fe 巡游自旋极化载流子跨越 vdW 间隙）；并讨论了纳米析出相在稳定常规不可达块体相中的统一作用，为 vdW 磁性金属的原子级工程提供了直接电子学依据。
papers.method_zh: 结构与电子表征（coordinated structural and electronic characterization）、第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）、自旋分辨及角分辨光电子能谱（spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, ARPES）；并将金属富集的 vdW 磁体与二元磁性合金进行对比讨论。

papers.title: High-fidelity k$\cdot$p representations of first-principles electronic band structures through covariant renormalization
papers.abstract: The k$\cdot$p method can be applied directly to first-principles energies and momentum matrix elements, but the resulting models converge slowly with the number of bands and are inexact wherever the underlying Hamiltonian is nonlocal. We show that both limitations can be largely removed by renormalizing the eigenvalue spectra of the Hermitian momentum matrices. These spectra are gauge invariant, and are identical for symmetry-related Cartesian components, hence scaling the recurring magnitudes provides a modest set of parameters that preserves degeneracies and crystal symmetry without needing to construct a symmetry-adapted basis. We choose to renormalize the models against reference eigenvalues and band velocities on rays out of a high-symmetry point. For GaP, a 15-band model can reproduce the band structure in the near-gap reference regions within a few meV. For zincblende and wurtzite AlN, similar accuracy requires 30- or 66-band models, which in the case of zincblende is traced to the strong warping in the [110] direction. The scheme readily generalizes to rocksalt PbTe, which includes spin-orbit coupling, and has L-centered valence and conduction band extrema. Further, we demonstrate, for GaP, how compact four-band Hamiltonians can be obtained by downfolding within the same renormalization scheme. Moreover, by changing the fitting regime to encompass the entire Brillouin zone, the scheme can be used to generate full-zone models that reproduce the density of states. The practical utility is illustrated with a 59-band k.p model for GaP, which can be evaluated on meshes far denser than the reference calculation, that in turn can be used both to resolve fine features in the density of states and to compute the hole conductivity at low temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles electronic band structures、k·p method、renormalization、band velocities、density of states、hole conductivity 等，均为计算方法与模型构建相关术语，摘要中未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：多种半导体材料的电子能带结构，具体包括 GaP、闪锌矿和纤锌矿结构的 AlN、岩盐矿结构的 PbTe。研究的是如何用 k·p 方法高保真地重现第一性原理能带结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对厄米动量矩阵的本征值谱进行重整化（covariant renormalization），可以大幅消除传统 k·p 方法收敛慢和非局域哈密顿量下不精确的两个局限。重整化后的模型能用较少的能带数（如 GaP 用 15 带）在近带隙参考区域以几 meV 精度重现能带结构；闪锌矿 AlN 因 [110] 方向强翘曲需要 30 带，纤锌矿 AlN 需要 66 带。该方案可推广到含自旋轨道耦合的 PbTe，并可通过下折叠获得紧凑的四带哈密顿量，也可通过改变拟合区域生成全布里渊区模型以重现态密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对厄米动量矩阵的本征值谱进行重整化（covariant renormalization），可以大幅消除传统 k·p 方法收敛慢和非局域哈密顿量下不精确的两个局限。重整化后的模型能用较少的能带数（如 GaP 用 15 带）在近带隙参考区域以几 meV 精度重现能带结构；闪锌矿 AlN 因 [110] 方向强翘曲需要 30 带，纤锌矿 AlN 需要 66 带。该方案可推广到含自旋轨道耦合的 PbTe，并可通过下折叠获得紧凑的四带哈密顿量，也可通过改变拟合区域生成全布里渊区模型以重现态密度。；创新点：提出了一种协变重整化方案来改进 k·p 模型对第一性原理能带的拟合精度和收敛性，无需构造对称适配基即可保持简并和晶体对称性；该方案具有通用性，可推广到不同晶体结构（闪锌矿、纤锌矿、岩盐矿）和含自旋轨道耦合的体系，并支持 downfolding 和全布里渊区拟合两种模式。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算得到的能量和动量矩阵元，采用 k·p 方法，并对厄米动量矩阵的本征值谱进行重整化（利用其规范不变性和对称性相关笛卡尔分量的等同性），以高对称点出发的射线上的参考本征值和能带速度为拟合目标。还使用了 downfolding 技术获得紧凑模型，并在更密网格上评估模型以计算态密度和低温空穴电导率。

papers.title: Sub-cycle doublon-holon dynamics in one-dimensional Mott insulators revealed by two-color high-harmonic spectroscopy
papers.abstract: Solid-state high-harmonic spectroscopy is becoming an emerging tool for probing nonequilibrium many-body dynamics. Yet, direct measurements of strongly driven, sub-optical-cycle dynamics in correlated materials during high-harmonic emission remain largely unexplored. Here, we measure high-harmonic emission chirp in a prototypical one-dimensional Mott insulator, which encodes strongly driven doublon-holon dynamics at sub-optical-cycle timescales. We observe a positive chirp for above band gap harmonics, indicating that high harmonics are dominated by doublon-holon recombinations. We further show a harmonic order-dependent dephasing, which can be understood through different doublon-holon excursion distances associated with each harmonic. These results reveal coherent doublon-holon dynamics and their ultrafast dephasing in Mott insulators, which is relevant to other nonequilibrium light-induced phenomena, such as Floquet engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中使用“measure”“observe”“show”等表述，表明工作以实验测量为主，理论理解作为辅助解释。；研究对象：一维莫特绝缘体（one-dimensional Mott insulator）中的双占位-空位（doublon-holon）动力学，以及高次谐波发射过程中的亚光周期动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原型一维莫特绝缘体中测量到高次谐波发射的啁啾，发现带隙以上谐波呈现正啁啾，表明高次谐波主要由双占位-空位复合主导；同时观察到与谐波阶数相关的退相位，可归因于不同谐波对应的双占位-空位 excursion 距离不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原型一维莫特绝缘体中测量到高次谐波发射的啁啾，发现带隙以上谐波呈现正啁啾，表明高次谐波主要由双占位-空位复合主导；同时观察到与谐波阶数相关的退相位，可归因于不同谐波对应的双占位-空位 excursion 距离不同。；创新点：首次直接测量了关联材料在高次谐波发射过程中强驱动的亚光周期动力学，特别是通过高次谐波啁啾揭示了莫特绝缘体中相干双占位-空位动力学及其超快退相位，而此前这类强驱动亚光周期动力学在关联材料中基本未被直接测量。
papers.method_zh: 固态高次谐波光谱学（solid-state high-harmonic spectroscopy），具体为双色高次谐波光谱（two-color high-harmonic spectroscopy），通过测量高次谐波发射的啁啾来探测亚光周期时间尺度的动力学。

papers.title: Piezomagnetism in a model cubic noncollinear altermagnet
papers.abstract: Altermagnets constitute a distinct class of magnetic materials that combine compensated magnetic order with spin-polarized electronic bands, hence carrying characteristics of both antiferromagnets and ferromagnets. Piezomagnetism - the linear relationship between lattice strain and a net magnetic moment - has emerged as smoking-gun evidence of altermagnetism that distinguishes it from antiferromagnetism. Here, we uncover a large piezomagnetic response in MnTe2, a cubic altermagnet with a noncollinear spin arrangement and weak spin-orbit coupling. We combine dilatometry with nuclear magnetic resonance, a bulk local probe, to observe signatures of both direct and inverse piezomagnetism consistent with symmetry considerations and first-principles calculations. The dilatometry measurements reveal a shear deformation proportional to an applied magnetic field, while magnetic resonance detects a ferromagnetic moment induced by shear strain. The respective results for the piezomagnetic coupling strength are in good agreement, and they are captured by first-principles results. These findings for simple binary MnTe2 position this material as a model altermagnet, demonstrate the utility of nuclear magnetic resonance in investigations of piezomagnetism, and open new avenues for multimodal strain and magnetic-field control in spintronic and memory applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据关键词：dilatometry（膨胀测量）、nuclear magnetic resonance（核磁共振）等实验手段，以及 first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算），两者结合验证结果。；研究对象：立方非共线交替磁体 MnTe₂（一种具有非共线自旋排列和弱自旋轨道耦合的立方交替磁体），研究其中的压磁效应（piezomagnetism），即晶格应变与净磁矩之间的线性关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 MnTe₂ 中发现了大的压磁响应：膨胀测量观察到与外加磁场成正比的剪切形变（正压磁效应），核磁共振检测到由剪切应变诱导的铁磁矩（逆压磁效应），两者给出的压磁耦合强度结果一致，且与第一性原理计算吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 MnTe₂ 中发现了大的压磁响应：膨胀测量观察到与外加磁场成正比的剪切形变（正压磁效应），核磁共振检测到由剪切应变诱导的铁磁矩（逆压磁效应），两者给出的压磁耦合强度结果一致，且与第一性原理计算吻合。；创新点：在简单的二元化合物 MnTe₂ 中揭示了大的压磁响应，将其定位为一种模型交替磁体；展示了核磁共振在研究压磁效应中的实用性；为自旋电子学和存储应用中多模式应变与磁场调控开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上结合了膨胀测量法（dilatometry）与核磁共振（NMR，作为体相局域探针）；理论上采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）并与对称性分析进行对照。

papers.title: Block entropy area based non-local fermionic mode optimization with gradient disentanglers
papers.abstract: We introduce a systematic block entropy area based mode optimization algorithm for many-body quantum states of interacting fermions represented by matrix product states. From the gradient of a global cost function, the block entropy area, a long-ranged, non-interacting effective disentangler Hamiltonian is formed. We then simulate the time-dependent Schrödinger equation driven by the disentangler Hamiltonian by employing the time-dependent variational principle based on projector splitting, and minimize the cost function. The combination of the density matrix renormalization group with this gradient-based entanglement minimization forms an efficient low-rank iterative ground-state algorithm that also provides an optimized single-particle basis for matrix product state representation. We demonstrate the method on two-dimensional lattice models of interacting fermions and the Fe${_4}$S${_4}$ cluster, and show its robustness and superiority over earlier protocols using nearest-neighbor mode rotations and reorderings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键依据：提出算法、构建有效哈密顿量、模拟含时薛定谔方程、结合 DMRG 进行基态计算，并在晶格模型和团簇上做数值演示，无实验测量。；研究对象：相互作用费米子的多体量子态，具体包括二维晶格模型中的相互作用费米子体系，以及 Fe₄S₄ 团簇。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于块熵面积（block entropy area）的费米子模式优化算法，通过梯度构造长程非相互作用的有效解纠缠哈密顿量并驱动含时演化来最小化代价函数，从而获得优化的单粒子基；该方法与 DMRG 结合形成高效低秩迭代基态算法，在二维相互作用费米子晶格模型和 Fe₄S₄ 团簇上表现出优于此前基于最近邻模式旋转与重排方案的鲁棒性和性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于块熵面积（block entropy area）的费米子模式优化算法，通过梯度构造长程非相互作用的有效解纠缠哈密顿量并驱动含时演化来最小化代价函数，从而获得优化的单粒子基；该方法与 DMRG 结合形成高效低秩迭代基态算法，在二维相互作用费米子晶格模型和 Fe₄S₄ 团簇上表现出优于此前基于最近邻模式旋转与重排方案的鲁棒性和性能。；创新点：相对于此前使用最近邻模式旋转和重排的方案，本文提出基于块熵面积梯度的长程非相互作用解纠缠哈密顿量，并通过 TDVP（投影分裂）驱动其含时演化来实现模式优化，同时为 MPS 表示提供优化的单粒子基，在二维晶格模型和 Fe₄S₄ 团簇上展现出更好的鲁棒性与优越性。
papers.method_zh: 以矩阵乘积态（MPS）表示多体量子态；从全局代价函数（块熵面积）的梯度出发构造长程非相互作用有效解纠缠哈密顿量；用基于投影分裂（projector splitting）的含时变分原理（TDVP）模拟该哈密顿量驱动的含时薛定谔方程以最小化代价函数；与密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）结合形成低秩迭代基态算法；在二维相互作用费米子晶格模型和 Fe₄S₄ 团簇上做数值验证。

papers.title: Interacting Tomonaga-Lüttinger liquid with impurity for interaction constant $K = 1/2$: Thermopower investigation, entropy variation and heat capacity densities associated with thermoelectric particle transport
papers.abstract: We investigate thermoelectric and thermodynamic properties of a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid with interaction parameter $K=1/2$ in the presence of a localized impurity. Using bosonization and refermionization, we derive an exact expression for the thermopower in the nonlinear regime and obtain the corresponding Seebeck coefficient in linear response. At low temperature, the Seebeck coefficient follows a Mott-like relation governed by the energy dependence of the transmission coefficient and is found to be closely related to the entropy per particle. This connection allows us to derive using Kelvin formula the thermopower contribution to the entropy density variation and the charge-carriers contribution to the heat capacity density. Both quantities exhibit Mott-like behavior in the low-temperature regime. We apply our results to a fractional quantum Hall quantum point contact and to a one-channel quantum conductor coupled to an Ohmic environment. Our results demonstrate the close connection between thermoelectric transport and thermodynamic properties in interacting one-dimensional quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Using bosonization and refermionization, derive an exact expression, derive using Kelvin formula——摘要中未出现任何实验测量或数值模拟方法的描述，全部为解析理论推导。；研究对象：含局域杂质的 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体（相互作用参数 K=1/2）中的热电与热力学性质，具体涉及热电势（thermopower）、Seebeck 系数、熵变和热容密度。摘要还将结果应用于分数量子霍尔量子点接触（fractional quantum Hall quantum point contact）和耦合至欧姆环境的一通道量子导体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温下，Seebeck 系数遵循由透射系数能量依赖性决定的 Mott 型关系，且与每粒子熵密切相关；通过 Kelvin 公式，热电势对熵密度变化的贡献和载流子对热容密度的贡献在低温区均表现出 Mott 型行为。结果表明相互作用一维量子系统中热电输运与热力学性质之间存在紧密联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温下，Seebeck 系数遵循由透射系数能量依赖性决定的 Mott 型关系，且与每粒子熵密切相关；通过 Kelvin 公式，热电势对熵密度变化的贡献和载流子对热容密度的贡献在低温区均表现出 Mott 型行为。结果表明相互作用一维量子系统中热电输运与热力学性质之间存在紧密联系。；创新点：摘要中明确指出在 K=1/2 且含局域杂质的 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体中，利用玻色化/再费米化获得了非线性区域热电势的精确表达式，并揭示了低温下 Seebeck 系数与每粒子熵之间的密切联系，进而通过 Kelvin 公式导出了热电势对熵密度变化和热容密度的贡献，且两者均呈现 Mott 型行为。相对于已有研究的具体新意程度，摘要未明确说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用玻色化（bosonization）和再费米化（refermionization）技术，在非线性区域推导热电势的精确表达式，并在线性响应下获得 Seebeck 系数；利用 Kelvin 公式从熵的角度推导热电势对熵密度变化和热容密度的贡献。

papers.title: Learning Quantum Matter through Attention in Complex Space
papers.abstract: Magnetic many-electron wavefunctions require amplitude and phase to be optimized together. Whether a complex internal representation improves this variational search is a practical question for neural wavefunction design. We introduce Complex Psiformer for interacting electrons in a magnetic moiré continuum, combining complex hidden features and Hermitian-magnitude attention with magnetic boundary conditions and fermionic antisymmetry. After the same number of optimization steps, Complex Psiformer reaches lower energies than Real Psiformer in two finite supercells. Both Psiformers also improve on their respective neural Hartree-Fock references. Across five training seeds in the 25-cell system, the mean Complex advantage is 1.458 meV per electron, with a smaller observed spread. A separately trained two-electron Complex state has a smaller energy gap to a finite configuration interaction reference than its Real counterpart. In the Complex states, flux scans show nonmonotonic density correlations and weaker honeycomb mean-density modulation at higher flux, while connected fluctuations persist. Gauge invariant current maps provide a qualitative comparison of local circulation in the optimized states. These benchmarks support the combined architecture as a variational ansatz for studying energies and charge arrangements in finite magnetic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：论文使用神经网络波函数（Complex Psiformer、Real Psiformer）进行变分优化，与神经 Hartree-Fock 参考、有限组态相互作用参考进行基准比较，属于数值计算/方法开发类工作。；研究对象：磁性莫尔连续体中的相互作用电子体系（interacting electrons in a magnetic moiré continuum），具体为有限超胞（两个有限超胞、25-cell 系统、双电子体系）中的多电子波函数，关注能量、密度关联、电流分布等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相同优化步数下，Complex Psiformer 在两个有限超胞中达到比 Real Psiformer 更低的能量；在 25-cell 系统中跨五个训练种子，Complex 平均优势为每电子 1.458 meV，且观测到的离散度更小；单独训练的双电子 Complex 态与有限组态相互作用参考之间的能隙小于对应的 Real 态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相同优化步数下，Complex Psiformer 在两个有限超胞中达到比 Real Psiformer 更低的能量；在 25-cell 系统中跨五个训练种子，Complex 平均优势为每电子 1.458 meV，且观测到的离散度更小；单独训练的双电子 Complex 态与有限组态相互作用参考之间的能隙小于对应的 Real 态。；创新点：提出了 Complex Psiformer 这一复数内部表示的注意力神经网络波函数架构，将复数隐藏特征与 Hermitian-magnitude 注意力结合，并配合磁边界条件和费米子反对称性，用于磁性莫尔连续体中的有限磁系统；通过基准测试表明复数表示在变分搜索中优于实数表示，并提供了能量、密度关联与局域环流的分析。
papers.method_zh: 采用神经网络变分蒙特卡洛类方法，具体为 Complex Psiformer 架构：结合复数隐藏特征、Hermitian-magnitude 注意力机制，并施加磁边界条件与费米子反对称性；与 Real Psiformer、神经 Hartree-Fock 参考以及有限组态相互作用参考进行对比；通过通量扫描（flux scans）分析密度关联，并绘制规范不变电流图（gauge invariant current maps）。

papers.title: Condensation temperature and magnetic phases of trapped coherently coupled Bose gases
papers.abstract: We investigate condensation and finite-temperature magnetic phase transitions in a coherently (Rabi) coupled Bose gas confined in a three-dimensional harmonic trap. For the noninteracting system, we derive analytical expressions for the critical temperature and condensate fraction using a semiclassical description of the single-particle spectrum and density of states. At fixed particle number, coherent coupling enhances the critical temperature relative to the uncoupled system, and this enhancement decreases with increasing particle number $N$. The finite-size correction, in contrast, lowers the transition temperature, with its effect diminishing for larger $N$. We then incorporate repulsive interactions within the Hartree--Fock--Bogoliubov--Popov framework to investigate the finite-temperature phase diagram in the temperature--Rabi coupling plane. The system undergoes successive transitions from a ferromagnetic to a paramagnetic condensate and, at higher temperature, to a thermal gas. The transition boundaries obtained from the vanishing of the condensate fraction show excellent agreement with the analytical Hartree-Fock predictions. We find that the interactions substantially suppress the variation in the condensation temperature with an increase in the coherent coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：derive analytical expressions、semiclassical description、Hartree–Fock–Bogoliubov–Popov framework、analytical Hartree-Fock predictions，摘要中未出现实验测量或数值模拟方法的描述。；研究对象：三维谐振子势阱中相干（Rabi）耦合的玻色气体，研究其凝聚温度以及有限温度下的磁性相变（铁磁凝聚体→顺磁凝聚体→热气体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于无相互作用体系，相干耦合会提高临界温度（相对于无耦合体系），该增强效应随粒子数 N 增大而减弱，而有限尺寸修正则降低转变温度且其影响随 N 增大而减小；引入排斥相互作用后，体系随温度升高经历铁磁凝聚体→顺磁凝聚体→热气体的连续相变，且相互作用会显著抑制凝聚温度随相干耦合的变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于无相互作用体系，相干耦合会提高临界温度（相对于无耦合体系），该增强效应随粒子数 N 增大而减弱，而有限尺寸修正则降低转变温度且其影响随 N 增大而减小；引入排斥相互作用后，体系随温度升高经历铁磁凝聚体→顺磁凝聚体→热气体的连续相变，且相互作用会显著抑制凝聚温度随相干耦合的变化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 无相互作用情形下，采用单粒子谱与态密度的半经典描述推导临界温度和凝聚体分数的解析表达式；有相互作用情形下，在 Hartree–Fock–Bogoliubov–Popov 框架内处理排斥相互作用，计算温度–Rabi 耦合平面内的有限温度相图，并通过凝聚体分数消失确定相变边界，与解析 Hartree-Fock 预测进行对比。

papers.title: Device Engineering and Performance Optimization of Cu2NiGeS4 Thin-Film Solar Cells with In2S3/MoTe2 Charge-Selective Layers: A Computational Study
papers.abstract: The pursuit of efficient and sustainable thin-film photovoltaics increasingly demands absorber materials that combine strong optical absorption with earth-abundant and environmentally benign constituents. Cu2NiGeS4 (CNGS) has emerged as a promising quaternary chalcogenide absorber owing to its favorable optoelectronic properties and high absorption coefficient, yet its photovoltaic potential remains comparatively underexplored, particularly in conjunction with optimized charge-selective layers. Here, we introduce and comprehensively investigate an CNGS-based solar-cell architecture using SCAPS-1D, with In2S3 and MoTe2 serving as the electron and hole-transport layers respectively. The analysis of energy-band profiles, electric fields, carrier distributions, and generation-recombination characteristics reveals the mechanisms governing carrier separation and extraction across the heterojunctions. Systematic optimization of layer thickness, doping density, bulk and interface defect densities, recombination coefficients, parasitic resistances, temperature, and illumination intensity identifies the key factors limiting device performance. The optimized device is predicted to achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 28.44% with a open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.984 V, short-circuit current density (JSC) of 34.39 mA/cm2, and fill factor (FF) of 84.04%, under AM1.5G illumination at 300 K. This simulated efficiency exceeds the previously reported 6.25-21.17% range for CNGS-based solar cells considered in this study. The findings establish In2S3/CNGS/MoTe2 as a promising platform for next-generation thin-film photovoltaics and provide physically grounded design guidelines for absorber optimization, interface engineering, and future experimental realization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：SCAPS-1D、computational study、simulated efficiency、predicted to achieve。；研究对象：Cu2NiGeS4（CNGS）四元硫属化合物薄膜太阳能电池，具体为 In2S3/CNGS/MoTe2 异质结架构，其中 In2S3 作为电子传输层、MoTe2 作为空穴传输层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统优化层厚度、掺杂浓度、体缺陷与界面缺陷密度、复合系数、寄生电阻、温度和光照强度等参数，预测优化后的器件在 AM1.5G、300 K 条件下可实现 28.44% 的光电转换效率，同时开路电压为 0.984 V、短路电流密度为 34.39 mA/cm²、填充因子为 84.04%，该模拟效率超过了本研究中所考虑的先前的 CNGS 基太阳能电池的 6.25–21.17% 范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统优化层厚度、掺杂浓度、体缺陷与界面缺陷密度、复合系数、寄生电阻、温度和光照强度等参数，预测优化后的器件在 AM1.5G、300 K 条件下可实现 28.44% 的光电转换效率，同时开路电压为 0.984 V、短路电流密度为 34.39 mA/cm²、填充因子为 84.04%，该模拟效率超过了本研究中所考虑的先前的 CNGS 基太阳能电池的 6.25–21.17% 范围。；创新点：首次提出并综合研究了以 In2S3 和 MoTe2 分别作为电子和空穴传输层的 CNGS 基太阳能电池架构，通过系统的器件工程优化将模拟效率提升至 28.44%，超越了此前 CNGS 基太阳能电池报道的 6.25–21.17% 范围，为 CNGS 吸收层的优化和界面工程提供了设计指导。
papers.method_zh: 使用 SCAPS-1D 软件进行数值模拟，分析了能带分布、电场、载流子分布以及产生-复合特性，并对层厚度、掺杂密度、体缺陷与界面缺陷密度、复合系数、寄生电阻、温度和光照强度进行了系统优化。

papers.title: Unraveling the Kagome Antiferromagnetic $3J$ Model and Its Materials: An Integrated Approach
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state and finite-temperature properties of the kagome antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model with three inequivalent couplings, dubbed the 3J model, which is designed for the candidate Dirac quantum spin liquid (QSL) material YCu$_3$(OH)$_6$Br$_2$[Br$_{1-x}$(OH)$_x$] (see, e.g., Zeng et al., 2024). Employing large-scale density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) supplemented by neural quantum states (NQS) simulations, we identify an intermediate QSL phase between two magnetically ordered phases. We also find that this QSL is separated from the kagome spin liquid ground state at the isotropic limit. To establish a direct comparison with experiments, we compute the specific heat of the model by means of advanced exponential (XTRG) and tangent-space (tanTRG) thermal tensor-network methods. In the magnetically ordered phase, the specific heat over temperature exhibits a shoulder at a temperature that is a fraction of the coupling strength $J_{hex}$, which disappears in the QSL phase. These universal behaviors are consistent with the experimentally observed specific heat in 3J materials for both ordered and QSL candidate samples. Our work thus connects microscopic models with experimentally measurable signatures, exemplifying an integrated approach (see Meng et al., 2026) to understanding QSL phenomena in frustrated quantum magnets, with 3J materials serving as a representative case and providing a foundation for future studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：large-scale DMRG、neural quantum states (NQS) simulations、exponential (XTRG) and tangent-space (tanTRG) thermal tensor-network methods。摘要中未提及任何实验测量手段，实验数据仅作为对比参考。；研究对象：具有三种不等价耦合的笼目（kagome）反铁磁海森堡模型（即 3J 模型），以及与之对应的候选 Dirac 量子自旋液体（QSL）材料 YCu₃(OH)₆Br₂[Br₁₋ₓ(OH)ₓ]。研究关注该模型的基态与有限温度性质，包括磁有序相、中间 QSL 相以及比热行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在两种磁有序相之间识别出一个中间 QSL 相，且该 QSL 相与各向同性极限下的笼目自旋液体基态是分离的。在磁有序相中，比热/温度曲线在约为耦合强度 J_hex 某一分数的温度处出现肩部特征，该肩部在 QSL 相中消失；这些普适行为与 3J 材料中有序样品和 QSL 候选样品的实验比热观测一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在两种磁有序相之间识别出一个中间 QSL 相，且该 QSL 相与各向同性极限下的笼目自旋液体基态是分离的。在磁有序相中，比热/温度曲线在约为耦合强度 J_hex 某一分数的温度处出现肩部特征，该肩部在 QSL 相中消失；这些普适行为与 3J 材料中有序样品和 QSL 候选样品的实验比热观测一致。；创新点：将微观 3J 模型与实验可测量的比热信号直接联系起来，揭示了磁有序相中比热肩部特征在 QSL 相中消失这一可作为判别依据的普适行为，并证明该 QSL 相与各向同性极限的笼目自旋液体不同；体现了理论模型与实验测量相结合的综合研究路径，为后续研究提供了基础。
papers.method_zh: 大规模密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG），辅以神经量子态（NQS）模拟来确定基态与相图；采用先进的指数张量重整化群（XTRG）和切空间张量重整化群（tanTRG）热张量网络方法计算模型的比热。

papers.title: Hilbert-space selected switch of helical edges in an artificial quantum Hall insulator
papers.abstract: Quantum Hall effects (QHE) host one-dimensional topologically-protected edge channels, which can serve as an essential ingredient in exotic quantum electronic systems. Yet the manual reconstruction of Landau-level topology, by electrostatic confinement or symmetry breaking, remains experimentally challenging. Here, we show that interfacial charge transfer in between CrOCl and large-angle twisted bilayer graphene offsets the two otherwise decoupled Dirac Landau-level ladders in each graphene layer, creating a new sequence of composite filling configurations. At charge neutrality, the composited $(+2,-2)$ state involves only the zeroth Landau levels and becomes fully insulating, with longitudinal resistance reaching the G$Ω$ regime. By contrast, higher composite zero-filling quantum Hall states, including $(+6,-6)$ and $(+10,-10)$, retain counter-propagating helical edge channels and exhibit pronounced non-local transport, reaching up to $50\%$ of the local response. We attribute such switching-behavior to the Landau-spinor Hilbert space -- as the filling is reduced from $(+6,-6)$ to $(+2,-2)$, the orthogonal $N=\pm1$ orbital components are removed, eliminating the edge-compatible channel and gapping both bulk and boundary transport. The interaction nature of the observed gapped sates was further examined both experimentally and theoretically. Our results suggest that charge transfer provides a direct route to engineer artificial quantum Hall insulators, opening possibilities for wavefunction-selective control of helical edge modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼含理论分析）。判断依据的关键词：摘要中出现“we show that...”“longitudinal resistance reaching the GΩ regime”“non-local transport, reaching up to 50% of the local response”“examined both experimentally and theoretically”，表明以实验观测为主，并辅以理论分析。；研究对象：CrOCl 与大角度扭转双层石墨烯（large-angle twisted bilayer graphene）构成的界面体系。具体研究的是界面电荷转移（interfacial charge transfer）对两层石墨烯中狄拉克朗道能级阶梯的调控，以及由此产生的复合填充量子霍尔态（如 (+2,-2)、(+6,-6)、(+10,-10)）及其螺旋边缘通道的输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面电荷转移将两层石墨烯原本解耦的狄拉克朗道能级阶梯错开，产生新的复合填充构型；在电荷中性处的复合 (+2,-2) 态仅涉及零级朗道能级，完全绝缘（纵向电阻达 GΩ 量级），而更高填充的复合零填充量子霍尔态（如 (+6,-6) 和 (+10,-10)）保留反向传播的螺旋边缘通道并表现出显著的非局域输运（可达局域响应的 50%）。作者将这种开关行为归因于朗道旋量希尔伯特空间：从 (+6,-6) 降到 (+2,-2) 时，正交的 N=±1 轨道分量被移除，消除了边缘兼容通道，使体和边界输运均被能隙化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面电荷转移将两层石墨烯原本解耦的狄拉克朗道能级阶梯错开，产生新的复合填充构型；在电荷中性处的复合 (+2,-2) 态仅涉及零级朗道能级，完全绝缘（纵向电阻达 GΩ 量级），而更高填充的复合零填充量子霍尔态（如 (+6,-6) 和 (+10,-10)）保留反向传播的螺旋边缘通道并表现出显著的非局域输运（可达局域响应的 50%）。作者将这种开关行为归因于朗道旋量希尔伯特空间：从 (+6,-6) 降到 (+2,-2) 时，正交的 N=±1 轨道分量被移除，消除了边缘兼容通道，使体和边界输运均被能隙化。；创新点：提出通过界面电荷转移来人工重构朗道能级拓扑，从而实现对螺旋边缘模式的“波函数选择性控制”（wavefunction-selective control of helical edge modes）；展示了希尔伯特空间选择性的边缘通道开关行为，为工程化人工量子霍尔绝缘体提供了直接途径。相对于以往通过静电限制或对称性破缺来重构朗道能级拓扑的方式，该工作提供了一种新的调控手段。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段（如具体测量装置、温度、磁场条件等）和具体的理论计算方法。摘要仅提到对观测到的能隙态进行了“experimentally and theoretically”的检验，但未给出具体技术细节。

papers.title: Interplay of Kekulé order, flat bands and electron-phonon coupling in graphene
papers.abstract: The Kekulé order in graphene is known to give rise to extended flat bands near the van Hove singularity (VHS) and enhanced electron-phonon coupling. However, the microscopic mechanism underlying the coexistence of these effects remains unclear. Here, it is shown that they jointly emerge as a consequence of the lattice distortion manifested through the differentiation of carbon bonds and associated electronic hoppings. In this picture, the conduction band around the $M$ point decreases almost linearly in width with increasing Kekulé order, while the VHS and dimensionless electron-phonon coupling exhibit approximately quadratic upward responses. The resulting enhancement of the electron-phonon coupling is governed predominantly by the increasing density of states at the VHS, with the effective deformation potential remaining weakly affected by the distortion. As such, the obtained results are consistent with previous related theoretical and experimental studies, while also pointing toward a potential shallowing of the conduction band under the characteristic $1/4$ filling and an increasing relevance of nonadiabatic electron-phonon effects beyond the conventional Migdal approximation. Altogether, these findings highlight the potential of controlled Kekulé ordering for engineering emergent correlated quantum phases in graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要以“it is shown that...”“In this picture...”“the obtained results are consistent with previous related theoretical and experimental studies”等理论推导与模型分析表述为主，未提及具体实验测量手段。；研究对象：石墨烯中的 Kekulé 序（Kekulé order），以及其与平带（flat bands）、电子-声子耦合（electron-phonon coupling）之间的相互关系。具体涉及范霍夫奇点（VHS）附近的扩展平带和增强的电子-声子耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Kekulé 序、平带和增强的电子-声子耦合三者共同起源于晶格畸变（即碳键差异化及关联的电子跃迁变化）；随着 Kekulé 序增强，M 点附近导带宽度近似线性减小，而 VHS 和无量纲电子-声子耦合近似二次方上升，其中电子-声子耦合的增强主要由 VHS 处态密度增加主导，有效形变势受畸变影响较弱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Kekulé 序、平带和增强的电子-声子耦合三者共同起源于晶格畸变（即碳键差异化及关联的电子跃迁变化）；随着 Kekulé 序增强，M 点附近导带宽度近似线性减小，而 VHS 和无量纲电子-声子耦合近似二次方上升，其中电子-声子耦合的增强主要由 VHS 处态密度增加主导，有效形变势受畸变影响较弱。；创新点：揭示了 Kekulé 序、平带与电子-声子耦合三者共存背后的统一微观机制——即均由晶格畸变（碳键差异化及电子跃迁变化）联合导致；并指出在特征 1/4 填充下导带可能变浅，以及超出传统 Migdal 近似的非绝热电子-声子效应可能变得更加重要。
papers.method_zh: 基于晶格畸变导致的碳键差异化和关联电子跃迁变化的微观理论模型/机制分析。摘要未明确说明具体采用了何种计算方法或理论框架（如 DFT、紧束缚模型等）。

papers.title: Impact waves in soft bilayer tissues
papers.abstract: In this study, we investigate impact-wave propagation in a pre-stressed compressible hyperelastic bilayer resting on a frictionless rigid substrate within the framework of nonlinear elasticity. Semi-analytical solutions for the transient displacement fields induced by localized surface impulses are derived using the Fourier-Laplace transform, and their long-time asymptotic behavior is obtained through the method of stationary phase. Finite element simulations are further performed to validate the theoretical predictions. The results establish a direct connection between characteristic features of the transient displacement fields and the group velocities of the guided-wave modes, revealing how dispersive propagation and modal contributions shape the observed waveforms. Three representative bilayer models corresponding to human articular cartilage, gingiva, and skin are then considered to examine the effects of variations in layer stiffness and thickness. The results show that structural and material variations can substantially modify the spatial distribution, arrival positions, and characteristic velocities of impact waves. In particular, higher-order modes can make significant contributions to the displacement response in certain parameter regimes, such that the dominant features of the wavefield cannot always be characterized by the fundamental mode alone. These findings demonstrate that transient-wave measurements contain mechanical information beyond that captured by a single characteristic surface-wave velocity and provide a theoretical basis for interpreting transient wavefields in multilayered soft materials and for future non-invasive mechanical characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算混合型文章。判断依据关键词：非线性弹性框架下的半解析解推导（Fourier-Laplace 变换、驻相法）、有限元模拟验证，无实验测量。；研究对象：预应力可压缩超弹性双层软组织在无摩擦刚性基底上的冲击波传播现象。具体考察了三种代表性双层模型：人体关节软骨、牙龈和皮肤。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 瞬态位移场的特征与导波模式的群速度直接相关，色散传播和模态贡献共同决定了观测到的波形；结构参数和材料参数的变化可显著改变冲击波的空间分布、到达位置和特征速度，且在某些参数区间高阶模态对位移响应有重要贡献，波场的主导特征不能仅用基阶模态描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：瞬态位移场的特征与导波模式的群速度直接相关，色散传播和模态贡献共同决定了观测到的波形；结构参数和材料参数的变化可显著改变冲击波的空间分布、到达位置和特征速度，且在某些参数区间高阶模态对位移响应有重要贡献，波场的主导特征不能仅用基阶模态描述。；创新点：揭示了瞬态波测量所包含的力学信息超出单一特征表面波速所能捕获的内容，证明了高阶模态在特定参数区间的重要性，为多层软材料的瞬态波场解读和未来非侵入式力学表征提供了理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 在非线性弹性理论框架下，采用 Fourier-Laplace 变换推导局部表面脉冲引起的瞬态位移场的半解析解，通过驻相法获得长时渐近行为，并用有限元模拟对理论预测进行验证。

papers.title: Out-of-equilibrium relaxation dynamics of the superconducting order parameter in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: The application of a time-varying strain field drives a superconducting order parameter out of equilibrium. How the order parameter relaxes back to equilibrium depends both on the structure of the superconducting gap and on the nature of quasiparticle scattering. We report the discovery of an ultrasonic attenuation peak inside the superconducting state of the kagome superconductor CsV$_3$Sb$_5$. This peak is the natural consequence of the order parameter relaxation time matching the ultrasonic drive frequency near $T_{\rm c}$. From the measured frequency dependence of the peak, we extract a microscopic scattering time of $τ_N = 25$ ps. This timescale is two orders of magnitude longer than the elastic scattering time as determined by resistivity measurements, but is comparable to the inelastic scattering time determined by thermal transport. Within the conventional framework of order-parameter relaxation, this implies that elastic scattering is ineffective at relaxing the superconducting condensate, consistent with a sign-preserving $s$-wave state obeying Anderson's theorem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“We report the discovery of an ultrasonic attenuation peak”“From the measured frequency dependence of the peak, we extract...”等表述，说明工作以实验测量（超声衰减）为主。；研究对象：笼目超导体 CsV₃Sb₅ 中超导序参量的非平衡弛豫动力学。具体研究在时变应变场驱动下，超导序参量偏离平衡后如何弛豫回平衡态，以及超导能隙结构与准粒子散射性质对弛豫的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 CsV₃Sb₅ 超导态内观测到超声衰减峰，该峰源于序参量弛豫时间在 T_c 附近与超声驱动频率匹配。从峰的频率依赖关系提取出微观散射时间 τ_N = 25 ps，该时间比电阻率测得的弹性散射时间长两个数量级，但与热输运测得的非弹性散射时间相当；在传统序参量弛豫框架下，这表明弹性散射对弛豫超导凝聚体无效，与满足 Anderson 定理的保号 s 波态一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 CsV₃Sb₅ 超导态内观测到超声衰减峰，该峰源于序参量弛豫时间在 T_c 附近与超声驱动频率匹配。从峰的频率依赖关系提取出微观散射时间 τ_N = 25 ps，该时间比电阻率测得的弹性散射时间长两个数量级，但与热输运测得的非弹性散射时间相当；在传统序参量弛豫框架下，这表明弹性散射对弛豫超导凝聚体无效，与满足 Anderson 定理的保号 s 波态一致。；创新点：首次在笼目超导体 CsV₃Sb₅ 超导态内发现超声衰减峰，并通过其频率依赖关系提取出微观散射时间 τ_N = 25 ps；该时间尺度与弹性散射时间相差两个数量级而与非弹性散射时间相当，为判断该材料超导态为满足 Anderson 定理的保号 s 波态提供了新的动力学证据。
papers.method_zh: 超声衰减测量：施加时变应变场驱动超导序参量偏离平衡，测量超声衰减峰及其频率依赖关系，从中提取微观散射时间 τ_N。并将该时间尺度与电阻率测量得到的弹性散射时间、热输运得到的非弹性散射时间进行对比分析，在传统序参量弛豫理论框架下解释结果。

papers.title: Bridging steady-state and time-domain descriptions of molecular electron transport
papers.abstract: Electron transmission from an input electrode, through a molecular system, to an output electrode has been widely studied using the steady-state non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) method. Recently, the wave packet method, which provides access to the transient dynamics of electrons as well as internal molecular degrees of freedom, has been employed to investigate enantiospecific electron transport through chiral molecules. In this work, we derive the quantitative relation between the transmission of a finite-size wave packet and the energy-resolved NEGF transmission, showing that the former corresponds to a spectral average of the latter weighted by the wave packet energy distribution. Exploiting this correspondence, we construct non-Gaussian auxiliary wave packets whose spectral weight encodes the Landauer energy-window, allowing current-voltage characteristics to be obtained directly from time propagation. We further show that the correspondence extends to spin-resolved transport in a spin-phonon model of chirality-induced spin selectivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：论文以推导定量关系、构建辅助波包、扩展对应关系为核心，属于理论框架的建立与推导，摘要中未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：分子电子输运现象，具体包括电子从输入电极经分子体系到输出电极的透射过程，以及手性分子中的对映体特异性电子输运和手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）中的自旋分辨输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限尺寸波包的透射对应于能量分辨的 NEGF 透射按波包能量分布加权后的谱平均；利用这一对应关系，可以构造非高斯辅助波包，使其谱权重编码 Landauer 能量窗口，从而直接从时间传播中获得电流-电压特性；该对应关系还可推广到自旋-声子模型中的自旋分辨输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限尺寸波包的透射对应于能量分辨的 NEGF 透射按波包能量分布加权后的谱平均；利用这一对应关系，可以构造非高斯辅助波包，使其谱权重编码 Landauer 能量窗口，从而直接从时间传播中获得电流-电压特性；该对应关系还可推广到自旋-声子模型中的自旋分辨输运。；创新点：首次建立了有限尺寸波包透射与能量分辨 NEGF 透射之间的定量关系（谱平均对应），并据此提出用非高斯辅助波包编码 Landauer 能量窗口以从时间传播直接获取电流-电压特性的方案，同时将该对应关系推广至自旋分辨的手性诱导自旋选择性输运。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值方法结合。具体包括：稳态非平衡格林函数（NEGF）方法、波包方法（wave packet method）、时间传播（time propagation）、以及自旋-声子模型（spin-phonon model）用于描述手性诱导自旋选择性。

papers.title: Acoustic Wave-Function Imaging of Sublattice Physics in a Kagome Lattice
papers.abstract: The canonical kagome band structure hosts a Dirac cone, saddle-point van Hove singularities (vHS), and a flat band. Characteristically, these features exhibit distinct sublattice localization within the three-site basis of the kagome lattice. However, experimental proof of this sublattice character is challenging and requires direct access to both the real-space wave function and its associated momentum-space texture. Here, we implement an acoustic kagome lattice on the cm scale and measure the full excitation spectrum, thereby imaging the wave function at each lattice site, including both amplitude and phase. This enables investigation of the momentum-dependent sublattice texture across the complete band structure, particularly at the flat band and at the mixed- and pure-sublattice van Hove singularities. Our results are in excellent agreement with minimal tight-binding model calculations and constitutes the first direct experimental observation of the sublattice-resolved band structure in a kagome lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：implement an acoustic kagome lattice、measure the full excitation spectrum、imaging the wave function、first direct experimental observation。；研究对象：在厘米尺度上构建的声学 kagome 晶格（acoustic kagome lattice），研究其中的完整激发谱以及 kagome 能带结构（Dirac 锥、鞍点 van Hove 奇异性、平带）所对应的子晶格局域化物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验直接观测到了 kagome 晶格中子晶格分辨的能带结构，包括平带以及混合子晶格和纯子晶格的 van Hove 奇异性处的动量依赖子晶格织构，结果与最小紧束缚模型计算高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验直接观测到了 kagome 晶格中子晶格分辨的能带结构，包括平带以及混合子晶格和纯子晶格的 van Hove 奇异性处的动量依赖子晶格织构，结果与最小紧束缚模型计算高度一致。；创新点：首次直接实验观测到 kagome 晶格中子晶格分辨的能带结构，实现了对实空间波函数及其动量空间织构的直接访问，从而验证了 kagome 能带特征所对应的子晶格局域化。
papers.method_zh: 在厘米尺度上实现声学 kagome 晶格，测量完整激发谱，对每个晶格位点的波函数进行成像（同时获取振幅和相位），从而获得动量依赖的子晶格织构；并与最小紧束缚模型计算进行对比。

papers.title: Certified reduced-basis emulation of conformal field theories on the fuzzy sphere
papers.abstract: Fuzzy-sphere regularization gives numerical access to three-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs), but locating one requires testing for criticality across the parameter space of microscopic couplings. We reduce the search cost by about two orders of magnitude, combining an exact diagonalization based on states having definite total angular momentum with a certified reduced-basis emulator that reconstructs energies, observables and their derivatives continuously across the couplings from a handful of exact solutions per system size. The combination reproduces the published ground-state-energy analysis of the fuzzy-sphere Ising model and the published conformal data of a three-flavor fuzzy-sphere realization of the O(2) Wilson--Fisher CFT, including quantities defined by parameter derivatives. Applied to the O(2) model with no CFT input, the ground-state-energy criterion locates the critical coupling to within half a percent of a density matrix renormalization group value obtained on systems more than twice the size, and maps the critical line of the model across the coupling plane. Ground-state criteria locate the critical line robustly, but the point they select along it is weakly determined, and the computed dimensions come closest to the bootstrap elsewhere along the line.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：exact diagonalization、certified reduced-basis emulator、density matrix renormalization group、数值定位临界耦合与临界线。；研究对象：模糊球（fuzzy sphere）正则化下的三维共形场论（CFT），具体包括模糊球 Ising 模型、三味模糊球实现的 O(2) Wilson–Fisher CFT，以及无 CFT 输入的 O(2) 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将基于确定总角动量态的精确对角化与经过认证的约化基模拟器结合，可将寻找 CFT 的搜索成本降低约两个数量级；该方法复现了已发表的模糊球 Ising 模型基态能量分析和 O(2) Wilson–Fisher CFT 的共形数据，并在无 CFT 输入的 O(2) 模型中把临界耦合定位到 DMRG 值（系统尺寸大一倍以上）的 0.5% 以内，同时映射出耦合平面上的临界线；但基态判据虽能稳健定位临界线，其沿线选出的点却确定得较弱，计算得到的维度在沿线其他位置才最接近 bootstrap 结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将基于确定总角动量态的精确对角化与经过认证的约化基模拟器结合，可将寻找 CFT 的搜索成本降低约两个数量级；该方法复现了已发表的模糊球 Ising 模型基态能量分析和 O(2) Wilson–Fisher CFT 的共形数据，并在无 CFT 输入的 O(2) 模型中把临界耦合定位到 DMRG 值（系统尺寸大一倍以上）的 0.5% 以内，同时映射出耦合平面上的临界线；但基态判据虽能稳健定位临界线，其沿线选出的点却确定得较弱，计算得到的维度在沿线其他位置才最接近 bootstrap 结果。；创新点：提出并验证了一种将精确对角化与 certified reduced-basis emulator 相结合的方案，能以少量精确解连续重构能量、可观测量及其参数导数，从而把模糊球 CFT 的临界性搜索成本降低约两个数量级，并成功复现已有结果、定位临界耦合与临界线。
papers.method_zh: 基于具有确定总角动量的态进行精确对角化，并结合经过认证的约化基模拟器（certified reduced-basis emulator），从每个系统尺寸的少量精确解出发，连续重构能量、可观测量及其对耦合的导数；并与密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）结果进行对比。

papers.title: Competition between vacancy creation and filling in defect-engineering of hBN
papers.abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) has recently become the focus of intense research as a material that can host quantum emitters. It is known that such emission is related to point defects, but in order to conclusively correlate specific defects to their spectra, having control over the defect creation mechanism is required. Here, we prepare freestanding, monolayer hBN samples and irradiate them with ultra-low-energy (150 eV) Ar+ ions. The samples are characterized before and after irradiation via scanning transmission electron microscopy to assess the defect density and distribution. Contrary to what analytical potential molecular dynamics simulations have predicted, we predominantly observe boron single vacancies after ion irradiation, followed by double vacancies at half the count. Moreover, we also observe that vacancy filling with Si and C impurity atoms plays a more significant role in the created defects than previously assumed, potentially posing a problem for selective creation of quantum emitters in hBN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：论文制备了自支撑单层 hBN 样品，并进行 Ar+ 离子辐照，辐照前后用扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）表征缺陷密度与分布；摘要中提到的分子动力学模拟仅作为对比参照，并非本文主要工作。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的点缺陷工程，具体研究超低能 Ar+ 离子辐照下 hBN 中空位（缺陷）的产生与填充行为，以及其与量子发射体相关的缺陷控制问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 150 eV Ar+ 离子辐照后，实验主要观察到硼单空位，其次是数量约为其一半的双空位，这与分析势分子动力学模拟的预测相反；此外，Si 和 C 杂质原子对空位的填充在缺陷形成中比以往假设的更为重要，这可能对在 hBN 中选择性制备量子发射体构成问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 150 eV Ar+ 离子辐照后，实验主要观察到硼单空位，其次是数量约为其一半的双空位，这与分析势分子动力学模拟的预测相反；此外，Si 和 C 杂质原子对空位的填充在缺陷形成中比以往假设的更为重要，这可能对在 hBN 中选择性制备量子发射体构成问题。；创新点：实验上揭示了超低能 Ar+ 离子辐照 hBN 时以硼单空位为主、双空位次之的缺陷类型分布，与分子动力学模拟预测相矛盾；并指出 Si、C 杂质原子填充空位的作用比此前认为的更显著，这对 hBN 中量子发射体的选择性制备提出了新的挑战。
papers.method_zh: 制备自支撑单层 hBN 样品，用超低能（150 eV）Ar+ 离子辐照，并通过扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）在辐照前后对样品进行表征，以评估缺陷密度和分布；摘要中还提及与分析势分子动力学模拟结果进行了对比。

papers.title: High-throughput thermodynamic screening of oxide-scale adhesion across the CoCrFeMnNiAl high-entropy alloys
papers.abstract: One significant benefit of reactive element (RE) additions is the colossal improvement in oxide-scale retention during high-temperature oxidation. Selecting optimal RE dopants in high-entropy alloys remains empirical because the relevant thermodynamic landscape is inaccessible to first-principles at the required compositional resolution. Here we apply the macroscopic atom model, coupled with McLean isotherm and Guttmann models, to screen adhesion across nine CoCrFeMnNiAl sub-families at \ce{Cr2O3} and \ce{Al2O3} interfaces, ranking five REs (Hf, Y, Zr, La, Ti) for segregation, adhesion enhancement, and sulfur displacement. The screening reveals an oxide-dependent ranking inversion, with Hf dominating at \ce{Cr2O3} and La dominating at \ce{Al2O3}, driven by the interplay between RE--O and RE--matrix interaction enthalpies. Mn-containing alloys exhibit intrinsic sulfur resistance, consistent with their experimentally observed oxidation characteristics. A sulfur immunity phase diagram identifies compositions with Al~+~Mn~$\gtrsim$~25~at\% as thermodynamically immune to S-induced adhesion loss. All crossover concentrations collapse onto a universal exponential governed by the segregation enthalpy difference, providing a transferable design rule. Inverse design identifies \ce{Co16Cr16Fe16Ni16Al35} as the optimal S-immune composition with $W_\text{sep} = 5.95$~J/m$^2$ without RE doping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键依据：摘要中使用“macroscopic atom model”“McLean isotherm”“Guttmann models”“screen/ranking”“phase diagram”“inverse design”等建模与高通量筛选术语，未提及任何实验制备或表征手段。；研究对象：CoCrFeMnNiAl 高熵合金体系中的氧化皮（oxide-scale）附着/抗剥落问题，具体涉及九个子族合金在 Cr₂O₃ 和 Al₂O₃ 界面上的活性元素（RE：Hf、Y、Zr、La、Ti）偏聚、附着增强与硫置换行为，以及硫致附着失效的免疫成分设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RE 对附着力的提升存在氧化物依赖性排序反转：Cr₂O₃ 界面以 Hf 最优，Al₂O₃ 界面以 La 最优，其根源是 RE–O 与 RE–基体相互作用焓的竞争；含 Mn 合金具有本征抗硫性，且 Al+Mn ≳ 25 at% 的成分在热力学上对硫致附着损失免疫；所有交叉浓度遵循由偏聚焓差控制的普适指数规律，可作可迁移设计规则；逆向设计给出无 RE 掺杂的最优抗硫成分 Co₁₆Cr₁₆Fe₁₆Ni₁₆Al₃₅，W_sep = 5.95 J/m²。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RE 对附着力的提升存在氧化物依赖性排序反转：Cr₂O₃ 界面以 Hf 最优，Al₂O₃ 界面以 La 最优，其根源是 RE–O 与 RE–基体相互作用焓的竞争；含 Mn 合金具有本征抗硫性，且 Al+Mn ≳ 25 at% 的成分在热力学上对硫致附着损失免疫；所有交叉浓度遵循由偏聚焓差控制的普适指数规律，可作可迁移设计规则；逆向设计给出无 RE 掺杂的最优抗硫成分 Co₁₆Cr₁₆Fe₁₆Ni₁₆Al₃₅，W_sep = 5.95 J/m²。；创新点：将宏观原子模型与 McLean/Guttmann 模型耦合用于高熵合金氧化皮附着的高通量热力学筛选，揭示了 Cr₂O₃ 与 Al₂O₃ 界面间 RE 排序反转现象及其热力学起源，提出硫免疫相图与由偏聚焓差控制的普适指数设计规则，并通过逆向设计给出无 RE 掺杂的最优抗硫成分。
papers.method_zh: 宏观原子模型（macroscopic atom model），结合 McLean 等温线与 Guttmann 模型，对九个 CoCrFeMnNiAl 子族在 Cr₂O₃ 与 Al₂O₃ 界面的附着进行高通量热力学筛选，对五种 RE（Hf、Y、Zr、La、Ti）在偏聚、附着增强和硫置换方面排序，并构建硫免疫相图与逆向设计。

papers.title: Phase-Controlled Majorana Zero Modes in Altermagnetic Topological-Insulator Josephson Junctions
papers.abstract: We exploit facet-dependent Andreev phase shifts to control topological superconductivity with a phase bias in a three-dimensional altermagnetic topological-insulator Josephson junction. In the weak link between two conventional s-wave superconductors, the d-wave altermagnetic order produces facet-dependent momentum shifts of the surface Dirac cones. The resulting net momentum of the states involved in Andreev reflection generates additional propagation phases that differ between facets. Consequently, the facet-resolved Andreev spectra exhibit gap closings at distinct phase biases, giving rise to topological superconducting regimes that host Majorana zero modes(MZMs). We further show that tuning the phase bias controls the spatial localization of these modes. The associated topological superconducting transitions are only weakly affected by moderate variations in the chemical potential, obviating the need for fine-tuning to the Dirac point. Our results establish a platform for realizing and spatially controlling MZMs by tuning the superconducting phase bias in altermagnetic topological-insulator Josephson junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“We exploit...”“We further show...”“Our results establish a platform...”等表述，以理论模型与机制分析为主，未提及具体实验测量手段或计算细节。；研究对象：三维交变磁性拓扑绝缘体约瑟夫森结（altermagnetic topological-insulator Josephson junction），具体为两个常规s波超导体之间的弱连接区域，其中交变磁序为d波。研究现象为该体系中由相位偏置控制的拓扑超导性和马约拉纳零能模（MZMs）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: d波交变磁序使表面狄拉克锥产生依赖于晶面的动量移动，导致不同晶面的Andreev反射中参与态具有不同净动量，从而产生额外的传播相位；这使得不同晶面的Andreev谱在不同相位偏置下发生能隙闭合，形成可承载MZMs的拓扑超导区域。此外，调节相位偏置可控制这些MZMs的空间局域化，且相关拓扑超导转变对化学势的适度变化仅弱敏感，无需精细调节至狄拉克点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：d波交变磁序使表面狄拉克锥产生依赖于晶面的动量移动，导致不同晶面的Andreev反射中参与态具有不同净动量，从而产生额外的传播相位；这使得不同晶面的Andreev谱在不同相位偏置下发生能隙闭合，形成可承载MZMs的拓扑超导区域。此外，调节相位偏置可控制这些MZMs的空间局域化，且相关拓扑超导转变对化学势的适度变化仅弱敏感，无需精细调节至狄拉克点。；创新点：提出利用交变磁性拓扑绝缘体约瑟夫森结中晶面依赖的Andreev相移，通过超导相位偏置来控制和空间局域化MZMs；该机制对化学势变化不敏感，避免了精细调节至狄拉克点的需求。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的计算方法或理论框架（如未提及BdG方程、紧束缚模型、DFT等），仅从物理机制层面描述了利用晶面依赖的Andreev相移、表面狄拉克锥动量移动及Andreev谱分析来研究拓扑超导转变。

papers.title: Robust Spin-1 Haldane Topology under Itinerant Doping
papers.abstract: We study itinerant hole doping of the spin-$1$ Haldane symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase in two $t$--$J$ chains coupled by ferromagnetic (FM) Hund exchange. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations show that string order, a finite spin gap, and the Haldane entanglement structure coexist over a broad doping range. Combined with entanglement-entropy scaling consistent with a single gapless charge mode, these results support a metallic doped Haldane SPT with a $C1S0$ low-energy description. At low doping, short-range charge correlations reduce the density of spin-$1/2$ defect rungs, whereas at larger doping their positions become nearly uncorrelated while their spins are collectively incorporated into the correlated spin sector. The doped Haldane SPT terminates in a fully spin-polarized FM phase, which forms a reentrant pocket at high doping in the global phase diagram. Dilute-limit analyses trace the two FM boundaries to spin--charge factorization at weak Hund coupling and to rung-triplet binding with reduced pair mobility at strong Hund coupling. Our results show how mobile carriers reorganize the Haldane spin structure while preserving its characteristic signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键判断依据：摘要明确提到“Density-matrix renormalization group calculations”（密度矩阵重整化群计算），属于数值计算方法研究，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：两条由铁磁（FM）Hund交换耦合的 t–J 链中的自旋-1 Haldane 对称保护拓扑（SPT）相的巡游空穴掺杂。具体涉及掺杂 Haldane SPT 的金属态、自旋-电荷分离行为以及掺杂诱导的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在宽掺杂范围内，弦序、有限自旋能隙和 Haldane 纠缠结构共存，结合与单一无隙电荷模式一致的纠缠熵标度行为，支持存在一个具有 C1S0 低能描述的金属性掺杂 Haldane SPT。掺杂 Haldane SPT 最终终止于完全自旋极化的铁磁相，该铁磁相在高掺杂区域形成回归口袋（reentrant pocket）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在宽掺杂范围内，弦序、有限自旋能隙和 Haldane 纠缠结构共存，结合与单一无隙电荷模式一致的纠缠熵标度行为，支持存在一个具有 C1S0 低能描述的金属性掺杂 Haldane SPT。掺杂 Haldane SPT 最终终止于完全自旋极化的铁磁相，该铁磁相在高掺杂区域形成回归口袋（reentrant pocket）。；创新点：摘要表明，该工作展示了移动载流子如何重组 Haldane 自旋结构同时保留其特征信号，并揭示了掺杂 Haldane SPT 在宽掺杂范围内的稳健性、其金属性 C1S0 描述、以及在高掺杂区出现铁磁回归口袋等新结果。相对于已有研究的具体新意，摘要未进一步明确说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算；结合纠缠熵标度分析；并在稀薄极限下进行分析，以追踪铁磁边界与自旋-电荷因子化（弱 Hund 耦合）及梯级三重态束缚伴随配对迁移率降低（强 Hund 耦合）之间的关系。

papers.title: Effect of Stress and Surface Roughness on Electrodeposition in All-Solid-State Batteries: A Computational Investigation
papers.abstract: All-solid-state batteries (ASSBs) promise high energy density and enhanced safety, but their development is hindered by instability and incompatibility at solid-solid interfaces. In Li-metal ASSBs, lithium penetration occurs despite stiff ceramic electrolytes via grain boundaries, often initiated by minor Li/SE interfacial irregularities. Here we introduce a two-dimensional continuum model with electro-chemo-mechanical coupling to investigate interfacial current distribution in Li ASSBs with surface-roughened argyrodite electrolyte under stack pressures and applied current density. Our theoretical analysis and simulation studies highlight the critical role of mechanical stress in interfacial current distribution. We find that prominent stress variations around elongated surface protrusions are the key to nonuniform Li deposition, without which Li deposition becomes uniform even on a rough surface. Moreover, our parametric study elucidates that stress effects dominate the overpotential and current distribution under low interfacial current density to exchange current density ratios, otherwise the high interfacial resistance due to surface-roughness-induced interfacial area becomes dominant. With these insights, we also discuss the potential of engineering artificial interlayers to modulate interfacial current distributions, offering guidance for improving the long-term performance and reliability of ASSBs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：two-dimensional continuum model、electro-chemo-mechanical coupling、simulation studies、parametric study、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：Li金属全固态电池（ASSBs）中，表面粗糙的银辉石（argyrodite）固态电解质与Li金属界面处的界面电流分布及Li沉积行为，重点关注堆叠压力和施加电流密度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机械应力在界面电流分布中起关键作用：细长表面凸起周围的显著应力变化是导致Li非均匀沉积的关键因素，若无应力效应，即使表面粗糙Li沉积也会均匀。此外，在低界面电流密度与交换电流密度之比下，应力效应主导过电位和电流分布；否则表面粗糙度引起的界面面积增大导致的高界面电阻成为主导因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机械应力在界面电流分布中起关键作用：细长表面凸起周围的显著应力变化是导致Li非均匀沉积的关键因素，若无应力效应，即使表面粗糙Li沉积也会均匀。此外，在低界面电流密度与交换电流密度之比下，应力效应主导过电位和电流分布；否则表面粗糙度引起的界面面积增大导致的高界面电阻成为主导因素。；创新点：通过电-化学-力学耦合的二维连续模型，揭示了应力变化（而非仅表面粗糙度本身）是导致Li非均匀沉积的关键机制，并阐明了在不同界面电流密度与交换电流密度比值下应力效应与界面电阻效应的竞争关系；此外还讨论了通过人工中间层工程调控界面电流分布的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 建立了二维连续介质模型，包含电-化学-力学耦合（electro-chemo-mechanical coupling），对表面粗糙化的银辉石电解质在堆叠压力和外加电流密度下的界面电流分布进行理论分析和数值模拟，并开展了参数化研究。

papers.title: Finite-time effects in periodically kicked systems
papers.abstract: In this work, we study finite-time effects in ultracold atomic systems by considering time-dependent modulations with variable waveforms and durations. These two characteristics can be controlled by adjusting only a single parameter. For arbitrarily short pulses, our model recovers the paradigmatic kicked rotor while maintaining the impulse transmitted per period and unit amplitude constant. Furthermore, we demonstrate that finite-time effects have a profound impact on dynamical localization, a result that cannot be captured by the δ-kicked-rotor model. Through a detailed analysis of the effects of different modulation amplitudes, periods, and waveforms, we identify the conditions for which dynamical localization is significantly enhanced. We show that the strength of dynamical localization increases sharply as the system approaches the δ-kicked-rotor limiting case. Moreover, we establish the existence of an optimal value of the period that maximizes dynamical localization for given values of the amplitude and shape parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：考虑时间依赖调制、模型恢复为 kicked rotor、分析不同调制振幅/周期/波形的影响、建立最优值——摘要中未提及具体实验平台或实验测量，属于理论建模与数值分析。；研究对象：超冷原子系统（ultracold atomic systems）中受周期性脉冲驱动（periodically kicked）的量子系统，具体关注有限脉冲时间（finite-time）效应对动力学局域化（dynamical localization）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限时间效应（即脉冲具有有限持续时间而非理想δ脉冲）对动力学局域化有深远影响，这是理想δ-kicked-rotor模型无法描述的；当系统趋近δ-kicked-rotor极限时，动力学局域化强度急剧增强；且在给定振幅和形状参数下，存在一个使动力学局域化最大化的最优周期值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限时间效应（即脉冲具有有限持续时间而非理想δ脉冲）对动力学局域化有深远影响，这是理想δ-kicked-rotor模型无法描述的；当系统趋近δ-kicked-rotor极限时，动力学局域化强度急剧增强；且在给定振幅和形状参数下，存在一个使动力学局域化最大化的最优周期值。；创新点：将有限脉冲时间效应引入周期性驱动超冷原子系统的研究中，揭示了有限时间效应对动力学局域化的显著影响，这是传统δ-kicked-rotor模型所无法捕捉的；并识别出动力学局域化显著增强的条件以及最大化局域化的最优周期值。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值分析。构建了具有可变波形和持续时间的周期性调制模型，该模型仅通过调节单一参数即可控制波形和持续时间；在脉冲任意短时，模型在保持每周期传递冲量和单位振幅不变的条件下恢复为标准的 kicked rotor 模型。摘要未明确说明具体的数值方法或解析技术。

papers.title: Skyrmion nucleus resolves the Landauer paradox
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric switching is among the most fundamental and widely studied symmetry-breaking processes in physics. However, the Landauer paradox asserts that an ideal single-domain ferroelectric should be kinetically unswitchable, because a three-dimensional reversed nucleus would carry a prohibitive depolarization penalty, leading to unphysically large coercive field (the electric field required to switch the polarization). Here we show that this long-standing paradox is resolved by topology. In defect-free PbTiO3, large-scale molecular dynamics simulations reveal that the intrinsic critical nucleus is a three-dimensional polar skyrmion. Its continuous polarization rotation and Néel-type boundary walls self-compensate bound charge, suppressing the depolarization energy by orders of magnitude and bringing the predicted coercive field into agreement with experiment. This topological nucleus further overturns the 60-year-old Janovec-Kay-Dunn law. We derive an analytical thickness-dependent coercive-field law governed by field-induced softening of the parent ferroelectric state and controlled by a single material descriptor. This framework captures diverse experimental trends across ferroelectric families and recasts the Kay-Dunn exponent of -2/3 as an effective finite-window behavior. These results establish polar topology as an organizing principle for intrinsic switching and suggest that hidden topological transition states may broadly shape nonequilibrium phase transformations traditionally understood as Landau-type symmetry breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：large-scale molecular dynamics simulations（大规模分子动力学模拟）、analytical thickness-dependent coercive-field law（解析推导的厚度依赖矫顽场定律）。摘要中未提及任何实验测量手段，属于以计算模拟为主并结合理论解析推导的工作。；研究对象：铁电材料中的铁电翻转（ferroelectric switching）过程与矫顽场（coercive field）问题，具体材料为无缺陷的 PbTiO3（钛酸铅）。涉及的核心物理现象是铁电极化翻转中的临界核（critical nucleus）本质，以及长期存在的 Landauer 悖论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无缺陷 PbTiO3 中，本征临界核是一个三维极性斯格明子（polar skyrmion），其连续极化旋转与 Néel 型畴壁能自补偿束缚电荷，将退极化能压低数个数量级，从而使预测矫顽场与实验相符，解决了 Landauer 悖论；该拓扑核还推翻了沿用 60 年的 Janovec-Kay-Dunn 定律，作者推导出由母铁电态场致软化主导、由单一材料描述符控制的厚度依赖矫顽场定律，并将 Kay-Dunn 的 -2/3 指数重新解释为有限窗口下的有效行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无缺陷 PbTiO3 中，本征临界核是一个三维极性斯格明子（polar skyrmion），其连续极化旋转与 Néel 型畴壁能自补偿束缚电荷，将退极化能压低数个数量级，从而使预测矫顽场与实验相符，解决了 Landauer 悖论；该拓扑核还推翻了沿用 60 年的 Janovec-Kay-Dunn 定律，作者推导出由母铁电态场致软化主导、由单一材料描述符控制的厚度依赖矫顽场定律，并将 Kay-Dunn 的 -2/3 指数重新解释为有限窗口下的有效行为。；创新点：首次提出铁电临界核的拓扑本质——三维极性斯格明子，用拓扑机制解决 Landauer 悖论；推翻 60 年的 Janovec-Kay-Dunn 定律，给出新的厚度依赖矫顽场解析定律，并将原 -2/3 指数重新诠释为有限窗口有效行为；提出极性拓扑可作为本征翻转的组织原则，并暗示隐藏的拓扑过渡态可能普遍影响传统上被理解为 Landau 型对称破缺的非平衡相变。
papers.method_zh: 大规模分子动力学模拟（large-scale molecular dynamics simulations），对象为无缺陷 PbTiO3；并辅以解析理论推导，得到厚度依赖的矫顽场定律及单一材料描述符。摘要未明确说明具体使用的势函数、模拟软件或第一性原理参数等细节。

papers.title: Néel-Vector-Dependent Altermagnetic Spin Splitting in the One-Dimensional Limit
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism is normally identified by nonrelativistic spin-split bands in a compensated collinear magnet. Under one-dimensional confinement, however, this diagnostic can disappear: a boundary-compatible sublattice-exchange operation may leave the only Bloch momentum unchanged, forcing the nonrelativistic spin-up and spin-down spectra to coincide. We show that nonrelativistic spin degeneracy can coexist with relativistic spin splitting in a compensated one-dimensional magnet. In a Lieb-based construction, confinement along the diagonal cancels the projected $d$-wave spin splitting while preserving the real-space sublattice-exchange motif. Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) then locks spin to the lattice, so the Néel-vector orientation selects a magnetic line group that can reveal spin-split bands. Using fully compensated $[110]$ Ta$_2$TeSeO nanoribbons as a prototype, we find spin-degenerate nonrelativistic bands and sizable SOC splitting in the inherited easy-axis domain, $\mathbf N\parallel[100]$ or $[010]$. For sufficiently wide ribbons that retain the parent easy-axis order, this splitting is an equilibrium property. The easy-axis ribbon also supports a right-moving-mode spin polarization of about $35\%$ at finite ideal conductance. Our results establish one-dimensional fully compensated altermagnetic functionality hidden inside apparently conventional antiferromagnetic bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中出现“We show that…”“In a Lieb-based construction…”“Using fully compensated [110] Ta₂TeSeO nanoribbons as a prototype, we find…”等，属于以理论构造与计算模拟为主的研究，摘要未提及具体实验测量手段。；研究对象：一维受限下的完全补偿共线磁体（altermagnet），具体原型为沿 [110] 方向的 Ta₂TeSeO 纳米带（nanoribbons）。研究现象为一维限制下非相对论自旋劈裂的消失与相对论（自旋轨道耦合）自旋劈裂的共存，以及 Néel 矢量取向对自旋劈裂的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一维受限的完全补偿磁体中，非相对论自旋简并可以与相对论自旋劈裂共存：沿对角方向的限制会抵消投影的 d 波自旋劈裂，但保留实空间子格交换图案；自旋轨道耦合将自旋锁定于晶格，使 Néel 矢量取向选择不同的磁线群，从而在易轴畴（N∥[100] 或 [010]）中显现出自旋劈裂能带。足够宽的、保持母体易轴序的纳米带中，这种劈裂是平衡态性质；易轴纳米带在有限理想电导下还支持约 35% 的右移模式自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一维受限的完全补偿磁体中，非相对论自旋简并可以与相对论自旋劈裂共存：沿对角方向的限制会抵消投影的 d 波自旋劈裂，但保留实空间子格交换图案；自旋轨道耦合将自旋锁定于晶格，使 Néel 矢量取向选择不同的磁线群，从而在易轴畴（N∥[100] 或 [010]）中显现出自旋劈裂能带。足够宽的、保持母体易轴序的纳米带中，这种劈裂是平衡态性质；易轴纳米带在有限理想电导下还支持约 35% 的右移模式自旋极化。；创新点：指出 altermagnetism 的常规判据（非相对论自旋劈裂能带）在一维限制下可能失效，提出非相对论自旋简并与相对论自旋劈裂可共存的新机制；揭示 Néel 矢量取向通过 SOC 选择磁线群来控制自旋劈裂；并预言一维完全补偿 altermagnet 可隐藏在看似常规的反铁磁能带中，同时给出约 35% 的自旋极化输运特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于 Lieb 构造的理论框架分析一维限制下的子格交换操作与 Bloch 动量关系；以完全补偿的 [110] Ta₂TeSeO 纳米带为原型进行能带计算，结合自旋轨道耦合（SOC）与磁线群分析。摘要未明确说明是否使用 DFT、DFT+U 或其他具体第一性原理方法。

papers.title: Work as a function of protocol duration for the efficient erasure of an underdamped memory: isothermal to adiabatic transition
papers.abstract: We use evolutionary reinforcement learning to determine efficient time-dependent erasure protocols for an underdamped cantilever moving in a double-well potential, an experimental realization of a 1-bit memory. We investigate how the mean work $\langle W \rangle $ needed to erase a bit scales as a function of the protocol duration $τ$. We find two regimes, depending on how $τ$ compares to the relaxation time of the system $t_r$. For $τ\gg t_r$, the quasistatic isothermal regime, we recover Landauer's bound plus an overhead that scales as $1/τ$, similar to the overdamped case. By contrast, for $τ<t_r$ erasure becomes adiabatic and $\langle W \rangle$ grows more slowly than in the isothermal case. This growth is bounded from below as $1/τ$, which we derive using a gedanken optimal protocol. Finally, comparison with overdamped erasure shows that learned protocols can outperform protocols that are optimal subject to equilibrium boundary conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：evolutionary reinforcement learning、gedanken optimal protocol、learned protocols，表明工作以数值优化/计算为主，摘要中未提及具体实验测量。；研究对象：在双势阱中运动的欠阻尼悬臂梁（underdamped cantilever），这是1比特存储器的实验实现体系；研究的是比特擦除过程中平均功随协议时长标度的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平均擦除功⟨W⟩随协议时长τ的标度存在两个区间：当τ≫t_r（准静态等温区）时，⟨W⟩趋于Landauer极限加上按1/τ衰减的额外开销，与过阻尼情形类似；当τ<t_r时擦除变为绝热过程，⟨W⟩增长比等温情形更慢，且其下界为1/τ。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平均擦除功⟨W⟩随协议时长τ的标度存在两个区间：当τ≫t_r（准静态等温区）时，⟨W⟩趋于Landauer极限加上按1/τ衰减的额外开销，与过阻尼情形类似；当τ<t_r时擦除变为绝热过程，⟨W⟩增长比等温情形更慢，且其下界为1/τ。；创新点：将强化学习用于寻找欠阻尼1比特存储器的擦除协议，揭示了等温到绝热转变下功随协议时长的两种不同标度行为，并给出了绝热区1/τ下界的推导；同时表明学习得到的协议可以优于在平衡边界条件下最优的协议。
papers.method_zh: 采用演化强化学习（evolutionary reinforcement learning）来确定高效的时间依赖擦除协议；并通过一个思想实验中的最优协议（gedanken optimal protocol）推导出绝热区⟨W⟩的1/τ下界；此外还与过阻尼擦除协议进行了对比。

papers.title: Topological band structure of excitons in octochlore KTb$_{3}$F$_{10}$: an analog of the Luttinger Semimetal
papers.abstract: Understanding the symmetry and topology of band structures in crystalline solids has been among the defining themes of a generation of condensed matter physicists, with implications across many different platforms including electronic bands, photonic crystals, phonons and magnetic excitations. In the latter systems, there is usually magnetic long-range order and time reversal symmetry breaking. Here we further enrich the possible band structures available to magnetic systems by examining dispersive crystal field excitations above a ground state that is a simple product of singlets. In these systems, there is an interplay of magnetic interactions and band topology with both crystal and time reversal symmetries. Using high-resolution neutron spectroscopy we reveal the dispersion relations of bosonic excitons in KTb$_{3}$F$_{10}$, an experimental realization of the octochlore lattice. We show that there are pinch point features in the scattering intensity. The dominant coupling in this system is the long-range magnetostatic dipolar interaction, whose singularity at the zone center is passed onto the scattering intensity. However, the pinch points survive when the range of the dipoles is truncated to finite shell number in the form of a three-band quadratic band touching protected by cubic symmetry. This model, which is related to the Luttinger semi-metal, provides a general long wavelength model for the emergence of pinch point scattering intensity encompassing also the true long-range dipolar model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 理论）。判断依据关键词：使用高分辨率中子谱学（high-resolution neutron spectroscopy）进行测量，同时构建了与 Luttinger 半金属相关的理论模型。；研究对象：八氯格（octochlore）晶格的实际材料 KTb₃F₁₀ 中的激子（晶体场激发）色散关系与拓扑能带结构，以及其中出现的 pinch point 散射强度特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 KTb₃F₁₀ 中观测到玻色型激子的色散关系和散射强度中的 pinch point 特征；主导耦合为长程静磁偶极相互作用，其布里渊区中心的奇异性传递到散射强度中；即使将偶极相互作用截断到有限壳层，pinch point 仍然存活，表现为受立方对称性保护的三带二次能带接触，该模型与 Luttinger 半金属相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 KTb₃F₁₀ 中观测到玻色型激子的色散关系和散射强度中的 pinch point 特征；主导耦合为长程静磁偶极相互作用，其布里渊区中心的奇异性传递到散射强度中；即使将偶极相互作用截断到有限壳层，pinch point 仍然存活，表现为受立方对称性保护的三带二次能带接触，该模型与 Luttinger 半金属相关。；创新点：将拓扑能带结构的研究拓展到基态为单态简单乘积的磁性系统中，展示了磁相互作用与能带拓扑在晶体对称性和时间反演对称性共存下的相互作用；揭示了 pinch point 散射强度在偶极相互作用截断后仍由立方对称性保护的三带二次能带接触所维持，提供了一个涵盖真实长程偶极模型的通用长波长模型。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用高分辨率中子谱学（high-resolution neutron spectroscopy）测量 KTb₃F₁₀ 中玻色型激子的色散关系；理论上构建了长波长模型，包括真实长程偶极模型和截断偶极范围后的三带二次能带接触模型，并与 Luttinger 半金属进行类比。

papers.title: A Community-Developed Domain Ontology for Magnetic Materials
papers.abstract: Magnetic materials play a crucial role in energy-related technologies, mobility, and sensing, but their complex multiscale behaviour and the coexistence of multiple unit systems pose persistent challenges for data exchange and interpretation. This paper presents a domain ontology for magnetic materials, developed within the European Union funded Magnetic Multiscale Modelling Suite (MaMMoS) project and aligned with the Elementary Multiperspective Material Ontology (EMMO). The ontology formalises intrinsic, hysteretic, and microstructural properties across multiple length scales and supports semantic interoperability between simulation tools, databases, and experimental workflows. One key feature of the ontology is its code-based and human-readable structure, enabled through the EMMOntoPy framework, which allows for direct manipulation and versioning without relying on opaque .owl or .ttl files. This facilitates collaborative development and improves transparency. The ontology supports FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) principles and is openly available for extension by the community. The aim of the MaMMoS project is to foster reproducibility, improve traceability, and promote the adoption of ontology in the magnetism domain. The ontology that has been developed already serves as the foundation for multiple software tools that handle all kinds of magnetic material data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：方法/工具类文章（本体论开发），非传统实验或计算物理文章。关键依据：摘要中强调“domain ontology”“semantic interoperability”“FAIR principles”“code-based and human-readable structure”，属于数据基础设施与语义建模工作，而非针对某一物理体系的实验或计算研究。；研究对象：磁性材料领域的领域本体（domain ontology），涵盖多尺度下的内禀性质、磁滞性质和微观结构性质，以及模拟工具、数据库和实验工作流之间的语义互操作。不针对某一具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作提出了一个面向磁性材料的领域本体，可形式化描述跨多个长度尺度的内禀、磁滞和微观结构性质，并支持模拟工具、数据库与实验工作流之间的语义互操作。该本体基于代码且人类可读，便于协作开发、版本管理和透明化，已作为多个处理磁性材料数据的软件工具的基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作提出了一个面向磁性材料的领域本体，可形式化描述跨多个长度尺度的内禀、磁滞和微观结构性质，并支持模拟工具、数据库与实验工作流之间的语义互操作。该本体基于代码且人类可读，便于协作开发、版本管理和透明化，已作为多个处理磁性材料数据的软件工具的基础。；创新点：主要新意在于：面向磁性材料领域、跨多尺度并支持语义互操作的领域本体；采用基于代码且人类可读的结构（通过 EMMOntoPy 实现），避免依赖不透明的 .owl/.ttl 文件，从而促进协作开发与透明度；支持 FAIR 原则并开放供社区扩展。摘要未突出说明与已有本体相比在物理建模层面的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 在欧洲联盟资助的 MaMMoS（Magnetic Multiscale Modelling Suite）项目框架内开发，并与 EMMO（Elementary Multiperspective Material Ontology）对齐。通过 EMMOntoPy 框架实现基于代码且人类可读的本体结构，从而无需依赖不透明的 .owl 或 .ttl 文件即可直接操作和版本管理。摘要未明确说明是否包含具体实验手段、计算方法或理论框架。

papers.title: Bottom-up Synthesis of Metastable 2D Hexagonal Copper(I) Iodide on Monolayer and within Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Copper(I) iodide (CuI) is a wide-bandgap semiconductor crystallizing in the 3D $γ$-phase under ambient conditions; its layered van der Waals bulk phase $β$-CuI is stable only between 643 and 673 K. The two-dimensional (2D) h-CuI form has been obtained via liquid-phase exfoliation of mechanochemically prepared precursors and via encapsulation between graphene sheets, whereas bottom-up growth of 2D h-CuI on open surfaces has not yet been demonstrated. Here, we report a vapor-phase synthesis of h-CuI directly on low-defect, large-area monolayer and within bilayer reduced oxo-graphene (r-oxo-G) at low temperatures. Using a copper TEM grid as the solid-state precursor for copper, HI-vapor exposure at 40 $°$C initiates nucleation, while annealing at 180 $°$C promotes the growth of extended h-CuI domains. Aberration-corrected HRTEM resolves the atomic structure, local twist angles, and lattice anisotropy of the CuI/r-oxo-G nanohybrid, while STEM-EDX yields a Cu:I ratio consistent with 1:1. First-principles calculations show that van der Waals adhesion to graphene stabilizes the supported hexagonal layer. Under the presented low-temperature precursor conditions, pathways for nucleation of the $γ$-phase are not available, allowing the hexagonal phase to form selectively at the graphene interface. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations show that the heterostructure retains its hexagonal lattice order at 600 K, including on an open monolayer graphene support. The lateral extent of the growth is limited mainly by remaining interfacial adsorbates. These results establish a route to metastable 2D h-CuI on a chemically inert graphene template, which may be useful for wide-bandgap electronic and optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据关键词：vapor-phase synthesis、HRTEM、STEM-EDX（实验）；first-principles calculations、ab initio molecular dynamics simulations（计算）。；研究对象：在低缺陷、大面积单层还原氧化石墨烯（r-oxo-G）表面及双层石墨烯之间，通过自下而上气相合成亚稳态二维六方相碘化铜（h-CuI），形成CuI/r-oxo-G纳米杂化体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低温条件下（40 °C HI蒸气引发成核，180 °C退火促进生长），可在石墨烯模板上选择性生长出亚稳态二维六方相CuI；石墨烯界面的范德华粘附稳定了六方层，且在该低温前驱体条件下γ相成核路径不可用，从而使六方相在石墨烯界面选择性形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低温条件下（40 °C HI蒸气引发成核，180 °C退火促进生长），可在石墨烯模板上选择性生长出亚稳态二维六方相CuI；石墨烯界面的范德华粘附稳定了六方层，且在该低温前驱体条件下γ相成核路径不可用，从而使六方相在石墨烯界面选择性形成。；创新点：此前二维h-CuI仅通过液相剥离机械化学前驱体或石墨烯片间封装获得，尚未实现在开放表面的自下而上生长；本工作首次报道了在低缺陷大面积单层及双层还原氧化石墨烯上低温气相合成h-CuI，建立了在化学惰性石墨烯模板上生长亚稳态二维h-CuI的路线。
papers.method_zh: 实验：以铜TEM网格作为固态铜前驱体，HI蒸气暴露（40 °C）引发成核，180 °C退火生长；采用像差校正HRTEM解析原子结构、局部扭转角和晶格各向异性，STEM-EDX测定Cu:I比例。计算：第一性原理计算（验证范德华粘附稳定六方层），从头算分子动力学模拟（验证异质结构在600 K下保持六方晶格有序，包括在开放单层石墨烯支撑上）。

papers.title: Vacancy Order and Physical Properties of a Ternary Compound Fe0.68Pd0.80Te with an α-Fe1+xTe-Type Structure
papers.abstract: We report the identification and characterization of a new compound Fe0.68Pd0.80Te with an α-Fe1+xTe prototype structure. Different from the Fe-square net and minor occupancy of interstitial Fe-sites in Fe1+xTe, Fe0.68Pd0.80Te is featured by a Pdsquare net and near 68% occupancy of the corresponding interstitial Fe-sites. Furthermore, noncontact atomic force microscopy and X-ray diffraction provide evidence for the existence of a 3*3*3 Pd-vacancy order in this layered material. A spin-glass ground state below Tg 40 K is identified via magnetic characterization. Electrical transport measurements show that Fe0.68Pd0.80Te is a semiconductor with a very small band gap below 10 meV. It has weak negative magnetoresistance and holelike charge carriers below room temperature. Our results demonstrate its potentials for further exploring various quantum phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：noncontact atomic force microscopy、X-ray diffraction、magnetic characterization、electrical transport measurements 等均为实验表征手段。；研究对象：一种具有 α-Fe1+xTe 原型结构的新型三元化合物 Fe0.68Pd0.80Te，及其空位有序、磁性和电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe0.68Pd0.80Te 具有 Pd 方形网和约 68% 的间隙 Fe 位占据，存在 3×3×3 的 Pd 空位有序；其基态为自旋玻璃态（Tg 约 40 K），电输运表现为带隙小于 10 meV 的半导体，具有弱负磁阻和空穴型载流子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe0.68Pd0.80Te 具有 Pd 方形网和约 68% 的间隙 Fe 位占据，存在 3×3×3 的 Pd 空位有序；其基态为自旋玻璃态（Tg 约 40 K），电输运表现为带隙小于 10 meV 的半导体，具有弱负磁阻和空穴型载流子。；创新点：首次报道并表征了 Fe0.68Pd0.80Te 这一新化合物，其结构特征（Pd 方形网、间隙 Fe 位高占据率、Pd 空位有序）不同于 Fe1+xTe 的 Fe 方形网和低间隙 Fe 占据，并揭示了其自旋玻璃基态和极窄带隙半导体行为。
papers.method_zh: 非接触原子力显微镜（nc-AFM）、X 射线衍射（XRD）、磁性表征、电输运测量。

papers.title: Anisotropy of Ultrafast Strain in $V_2O_3$ Thin Films: Out-of-Equilibrium Phase Transitions under Interfacial Clamping
papers.abstract: Ultrafast photoinduced insulator-to-metal transitions in correlated materials are often mediated by lattice distortions, yet the role of interfacial lattice constraints in shaping nonequilibrium pathways remains largely unexplored. We use azimuth-resolved time-resolved X-ray diffraction to track orientation-dependent strain dynamics in granular V$_2$O$_3$ thin films on c-cut sapphire, where thermal-expansion mismatch imposes anisotropic interfacial strain. Across the thermal transition, the azimuthal profile of the (110)$_H$ strain inverts curvature, providing direct evidence of partial clamping of the hexagonal basal-plane lattice (a$_H$,b$_H$). After photoexcitation of the antiferromagnetic insulating phase, the structural response remains clamp-limited: weakly constrained grain families reach the full basal-plane contraction characteristic of the metallic-like state, whereas strongly constrained families exhibit a strongly reduced distortion. Fluence-dependent measurements further disentangle transformed fraction from clamping-limited lattice distortion.
