Our results show that interfacial clamping acts as a static selector for ultrafast phase switching and provide a general route to quantify anisotropic strain dynamics in heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：使用方位分辨的时间分辨 X 射线衍射（azimuth-resolved time-resolved X-ray diffraction）进行测量，属于实验表征手段。；研究对象：生长在 c 切蓝宝石衬底上的颗粒状 V₂O₃ 薄膜，研究其超快光致绝缘体-金属相变中的晶格应变动力学，以及界面晶格约束（界面夹持）对非平衡相变路径的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面夹持会各向异性地限制 V₂O₃ 薄膜六方基面晶格的应变：热相变时 (110)_H 应变的方位角分布曲率反转，直接证明基面晶格被部分夹持；光激发反铁磁绝缘相后，弱约束晶粒族可达到金属态特征的完整基面收缩，而强约束晶粒族的畸变被显著抑制。界面夹持因此充当超快相切换的静态选择器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面夹持会各向异性地限制 V₂O₃ 薄膜六方基面晶格的应变：热相变时 (110)_H 应变的方位角分布曲率反转，直接证明基面晶格被部分夹持；光激发反铁磁绝缘相后，弱约束晶粒族可达到金属态特征的完整基面收缩，而强约束晶粒族的畸变被显著抑制。界面夹持因此充当超快相切换的静态选择器。；创新点：首次直接揭示界面晶格约束（夹持）在超快光致相变中作为静态选择器的作用，证明界面夹持会各向异性地限制非平衡晶格响应，并提供了一种量化异质结构中各向异性应变动力学的通用方法。摘要未明确说明此前是否已有类似方位分辨时间分辨 XRD 研究 V₂O₃ 薄膜的工作。
papers.method_zh: 方位分辨的时间分辨 X 射线衍射（azimuth-resolved time-resolved X-ray diffraction），对 c 切蓝宝石衬底上颗粒状 V₂O₃ 薄膜进行测量；通过热相变过程中 (110)_H 应变的方位角分布分析，以及不同光通量（fluence-dependent）测量来区分相变转化分数与受夹持限制的晶格畸变。

papers.title: Rare-History Transitions in Temporally Random Integrable Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: We study current fluctuations in a temporally random integrable quantum circuit. Commutativity reduces every drive history exactly to its layer composition, turning annealed fluctuations into a competition between current gain and the large-deviation cost of rare compositions. For each fixed composition, homogeneous thermodynamic Bethe ansatz dressing supplemented by ballistic fluctuation theory yields the conditional current statistics. Their annealed large-deviation contraction predicts a first-order switch between two dominant history classes, terminating on a line of regular cusp endpoints. Finite-time analysis shows how the switch is rounded. Thus temporal randomness can act as an emergent order-parameter-like coordinate in trajectory space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“study”“thermodynamic Bethe ansatz”“ballistic fluctuation theory”“large-deviation contraction”“predicts”等，均为理论/解析推导框架，未涉及实验测量或数值模拟平台。；研究对象：时间随机可积量子电路中的电流涨落（current fluctuations）。具体体系为时间上随机的可积量子电路，研究的是其中的电流统计与稀有历史转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由于可积性导致算符对易，每个驱动历史可精确约化为其层组成，使退火涨落转化为电流增益与稀有组成大偏差代价之间的竞争；退火大偏差收缩预测在两类主导历史之间存在一级转变，并终止于一条规则尖点端点线；有限时间分析表明该转变会被圆滑化。因此时间随机性可作为轨迹空间中类序参量的涌现坐标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由于可积性导致算符对易，每个驱动历史可精确约化为其层组成，使退火涨落转化为电流增益与稀有组成大偏差代价之间的竞争；退火大偏差收缩预测在两类主导历史之间存在一级转变，并终止于一条规则尖点端点线；有限时间分析表明该转变会被圆滑化。因此时间随机性可作为轨迹空间中类序参量的涌现坐标。；创新点：将时间随机可积量子电路中的电流涨落问题映射为驱动历史层组成之间的竞争，并揭示退火涨落下两类主导历史之间的一级转变及尖点端点结构；提出时间随机性可作为轨迹空间中类序参量坐标。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：利用可积性/对易性将驱动历史约化为层组成；对每个固定组成使用均匀热力学Bethe ansatz（TBA）dressing，并结合弹道涨落理论（ballistic fluctuation theory）得到条件电流统计；再通过退火大偏差收缩（annealed large-deviation contraction）分析主导历史类别之间的转变；并进行有限时间分析。

papers.title: Instabilities in self-consistent diagrammatic approaches and how to cure them
papers.abstract: While self-consistent diagrammatic approaches are widely used to compute the physical properties of correlated quantum materials, their applicability may get severely hindered precisely in the parameter regions, where the most exciting physics is observed. One of the major issues, referred to as "misleading convergence", is the tendency of iterative schemes to converge to unphysical fixed points for intermediate-to-strong electronic interactions, regardless of numerical accuracy of the computation. Here, we explicitly verify that the origin of this problem in several established self-consistent many-electron approaches, defined in the general diagrammatic framework of the boson-exchange formalism, resides exclusively in the stability condition of the respective iteration schemes, and not in an intrinsic breakdown of their self-consistent diagrammatic description. This insight enables a simple and general remedy, as recently proposed in Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 016502 (2026): The redefinition of the iterative procedure, by inverting the unstable eigendirections of the Jacobian associated to the fixed point of the self-consistent algorithm. We illustrate the successful outcome of this procedure by means of systematic calculations performed on testbed, exactly solvable, models. Our results demonstrate that the physical fixed point of the diagrammatic schemes we considered can be stabilized, de facto, across the entire parameter range, including the most challenging nonperturbative/strong-coupling regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：self-consistent diagrammatic approaches、boson-exchange formalism、iterative schemes、Jacobian、fixed point、exactly solvable models——全文为理论框架分析与数值验证，不涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：自洽图解多电子方法（self-consistent diagrammatic approaches）本身，具体是在 boson-exchange formalism 框架下定义的若干已建立的自洽多电子方法，以及这些方法在中间到强电子相互作用区域出现的“误导性收敛”（misleading convergence）问题。摘要未明确说明针对某一具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: “误导性收敛”的根源完全在于迭代格式的稳定性条件，而非自洽图解描述本身的内在失效；通过反转自洽算法不动点处 Jacobian 的不稳定本征方向来重新定义迭代过程，可以稳定这些图解方案在包括非微扰/强耦合在内的整个参数范围内的物理不动点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：“误导性收敛”的根源完全在于迭代格式的稳定性条件，而非自洽图解描述本身的内在失效；通过反转自洽算法不动点处 Jacobian 的不稳定本征方向来重新定义迭代过程，可以稳定这些图解方案在包括非微扰/强耦合在内的整个参数范围内的物理不动点。；创新点：明确指认“误导性收敛”来源于迭代格式的稳定性条件而非自洽图解描述的内在崩溃，并验证了一种简单通用的补救方案（反转 Jacobian 不稳定本征方向）可使所考虑图解方案的物理不动点在整个参数范围（含最具挑战性的非微扰/强耦合区）内被稳定化。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为 boson-exchange formalism 下的自洽图解多电子方法；通过分析迭代格式的稳定性条件及不动点处 Jacobian 的本征方向来诊断问题；采用反转不稳定本征方向的迭代过程重定义方案（引自 Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 016502 (2026)）；并在可精确求解的测试模型（testbed, exactly solvable models）上进行系统计算验证。

papers.title: Microwave-controlled interactions and stripe formation of static-field-shielded polar molecules
papers.abstract: We study polar molecules where short-range losses are suppressed by a shielding scheme involving a static electric field and an elliptically polarized microwave field. Using perturbation theory, we derive the effective interaction potential and validate it against coupled channel calculations. We identify a parameter regime where two-body losses are strongly suppressed and the extended mean-field description of dilute molecular Bose-Einstein condensates is justified. We calculate the collective excitations and show that intriguingly, supersolidity in quasi-two-dimensional confinement emerges as a stripe phase even at small values of microwave ellipticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：perturbation theory（微扰论）、derive the effective interaction potential（推导有效相互作用势）、validate it against coupled channel calculations（与耦合通道计算对比验证）、extended mean-field description（扩展平均场描述）。；研究对象：极性分子体系。具体涉及：通过静电场和椭圆偏振微波场屏蔽方案抑制短程损耗的极性分子，以及稀薄分子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的集体激发和准二维束缚下的条纹相（超固态）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短程损耗被强抑制的参数区间内，稀薄分子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的扩展平均场描述成立；在准二维束缚下，即使微波椭圆率很小，也会出现条纹相，即超固态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短程损耗被强抑制的参数区间内，稀薄分子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的扩展平均场描述成立；在准二维束缚下，即使微波椭圆率很小，也会出现条纹相，即超固态。；创新点：揭示了在静电场与椭圆偏振微波场联合屏蔽方案下，准二维极性分子体系中即使微波椭圆率很小也能涌现出条纹相（超固态），并给出了有效相互作用势的微扰论推导及其与耦合通道计算的验证。
papers.method_zh: 微扰论推导有效相互作用势，并与耦合通道计算进行验证对比；在确认两体损耗被强抑制、扩展平均场描述适用的参数区间后，计算了集体激发。

papers.title: Disordered ground states in one-dimensional exactly solvable fluids
papers.abstract: One-dimensional fluids of classical hard-core particles of diameter $a$, interacting in pairs via a soft repulsive (monotonically decreasing) potential of finite range $\varphi(x)=\varepsilon \left[ (a'-x)/(a'-a)\right]^{1/ν}$ $(a\le x\le a')$ with real positive parameters $\varepsilon$ and $ν$, are studied in an isothermal-isobaric ensemble. If $a'\le 2a$, the pairwise interactions are reduced to nearest-neighbour interactions, which allows for an exact solution of the thermal equilibrium. We focus on the $T\to 0$ ground states, specifically on the equation of state for the mean distance between nearest neighbours $l_0$ and the pair correlation function $g_0(x)$. If $\varphi(x)$ is concave $(ν\ge 1)$, there exists an ``incompressibility'' pressure $p_i=\varepsilon/(a'-a)$ such that the ground state is an equidistant chain of particles with spacing $l_0=a'$ for $0<p<p_i$ and with spacing $l_0=a$ for $p>p_i$. If $ν>1$ (strict concavity), the ground state at $p=p_i$ is disordered with $l_0=\left[ νa +(ν-1)a'\right]/(2ν-1)$ and $g_0(x)$ being a superposition of weighted Dirac delta functions over discrete positions. If $ν=1$ (linear ramp), the ground state at $p=p_i$ is disordered with $l_0=(a+a')/2$ and the continuous $g_0(x)$ is a superposition of Heaviside step functions multiplied by polynomials in $x$. The isothermal susceptibility at $T=0$ is nonzero for concave $\varphi(x)$ ($ν\ge 1$) at $p=p_i$ and, therefore, the corresponding disordered ground states are non-hyperuniform, i.e., they resemble disordered fluids at nonzero temperatures. It turns out that pair correlation functions of disordered ground states, which occur only at a single pressure $p_i$, extend their predictive power to thermodynamic states at nonzero temperatures over a wider range of pressures around $p_i$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：exactly solvable fluids、isothermal-isobaric ensemble、exact solution、equation of state、pair correlation function，均为解析理论推导，摘要中未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：一维经典硬核粒子流体体系。粒子直径为 $a$，粒子间通过有限程软排斥势 $\varphi(x)=\varepsilon[(a'-x)/(a'-a)]^{1/\nu}$（$a\le x\le a'$）成对相互作用，参数 $\varepsilon$、$\nu$ 为实正数。研究其在等温等压系综下的 $T\to 0$ 基态，具体关注最近邻平均距离 $l_0$ 的状态方程和配对关联函数 $g_0(x)$。

u=1$（线性斜坡）时 $l_0=(a+a')/2$，连续 $g_0(x)$ 为 Heaviside 阶跃函数乘以 $x$ 的多项式之叠加。$T=0$ 时等温磁化率在 $p=p_i$ 处非零，因此相应的无序基态是非超均匀的，类似于非零温度下的无序流体。此外，无序基态的配对关联函数（仅出现在单一压强 $p_i$ 处）其预测能力可延伸至 $p_i$ 附近更宽压强范围内的非零温度热力学态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但可归纳为：发现了一维可精确求解流体中由压强 $p_i$ 驱动的无序基态，并给出了凹势（$
u\ge 1$）下无序基态的解析形式（Dirac delta 叠加或 Heaviside 阶跃函数叠加），指出这些无序基态是非超均匀的，且其配对关联函数可预测 $p_i$ 附近非零温度的热力学行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：一维经典硬核粒子流体的精确解析求解，在等温等压系综下处理最近邻相互作用模型，推导 $T\to 0$ 基态的状态方程和配对关联函数。摘要未明确说明是否使用数值验证或模拟。

papers.title: Orientational order on non-orientable domains
papers.abstract: We study the statistical properties of passive and active many-body systems with orientational degrees of freedom on non-orientable domains. By rephrasing topological constraints as non-local symmetry relations on an orientable double-cover, we show that non-orientability eliminates global rotational soft modes without acting like an external field. In a passive XY model, this results in topological caging, where orientational fluctuations that exhibit conventional diffusive behavior on a torus saturate on a Klein bottle to a finite value that we compute exactly in the thermodynamic limit. In models of active self-propelled particles with orientational degrees of freedom, topological caging persists despite continuously changing interaction neighborhoods. In an active Ising spin model, non-orientability enforces the coexistence of ordered anti-parallel domains with vanishing global polar order, a state that is absent on orientable domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中使用“We study the statistical properties”“we show”“we compute exactly in the thermodynamic limit”等表述，属于理论建模与解析推导，未涉及具体实验或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：具有取向自由度的被动和主动多体系统在不可定向（non-orientable）区域上的统计性质。具体包括：被动 XY 模型、主动自驱动粒子模型、主动 Ising 自旋模型，以及克莱因瓶（Klein bottle）等不可定向流形上的取向有序问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不可定向性通过消除全局旋转软模（而非充当外场）导致“拓扑囚禁”（topological caging）：在被动 XY 模型中，取向涨落在环面上呈常规扩散行为，但在克莱因瓶上饱和为有限值（作者在热力学极限下精确计算了该值）；在主动自驱动粒子模型中拓扑囚禁持续存在；在主动 Ising 模型中，不可定向性强制有序反平行畴共存且全局极化序消失，该状态在可定向区域上不存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不可定向性通过消除全局旋转软模（而非充当外场）导致“拓扑囚禁”（topological caging）：在被动 XY 模型中，取向涨落在环面上呈常规扩散行为，但在克莱因瓶上饱和为有限值（作者在热力学极限下精确计算了该值）；在主动自驱动粒子模型中拓扑囚禁持续存在；在主动 Ising 模型中，不可定向性强制有序反平行畴共存且全局极化序消失，该状态在可定向区域上不存在。；创新点：首次系统研究了不可定向区域上具有取向自由度的被动与主动多体系统的统计物理，揭示了不可定向性通过非局域对称关系消除全局旋转软模的机制，提出了“拓扑囚禁”这一新概念，并发现不可定向性可在主动 Ising 模型中强制产生可定向区域上不存在的反平行畴共存态。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将拓扑约束重新表述为可定向双覆盖（orientable double-cover）上的非局域对称关系；对被动 XY 模型在热力学极限下进行精确解析计算；对主动自驱动粒子模型和主动 Ising 模型进行理论分析。摘要未明确说明是否使用数值模拟或具体场论方法。

papers.title: Correlation enhanced altermagnetism mediated by spin-lattice coupling in CrSb
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, making them promising platforms for spintronic applications. While the symmetry and multipolar origins of nonrelativistic altermagnetic spin splitting (NRASS) are well established, the role of electronic correlations and spin-lattice coupling (SLC) in controlling NRASS remain unexplored. In particular, SLC provides a direct pathway for tuning altermagnetism through lattice degrees of freedom. Here we first investigate the role of electronic correlations on altermagnetic strength in NiAs-type material CrSb using density functional theory (DFT), DFT+$U$, and dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). We find that increasing electronic correlations substantially enhance NRASS and drive the stabilization of an incommensurate spin-spiral (SS) state, while dynamical correlations further amplify the spin splitting through quasiparticle renormalization of the Cr-$3d$ states. We find that the NRASS remains 12.5\% larger in DFT+DMFT than in DFT. By evaluating SLC in next step, we establish its direct connection to the evolution of NRASS and identify SLC as a microscopic descriptor between electronic correlation and enhanced altermagnetism in CrSb. Investigating it in another NiAs-type compound MnTe, we show that the SLC-NRASS correlation is generic across AMs and establish SLC as a microscopic descriptor of altermagnetic strength. Our results provide a unified framework for tuning altermagnetism through the interplay between the electronic correlations and lattice degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键依据：使用 DFT、DFT+U、DMFT 等第一性原理与多体计算方法，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：NiAs 型化合物 CrSb 中的非相对论交变磁性自旋劈裂（NRASS），以及电子关联和自旋-晶格耦合（SLC）对其的调控；并将 SLC-NRASS 关联推广到另一 NiAs 型化合物 MnTe。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增强电子关联会显著增强 NRASS，并驱动体系稳定到非公度自旋螺旋（SS）态；动力学关联通过 Cr-3d 态准粒子重整化进一步放大自旋劈裂，使 DFT+DMFT 下的 NRASS 比 DFT 大约 12.5%。SLC 被确立为连接电子关联与交变磁性增强的微观描述符，且该 SLC-NRASS 关联在交变磁体中具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增强电子关联会显著增强 NRASS，并驱动体系稳定到非公度自旋螺旋（SS）态；动力学关联通过 Cr-3d 态准粒子重整化进一步放大自旋劈裂，使 DFT+DMFT 下的 NRASS 比 DFT 大约 12.5%。SLC 被确立为连接电子关联与交变磁性增强的微观描述符，且该 SLC-NRASS 关联在交变磁体中具有普适性。；创新点：已有研究主要关注 NRASS 的对称性与多极起源，而本文首次探讨电子关联与自旋-晶格耦合在调控 NRASS 中的作用，提出 SLC 可作为交变磁性强度的微观描述符，并给出通过电子关联与晶格自由度相互作用调控交变磁性的统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）、DFT+U、动力学平均场理论（DMFT）；通过评估自旋-晶格耦合（SLC）建立其与 NRASS 演化的联系；并在 MnTe 中验证 SLC-NRASS 关联的普适性。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Characterization of Macroscopic Chaos Emerging from the Chemical Master Equation
papers.abstract: Open chemical reaction networks exhibit stochastic concentration dynamics at finite system sizes, whereas their macroscopic limit is governed by deterministic rate equations that can display chaos. In this Letter, we show theoretically that a rate of information loss constructed from two-time mutual information recovers the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy in the deterministic limit. We verify this result through numerical simulations of a Markov jump process for a three-species system involving seven reactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼含数值验证）。判断依据的关键词：show theoretically、verify this result through numerical simulations。核心是理论推导，数值模拟用于验证。；研究对象：有限系统尺寸下的开放化学反应网络（open chemical reaction networks）的随机浓度动力学，以及其宏观极限下的确定性速率方程所展现的混沌现象。具体数值验证体系为含七种反应的三组分（three-species）系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由双时互信息（two-time mutual information）构造的信息损失率，在确定性极限下可以恢复出Kolmogorov-Sinai熵，从而将随机化学主方程框架与宏观确定性混沌之间建立了信息论联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由双时互信息（two-time mutual information）构造的信息损失率，在确定性极限下可以恢复出Kolmogorov-Sinai熵，从而将随机化学主方程框架与宏观确定性混沌之间建立了信息论联系。；创新点：提出了从双时互信息构造信息损失率的方法，并证明其在确定性极限下可恢复Kolmogorov-Sinai熵，从而为宏观混沌提供了信息论刻画，并将其与有限尺寸随机化学动力学联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为化学主方程（Chemical Master Equation）描述的马尔可夫跳跃过程（Markov jump process），并结合确定性速率方程；采用双时互信息构造信息损失率；通过三组分七反应系统的马尔可夫跳跃过程数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Universal sampling of spin systems across quenched disorder
papers.abstract: Statistical physics extracts macroscopic laws by averaging over the many microscopic degrees of freedom of a system. Disordered systems demand a second and far harder average, one over the quenched randomness itself. The classic analytical routes, the replica and cavity methods, become uncontrolled outside mean-field or tree-like limits, and conventional numerical algorithms like parallel tempering require expensive, independent equilibration for every disorder realization. In this work, we introduce a universal neural variational framework that amortizes inference across the disorder ensemble, eliminating both the need for per-instance Markov chain equilibration and the cost of retraining instance-specific variational ansatzes. Built on an encoder-decoder Transformer architecture, after training once, it produces an explicit approximation to the Boltzmann distribution given previously unseen disorder realizations without further optimization. We validate this framework on 2D Edwards-Anderson models, and apply it to the random-bond Ising model, successfully capturing the Binder cumulant crossings near the Nishimori multicritical point. These results shift the object of variational inference from the single instance to the disorder ensemble, opening a route to frustrated many-body systems where instance-by-instance computation is prohibitive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（数值与机器学习方法发展为主）。关键依据：提出“神经变分框架”、基于“encoder-decoder Transformer 架构”、在“2D Edwards-Anderson 模型”和“random-bond Ising 模型”上做数值验证，摘要中未涉及任何实验测量。；研究对象：无序自旋系统，具体为二维 Edwards-Anderson 模型和随机键 Ising 模型（random-bond Ising model），关注淬火无序（quenched disorder）系综下的统计物理与相变行为，包括 Nishimori 多临界点附近的 Binder 累积量交叉。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个可跨无序系综“摊销”推断的通用神经变分框架，训练一次后即可对未见过的无序实现直接给出 Boltzmann 分布的显式近似，无需逐实例的 Markov 链平衡或重新训练；在 2D Edwards-Anderson 模型上得到验证，并在随机键 Ising 模型中成功捕捉到 Nishimori 多临界点附近的 Binder 累积量交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个可跨无序系综“摊销”推断的通用神经变分框架，训练一次后即可对未见过的无序实现直接给出 Boltzmann 分布的显式近似，无需逐实例的 Markov 链平衡或重新训练；在 2D Edwards-Anderson 模型上得到验证，并在随机键 Ising 模型中成功捕捉到 Nishimori 多临界点附近的 Binder 累积量交叉。；创新点：将变分推断的对象从“单个无序实例”转变为“整个无序系综”：一次训练即可泛化到未见的无序实现，从而同时消除逐实例 Markov 链平衡的开销和逐实例重新训练变分拟设的成本，为逐实例计算不可行的阻挫多体系统提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 神经变分推断（neural variational framework），采用 encoder-decoder Transformer 架构，对无序系综进行摊销式（amortized）推断；与需要逐无序实现独立平衡的并行回火（parallel tempering）等传统数值算法相对照。摘要未明确说明具体的训练细节、网络规模、采样器或变分目标函数形式。

papers.title: Interface-Controlled Phase Stability in Polymorphic HfO$_2$ Revealed by Machine-Learning Atomistic Simulations
papers.abstract: HfO$_2$ exhibits rich polymorphism, and competition among different phases underpins many of its functional properties. Yet bulk free-energy relations alone cannot explain phase selection at mixed-phase boundaries, where interface orientation and structural continuity constrain collective rearrangements. Here, using machine-learning atomistic simulations and a Hf-centered local phase classification scheme, we show that crystallographic interface matching redirects phase competition and accessible transformation pathways. The M(100)/T(100) interface remains pinned as an M/T mixture throughout 3 ns simulations from 300 to 1800 K. M/PO, M/AO, and PO/AO interfaces retain two-phase coexistence up to 900 K, whereas all T/PO interfaces become PO-dominant. At 1800 K, all non-M interfaces become T-dominant, while M-containing interfaces retain a monoclinic majority. Nudged elastic band calculations reveal lower-barrier routes through interface states. For M(100)$\rightarrow$T(100), the interface-mediated route in a long cell ($\sim$12 nm) yields a barrier of 136.03 meV/f.u., 29.2 % lower than the direct route in a short cell ($\sim$3 nm). This difference is associated with sequential phase-front motion absent from the short cell. These results identify phase boundaries as active participants in phase stability and transformation and establish interface orientation and crystallographic matching as variables for stabilizing metastable polymorphs and directing phase conversion in HfO$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键判断依据：使用 machine-learning atomistic simulations、nudged elastic band calculations 等计算方法，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：多晶型 HfO₂ 中的相稳定性与相变，特别是混合相界面（M/T、M/PO、M/AO、PO/AO、T/PO 等界面）对相竞争和相变路径的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶体学界面匹配会重新引导相竞争和可及的相变路径：M(100)/T(100) 界面在 300–1800 K 的 3 ns 模拟中始终保持 M/T 混合态；M/PO、M/AO、PO/AO 界面在 900 K 以下保持两相共存，而所有 T/PO 界面均变为 PO 主导；1800 K 时所有非 M 界面变为 T 主导，含 M 界面保持单斜相为主。界面介导的 M(100)→T(100) 转变路径势垒为 136.03 meV/f.u.，比短胞直接路径低 29.2%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶体学界面匹配会重新引导相竞争和可及的相变路径：M(100)/T(100) 界面在 300–1800 K 的 3 ns 模拟中始终保持 M/T 混合态；M/PO、M/AO、PO/AO 界面在 900 K 以下保持两相共存，而所有 T/PO 界面均变为 PO 主导；1800 K 时所有非 M 界面变为 T 主导，含 M 界面保持单斜相为主。界面介导的 M(100)→T(100) 转变路径势垒为 136.03 meV/f.u.，比短胞直接路径低 29.2%。；创新点：将相界面识别为相稳定性和相变的主动参与者，而非被动边界；提出界面取向和晶体学匹配可作为稳定亚稳多晶型和调控 HfO₂ 相变的变量；揭示了界面介导路径通过序贯相前沿运动降低转变势垒的机制。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习原子尺度模拟（machine-learning atomistic simulations）、以 Hf 为中心的局域相分类方案（Hf-centered local phase classification scheme）、NEB（nudged elastic band）计算。模拟温度范围 300–1800 K，时长 3 ns；对比长胞（约 12 nm）与短胞（约 3 nm）。

papers.title: Optically induced metallic state with persistent monoclinic symmetry in NdNiO$_3$
papers.abstract: Understanding whether electronic and structural order remain coupled under nonequilibrium conditions is a central challenge in correlated materials. Here, we simultaneously track metallicity and symmetry across the photoinduced insulator-to-metal transition in NdNiO$_3$ using time-resolved optical reflectivity and symmetry-sensitive second-harmonic generation. We find that metallic reflectivity emerges at significantly lower excitation fluence than restoration of the orthorhombic high-temperature symmetry. As a result, optical excitation stabilizes a metastable state that combines the reflectivity of the metallic phase with the monoclinic symmetry of the insulating phase, revealing an optically induced monoclinic metal. Only at substantially higher fluences does the symmetry fully recover to that of the high-temperature phase. These results demonstrate a nonequilibrium decoupling of metallicity and structural symmetry and establish simultaneous multiprobe spectroscopy as a powerful approach for identifying emergent phases in correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“time-resolved optical reflectivity”“symmetry-sensitive second-harmonic generation”等实验探测手段，属于超快光谱实验研究。；研究对象：NdNiO₃中的光诱导绝缘体-金属相变，具体关注该相变过程中金属性与结构对称性（正交高温相对称性 vs 单斜绝缘相对称性）是否保持耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光激发可以在远低于恢复正交高温对称性所需注量的条件下诱导出金属性反射率，从而稳定一种兼具金属相反射率和绝缘相单斜对称性的亚稳态，即“光诱导单斜金属”；只有在更高注量下结构对称性才完全恢复到高温相。这表明非平衡条件下金属性与结构对称性发生了解耦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光激发可以在远低于恢复正交高温对称性所需注量的条件下诱导出金属性反射率，从而稳定一种兼具金属相反射率和绝缘相单斜对称性的亚稳态，即“光诱导单斜金属”；只有在更高注量下结构对称性才完全恢复到高温相。这表明非平衡条件下金属性与结构对称性发生了解耦。；创新点：首次在NdNiO₃中同时追踪光诱导相变过程中的金属性与结构对称性，发现二者在非平衡条件下解耦，并识别出一种兼具金属反射率与单斜对称性的亚稳态“单斜金属”相；同时展示了多探针联合光谱方法在关联材料中识别涌现相的能力。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨光学反射率测量（追踪金属性）与对称性敏感的二阶谐波产生（SHG）测量（追踪结构对称性），对NdNiO₃光诱导绝缘体-金属相变进行同时多探针探测。

papers.title: Kinetics of ferritin crystal formation and melting in acoustically levitated droplets
papers.abstract: Understanding protein crystallization pathways is essential for controlling crystallization in structural biology, materials science, and pharmaceutical applications. Classical nucleation theory does not fully capture crystallization processes for several proteins, including ferritin. Here, we combine acoustic levitation with small- and wide-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS and WAXS) to monitor ferritin crystallization in evaporating aqueous polyethylene glycol (PEG) solutions. Acoustic levitation rapidly drives the droplets through a broad range of protein and polymer concentrations, enabling time-resolved measurements of crystallization during evaporation. The scattering data show that ferritin crystals form during evaporation and subsequently lose their crystalline order upon further dehydration. Varying the PEG molecular weight switches between distinct crystallization pathways: one dominated by attractive protein-protein interactions and another dominated by repulsive interactions and excluded-volume effects. Furthermore, we find that lower molecular weight PEG (1000 g/mol) suppresses the dehydration-induced loss of crystalline order observed for higher molecular weight PEG (6000 g/mol), providing a simple strategy for improving protein crystal stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中明确使用“combine acoustic levitation with SAXS and WAXS to monitor”“time-resolved measurements”等实验手段描述，属于实验研究。；研究对象：铁蛋白（ferritin）在蒸发中的聚乙二醇（PEG）水溶液液滴内的结晶与熔化（即脱水导致晶体有序性丧失）过程，以及不同PEG分子量对结晶路径和晶体稳定性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁蛋白晶体在液滴蒸发过程中形成，但进一步脱水会使其失去晶体有序性；不同PEG分子量可切换结晶路径（分别由吸引性蛋白-蛋白相互作用主导，或由排斥相互作用与排除体积效应主导）；较低分子量PEG（1000 g/mol）能抑制较高分子量PEG（6000 g/mol）中观察到的脱水诱导晶体有序性丧失，从而提高蛋白晶体稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁蛋白晶体在液滴蒸发过程中形成，但进一步脱水会使其失去晶体有序性；不同PEG分子量可切换结晶路径（分别由吸引性蛋白-蛋白相互作用主导，或由排斥相互作用与排除体积效应主导）；较低分子量PEG（1000 g/mol）能抑制较高分子量PEG（6000 g/mol）中观察到的脱水诱导晶体有序性丧失，从而提高蛋白晶体稳定性。；创新点：利用声悬浮快速驱动液滴经历广泛的蛋白和聚合物浓度范围，实现蒸发过程中结晶的时间分辨监测；揭示了PEG分子量可切换铁蛋白结晶路径，并发现低分子量PEG可抑制脱水诱导的晶体有序性丧失，提供了一种改善蛋白晶体稳定性的简单策略。
papers.method_zh: 将声悬浮（acoustic levitation）与小角/广角X射线散射（SAXS和WAXS）结合，对蒸发中的铁蛋白-PEG水溶液液滴进行时间分辨测量；通过改变PEG分子量比较不同结晶路径。

papers.title: Enhancing charge stability of Ge quantum well heterostructures via SiGe layer composition engineering
papers.abstract: Composition modulation is a powerful technique for designing materials with tailored properties, fueling the development of advanced semiconductor devices. In this work, we have implemented this technique into Ge quantum well heterostructures, offering a promising avenue to address the critical challenge of charge stability in spin qubit devices. Harnessing the atomic-scale precision of molecular beam epitaxy, we have engineered the band structure of the SiGe top barrier via graded composition modulation, thereby reducing charge accumulation states at the SiGe-dielectric interface and strengthening the effective confinement to the hole gases in the Ge quantum wells. The enhanced charge stability of composition-modulated SiGe/Ge quantum well heterostructures is confirmed in Hall devices, featuring an enlarged stable gate voltage range. We have further fabricated quantum dot devices from the composition-modulated SiGe/Ge quantum well heterostructures and observed remarkably low charge noise with an averaged amplitude of $0.46\,\mathrm{μeV}/\mathrm{\sqrt{Hz}}$ at $1\,\mathrm{Hz}$---the lowest reported value for Ge quantum wells grown on silicon. This exceptional charge stability of the quantum dots persists in the few-hole regime, with no observable voltage drift over $\sim$hours. With reduced charge noise and enhanced energy stability, composition-modulated SiGe/Ge heterostructures exhibit significant potential for applications in building high-performance quantum devices, including spin qubits with a long coherence time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：使用了分子束外延（MBE）生长样品、制备了 Hall 器件和量子点器件、进行了输运/电荷噪声测量，属于以实验为主的工作。；研究对象：Ge 量子阱异质结（SiGe/Ge 量子阱异质结构），具体关注其电荷稳定性，以及基于该异质结构制备的 Hall 器件和量子点器件中的电荷噪声与栅压稳定性，面向自旋量子比特应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过梯度组分调制 SiGe 顶势垒的能带结构，减少了 SiGe-介电层界面的电荷积累态并增强了对 Ge 量子阱中空穴气的有效限制，从而扩大了稳定栅压范围；基于该异质结构的量子点在 1 Hz 处获得平均幅度为 0.46 μeV/√Hz 的低电荷噪声，为已报道的硅上生长 Ge 量子阱中的最低值，且在少空穴区持续约数小时无可观测电压漂移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过梯度组分调制 SiGe 顶势垒的能带结构，减少了 SiGe-介电层界面的电荷积累态并增强了对 Ge 量子阱中空穴气的有效限制，从而扩大了稳定栅压范围；基于该异质结构的量子点在 1 Hz 处获得平均幅度为 0.46 μeV/√Hz 的低电荷噪声，为已报道的硅上生长 Ge 量子阱中的最低值，且在少空穴区持续约数小时无可观测电压漂移。；创新点：将组分调制技术引入 Ge 量子阱异质结构的 SiGe 顶势垒能带工程，以提升自旋量子比特器件的电荷稳定性；所实现的量子点电荷噪声（1 Hz 处 0.46 μeV/√Hz）为硅上生长 Ge 量子阱中已报道的最低值，并在少空穴区表现出长时间无电压漂移的稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（MBE）以原子级精度生长组分梯度调制的 SiGe/Ge 量子阱异质结构；通过 Hall 器件测量稳定栅压范围；进一步制备量子点器件并测量电荷噪声及电压漂移。

papers.title: Interplay of spin-lattice and electronic coupling far above Neel ordering in 2D antiferromagnetic CrPS4 and its interface manifestation
papers.abstract: A short-range spin correlation driven, strongly intercoupled spin-phonon-electronic state far above TN (~38K) is identified in the low dimensional van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS4. Temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy reveals spin-phonon coupling persisting up to T*~120K, concomitant with local lattice distortion. The setting of vibronic progression in photoluminescence spectra suggests the strengthening of electron-phonon coupling around T*. Furthermore, both the electrical transport and optoelectronic response also change significantly at T*. The results indicate that spin-phonon coupling above TN in CrPS4 originates from local lattice distortion induced by short range magnetic correlations which in turn enhances the electron-phonon interaction. Furthermore, using a CrPS4/In2Se3 heterostructure, we demonstrate that the anomaly associated with the coupled degrees of freedom in CrPS4 also influences the adjacent In2Se3 layer. The lattice dynamics of In2Se3 is significantly modified across the magnetic anomaly of CrPS4, and the coupled dynamics is observed at T*. These interfacial manifestation opens up new possibilities for achieving correlated multifunctionalities in artificially designed heterostructure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：温度依赖拉曼光谱、光致发光光谱、电输运与光电响应测量，以及 CrPS4/In2Se3 异质结构的界面表征，均为实验手段。；研究对象：低维范德华反铁磁体 CrPS4（奈尔温度 TN 约 38 K），以及 CrPS4/In2Se3 异质结。关注的是远高于 TN 的短程自旋关联驱动的自旋-声子-电子强耦合态及其界面表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 CrPS4 中，远高于 TN（约 38 K）直至 T*~120 K 存在由短程磁关联驱动的强耦合自旋-声子-电子态：自旋-声子耦合持续到 T*，伴随局域晶格畸变，并在 T* 附近增强电子-声子耦合，同时电输运和光电响应也发生显著变化。此外，该耦合自由度异常还能影响相邻的 In2Se3 层，在 CrPS4 磁异常处 In2Se3 的晶格动力学被显著改变，并在 T* 处观察到耦合动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 CrPS4 中，远高于 TN（约 38 K）直至 T*~120 K 存在由短程磁关联驱动的强耦合自旋-声子-电子态：自旋-声子耦合持续到 T*，伴随局域晶格畸变，并在 T* 附近增强电子-声子耦合，同时电输运和光电响应也发生显著变化。此外，该耦合自由度异常还能影响相邻的 In2Se3 层，在 CrPS4 磁异常处 In2Se3 的晶格动力学被显著改变，并在 T* 处观察到耦合动力学。；创新点：揭示了 CrPS4 中远高于 TN 的短程磁关联驱动的自旋-声子-电子强耦合态，并证明该耦合自由度异常可通过异质结界面传递至相邻 In2Se3 层，为人工设计异质结构中的关联多功能性提供了新可能。
papers.method_zh: 温度依赖拉曼光谱（探测自旋-声子耦合与晶格畸变）、光致发光光谱（观测振动进展，判断电子-声子耦合增强）、电输运测量、光电响应测量，以及 CrPS4/In2Se3 异质结构的界面晶格动力学表征。

papers.title: Fingerprints of Excitonic Collective Modes in the Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
papers.abstract: The two-dimensional homogeneous electron gas (2D HEG) is a prototype system of fundamental interest that can be realized experimentally over a wide range of densities. Here, we investigate its collective charge excitations at low densities, using time-dependent density functional theory. We demonstrate that, beyond traditional plasmons, new collective excitonic modes emerge for a Wigner-Seitz radius larger than $r_{\mathrm s} \approx 1$. These excitonic modes leave characteristic fingerprints in experimentally accessible quantities, namely, asymmetric peak structures in the loss function and very strong Friedel-like oscillations in the static linear density response that increase when the system approaches a regime of instability. Indeed, at low enough densities the collective modes cross the zero energy axis, indicating an instability of the paramagnetic 2D HEG towards the formation of a charge-density-wave phase with excitonic origin. These findings provide valuable insights for the experimental detection of excitonic collective modes in tunable 2D electron systems and contribute to the fundamental understanding of many-body effects in low-density electron gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：使用 time-dependent density functional theory（含时密度泛函理论）进行研究，属于理论计算工作，摘要中未提及任何实验测量。；研究对象：二维均匀电子气（2D HEG）在低密度下的集体电荷激发，以及其向电荷密度波相的不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Wigner-Seitz 半径大于约 1 时，除传统等离激元外会出现新的集体激子模式；这些模式在损失函数中表现为不对称峰结构，在静态线性密度响应中表现为强烈的 Friedel 型振荡；在足够低密度下集体模式穿过零能轴，表明顺磁 2D HEG 存在由激子驱动的向电荷密度波相的不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Wigner-Seitz 半径大于约 1 时，除传统等离激元外会出现新的集体激子模式；这些模式在损失函数中表现为不对称峰结构，在静态线性密度响应中表现为强烈的 Friedel 型振荡；在足够低密度下集体模式穿过零能轴，表明顺磁 2D HEG 存在由激子驱动的向电荷密度波相的不稳定性。；创新点：在传统等离激元之外，预言了 2D HEG 中新的集体激子模式，并指出其在实验可及量（损失函数的不对称峰、静态线性密度响应中的 Friedel 型振荡）中的特征指纹，同时揭示了该激子模式导致电荷密度波不稳定性的机制。
papers.method_zh: 含时密度泛函理论（time-dependent density functional theory）。

papers.title: High-Performance Scaled P-Type SnOx Transistor by Atomic Layer Deposition with CFET Integration
papers.abstract: The development of high-performance p-type oxide semiconductors is essential for realizing complementary logic for monolithic 3D integration, yet p-type oxide semiconductors still exhibit substantially inferior performance compared with their n-type counterparts. In this work, we demonstrate high-performance p-type SnOx transistors by atomic layer deposition (ALD), as back-end-of-line compatible devices for monolithic 3D integration. The SnOx transistors exhibit high field-effect mobility of 6.9 cm2/Vs, low subthreshold swing (SS) of 185 mV/dec, decent on/off ratio (ION/IOFF) of 1.8*104 and high bias stability. By scaling the channel length down to 80 nm, a high on-current of 38.7 mA/mm at VDS of -1 V is achieved. It is understood that precursor and reaction engineering to suppress Sn4+ component in SnOx film are the key for performance enhancement. Furthermore, a complementary field-effect transistor with ALD SnOx p-FET vertically stacking on ALD In2O3 n-FET is also demonstrated, achieving maximum voltage gain of 21 V/V at VDD of 4 V. These findings suggest ALD SnOx as a promising candidate for scaled high-performance BEOL p-type transistors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：atomic layer deposition (ALD)、demonstrate、fabricated devices、electrical characterization（field-effect mobility、SS、on/off ratio、bias stability、on-current、voltage gain 等均为实验测量指标）。；研究对象：p型氧化锡（SnOx）薄膜晶体管，以及由 ALD SnOx p-FET 与 ALD In2O3 n-FET 垂直堆叠构成的互补场效应晶体管（CFET）。属于后段制程（BEOL）兼容的 p 型氧化物半导体器件体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过 ALD 制备的 p 型 SnOx 晶体管实现了较高的场效应迁移率（6.9 cm²/Vs）、低亚阈值摆幅（185 mV/dec）、较好的开关比（1.8×10⁴）和高的偏压稳定性；将沟道长度缩小至 80 nm 时，在 VDS = -1 V 下获得 38.7 mA/mm 的高开态电流。前驱体与反应工程抑制 SnOx 薄膜中的 Sn⁴⁺ 组分是性能提升的关键。此外，ALD SnOx p-FET 与 ALD In2O3 n-FET 垂直堆叠的 CFET 在 VDD = 4 V 下实现了最大电压增益 21 V/V。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过 ALD 制备的 p 型 SnOx 晶体管实现了较高的场效应迁移率（6.9 cm²/Vs）、低亚阈值摆幅（185 mV/dec）、较好的开关比（1.8×10⁴）和高的偏压稳定性；将沟道长度缩小至 80 nm 时，在 VDS = -1 V 下获得 38.7 mA/mm 的高开态电流。前驱体与反应工程抑制 SnOx 薄膜中的 Sn⁴⁺ 组分是性能提升的关键。此外，ALD SnOx p-FET 与 ALD In2O3 n-FET 垂直堆叠的 CFET 在 VDD = 4 V 下实现了最大电压增益 21 V/V。；创新点：首次（据摘要表述）展示通过 ALD 制备的高性能 p 型 SnOx 晶体管作为 BEOL 兼容器件用于单片三维集成；通过前驱体与反应工程抑制 Sn⁴⁺ 实现性能增强；实现了沟道长度缩至 80 nm 的按比例缩小器件并获得高开态电流；并演示了 ALD SnOx p-FET 与 ALD In2O3 n-FET 垂直堆叠的 CFET 集成，获得 21 V/V 的电压增益。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子层沉积（ALD）制备 SnOx 薄膜及晶体管器件；通过前驱体和反应工程调控薄膜中 Sn⁴⁺ 含量；对器件进行电学表征（场效应迁移率、亚阈值摆幅、开关比、偏压稳定性、开态电流等）；并将 ALD SnOx p-FET 与 ALD In2O3 n-FET 垂直堆叠集成 CFET 并测量电压增益。摘要未明确说明是否使用其他表征手段（如 XRD、XPS 等）。

papers.title: A Phase-Field Study of Desiccation Crack Pattern Maturation under Drying-Wetting Cycles
papers.abstract: The characteristic intersection angle of the desiccation crack relaxes from near \ang{90} toward \ang{120} under repeated drying--wetting cycles. However, the theoretical understanding of this relaxation is insufficient, especially the modeling of the drying--wetting cycles. Here we introduce a phase-field model of desiccation fracture, extending the model proposed in previous studies by adding crack healing and a scar effect left by past cracks. By repeating drying--wetting cycles in a finite element simulation, we find that the angle distribution develops a growing peak near \ang{120} as the cycle number increases, consistent with experiments. The standard deviation of the intersection angle from \ang{120} relaxes exponentially with a characteristic time of about 2.85 cycles. These results are consistent with experiments, except that the characteristic time is slightly smaller than the experimental value. Crack energy dominates the total energy and also relaxes exponentially with nearly the same characteristic cycle as the angle relaxation. This decay is driven mainly by a shortening of the effective crack length rather than a change in effective fracture toughness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：phase-field model（相场模型）、finite element simulation（有限元模拟）、repeating drying–wetting cycles in a finite element simulation。；研究对象：干燥裂纹（desiccation crack）在反复干湿循环下的裂纹图案成熟过程，具体关注裂纹交叉角从接近90°向120°松弛的现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着干湿循环次数增加，交叉角分布逐渐在120°附近形成一个增长的峰，与实验一致；交叉角偏离120°的标准差以约2.85个循环的特征时间指数松弛。裂纹能量主导总能量，并以几乎相同的特征循环数指数衰减，这种衰减主要由有效裂纹长度缩短驱动，而非有效断裂韧性变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着干湿循环次数增加，交叉角分布逐渐在120°附近形成一个增长的峰，与实验一致；交叉角偏离120°的标准差以约2.85个循环的特征时间指数松弛。裂纹能量主导总能量，并以几乎相同的特征循环数指数衰减，这种衰减主要由有效裂纹长度缩短驱动，而非有效断裂韧性变化。；创新点：在已有相场干燥断裂模型基础上引入了裂纹愈合和疤痕效应，从而能够模拟反复干湿循环过程，并定量复现实验中交叉角向120°松弛的趋势及指数松弛特征。
papers.method_zh: 相场干燥断裂模型（phase-field model of desiccation fracture），在已有模型基础上加入裂纹愈合（crack healing）和过去裂纹留下的疤痕效应（scar effect），并通过有限元模拟（finite element simulation）重复干湿循环。

papers.title: Transdimensional quantum droplets in an optically trapped Bose mixture
papers.abstract: We study quantum droplets in a symmetric two-component Bose mixture with interspecies $p$-wave interactions and a two-dimensional transverse optical lattice. The lattice drives a crossover from an anisotropic three-dimensional gas to weakly coupled one-dimensional tubes. We calculate the ground-state energy and quantum depletion at the Gaussian level and derive their limiting forms. At $y=g_{12}/g=-0.95$, where the bare mean field is repulsive and no free-space droplet exists, the calculated bulk equation of state supports a self-bound minimum across the crossover: a negative lattice contribution at order $n^{2}$ supplies the attraction in the three-dimensional regime, and attractive fluctuations do so in the quasi-one-dimensional regime, with the intermediate, transdimensional range described quantitatively by neither limit. The interspecies $p$-wave interaction modifies only the spin branch. In the parameter range studied, increasing its strength lowers the equilibrium density across the crossover, consistently with a weakening of the induced binding.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用“We study”“We calculate”“at the Gaussian level”“derive their limiting forms”等，表明工作以理论建模与计算为主，未提及具体实验测量。；研究对象：对称双组分玻色混合物中的量子液滴，体系具有种间 p 波相互作用，并处于二维横向光学晶格中。该晶格驱动体系从各向异性三维气体到弱耦合一维管道的渡越（crossover）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 g₁₂/g = −0.95（裸平均场为排斥、自由空间不存在液滴）时，计算得到的体态方程在三维到准一维的渡越过程中支持自束缚极小值：三维区域由 n² 阶的负晶格贡献提供吸引力，准一维区域由吸引涨落提供吸引力，而中间“跨维度”区域无法由任一极限定量描述。种间 p 波相互作用仅修改自旋分支；在所研究参数范围内，增强其强度会降低整个渡越过程中的平衡密度，与诱导束缚减弱一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 g₁₂/g = −0.95（裸平均场为排斥、自由空间不存在液滴）时，计算得到的体态方程在三维到准一维的渡越过程中支持自束缚极小值：三维区域由 n² 阶的负晶格贡献提供吸引力，准一维区域由吸引涨落提供吸引力，而中间“跨维度”区域无法由任一极限定量描述。种间 p 波相互作用仅修改自旋分支；在所研究参数范围内，增强其强度会降低整个渡越过程中的平衡密度，与诱导束缚减弱一致。；创新点：研究了具有种间 p 波相互作用和二维横向光学晶格的对称双组分玻色混合物中的量子液滴，揭示了从三维到准一维渡越过程中的“跨维度”量子液滴行为，并指出在裸平均场排斥且无自由空间液滴的参数下，晶格贡献与涨落效应可分别在不同维度极限下提供吸引力，而中间区域无法由任一极限定量描述。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 在 Gaussian 级别计算基态能量和量子耗尽，并推导其极限形式；通过体态方程分析自束缚极小值。摘要未明确说明是否使用其他数值方法（如 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程数值求解、量子蒙特卡罗等）。

papers.title: Slow Dynamics and the Geometry of Jammed Packings
papers.abstract: Saddle points in the energy landscape of granular packings dominate the discrete steepest descent dynamics and ultimately determine the path that an out of mechanical equilibrium packing will follow and the resulting stable minimum that it will find. The saddle points that ultimately determine the resulting minima tend to be low-index saddle points. For models with an analytic energy landscape, such as the $p$-spin model, the steepest descent minimization path is affected by higher-index saddle points, which pull the system towards saddle points of decreasing index before arriving at the minima. Here, we examine the steepest descent minimization path of granular packings and compare them to the $p$-spin model. We show that the granular packing steepest descent minimization paths act like their smooth energy landscape counterparts and get attracted by saddle points. The index versus time curves for all models follow a shifted, stretched exponential. We further show that the shape parameter for the granular packings is unchanged when the energy landscape is modified to become analytic (Gaussian potential in a harmonic well) or non-local (Mari-Krzakala-Kurchan). The $p$-spin, on the other hand, has a significantly larger shape parameter. The reason is not due to the dimensionality, packing fraction, nonanalyticity, or the locality of the Hamiltonian of the models. The exact reason for the discrepancy in the shape parameter is \st{still} an unsolved mystery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：steepest descent minimization、energy landscape、模型比较（granular packings 与 p-spin model）、Gaussian potential、Mari-Krzakala-Kurchan 等，均为数值模拟与理论分析用语，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：颗粒堆积（granular packings）的陡降最小化路径及其能量景观中的鞍点，并与 p-spin 模型的对应行为进行对比。属于非平衡态/玻璃态与阻塞（jamming）相关的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 颗粒堆积的陡降最小化路径与光滑能量景观体系类似，会被鞍点吸引；所有模型的鞍点指数随时间变化曲线都遵循平移的拉伸指数（shifted stretched exponential）。颗粒堆积的形状参数在能量景观被改为解析形式（谐振子势中的高斯势）或非局域形式（Mari-Krzakala-Kurchan）时保持不变，而 p-spin 模型的形状参数显著更大；该差异的原因并非来自维度、堆积分数、非解析性或哈密顿量的局域性，摘要明确指出其确切原因仍是未解之谜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：颗粒堆积的陡降最小化路径与光滑能量景观体系类似，会被鞍点吸引；所有模型的鞍点指数随时间变化曲线都遵循平移的拉伸指数（shifted stretched exponential）。颗粒堆积的形状参数在能量景观被改为解析形式（谐振子势中的高斯势）或非局域形式（Mari-Krzakala-Kurchan）时保持不变，而 p-spin 模型的形状参数显著更大；该差异的原因并非来自维度、堆积分数、非解析性或哈密顿量的局域性，摘要明确指出其确切原因仍是未解之谜。；创新点：将颗粒堆积的陡降动力学路径与 p-spin 模型进行系统对比，揭示颗粒堆积路径同样受鞍点吸引，并发现鞍点指数-时间曲线普遍遵循平移拉伸指数；进一步通过改变能量景观的解析性与局域性，排除了维度、堆积分数、非解析性和哈密顿量局域性作为形状参数差异的来源，指出该差异的确切原因仍待解决。
papers.method_zh: 对颗粒堆积进行陡降最小化（steepest descent minimization）数值计算，追踪其路径与鞍点指数随时间的演化；与 p-spin 模型的对应行为进行比较；并通过修改能量景观（采用谐振子势中的高斯势使其解析化，以及采用 Mari-Krzakala-Kurchan 势使其非局域化）来检验形状参数的变化。摘要未明确说明具体的数值算法细节或体系尺寸。

papers.title: In-plane magnetic field control of anomalous Hall response enabled by magnetic anisotropy engineering
papers.abstract: Engineering magnetic anisotropy provides a powerful route to control magnetization orientation and unlock emerging functionalities in opto-spintronic and current-driven devices. Beyond its role in magnetization reversal, the effective anisotropy can strongly influence the magnetotransport response, offering an additional degree of freedom to tune new device functionalities. In this work, we report a magnetotransport study of a ferrimagnetic [Tb/Co]$_{\times 5}$ multilayer grown with a Tb thickness gradient, whose wedge-shaped tilts the uniaxial anisotropy axis slightly away from the film normal. Anomalous Hall resistivity measurements from 80 K to 300 K reveal a spin reorientation transition, while the angular dependence of the magnetotransport responses exposes the crucial role of the tilted anisotropy. A simplified macrospin model reproduces the full angular response across the transition and shows that the observed anomalous Hall effect when the in-plane magnetic field is applied originates from the tilt of the uniaxial anisotropy axis, which supplies a built-in symmetry-breaking mechanism, enabling in-plane field control over the out-of-plane anomalous Hall response, sign included. These findings establish tilted magnetic anisotropy as a promising route toward Hall effect-based sensor applications and highlight Tb/Co multilayers as a versatile platform for anisotropy-engineered spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论建模）。关键依据：摘要中出现“magnetotransport study”“measurements”“grown with a Tb thickness gradient”等实验性表述，同时包含“simplified macrospin model reproduces”的理论建模部分，但主体为实验研究。；研究对象：具有Tb厚度梯度的亚铁磁[ Tb/Co ]×5多层膜体系，研究其磁各向异性、自旋重取向转变以及异常霍尔效应等磁输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Tb厚度梯度使单轴各向异性轴略微偏离薄膜法线方向，该倾斜各向异性提供了内禀的对称性破缺机制，使得面内磁场能够控制面外异常霍尔响应（包括其符号）；同时在该体系中观察到自旋重取向转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Tb厚度梯度使单轴各向异性轴略微偏离薄膜法线方向，该倾斜各向异性提供了内禀的对称性破缺机制，使得面内磁场能够控制面外异常霍尔响应（包括其符号）；同时在该体系中观察到自旋重取向转变。；创新点：揭示了倾斜磁各向异性可作为内禀对称性破缺机制，实现面内磁场对面外异常霍尔响应（含符号）的调控，将倾斜各向异性确立为霍尔效应传感器应用的潜在途径，并表明Tb/Co多层膜是各向异性工程自旋电子器件的通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 在具有Tb厚度梯度的[ Tb/Co ]×5多层膜上进行磁输运测量（异常霍尔电阻率测量，温度范围80 K至300 K），测量磁输运响应的角度依赖性；并采用简化宏自旋模型（macrospin model）再现整个角度响应。

papers.title: A substrate booster for P-type 2D ferromagnetic semiconductor
papers.abstract: Spin transistors with its both charge and spin properties tuned via electrostatic gating are believed capable for widespread use, which however have proven challenging due to the extreme rareness of their physical base -- magnetic semiconductors. The latter are limited within very few systems including diluted magnetic semiconductors (DMS) and two-dimensional ferromagnetic semiconductors (2D-FMS), and known to suffer from inadequate gate-tunability of their electric and/or magnetic properties. Here, we show a substrate engineering paradigm by interfacing few-layered Cr$_{2}$Ge$_{2}$Te$_{6}$ (FL-CGT) with an antiferromagnetic insulator CrOCl. Owing to the subtle interfacial charge transfer couplings, CGT can be drastically turned from an ambipolar semiconductor into a high performance P-type semiconductor. When cooled below the Curie temperature, the ON-OFF ratio in such substrate-boosted FMS field-effect transistor (FET) reaches 10$^{5}$ with its coercive field $H_{c}$ of magnetic hysteresis loop tunable by a factor of more than 200$\%$, enabling {gate-assisted magnetic switching in the prototype semiconducting spin transistor architecture}. A crossover from critical power-law scaling to a dual power-law behaviour under heavy hole doping was further observed. Our findings {signify} an efficient interfacial charge transfer and electrically modulated magnetic anisotropy energy supported by calculations. This high performance P-type FMS-FET system suggests that active substrate-boosting paradigm might be a powerful path for the investigation of future gate-tunable spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章，兼有计算支持。判断依据的关键词：interfacing、field-effect transistor (FET)、ON-OFF ratio、coercive field 测量、observed，以及“supported by calculations”。；研究对象：少层 Cr₂Ge₂Te₆（FL-CGT）与反铁磁绝缘体 CrOCl 构成的界面/异质结体系，以及基于该体系构建的 P 型二维铁磁半导体场效应晶体管（FMS-FET）及其磁输运与磁各向异性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将少层 CGT 与反铁磁绝缘体 CrOCl 界面接触，利用界面电荷转移耦合，可将原本双极性半导体 CGT 显著转变为高性能 P 型半导体；在居里温度以下，该 FMS-FET 的开关比达到 10⁵，磁滞回线的矫顽场 H_c 可调范围超过 200%，并实现了栅极辅助的磁翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将少层 CGT 与反铁磁绝缘体 CrOCl 界面接触，利用界面电荷转移耦合，可将原本双极性半导体 CGT 显著转变为高性能 P 型半导体；在居里温度以下，该 FMS-FET 的开关比达到 10⁵，磁滞回线的矫顽场 H_c 可调范围超过 200%，并实现了栅极辅助的磁翻转。；创新点：提出一种“衬底增强（substrate engineering/boosting）”范式，即通过与反铁磁绝缘体 CrOCl 界面化，利用界面电荷转移耦合将双极性 CGT 转变为高性能 P 型铁磁半导体，并显著增强栅极对电学和磁学性质（如开关比和矫顽场）的调控能力，从而推进可栅极调控的自旋电子器件原型。
papers.method_zh: 制备少层 Cr₂Ge₂Te₆/CrOCl 界面并构建 FMS-FET 器件，进行电学输运与磁学测量（包括开关比、磁滞回线、矫顽场、栅极调控磁翻转），并观察重空穴掺杂下从临界幂律标度到双幂律行为的转变；同时结合计算支持界面电荷转移与电调制磁各向异性能的解释。摘要未明确说明具体计算框架（如是否为 DFT+U 等）。

papers.title: U-Shaped Fermi-Level Dependence of Point-Defect Aggregation Enthalpy in Silicon
papers.abstract: Point defects govern the electronic and structural behavior of silicon, yet their configuration and energy depend on both the charge state and the Fermi level (EF). Using an unbiased global structure search with first-principles calculations, we screened more than 1,500 candidate structures, covering intrinsic defects and C, H, O, N, P, and B impurities in charge states from -2 to +2. The reaction enthalpy of defect aggregation depends on EF in a U shape, being strongest where the net charge transferred during the reaction vanishes and weaker toward both band edges. This U arises because complexes are more charge-neutral than their isolated constituents, so the net charge transfer changes sign across the gap. The point where this sign change occurs is set by the transition levels of the specific defects. For typical reactions, the driving force is tunable by 0.3-0.5 eV, which shifts the equilibrium complex concentration by five to eight orders of magnitude at room temperature. Our results make the Fermi level a practical lever for defect engineering in as-grown and irradiated silicon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：unbiased global structure search、first-principles calculations、screened more than 1,500 candidate structures。；研究对象：硅中的点缺陷，包括本征缺陷以及 C、H、O、N、P、B 杂质，研究其聚集反应焓随费米能级的变化规律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 缺陷聚集的反应焓随费米能级呈 U 形依赖：在反应过程中净电荷转移为零处最强，向两个能带边缘方向减弱。其原因是复合体比其孤立组成成分更趋于电荷中性，因此净电荷转移在带隙中改变符号，符号改变点由具体缺陷的跃迁能级决定。对典型反应，驱动力可调范围为 0.3–0.5 eV，在室温下可使平衡复合体浓度变化五到八个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：缺陷聚集的反应焓随费米能级呈 U 形依赖：在反应过程中净电荷转移为零处最强，向两个能带边缘方向减弱。其原因是复合体比其孤立组成成分更趋于电荷中性，因此净电荷转移在带隙中改变符号，符号改变点由具体缺陷的跃迁能级决定。对典型反应，驱动力可调范围为 0.3–0.5 eV，在室温下可使平衡复合体浓度变化五到八个数量级。；创新点：揭示了缺陷聚集反应焓随费米能级的 U 形依赖关系，并阐明其物理起源（复合体较孤立成分更趋电荷中性导致净电荷转移在带隙中变号），表明费米能级可作为硅缺陷工程的实用调控手段。
papers.method_zh: 无偏全局结构搜索结合第一性原理计算，筛选了超过 1,500 个候选结构，覆盖电荷态从 -2 到 +2 的本征缺陷及 C、H、O、N、P、B 杂质。

papers.title: Silicon Solar Cell Design for >30% Efficiency via Singlet Fission
papers.abstract: Singlet fission (SF) materials convert high-energy photons into multiple charge carriers, providing a route to exceed the efficiency limits of single-junction silicon solar cells without many of the complexities of multi-junction tandem designs. Following the first demonstration of an SF-enhanced silicon solar cell in 2025, there is a need to understand how SF materials can be effectively integrated into high-efficiency industrial silicon devices and translated from proof of concept to a manufacturable technology. Using coupled optical and electrical simulations, we assess the efficiency potential of several industrially relevant silicon cell architectures combined with SF materials. Interdigitated back-contact (IBC) cells offer the greatest potential for improvement due to unrestricted front-surface access and can achieve efficiencies exceeding 33%. However, performance is highly sensitive to front-surface passivation quality. Appropriate silicon design, particularly controlled surface doping and fixed interfacial charge, can mitigate recombination losses and relax passivation requirements for ultra-thin exciton-transfer layers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：“Using coupled optical and electrical simulations”（使用耦合的光学与电学模拟），摘要中未提及任何实验制备或测量。；研究对象：将单线态裂分（Singlet Fission, SF）材料与工业相关硅太阳能电池架构（特别是叉指背接触 IBC 电池）相结合的器件体系，研究其效率潜力及表面钝化对性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: IBC 硅电池结合 SF 材料因前表面无遮挡而具有最大效率提升潜力，可实现超过 33% 的效率；但性能对前表面钝化质量高度敏感，合理的硅设计（尤其是受控表面掺杂和固定界面电荷）可缓解复合损失并放宽对超薄激子转移层的钝化要求。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：IBC 硅电池结合 SF 材料因前表面无遮挡而具有最大效率提升潜力，可实现超过 33% 的效率；但性能对前表面钝化质量高度敏感，合理的硅设计（尤其是受控表面掺杂和固定界面电荷）可缓解复合损失并放宽对超薄激子转移层的钝化要求。；创新点：在 2025 年首次演示 SF 增强硅太阳能电池之后，本文通过耦合光学-电学模拟系统评估了多种工业相关硅电池架构与 SF 材料集成的效率潜力，指出 IBC 电池可实现 >33% 效率，并揭示了前表面钝化质量的关键影响以及通过硅设计放宽钝化要求的途径，为 SF 技术从概念验证向可制造技术转化提供了设计指导。
papers.method_zh: 耦合的光学与电学模拟（coupled optical and electrical simulations），用于评估多种工业相关硅电池架构与 SF 材料组合的效率潜力。摘要未明确说明具体的模拟软件或理论框架。

papers.title: A model of grain growth in UN integrating molecular dynamics, phase-field modeling, and uncertainty quantification
papers.abstract: Grain growth kinetics and grain-boundary (GB) properties in uranium mononitride (UN) are investigated through an integrated multiscale framework combining molecular dynamics (MD), phase-field modeling, and surrogate-assisted uncertainty quantification. MD simulations yield GB energies for 27 symmetric tilt boundaries from 0--2000~K, which are consistent with available DFT values. The average GB energy is nearly temperature-independent below 1000~K and increases at higher temperatures. A mechanistic pore-drag model applied to the only available grain growth dataset for actinide nitrides yields a mobility reduction factor of $s \approx 0.93$--$0.99$, statistically indistinguishable from unity, confirming that pore drag is negligible under the experimental conditions. The intrinsic GB mobility is therefore extracted directly from the effective mobility, yielding $M_0 = 2.05\times10^{-15}$~m$^4$/(J$\cdot$s) and $Q_M = 0.89$~eV. Phase-field simulations conducted from 1500--2000~K confirm normal curvature-driven grain growth, with grain size distributions converging to the Hillert-like form. A surrogate-assisted global sensitivity analysis---combining principal component analysis, Gaussian process regression, and Sobol decomposition---reveals that the mobility prefactor $M_0$ dominates output variance at all times, followed by the activation energy $Q_M$, while the GB energy $γ$ contributes minimally. These results establish the first quantitative grain growth framework for UN and identify the reduction of uncertainty in $M_0$ and $Q_M$ as the highest-priority target for future experimental efforts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（混合多尺度计算框架）。判断依据的关键词：molecular dynamics、phase-field modeling、surrogate-assisted uncertainty quantification、DFT 对比、Sobol 分解——全文为模拟与建模工作，摘要中未提及任何实验测量。；研究对象：铀单氮化物（UN）中的晶粒生长动力学与晶界（GB）性质。具体包括 27 个对称倾斜晶界的晶界能、晶界迁移率、孔隙拖曳效应，以及 1500–2000 K 下的晶粒生长行为与晶粒尺寸分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在现有实验条件下孔隙拖曳可忽略（拖曳因子 s≈0.93–0.99，与 1 在统计上不可区分），因此可直接提取本征晶界迁移率 M₀ = 2.05×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴/(J·s)、Q_M = 0.89 eV；相场模拟确认 1500–2000 K 下为正常曲率驱动晶粒生长，晶粒尺寸分布收敛至类 Hillert 形式；全局敏感性分析表明 M₀ 主导输出方差，其次为 Q_M，晶界能 γ 贡献极小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在现有实验条件下孔隙拖曳可忽略（拖曳因子 s≈0.93–0.99，与 1 在统计上不可区分），因此可直接提取本征晶界迁移率 M₀ = 2.05×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴/(J·s)、Q_M = 0.89 eV；相场模拟确认 1500–2000 K 下为正常曲率驱动晶粒生长，晶粒尺寸分布收敛至类 Hillert 形式；全局敏感性分析表明 M₀ 主导输出方差，其次为 Q_M，晶界能 γ 贡献极小。；创新点：建立了 UN 的首个定量晶粒生长框架，并明确指出降低 M₀ 与 Q_M 的不确定度是未来实验的最高优先目标。摘要未突出说明该框架相对于其他材料体系已有方法的普适性方法学新意。
papers.method_zh: 多尺度集成框架：(1) 分子动力学（MD）计算 0–2000 K 下 27 个对称倾斜晶界的晶界能，并与已有 DFT 值对比；(2) 机理型孔隙拖曳模型拟合锕系氮化物唯一可用的晶粒生长数据集；(3) 相场模拟（1500–2000 K）；(4) 代理模型辅助的全局敏感性分析，结合主成分分析（PCA）、高斯过程回归与 Sobol 分解。

papers.title: Measuring chiral phonons
papers.abstract: Chiral phonons are quantized vibrations where the atomic motion in a solid breaks improper rotation symmetries. In many cases, chiral phonons possess angular momenta and are therefore selective to circularly polarized light. Both fundamental and applied research efforts on chiral phonons have been gaining increasing attention owing to their importance in a variety of fields including spintronics, spin-selective chemical reactions, thermal transport, quantum information processing and biosensing, where the bi-directional spin-lattice coupling enabled by chiral phonons can be harnessed in new ways, and potentially lead to new functionalities. Thus far, the studies of chiral phonons across diverse materials platforms have evolved largely independently within these fields, but the experimental techniques are often interrelated. In this perspective, we present a detailed description, as well as advantages and disadvantages of the current approaches for experimentally measuring chiral phonons in chiral and achiral materials. We conclude with a discussion of new methods for measuring chiral phonons. Ultimately, this work seeks to offer an experimental guide for systematically investigating the properties of chiral phonons in various materials systems and applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/展望（Perspective）文章。判断依据的关键词：“In this perspective, we present a detailed description”“offer an experimental guide”。摘要未报告新的实验或计算结果，属于对现有实验方法的梳理与展望。；研究对象：手性声子（chiral phonons）——即固体中原子振动破坏非真旋转对称性的量子化振动模式，以及其在手性和非手性材料中的实验测量方法。涉及的应用领域包括自旋电子学、自旋选择性化学反应、热输运、量子信息处理和生物传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未报告单一的新物理结论，而是指出：手性声子通常具有角动量，因而对圆偏振光具有选择性；手性声子可实现双向自旋-晶格耦合，有望带来新功能。文章系统总结了当前测量手性声子的实验方法的优缺点，并讨论了新的测量方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未报告单一的新物理结论，而是指出：手性声子通常具有角动量，因而对圆偏振光具有选择性；手性声子可实现双向自旋-晶格耦合，有望带来新功能。文章系统总结了当前测量手性声子的实验方法的优缺点，并讨论了新的测量方法。；创新点：主要新意在于：首次（据摘要表述）系统性地将分散于不同材料平台和领域的手性声子实验测量方法加以整合，给出各方法的优缺点对比，并提出新测量方法的讨论，最终为系统研究各类材料体系中的手性声子提供一份实验指南。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或理论框架，仅说明本文是对当前手性声子实验测量方法的详细描述与评述（perspective），并讨论了新测量方法。摘要未列出具体技术名称（如 ARPES、拉曼等）。

papers.title: Emergence of spin-orbit coupling among spin, atomic orbital, and Bloch dynamics in Janus double-transition-metal MXenes
papers.abstract: We found a spin-orbit coupling to cause a simultaneous correlation among three degrees of freedom, the electronic spin, orbital, and Bloch dynamics in an investigation into the electronic structure of Janus double-transition-metal MXenes, Mo$_2$HfC$_2$OS and W$_2$HfC$_2$OS. In this paper, it is also revealed that the spin-orbit coupling causes a staggered spin configuration with a trigonal pattern around the $Γ$ point near the insulating gap. We developed a reduced Hamiltonian describing the electronic states and show that the spin-orbit coupling cannot be equated with conventional forms for a single electron in solids, LS, Rashba, and Dresselhaus couplings, even in the approximation under the low-energy and small wave number condition. Because of the intrinsic shape of the conduction band, a trigonally alternating spin-momentum locking emerges with the spin axis perpendicular to the layer plane. The theoretical analysis shows that these Janus materials can provide a platform for exploring the spin-related phenomena due to the trigonal spin-momentum locking other than Rashba and Dresselhaus types.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：investigation into the electronic structure、developed a reduced Hamiltonian、theoretical analysis。摘要未明确说明使用了何种具体计算方法（如DFT等），但整体以理论分析为主。；研究对象：Janus双过渡金属MXenes材料，具体为Mo₂HfC₂OS和W₂HfC₂OS，研究其电子结构中的自旋-轨道耦合现象，以及电子自旋、原子轨道和Bloch动力学三个自由度之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合在这类Janus双过渡金属MXenes中引起自旋、轨道和Bloch动力学三个自由度的同时关联；在绝缘带隙附近Γ点周围出现三角图案的交错自旋构型；由于导带的内禀形状，产生三角交替的自旋-动量锁定，且自旋轴垂直于层平面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道耦合在这类Janus双过渡金属MXenes中引起自旋、轨道和Bloch动力学三个自由度的同时关联；在绝缘带隙附近Γ点周围出现三角图案的交错自旋构型；由于导带的内禀形状，产生三角交替的自旋-动量锁定，且自旋轴垂直于层平面。；创新点：揭示了该体系中自旋-轨道耦合不能等同于传统单电子固体中的LS耦合、Rashba耦合或Dresselhaus耦合，即使在低能小波数近似下也不成立；提出了三角自旋-动量锁定这一新机制，指出该类Janus材料可作为探索Rashba和Dresselhaus类型之外自旋相关现象的平台。
papers.method_zh: 发展了描述电子态的约化哈密顿量（reduced Hamiltonian），并在低能和小波数近似条件下分析了自旋-轨道耦合的形式。摘要未明确说明是否使用了第一性原理计算（如DFT）等具体数值方法。

papers.title: Irrationality Measure Controls Long-Wavelength Charge Fluctuations in Quasiperiodic Systems
papers.abstract: Quasiperiodic order is characterized by irrational frequencies whose rational approximability known as irrationality measure defines distinct arithmetic classes. We establish that this arithmetic classification has direct physical consequences for long-wavelength charge fluctuations. In translation-covariant quasiperiodic systems, the infrared scaling of charge fluctuation is governed by the interplay between the irrationality exponent of irrational frequency and the large-harmonic decay of the hull charge profile: the latter determines the available charge weight, while the former controls how efficiently that weight is transferred to the infrared. Consequently, all algebraic irrational frequencies share the same arithmetic scaling, whereas exceptionally well-approximable transcendental frequencies can exhibit strongly enhanced infrared fluctuation scaling. We further prove that occupied states separated from the Fermi level by a gap stable throughout the hull contribute only an analytic infrared background, leaving the nontrivial scaling to near-Fermi states. Our results extend to general translation-covariant multi-frequency quasiperiodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中无任何实验或数值计算关键词，通篇为“establish”“prove”“governed by”等理论推导与证明性表述，属于解析理论工作。；研究对象：平移协变（translation-covariant）的准周期系统，包括单频及多频准周期体系，研究其中的长波长电荷涨落（long-wavelength charge fluctuations）及其红外标度行为，涉及无理频率、hull 电荷分布、费米面附近态与能隙等概念。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准周期系统的长波长电荷涨落红外标度由两个因素共同决定：无理频率的无理性指数（irrationality exponent）控制电荷权重向红外转移的效率，而 hull 电荷分布的大谐波衰减决定可用电荷权重；因此所有代数无理频率具有相同的算术标度，而可被异常好逼近的超越无理频率则表现出显著增强的红外涨落标度。此外，被贯穿 hull 稳定的能隙与费米能级隔开的占据态只贡献解析的红外背景，非平凡标度仅来自近费米态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准周期系统的长波长电荷涨落红外标度由两个因素共同决定：无理频率的无理性指数（irrationality exponent）控制电荷权重向红外转移的效率，而 hull 电荷分布的大谐波衰减决定可用电荷权重；因此所有代数无理频率具有相同的算术标度，而可被异常好逼近的超越无理频率则表现出显著增强的红外涨落标度。此外，被贯穿 hull 稳定的能隙与费米能级隔开的占据态只贡献解析的红外背景，非平凡标度仅来自近费米态。；创新点：首次建立无理频率的算术分类（无理性测度）与准周期系统长波长电荷涨落红外标度之间的直接物理联系，揭示了无理性指数与 hull 电荷分布大谐波衰减之间的相互作用机制，并证明能隙内占据态仅贡献解析背景、非平凡标度仅源于近费米态，且结果可推广至多频准周期系统。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为平移协变准周期系统中的解析推导与证明，基于无理频率的有理逼近性（无理性测度/无理性指数）的算术分类，结合 hull 电荷分布的大谐波衰减分析，对电荷涨落的红外标度进行论证，并推广至一般多频准周期系统。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体数值计算或模型哈密顿量。

papers.title: Hyperspin Ferromagnets
papers.abstract: The behavior of spin quantum in k-space is key to identifying altermagnets (AMs) as the third kind of fundamental collinear magnetism. In contrast, non-collinear magnets,though abundant in nature,lack well-defined spin quantum numbers, and the resulting spin textures are often highly complex, which limits their potential for next-generation spintronic applications. Here we propose hyperspin, which lives in a higher-dimensional space, to address these drawbacks. Through analyzing the commutation relations between spin and Hamiltonian for a class of non-collinear magnets, we reveal it is a hyperspin, rather than the usual spin, that commutes with Hamiltonian. Unexpectedly, these non-collinear magnets should also show collinear spin-split bands in k-space like collinear AMs. We therefore classify such non-collinear magnets as hyperspin altermagnets (HAMs), as opposed to the usual collinear AMs. Our theory elucidates the fundamental physics of AMs and HAMs and provides a framework for exploring the wide range of non-collinear magnets that may possess other kinds of conserved quantities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“propose hyperspin”“analyzing the commutation relations”“Our theory elucidates”等理论构建与推导类表述，未提及任何实验测量或数值计算细节。；研究对象：一类非共线磁体（non-collinear magnets）中的自旋量子行为与能带自旋劈裂现象，以及由此提出的“超自旋铁磁体”（hyperspin ferromagnets）和“超自旋交替磁体”（hyperspin altermagnets, HAMs）概念。摘要未明确说明具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一类非共线磁体，与哈密顿量对易的不是通常的自旋，而是生活在更高维空间中的“超自旋”（hyperspin）；这类非共线磁体因此也会像共线交替磁体（AMs）一样，在k空间表现出共线的自旋劈裂能带，作者将其归类为“超自旋交替磁体”（HAMs）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一类非共线磁体，与哈密顿量对易的不是通常的自旋，而是生活在更高维空间中的“超自旋”（hyperspin）；这类非共线磁体因此也会像共线交替磁体（AMs）一样，在k空间表现出共线的自旋劈裂能带，作者将其归类为“超自旋交替磁体”（HAMs）。；创新点：提出“超自旋”（hyperspin）这一生活于更高维空间的新概念，指出在一类非共线磁体中与哈密顿量对易的是超自旋而非通常自旋；由此预言非共线磁体也可呈现类似共线AMs的共线自旋劈裂能带，并将其分类为“超自旋交替磁体”（HAMs），从而为探索具有其他类型守恒量的非共线磁体提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析一类非共线磁体中自旋与哈密顿量之间的对易关系（commutation relations）进行理论推导。摘要未明确说明是否使用了具体计算方法（如DFT等）或实验手段。

papers.title: Competing Interlayer Loop Currents and Superconductivity in the Bilayer $t$-$J_\perp$-$V$ Model
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of high-$T_c$ superconductivity in pressurized and thin-film bilayer nickelates, featuring a strong interlayer exchange coupling, and their potential similarities with cuprate superconductors, has made this a very active topic in condensed matter physics. In the present paper we study the strongly correlated one-orbital ($d_{x^2-y^2}$) bilayer $t$-$J_\perp$-$V$ model for nickelates, where $V$ denotes the Coulomb interactions, using a controlled large-$N$ expansion at and beyond the mean-field level. Focusing on the out-of-plane spin exchange interaction ($J_\perp$), we find that it triggers both out-of-plane $s$-wave superconductivity and an out-of-plane bond-order phase ($z$-BOP) instability. The $z$-BOP gives rise to a complex $z$-axis hopping dominated by its imaginary component, which drives out-of-plane currents and induces in-plane ones, spontaneously forming on the vertical plaquettes a loop-current state that breaks time-reversal symmetry. Competition between this loop-current phase and superconductivity yields a dome-shaped superconducting region, with optimal superconductivity occurring near the $z$-BOP quantum critical point. The resulting phase diagram features a pure loop-current region, a low-doping coexistence phase, a pure superconducting state at higher doping, and a correlated metallic state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：使用“controlled large-$N$ expansion at and beyond the mean-field level”进行研究，属于理论/计算物理研究，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：双层镍酸盐体系，具体为强关联单轨道（$d_{x^2-y^2}$）双层 $t$-$J_\perp$-$V$ 模型，其中 $J_\perp$ 为层间自旋交换相互作用，$V$ 为库仑相互作用。研究关注该体系中层间环流与超导的竞争关系及相关相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 层间自旋交换相互作用 $J_\perp$ 同时驱动面外 $s$-波超导和面外键序相（$z$-BOP）不稳定性；$z$-BOP 产生以虚部为主的复数 $z$ 轴跃迁，驱动面外电流并诱导面内电流，自发形成破坏时间反演对称性的环流态。环流相与超导的竞争产生穹顶形超导区域，最优超导出现在 $z$-BOP 量子临界点附近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：层间自旋交换相互作用 $J_\perp$ 同时驱动面外 $s$-波超导和面外键序相（$z$-BOP）不稳定性；$z$-BOP 产生以虚部为主的复数 $z$ 轴跃迁，驱动面外电流并诱导面内电流，自发形成破坏时间反演对称性的环流态。环流相与超导的竞争产生穹顶形超导区域，最优超导出现在 $z$-BOP 量子临界点附近。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但摘要指出该工作聚焦于层间自旋交换相互作用 $J_\perp$ 所驱动的面外超导与面外键序相及其竞争关系，并给出了包含纯环流区、低掺杂共存相、高掺杂纯超导态和关联金属态的相图。
papers.method_zh: 采用受控的大-$N$ 展开方法，在平均场层次及超越平均场层次对双层 $t$-$J_\perp$-$V$ 模型进行研究。

papers.title: Controlling topology in flux-mismatched Hofstadter bilayers
papers.abstract: Stacked two-dimensional materials provide a promising platform for electrically controlling topological electronic states. However, tunneling between layers hybridizes their bands and removes the crossings needed to change topology. We show that this does not always have to be the case. Band crossings and associated Weyl points are topologically enforced in Hofstadter bilayers whose layers experience different magnetic fluxes. When resonant magnetic Bloch multiplets carry unequal Chern numbers, their projected tunneling is topologically obstructed and must vanish at isolated momenta. Sweeping the layer bias through these zeros creates synthetic Weyl monopoles in momentum-bias space that transfer the Chern mismatch. We demonstrate two consequences: a direct transition between insulating Chern phases and a reentrant compensated metal in which Lifshitz transitions bound the metallic window while internal Weyl events reconstruct the band topology. Consequently, the fixed-filling Hall response remains continuous and nonquantized even as integer Chern number is transferred between bands. Berry-flux, TKNN, and interface calculations independently verify the mechanism and its multichannel chiral signature. We outline realizations in Moire and anomalous-Hall heterostructures, establishing flux mismatch as an experimentally accessible route to electrically programmable Chern phases and chiral transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要中使用了“We show that”“topologically enforced”“We demonstrate”“calculations independently verify”等表述，并以理论机制推导和数值验证为主，未提及具体实验测量手段或样品制备，属于理论/计算类工作。；研究对象：具有不同磁通量的 Hofstadter 双层体系（flux-mismatched Hofstadter bilayers），即两层经历不同磁通的双层二维材料体系。研究的具体物理现象包括：能带交叉与 Weyl 点的拓扑保护、层间隧穿的拓扑阻碍、Chern 数转移、绝缘 Chern 相之间的直接相变、重入补偿金属、Lifshitz 转变、固定填充下的 Hall 响应，以及手性输运特征。摘要还提到在 Moiré 和反常 Hall 异质结中的可能实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当 Hofstadter 双层中两层经历不同磁通量时，能带交叉及相关的 Weyl 点会被拓扑强制保留，层间隧穿在特定动量处因拓扑阻碍而必须消失；通过扫描层间偏压穿过这些零点，可在动量-偏压空间中产生合成 Weyl 单极子，从而实现 Chern 数失配的转移。由此可产生两种后果：绝缘 Chern 相之间的直接相变，以及一种重入补偿金属——其中 Lifshitz 转变限定金属窗口，而内部 Weyl 事件重构能带拓扑；即使整数 Chern 数在能带间转移，固定填充下的 Hall 响应仍保持连续且非量子化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当 Hofstadter 双层中两层经历不同磁通量时，能带交叉及相关的 Weyl 点会被拓扑强制保留，层间隧穿在特定动量处因拓扑阻碍而必须消失；通过扫描层间偏压穿过这些零点，可在动量-偏压空间中产生合成 Weyl 单极子，从而实现 Chern 数失配的转移。由此可产生两种后果：绝缘 Chern 相之间的直接相变，以及一种重入补偿金属——其中 Lifshitz 转变限定金属窗口，而内部 Weyl 事件重构能带拓扑；即使整数 Chern 数在能带间转移，固定填充下的 Hall 响应仍保持连续且非量子化。；创新点：主要新意在于指出层间隧穿并不必然消除改变拓扑所需的能带交叉：在磁通失配的 Hofstadter 双层中，能带交叉和 Weyl 点可被拓扑强制保留，且当共振磁 Bloch 多重态携带不同 Chern 数时，其投影隧穿受到拓扑阻碍而必须在孤立动量处消失。通过层间偏压扫描可产生合成 Weyl 单极子并转移 Chern 失配，从而实现绝缘 Chern 相之间的直接相变和重入补偿金属，并揭示固定填充下 Hall 响应连续非量子化的现象。摘要还提出磁通失配可作为实验上可及的途径，用于电可编程 Chern 相和手性输运，并概述了在 Moiré 和反常 Hall 异质结中的实现方案。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或计算方法名称。文中提到使用了 Berry 通量（Berry-flux）、TKNN 和界面计算来独立验证机制及其多通道手性特征，但未给出更具体的数值方法或实验技术细节。

papers.title: Dissipation-induced nonlocal phase-coherent transport in a topological superconductor
papers.abstract: Nonlocal phase-coherent transport via Majorana bound states, so-called teleportation, requires Coulomb blockade to suppress local Andreev reflection. We show that dissipation can replace the need for Coulomb blockade. We study a Kitaev chain coupled to a Markovian bath and identify a regime where the magnitude of nonlocal conductance contribution reach the local one. In this regime, the lowest-energy subspace is maximally mixed, reminiscent of a directly-grounded nontrivial topological superconductor. Phase coherence is confirmed by Aharonov-Bohm oscillations. Our results establish dissipation as a tool for controlling quantum teleportation in Majorana systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Kitaev chain、Markovian bath、理论模型分析（无具体实验平台或材料合成描述）。；研究对象：拓扑超导体中的非局域相位相干输运现象，具体为Kitaev链与马尔可夫浴耦合的系统，涉及Majorana束缚态介导的量子隐形传态（teleportation）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 耗散可以替代库仑阻塞来抑制局域Andreev反射，从而实现非局域相位相干输运；在特定参数区间内，非局域电导贡献可达到与局域电导相当的量级，此时最低能量子空间处于最大混合态，类似于直接接地的非平庸拓扑超导体。相位相干性通过Aharonov-Bohm振荡得到确认。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：耗散可以替代库仑阻塞来抑制局域Andreev反射，从而实现非局域相位相干输运；在特定参数区间内，非局域电导贡献可达到与局域电导相当的量级，此时最低能量子空间处于最大混合态，类似于直接接地的非平庸拓扑超导体。相位相干性通过Aharonov-Bohm振荡得到确认。；创新点：首次提出耗散可以作为替代库仑阻塞的手段来实现Majorana系统中的非局域相位相干输运（量子隐形传态），建立了耗散作为控制Majorana系统量子隐形传态工具的新范式。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Kitaev链模型耦合马尔可夫浴（Markovian bath），分析非局域电导与局域电导的贡献，并通过Aharonov-Bohm振荡验证相位相干性。摘要未明确说明具体的数值计算方法（如DMRG、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: On the physical origins of switching diversity in Cu-embedded SiO$_x$ memristive devices
papers.abstract: Resistive switching devices with sub-stoichiometric SiO$_x$ and pancake-like Cu nanoparticles (Cu-PCs) exhibit distinct macroscopic current-voltage characteristics classified as capacitive or gradual (interface-type switching) and abrupt or resistive (filamentary-type switching), motivating an analysis of the microscopic processes underlying this diversity. It is proposed that the device defect landscape is largely shaped by two charged defect types, mobile oxygen vacancies and immobile Cu-related defects, whose distributions jointly govern interfacial and bulk transport. An effective one-dimensional cloud-in-a-cell simulation framework is employed to reproduce the phenomenological picture of both interface-type and filamentary-type switching by incorporating the dominant coupled ionic and electronic processes underlying these mechanisms. The model includes oxygen-vacancy drift-diffusion, Schottky-limited injection at the metal/oxide interfaces, and bulk trap-assisted transport via Poole-Frenkel conduction, with Cu-PCs near the top interface treated effectively. A simulation-based parametric study varying voltage stress, sweep rate, and oxide thickness is used to examine how these factors rebalance voltage partitioning and the spatiotemporal electric field distribution, thereby altering vacancy redistribution and the relative contributions of interface- and bulk-limited conduction. Using representative, physically motivated parameter sets informed by prior device-level studies, the simulations accurately reproduce the characteristic $I$-$V$ signatures of seven different experimentally observed switching responses. Overall, the findings help to link microscopic defect landscapes and transport processes to experimentally measured macroscopic responses within a single, self-consistent modeling framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（含建模与仿真）。判断依据关键词：proposed、simulation framework、model includes、parametric study、simulations reproduce。；研究对象：Cu 嵌入 SiO$_x$ 阻变存储器件（memristive devices）中阻变行为的多样性，即电容型/渐变型（界面型）与突变型/电阻型（丝状型）两类宏观 I-V 特性的微观起源；涉及氧空位与 Cu 相关缺陷、界面与体输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 器件的缺陷景观主要由两类带电缺陷（可动氧空位与不可动 Cu 相关缺陷）共同决定，其分布共同调控界面与体输运；通过包含耦合离子与电子过程的模型，可在单一自洽框架内再现界面型与丝状型两类阻变，并准确复现七种实验观测到的 I-V 特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：器件的缺陷景观主要由两类带电缺陷（可动氧空位与不可动 Cu 相关缺陷）共同决定，其分布共同调控界面与体输运；通过包含耦合离子与电子过程的模型，可在单一自洽框架内再现界面型与丝状型两类阻变，并准确复现七种实验观测到的 I-V 特征。；创新点：提出以两类带电缺陷（可动氧空位与不可动 Cu 相关缺陷）的分布共同塑造缺陷景观，并在单一自洽的一维 cloud-in-a-cell 模型中耦合氧空位漂移-扩散、Schottky 注入与 Poole-Frenkel 体输运，从而将微观缺陷景观与输运过程同实验宏观响应（七种开关响应）联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效一维 cloud-in-a-cell 仿真框架；模型包含氧空位漂移-扩散、金属/氧化物界面 Schottky 限制注入、以及通过 Poole-Frenkel 传导的体陷阱辅助输运，并将靠近顶界面的 Cu-PCs 作有效处理；并进行改变电压应力、扫描速率和氧化物厚度的参数化研究。

papers.title: Thermal Stability of Encapsulated Molecular Structures with Extended OH-Hydrogen-Bond Chains
papers.abstract: Using a coarse-grained model, we performed numerical simulations of the dynamics of linear molecular chains adsorbed on a flat substrate (on the surface of an h-BN crystal). It is shown that molecules containing benzene rings and hydroxyl groups in their structure can form stable hydrogen-bond chains OH$\cdots$OH$\cdots$OH. Such chains can be formed by phenol C$_6$H$_5$OH, 4-phenylphenol C$_6$H$_5$--C$_6$H$_4$OH, paracetamol CH$_3$C(O)NHC$_6$H$_4$OH, and 4-hydroxybenzanilide C$_6$H$_5$C(O)NHC$_6$H$_4$OH molecules. The dissociation of these chains occurs at temperatures above $T_1=190$, 240, 300, and 400K, respectively. Coating such molecular systems with a hexagonal boron nitride sheet (their van der Waals encapsulation) significantly enhances their thermal stability. Such encapsulated molecular structures retain hydrogen-bond chains up to temperatures of $T_2=470$, 800, 880, and 1140K, respectively. The simulations allow us to conclude that h-BN-encapsulated chains of these molecules can be used to create anhydrous proton-exchange membranes capable of operating at high temperatures. The most promising are encapsulated chains of paracetamol and 4-hydroxybenzanilide molecules.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：coarse-grained model、numerical simulations。摘要中未提及任何实验手段，全部结论来自数值模拟。；研究对象：吸附在 h-BN 晶体平坦衬底上的线性分子链，具体包括苯酚（C₆H₅OH）、4-苯基苯酚（C₆H₅–C₆H₄OH）、扑热息痛（CH₃C(O)NHC₆H₄OH）和 4-羟基苯甲酰苯胺（C₆H₅C(O)NHC₆H₄OH）四种含苯环与羟基的分子，以及它们所形成的 OH⋯OH⋯OH 氢键链；同时研究用六方氮化硼片对这些分子体系进行范德华封装后的热稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 含苯环和羟基的分子可在衬底上形成稳定的 OH⋯OH⋯OH 氢键链，四种分子的氢键链解离温度分别为 T₁ = 190、240、300、400 K；用 h-BN 片进行范德华封装后热稳定性显著提升，氢键链可保持到 T₂ = 470、800、880、1140 K。模拟表明 h-BN 封装的这类分子链可用于制备能在高温下工作的无水质子交换膜，其中扑热息痛和 4-羟基苯甲酰苯胺的封装链最有前景。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：含苯环和羟基的分子可在衬底上形成稳定的 OH⋯OH⋯OH 氢键链，四种分子的氢键链解离温度分别为 T₁ = 190、240、300、400 K；用 h-BN 片进行范德华封装后热稳定性显著提升，氢键链可保持到 T₂ = 470、800、880、1140 K。模拟表明 h-BN 封装的这类分子链可用于制备能在高温下工作的无水质子交换膜，其中扑热息痛和 4-羟基苯甲酰苯胺的封装链最有前景。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但可归纳出的新结果为：定量给出了四种具体分子氢键链的解离温度，并证明 h-BN 范德华封装能大幅提高其热稳定性，进而提出将其用于高温无水质子交换膜的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用粗粒化模型（coarse-grained model）进行数值模拟，研究吸附在 h-BN 晶体表面的线性分子链动力学，并模拟 h-BN 片对分子体系的范德华封装。摘要未明确说明具体的模拟技术细节（如分子动力学、Monte Carlo 等）及力场形式。

papers.title: Consensus in Effective Model Inference for Disordered Ising Systems
papers.abstract: When independent learners are trained on data from the same disordered system, finite and noisy samples can lead them to different descriptions of the underlying physics. We quantify the reproducibility of such descriptions through consensus, the degree of agreement among independently trained models. In a teacher-student framework on the two-dimensional random-bond Ising model, an ensemble of students each infers a single uniform effective coupling from a finite set of equilibrium configurations drawn from one quenched bond realization. Aggregating the inferred couplings across students and realizations yields the consensus distribution, whose width quantifies the agreement among learners. The variance of this distribution separates exactly into a finite-sampling contribution, bounded below by inverse of Fisher information, and a quenched-disorder contribution. Sum of these two variance is minimized near critical region, so the consensus width has a minimum near the pseudocritical temperature that sharpens with increasing disorder. The two minima arise from different mechanisms: the sampling term inherits the critical peak of the Fisher information, while the disorder term is temperature-independent at leading order and acquires its critical minimum only at fourth order in the disorder strength, through the covariance between the linear and cubic responses to the bond disorder. Because the students fit a uniform coupling to a heterogeneous lattice, the inferred coupling also carries a misspecification bias that survives in the infinite-data limit. This bias displaces the minimum of the mean-squared error above the consensus minimum, so the temperature at which independent learners agree most closely is not the temperature at which their shared answer is most faithful.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：teacher-student framework、ensemble of students、inferred couplings、Fisher information、quenched bond realization——属于基于统计推断与有效模型学习的理论研究，摘要中未提及具体实验测量。；研究对象：二维随机键 Ising 模型（two-dimensional random-bond Ising model）中的无序 Ising 体系，以及从有限平衡构型中推断有效耦合这一“有效模型推断”问题；涉及临界/赝临界行为与无序强度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 独立训练的学习者从同一无序体系的有限噪声样本中会得到不同的有效描述；共识分布的方差可精确分解为有限采样贡献（下界由 Fisher 信息倒数给出）与淬火无序贡献，二者之和在临界区附近最小，使共识宽度在赝临界温度附近出现极小值，且随无序增强而变锐。此外，由于学生模型用均匀耦合拟合非均匀晶格，推断耦合存在误配偏差，该偏差在无限数据极限下仍存在，使均方误差的极小值位于共识极小值之上——即学习者最一致的温度并非其共同答案最忠实的温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：独立训练的学习者从同一无序体系的有限噪声样本中会得到不同的有效描述；共识分布的方差可精确分解为有限采样贡献（下界由 Fisher 信息倒数给出）与淬火无序贡献，二者之和在临界区附近最小，使共识宽度在赝临界温度附近出现极小值，且随无序增强而变锐。此外，由于学生模型用均匀耦合拟合非均匀晶格，推断耦合存在误配偏差，该偏差在无限数据极限下仍存在，使均方误差的极小值位于共识极小值之上——即学习者最一致的温度并非其共同答案最忠实的温度。；创新点：将“可重复性/共识”量化为独立训练模型间的一致程度，并给出共识分布方差的精确分解：采样项由 Fisher 信息下界控制，无序项在领头阶与温度无关、仅在无序强度四阶通过线性与三次响应的协方差获得临界极小；同时指出误配偏差使共识最优温度与最忠实温度分离。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为 teacher-student 框架：在二维随机键 Ising 模型上，对每个淬火键实现抽取有限平衡构型，由一组学生模型各自推断单一均匀有效耦合；通过跨学生与跨实现的耦合聚合得到共识分布，并用 Fisher 信息、方差分解（采样项与无序项）及对键无序的线性/三次响应协方差进行解析分析。

papers.title: Moiré Topology in Twisted Structures with Noncollinear Spin-Orbit Coupling
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices provide a powerful platform for flat bands and correlated topological phases, yet most established examples rely on valley-contrasting Berry curvature in hexagonal lattices. Here, we propose a different route to achieve topological moiré minibands based on noncollinear spin orbit coupling in centrosymmetric type II SOC bilayers. Interlayer hybridization opens local pseudogaps and produces sharply localized Berry curvature, which twisting reconstructs into isolated topological minibands without requiring valley degrees of freedom or hexagonal symmetry. We demonstrate this mechanism in tetragonal Dresselhaus-SOC HgI2, where a Lieb-like moiré potential yields topological flat bands. To improve miniband isolation, we develop a physics-informed machine-learning surrogate that identifies stronger SOC as a key design principle and guides the replacement of Hg by Pb. The resulting PbI2 minibands are narrower and better isolated, supporting correlation-driven magnetism and tunable quantum spin Hall and Chern insulating phases, thereby providing an optimized material realization for experimental exploration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：propose a different route、demonstrate this mechanism、physics-informed machine-learning surrogate、guides the replacement of Hg by Pb。摘要中未提及任何实验测量手段，属于理论提出与计算预测类工作。；研究对象：中心对称的 type II 自旋轨道耦合（SOC）双层体系中的莫尔超晶格，具体材料为四方结构的 Dresselhaus-SOC HgI₂ 以及经机器学习筛选后替换得到的 PbI₂。研究的物理现象是非共线自旋轨道耦合驱动的莫尔拓扑微带（拓扑平带）、关联驱动磁性以及可调量子自旋霍尔态与陈绝缘体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称的 type II SOC 双层中，层间杂化打开局域赝能隙并产生高度局域的贝里曲率，扭转后无需谷自由度或六角对称性即可重构出孤立的拓扑莫尔微带；在四方 Dresselhaus-SOC HgI₂ 中，类 Lieb 莫尔势产生拓扑平带；用 Pb 替换 Hg 后微带更窄、隔离性更好，可支持关联驱动磁性和可调量子自旋霍尔及陈绝缘体相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称的 type II SOC 双层中，层间杂化打开局域赝能隙并产生高度局域的贝里曲率，扭转后无需谷自由度或六角对称性即可重构出孤立的拓扑莫尔微带；在四方 Dresselhaus-SOC HgI₂ 中，类 Lieb 莫尔势产生拓扑平带；用 Pb 替换 Hg 后微带更窄、隔离性更好，可支持关联驱动磁性和可调量子自旋霍尔及陈绝缘体相。；创新点：提出了一条不依赖六角晶格中谷对比贝里曲率的拓扑莫尔微带实现新路径，基于中心对称 type II SOC 双层中的非共线自旋轨道耦合，无需谷自由度或六角对称性；并结合物理信息机器学习代理模型优化材料选择（Hg→Pb），获得了微带更窄、隔离性更好的优化材料实现。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的计算方法或理论框架（如是否使用 DFT、紧束缚模型、连续模型等），仅提到使用了物理信息引导的机器学习代理模型（physics-informed machine-learning surrogate）来识别更强 SOC 这一设计原则并指导材料替换。

papers.title: A Unified Theory of Collective Magnon and Orbiton Excitations in Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism has recently emerged as a distinct collinear magnetic phase exhibiting momentum-dependent spin-splitting despite vanishing net magnetization, as a consequence of inequivalent non-magnetic environments. Lately, it has been proposed that strong electronic correlations may yield spontaneous altermagnetism due to orbital ordering even for equivalent non-magnetic environments. While previous studies have largely focused on the electronic structure, a unified understanding of the collective excitations associated with these two different microscopic mechanisms stabilizing altermagnetism remains absent. Here, we develop an extended Kugel'-Khomskiĭ spin-orbital model on a decorated square lattice that simultaneously incorporates inequivalent non-magnetic environments and correlation-driven orbital ordering within a common theoretical framework. Employing a self-consistent mean-field spin-wave orbital-wave formalism, we demonstrate the emergence of mutually unhybridized but interdependent magnon and orbiton excitations exhibiting characteristic chiral-splitting.
