We show that the splitting originates from two distinct microscopic contributions: a lattice-dependent term arising from inequivalent non-magnetic environments and an orbital-order-induced exchange-anisotropy term that survives even for equivalent non-magnetic environments. The proposed framework therefore unifies the collective excitations associated with both types of altermagnetism. We further investigate the finite-temperature evolution of the coupled spin-orbital system, revealing the breakdown of spin-wave and orbital-wave approximations through spurious 1st-order transitions, while complementary classical Monte Carlo simulations recover the expected continuous 2nd-order behaviour. Our work establishes a unified microscopic framework for understanding collective magnon and orbiton excitations in altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提出“extended Kugel'-Khomskiĭ spin-orbital model”“self-consistent mean-field spin-wave orbital-wave formalism”“classical Monte Carlo simulations”，属于理论建模与计算分析，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：交替磁体（altermagnets）中集体磁振子（magnon）与轨道振子（orbiton）激发。具体体系为装饰正方晶格（decorated square lattice）上的扩展Kugel'-Khomskiĭ自旋-轨道模型，同时涵盖两类交替磁稳定机制：非磁环境不等价与关联驱动的轨道有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该统一框架下，磁振子和轨道振子激发互不杂化但相互依赖，并表现出特征性的手性劈裂；该劈裂来自两个不同微观贡献：源于非磁环境不等价的晶格依赖项，以及即使非磁环境等价时仍然存在的轨道序诱导交换各向异性项。此外，有限温下自旋波和轨道波近似会因虚假的一阶相变而失效，而经典Monte Carlo模拟恢复了预期的连续二阶行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该统一框架下，磁振子和轨道振子激发互不杂化但相互依赖，并表现出特征性的手性劈裂；该劈裂来自两个不同微观贡献：源于非磁环境不等价的晶格依赖项，以及即使非磁环境等价时仍然存在的轨道序诱导交换各向异性项。此外，有限温下自旋波和轨道波近似会因虚假的一阶相变而失效，而经典Monte Carlo模拟恢复了预期的连续二阶行为。；创新点：首次在一个统一微观框架中同时描述由非磁环境不等价和关联驱动轨道有序两种不同机制稳定的交替磁集体激发，揭示了磁振子与轨道振子虽不杂化但相互依赖且具有手性劈裂，并将劈裂分解为晶格依赖项与轨道序诱导交换各向异性项两个微观来源。
papers.method_zh: 构建了装饰正方晶格上的扩展Kugel'-Khomskiĭ自旋-轨道模型；采用自洽平均场自旋波-轨道波形式化方法；并结合经典Monte Carlo模拟研究有限温演化。

papers.title: Dissipative quantum mechanics of Andreev bound states
papers.abstract: We propose a microscopic scheme that allows to describe ac Josephson effect in superconducting junctions in terms of dissipative quantum dynamics of subgap Andreev bound states. This approach is particularly useful for highly transparent junctions at subgap bias voltages in which case a non-trivial combination of Landau-Zener tunneling between Andreev levels and their instability due to quasiparticle escape into continuum may play an important role. In the low bias regime, we evaluate the non-equilibrium current-phase relation of superconducting junctions at arbitrary transmissions and identify a sub-Ohmic phase-dependent dissipative contribution to the current controlled by quasiparticle dynamics near the superconducting gap edge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：propose a microscopic scheme、describe、evaluate、identify，摘要中未提及任何实验测量或数值计算方法，属于提出理论方案与解析推导的工作。；研究对象：超导结中的亚能隙 Andreev 束缚态（Andreev bound states）及其耗散量子动力学，具体涉及交流 Josephson 效应、Andreev 能级间的 Landau-Zener 隧穿、准粒子逃逸到连续谱导致的不稳定性，以及低偏压区间的非平衡电流-相位关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种用亚能隙 Andreev 束缚态的耗散量子动力学来描述超导结中交流 Josephson 效应的微观方案；在低偏压区间计算了任意透射率下超导结的非平衡电流-相位关系，并识别出一个由超导能隙边缘附近准粒子动力学控制的、与相位相关的亚欧姆（sub-Ohmic）耗散性电流贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种用亚能隙 Andreev 束缚态的耗散量子动力学来描述超导结中交流 Josephson 效应的微观方案；在低偏压区间计算了任意透射率下超导结的非平衡电流-相位关系，并识别出一个由超导能隙边缘附近准粒子动力学控制的、与相位相关的亚欧姆（sub-Ohmic）耗散性电流贡献。；创新点：将交流 Josephson 效应重新表述为亚能隙 Andreev 束缚态的耗散量子动力学问题，特别针对高透明结在亚能隙偏压下的情形，揭示了 Landau-Zener 隧穿与准粒子逃逸不稳定性的非平凡组合所起的重要作用，并给出了任意透射率下的非平衡电流-相位关系以及由能隙边缘准粒子动力学控制的亚欧姆相位相关耗散电流贡献。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为耗散量子动力学，将交流 Josephson 效应映射到亚能隙 Andreev 束缚态的描述上；具体处理了 Andreev 能级间的 Landau-Zener 隧穿与准粒子逃逸到连续谱所致不稳定性的组合效应；在低偏压区间对任意透射率求解非平衡电流-相位关系。摘要未明确说明是否采用具体数值方法或模型哈密顿量形式。

papers.title: Quantum interference between vortex- and impurity-bound states boosts thermoelectricity
papers.abstract: Thermoelectric effects in superconductors are generally suppressed by the approximate particle-hole symmetry of the quasiparticle spectrum, but can become pronounced near defects that host particle-hole asymmetric bound states. Here, we investigate how the local thermoelectric response is modified when multiple vortices or nonmagnetic impurities are brought into proximity. Using a lattice Bogolioubov-de Gennes approach combined with linear-response tunneling theory, we calculate the spatially resolved density of states and Seebeck coefficient in $s$- and $d$-wave superconductors. We find that the thermoelectric response can be strongly enhanced when spatially extended defect-induced states overlap. For vortices, this enhancement persists beyond the immediate core regions and originates from interference between vortex-bound states. For impurities, the thermoelectric response exhibits a comparable dependence on impurity separation in the $s$- and $d$-wave cases, although the associated spectral reconstruction is considerably more localized in the $s$-wave superconductor. Our results show that the spatial extent and interference of defect-induced quasiparticle states provide a means of controlling local thermoelectricity in inhomogeneous superconductors, with potential relevance for cryogenic thermoelectric sensing and energy conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：lattice Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach、linear-response tunneling theory、calculate。；研究对象：超导体中的局域热电效应，具体为 $s$-波和 $d$-波超导体中多个涡旋或非磁性杂质诱导的束缚态之间的量子干涉对Seebeck系数（热电响应）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当空间上延展的缺陷诱导态发生重叠时，热电响应可以被强烈增强；对于涡旋，这种增强源于涡旋束缚态之间的干涉，并可延伸至涡旋核心区域之外；对于杂质，热电响应对杂质间距的依赖在 $s$-波和 $d$-波情况下相当，但 $s$-波超导体中的谱重构更加局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当空间上延展的缺陷诱导态发生重叠时，热电响应可以被强烈增强；对于涡旋，这种增强源于涡旋束缚态之间的干涉，并可延伸至涡旋核心区域之外；对于杂质，热电响应对杂质间距的依赖在 $s$-波和 $d$-波情况下相当，但 $s$-波超导体中的谱重构更加局域化。；创新点：揭示了多个涡旋或杂质诱导的准粒子态之间的空间重叠与干涉可作为调控非均匀超导体局域热电性的手段，并指出其对低温热电传感和能量转换的潜在意义。
papers.method_zh: 格点Bogoliubov-de Gennes方法结合线性响应隧穿理论，计算 $s$-波和 $d$-波超导体中空间分辨的态密度和Seebeck系数。

papers.title: Lattice 2-group symmetries: operators, defects, and gauging
papers.abstract: We construct and study lattice realizations of finite 2-group symmetries in ${2+1}$d quantum lattice systems with finite-dimensional tensor-product Hilbert spaces. We focus on two broad classes of 2-groups with 0-form symmetry group $G$ and 1-form symmetry group $A$: split 2-groups with trivial Postnikov class ${[β]\in\mathcal{H}^3(G,A)}$, and central 2-groups with trivial action ${ρ\colon G\to\text{Aut}(A)}$. In both cases, we construct symmetry operators on the full tensor-product Hilbert space that become 2-group symmetry operators when restricted to the topological subspace of the lattice $A$ 1-form symmetry. While the lattice split 2-group symmetry operators are onsite, the lattice central 2-group symmetry operators are not, and can only be made onsite after introducing ancillae. We extensively explore various manifestations of $ρ$ and $[β]$ for these lattice 2-group symmetry operators and demonstrate their agreement with expectations from quantum field theory. These manifestations arise in the transformation of operators carrying symmetry charge, the structure of lattice 2-group symmetry defects, and the dual fusion 2-category symmetries obtained by gauging the lattice 2-group symmetries. We further propose families of local symmetric Hamiltonians for both classes of lattice 2-group symmetries and identify exactly solvable limits lying in phases with spontaneous 2-group symmetry breaking and nontrivial symmetry-enriched topological order. In one such limit, the gauged Hamiltonians are exactly solvable lattice realizations of the corresponding 2-group gauge theories, whose ground-state degeneracies we calculate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：论文标题与摘要均围绕“构造”“研究”“提出”格点模型与对称性算符，属于格点场论/凝聚态理论框架下的严格构造与解析研究，不涉及具体材料实验或数值计算。；研究对象：${2+1}$ 维量子格点系统（具有有限维张量积希尔伯特空间）中的有限 2-群对称性。具体研究两类 2-群：Postnikov 类平凡的 split 2-群，以及作用 ${\rho}$ 平凡的 central 2-群，其中 0-形式对称群为 $G$，1-形式对称群为 $A$。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文在完整张量积希尔伯特空间上构造了两类 2-群对称性算符，这些算符在限制到格点 $A$ 1-形式对称性的拓扑子空间时成为 2-群对称性算符；其中 split 2-群对称性算符是 onsite 的，而 central 2-群对称性算符不是 onsite 的，只有在引入辅助比特（ancillae）后才能变为 onsite。论文进一步展示了 ${\rho}$ 和 ${[β]}$ 在算符变换、格点 2-群对称性缺陷结构以及通过规范化得到的对偶融合 2-范畴对称性中的多种表现，并与量子场论预期一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文在完整张量积希尔伯特空间上构造了两类 2-群对称性算符，这些算符在限制到格点 $A$ 1-形式对称性的拓扑子空间时成为 2-群对称性算符；其中 split 2-群对称性算符是 onsite 的，而 central 2-群对称性算符不是 onsite 的，只有在引入辅助比特（ancillae）后才能变为 onsite。论文进一步展示了 ${\rho}$ 和 ${[β]}$ 在算符变换、格点 2-群对称性缺陷结构以及通过规范化得到的对偶融合 2-范畴对称性中的多种表现，并与量子场论预期一致。；创新点：首次在 ${2+1}$ 维量子格点系统上显式构造有限 2-群对称性的格点实现，区分了 split 2-群（onsite 算符）与 central 2-群（非 onsite，需辅助比特）两类情形；系统展示了 ${\rho}$ 和 ${[β]}$ 在算符变换、缺陷结构和规范化对偶融合 2-范畴中的表现并与量子场论预期对照；提出了相应的局域对称哈密顿量族，识别出自发 2-群对称性破缺相与对称性富化拓扑序相的可精确求解极限，并计算了规范化后 2-群规范理论基态简并度。
papers.method_zh: 格点构造方法：在有限维张量积希尔伯特空间上显式构造 2-群对称性算符与对称性缺陷；通过规范化（gauging）格点 2-群对称性得到对偶融合 2-范畴对称性；提出局域对称哈密顿量族并识别可精确求解极限，计算规范化哈密顿量的基态简并度。属于理论框架与格点模型构造，未涉及具体数值方法（如 DMRG、DFT 等）。

papers.title: Geometric Ginzburg-Landau theory of charge ordering and commensurability
papers.abstract: The concept of quantum geometry has recently led to reinvigorated insights in a wide range of fields including physical responses, superconductivity, and optical transitions, with effects most pronounced in systems with nearly flat dispersion. Here, we show that it plays an essential role in charge density wave formation (CDW) -- an important physical phenomenon that is responsible for driving various sharp changes in material transport properties including metal-insulator transitions. We derive an effective Ginzburg-Landau theory including uncharted contributions and, as a highlight, discover a general criterion for both CDW formation and commensurability transitions where underlying electron-phonon interactions manifest purely as electronic quantum geometric enhancements/suppressions. We benchmark our framework in a class of transition-metal dichalcogenides and resolve a longstanding puzzle where well-established purely kinetic CDW criteria fail in describing the correct ordering wavevector. Besides rendering robust criteria and fundamental insights that are immediately relevant to several experimental charge ordering systems, our theory can also be applied directly to other phonon-mediated phases such as superconductivity, and can be used as an important tool to explore the interplay between various such states. More generally, our framework provides a recipe for investigating the role of quantum geometry in phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：derive an effective Ginzburg-Landau theory、discover a general criterion、benchmark our framework、our theory can also be applied directly to other phonon-mediated phases。摘要中未提及具体实验测量或数值计算方法（如 DFT、DMRG 等），属于纯理论推导与框架构建。；研究对象：电荷密度波（CDW）的形成与公度性转变（commensurability transitions），以及电子-声子相互作用在其中的角色。论文在一类过渡金属硫族化合物（transition-metal dichalcogenides）中对自己的理论框架进行了基准验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子几何在电荷密度波形成中起关键作用；作者推导出包含新贡献的有效 Ginzburg-Landau 理论，并发现了一个同时适用于 CDW 形成和公度性转变的普遍判据——在该判据中，底层的电子-声子相互作用完全表现为电子量子几何的增强或抑制。该框架在一类过渡金属硫族化合物中成功解决了长期存在的难题：即传统纯动力学 CDW 判据无法描述正确的有序波矢。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子几何在电荷密度波形成中起关键作用；作者推导出包含新贡献的有效 Ginzburg-Landau 理论，并发现了一个同时适用于 CDW 形成和公度性转变的普遍判据——在该判据中，底层的电子-声子相互作用完全表现为电子量子几何的增强或抑制。该框架在一类过渡金属硫族化合物中成功解决了长期存在的难题：即传统纯动力学 CDW 判据无法描述正确的有序波矢。；创新点：首次将量子几何的概念系统性地引入电荷密度波形成的理论描述，推导出包含此前未涉及的贡献的有效 Ginzburg-Landau 理论；提出了一个将电子-声子相互作用完全归结为量子几何增强/抑制的 CDW 形成与公度性转变的普遍判据；解决了过渡金属硫族化合物中纯动力学判据无法给出正确有序波矢的长期难题。此外，该理论框架可直接推广至其他声子介导的相（如超导），并可用来探索不同量子几何驱动相之间的相互作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为有效 Ginzburg-Landau 理论，在其中引入量子几何贡献；通过该理论推导 CDW 形成与公度性转变的普遍判据，并在一类过渡金属硫族化合物中进行基准验证。摘要未明确说明是否使用了具体的第一性原理计算或模型哈密顿量等辅助手段。

papers.title: Generating is not discovering: a pre-registered physics judge for AI-proposed superconductors, calibrated on six known superconductors and one negative control
papers.abstract: Generative models now propose millions of "stable" crystal structures, and their own referees have shown that stability is not discovery; no public benchmark asks whether a candidate has the physics to do a job. For superconductors the job is twofold: to pair, with a definite gap symmetry, and to become wire. We present a physics judge that answers both from a structure alone (DFT+U, a gated Wannier model, the full rank-4 RPA susceptibility on a $24^3$ mesh, the linearized gap equation, an irreducible-representation classifier, a manufacturability funnel) and measure what it says about what generators propose. With answer keys pre-registered before computing, the judge was calibrated on six known superconductors (Nb, Nb$_3$Sn, MgB$_2$, BaFe$_2$As$_2$, La$_{2-x}$Sr$_x$CuO$_4$, YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_7$), recovering the expected class in all six after two dated corrections. On the ruthenium analogue of the iron pnictide, with two runs and their criterion pre-registered the day before, it returns a null verdict at the same physical interaction where iron gives s$\pm$ ($λ_1 \le 0.0007$ versus 0.096; critical U 4.17 versus 0.97 eV); the pre-registered equal-alpha run fails the letter of the criterion, and we declare the resolution in favour of absolute U as post-hoc. The funnel reproduces the industrial map with thresholds fixed before running. Three generation audits follow: a descriptor sweep over 150 Materials Project metals re-finds the canon; 1,248 MatterGen structures yield 0 candidates that are new, stable and carry a pairing motif; mechanism filters over 47,893 compounds, validated by a blind hold-out, re-derive the community's analogies: geometry plus d-count is necessary but not sufficient. Generation re-finds what is known; judgment is the bottleneck. We propose a public benchmark over the eleven lists of AI-proposed superconductor candidates, none of which classifies gap symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（含方法学与基准评测性质）。关键依据：摘要中出现的 DFT+U、Wannier 模型、RPA 磁化率、线性化能隙方程、不可约表示分类器等均为第一性原理与多体微扰计算工具，且核心工作是构建“物理判据器”并对 AI 生成结构做审计，无实验合成或测量描述。；研究对象：AI 生成模型提出的候选超导材料（晶体结构），以及作为标定基准的六种已知超导体：Nb、Nb₃Sn、MgB₂、BaFe₂As₂、La₂₋ₓSrₓCuO₄、YBa₂Cu₃O₇；另包括铁磷族化合物钌类似物（作为负对照）、150 个 Materials Project 金属、1,248 个 MatterGen 结构、47,893 个化合物。物理现象聚焦于超导配对（能隙对称性）与可制造性（成线/线材化）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该“物理判据器”能在六种已知超导体上复现预期配对类别，并在钌类似物上给出零结论（λ₁ ≤ 0.0007，对比铁的 0.096；临界 U 为 4.17 eV 对比 0.97 eV），表明生成模型只是重新发现已知材料，判断（judgment）才是瓶颈；对 AI 提出的候选结构，没有一个是既新、又稳定且带配对 motif 的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该“物理判据器”能在六种已知超导体上复现预期配对类别，并在钌类似物上给出零结论（λ₁ ≤ 0.0007，对比铁的 0.096；临界 U 为 4.17 eV 对比 0.97 eV），表明生成模型只是重新发现已知材料，判断（judgment）才是瓶颈；对 AI 提出的候选结构，没有一个是既新、又稳定且带配对 motif 的。；创新点：提出并预注册了一个面向 AI 生成超导候选的“物理判据器”基准，首次从结构出发同时判定配对能隙对称性与可制造性；通过负对照（钌类似物）和三类生成审计，量化了“生成不等于发现”，并倡议对十一份 AI 超导候选清单建立公开基准（现有清单均未对能隙对称性分类）。
papers.method_zh: DFT+U 计算、门控 Wannier 模型、24³ 网格上的完整四阶（rank-4）RPA 磁化率、线性化能隙方程、不可约表示分类器，以及可制造性筛选漏斗（manufacturability funnel）；并采用预注册（pre-registered）答案键与判据、描述符扫描、机制过滤器及盲法留出验证等审计流程。

papers.title: Hierarchy of Rényi Coherent Information in Stabilizer Codes
papers.abstract: Rényi coherent information, a computable proxy for the von Neumann coherent information, is widely used to study mixed-state phases of matter and decodability transitions in noisy quantum error-correcting codes. However, being a difference of two Rényi entropies, it need not be monotonic in the Rényi index, and lacks the operational meaning of its von Neumann counterpart. Here we address both issues for stabilizer codes. First, for Pauli noise generated by independent Bernoulli events, we prove that the Rényi-$n$ coherent information is nondecreasing in $n \in \mathbb{Z}^+$. This follows from a general theorem: if independent random bits are mapped linearly to a fine label $T$ and a coarse label $C$, then the Rényi entropy difference $H_n(C)-H_n(T)$ is nondecreasing in $n$. For stabilizer codes, $T$ is the joint syndrome--logical class and $C$ is the syndrome, and the difference is the Rényi-$n$ coherent information up to a constant. The same theorem covers classical linear codes and independent detector error models. Second, for arbitrary stochastic Pauli noise, we give the Rényi-$n$ coherent information an operational meaning via postselection on matching syndromes between one data block and $n-1$ auxiliary blocks. We determine when this defines a quantum channel and show that saturation of the Rényi-$n$ coherent information is equivalent to asymptotically perfect recovery of the postselected channel. Moreover, the Rényi-$n$ coherent information also upper-bounds the ordinary coherent information achievable after any syndrome-conditioned recovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中为数学定理证明（"we prove that..."）、一般性定理（"a general theorem"）、以及为信息量赋予操作意义的理论构造（"we give ... an operational meaning"），不涉及具体实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：稳定子码（stabilizer codes）在噪声下的量子信息量，具体为 Rényi 相干信息（Rényi coherent information）；涉及 Pauli 噪声（独立伯努利事件生成的 Pauli 噪声，以及任意随机 Pauli 噪声）、经典线性码和独立探测器错误模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于独立伯努利事件生成的 Pauli 噪声，Rényi-n 相干信息随 Rényi 指数 n∈Z⁺ 单调非减；其背后的一般定理是：若独立随机比特经线性映射得到细标签 T 和粗标签 C，则 Rényi 熵差 H_n(C)−H_n(T) 随 n 单调非减。此外，对任意随机 Pauli 噪声，Rényi-n 相干信息可通过在一个数据块与 n−1 个辅助块之间对匹配的 syndrome 做后选择来获得操作意义，其饱和等价于后选择信道的渐近完美恢复，并且它还是任意 syndrome 条件恢复后可达到的普通相干信息的上界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于独立伯努利事件生成的 Pauli 噪声，Rényi-n 相干信息随 Rényi 指数 n∈Z⁺ 单调非减；其背后的一般定理是：若独立随机比特经线性映射得到细标签 T 和粗标签 C，则 Rényi 熵差 H_n(C)−H_n(T) 随 n 单调非减。此外，对任意随机 Pauli 噪声，Rényi-n 相干信息可通过在一个数据块与 n−1 个辅助块之间对匹配的 syndrome 做后选择来获得操作意义，其饱和等价于后选择信道的渐近完美恢复，并且它还是任意 syndrome 条件恢复后可达到的普通相干信息的上界。；创新点：此前 Rényi 相干信息作为两个 Rényi 熵之差，不保证随 Rényi 指数单调，也缺乏类似 von Neumann 相干信息的操作意义；本文针对稳定子码同时解决了这两个问题：证明了在独立伯努利 Pauli 噪声下其对 n 的单调性（并推广到经典线性码与独立探测器错误模型），并为任意随机 Pauli 噪声下的 Rényi-n 相干信息给出了基于 syndrome 后选择的信道操作解释及恢复等价性与上界关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为量子信息论与量子纠错理论：以稳定子码为对象，用 Rényi 熵与 Rényi 相干信息作为工具，通过将独立随机比特线性映射到细/粗标签的一般定理进行证明；并借助 syndrome 后选择构造信道来分析操作意义。

papers.title: Quantifying Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: Quantifying properties of quantum states through the limits of their manipulation is a central goal of quantum resource theories. For symmetry breaking, the quantum geometric tensor governs asymptotic pure-state conversion, but a complete characterization for general mixed states has remained elusive. Here we fully resolve this problem for finite-dimensional systems under compact Lie group symmetries in the i.i.d. asymptotic regime. Specifically, we establish a single-letter formula for the optimal conversion rate between arbitrary states, with vanishing trace-distance error, in the resource theory of asymmetry. The rate is determined by a one-parameter family of quantum Fisher information (QFI) matrices that interpolates between the symmetric- and right-logarithmic-derivative QFIs. No state-independent finite subset of this family suffices in general, even for $U(1)$ symmetry, revealing a qualitative distinction from pure-state conversion. Our formula further yields an exact formula for pure-state distillation rates in terms of the generalized quantum geometric tensor, characterizes asymptotically reversible interconversion, and identifies bound asymmetry for quantum clocks. Complementarity among different members of the QFI family also uncovers an activation mechanism for quantum clocks. Our proof relies on two developments of independent interest. First, we extend quantum local asymptotic normality to unitary models with arbitrary rank and spectral degeneracy. Second, we characterize convertibility between quantum Gaussian shift models in terms of the same one-parameter family of QFIs. Together, these results provide an operational characterization of symmetry breaking for general quantum states in the i.i.d. asymptotic regime and reveal how distinct QFI constraints give rise to irreversibility and activation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：quantum resource theories、single-letter formula、quantum Fisher information matrices、quantum local asymptotic normality、i.i.d. asymptotic regime——全文为数学物理/量子信息理论推导，无实验或数值计算内容。；研究对象：有限维量子系统在紧致李群对称性下的对称破缺（asymmetry）资源理论，具体研究任意混合态之间在独立同分布（i.i.d.）渐近区域中的态转换与蒸馏问题，涉及量子时钟（quantum clocks）等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文建立了任意混合态之间最优转换率的单字母公式，该速率由一族单参数量子Fisher信息（QFI）矩阵决定，该族在对称对数导数QFI与右对数导数QFI之间插值；一般而言不存在与态无关的有限子集足以刻画该速率，即使对U(1)对称性也是如此，这揭示了与纯态转换的定性区别。该公式还给出了纯态蒸馏率的精确表达式、刻画了渐近可逆互转换、识别了量子时钟的束缚不对称性（bound asymmetry），并揭示了QFI族不同成员之间的互补性可导致量子时钟的激活机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文建立了任意混合态之间最优转换率的单字母公式，该速率由一族单参数量子Fisher信息（QFI）矩阵决定，该族在对称对数导数QFI与右对数导数QFI之间插值；一般而言不存在与态无关的有限子集足以刻画该速率，即使对U(1)对称性也是如此，这揭示了与纯态转换的定性区别。该公式还给出了纯态蒸馏率的精确表达式、刻画了渐近可逆互转换、识别了量子时钟的束缚不对称性（bound asymmetry），并揭示了QFI族不同成员之间的互补性可导致量子时钟的激活机制。；创新点：首次完整解决了有限维系统在紧致李群对称性下一般混合态对称破缺资源理论的渐近转换刻画问题；发现混合态转换需要一族连续QFI而非有限个QFI即可完全刻画（即使U(1)情形），这与纯态情形有本质区别；由此导出纯态蒸馏率的精确公式、渐近可逆性条件、量子时钟的束缚不对称性与激活机制；技术上推广了量子局部渐近正态性并刻画了高斯移位模型的可转换性。
papers.method_zh: 量子资源理论框架下的渐近态转换分析；将量子局部渐近正态性（quantum local asymptotic normality）推广到具有任意秩和谱简并的幺正模型；用同一单参数QFI族刻画量子高斯移位模型之间的可转换性；以消失的迹距离误差为准则推导单字母公式。

papers.title: Computational framework for quantum state tomography of spin ensembles
papers.abstract: We present Tomography-NMR, an open-source Python package that reconstructs quantum density matrices from spectroscopic measurement data. The package implements a complete analysis pipeline for two-qubit quantum state tomography based on the product operator formalism: raw time-domain signals are Fourier-transformed into frequency-domain spectra, spectral peak intensities are mapped to expansion coefficients of the density matrix, and the full quantum state is reconstructed. Three integration methods are provided for different use cases: direct peak height measurement and fixed-parameter numerical integration require no theoretical reference and are suited to unknown states, achieving fidelities of approximately 98\% on a benchmark set of known states, while a systematic parameter optimization against a known target state achieves reconstruction fidelities exceeding 99\% for the same benchmark states. While the detailed theoretical framework for quantum state tomography is well established, the practical procedures for extracting density matrices from experimental spectra are often inadequately documented in the literature and obscured within proprietary software. This package addresses that gap by providing a fully transparent, reproducible implementation of every analysis step, from spectral preprocessing to density matrix visualization. The software has been validated on experimentally prepared two-qubit states measured via nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy of coupled $^{31}$P nuclei. Average reconstruction fidelities range from 0.975 to 0.995 across a benchmark set of 20 two-qubit states, including the computational basis states, Bell states, and the outputs of three fundamental quantum gates (CNOT, H, and T). Although developed for NMR, the modular architecture facilitates adaptation to other spectroscopic platforms and alternative measurement protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工具类文章（混合了实验验证）。判断依据的关键词：open-source Python package、implements a complete analysis pipeline、validated on experimentally prepared two-qubit states。论文主体是开发计算工具包，但用NMR实验数据进行验证。；研究对象：自旋系综的量子态层析（quantum state tomography），具体为通过核磁共振（NMR）光谱测量的双量子比特量子态，实验体系为耦合的 \(^{31}\)P 原子核。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了名为 Tomography-NMR 的开源 Python 软件包，能够从光谱测量数据重建量子密度矩阵，在20个双量子比特基准态（含计算基态、Bell态及CNOT、H、T三种量子门输出态）上实现了平均重建保真度0.975至0.995；其中直接峰高测量和固定参数数值积分方法无需理论参考即可达到约98%保真度，而针对已知目标态的系统参数优化可超过99%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了名为 Tomography-NMR 的开源 Python 软件包，能够从光谱测量数据重建量子密度矩阵，在20个双量子比特基准态（含计算基态、Bell态及CNOT、H、T三种量子门输出态）上实现了平均重建保真度0.975至0.995；其中直接峰高测量和固定参数数值积分方法无需理论参考即可达到约98%保真度，而针对已知目标态的系统参数优化可超过99%。；创新点：现有文献中从实验光谱提取密度矩阵的实用流程往往记录不充分或被专有软件遮蔽；该工作提供了完全透明、可复现的每一步分析实现（从光谱预处理到密度矩阵可视化），并开源为Python包。此外，其模块化架构便于适配其他光谱平台和测量协议。
papers.method_zh: 基于乘积算符形式（product operator formalism）的完整分析流程：时域信号经傅里叶变换为频域光谱，光谱峰强度映射为密度矩阵展开系数，进而重建完整量子态。提供三种积分方法（直接峰高测量、固定参数数值积分、系统参数优化）。用NMR光谱实验制备的双量子比特态进行验证。

papers.title: Learning structural balance of graphs from quantum spectral features
papers.abstract: We develop a quantum approach to spectral feature extraction from the density of states (DOS) of a problem-dependent Hamiltonian, and apply it to machine learning on signed graphs. We propose to embed a signed graph as an Ising model instance with positive and negative interactions, and use the standardized moments of the Ising DOS as features for learning. We show that these moments count signed closed walks, are switching-invariant, and are size-free by construction. As a benchmark, we target learning the frustration index, an NP-hard measure of structural balance that can be labeled exactly at moderate size. At zero field, the models can be sampled classically, allowing the quantum extraction procedure to be certified against exact ground truth. We propose DOS-QPE, a phase estimation on a purified maximally mixed probe, which samples the spectral density with orders of magnitude fewer shots than Hadamard test-based trace sampling and feeds the resulting features directly into classically trained models. On $1.4\times10^5$ labeled graphs the exact DOS determines the frustration index, and five moments recover it with a mean error of 0.4, well below one sign flip. Beyond zero field, the underlying trace-estimation problem is DQC1-complete, providing access to spectral features for which no efficient classical sampling method is known. Our work opens routes towards quantum applications in social network balance analysis, spin-glass studies, correlation clustering, and protein-interaction networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（混合方法类）。判断依据的关键词：develop a quantum approach、propose to embed、phase estimation、classically trained models、DQC1-complete、trace-estimation problem。摘要中未涉及实际实验测量，属于提出量子算法框架并结合经典机器学习训练的计算/理论研究。；研究对象：符号图（signed graphs）的结构平衡（structural balance）问题，具体以阻挫指数（frustration index）为学习目标；将符号图嵌入为具有正负相互作用的 Ising 模型，研究其态密度（DOS）的谱特征。摘要未明确说明具体物理材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ising 态密度的标准化矩可以计数符号闭合游走、具有切换不变性且天然与尺寸无关，可作为学习特征；在 1.4×10^5 个标记图上，精确 DOS 可确定阻挫指数，五个矩即可将其恢复到平均误差 0.4（远小于一次符号翻转）。此外，零场之外所涉及的迹估计问题是 DQC1-complete 的，可提供尚无高效经典采样方法可及的谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ising 态密度的标准化矩可以计数符号闭合游走、具有切换不变性且天然与尺寸无关，可作为学习特征；在 1.4×10^5 个标记图上，精确 DOS 可确定阻挫指数，五个矩即可将其恢复到平均误差 0.4（远小于一次符号翻转）。此外，零场之外所涉及的迹估计问题是 DQC1-complete 的，可提供尚无高效经典采样方法可及的谱特征。；创新点：提出从问题相关哈密顿量态密度中提取量子谱特征并用于符号图机器学习的新框架；证明所用矩具有计数符号闭合游走、切换不变、尺寸无关的性质；提出 DOS-QPE 方法显著减少采样次数；并指出零场之外的迹估计问题属于 DQC1-complete，从而触及无高效经典采样方法的谱特征。摘要提到该工作为社交网络平衡分析、自旋玻璃、相关聚类和蛋白质相互作用网络等量子应用开辟了路径。
papers.method_zh: 提出将符号图嵌入为 Ising 模型实例，用 Ising DOS 的标准化矩作为特征；提出 DOS-QPE（对纯化的最大混合探针做相位估计）来采样谱密度，其所需测量次数比基于 Hadamard 测试的迹采样少若干数量级，并将所得特征直接输入经典训练的模型。零场情形可经典采样，用于对量子提取流程进行精确基准校验。

papers.title: Nonlinear dynamics and mechanical frequency combs with a Meissner-levitated micromagnet
papers.abstract: Nonlinearities in multimode mechanical systems can give rise to rich dynamical phenomena with great potential for sensing applications and for future quantum experiments. We demonstrate that the coupled center-of-mass and rotational motion of a Meissner-levitated micromagnet offer a promising platform for nonlinear dynamics, combining low dissipation, magnetic tunability, strong intrinsic Duffing nonlinearities, and nonlinear intermodal couplings. We use this tunability to demonstrate the generation of a mechanical frequency comb in the micromagnet dynamics, realized by parametric excitation of two translational modes followed by cascaded nonlinear frequency mixing, which produces a phononic comb with tunable spacing. At large amplitudes, nonlinear coupling to a low-frequency librational mode of the magnet leads to parametric excitation and phase locking of that mode, generating a dense spectral fine structure at subharmonics of the drive. These results establish levitated micromagnets as a platform for nonlinear multimode mechanics, with potential applications in precision sensing and quantum-limited metrology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中使用“We demonstrate”“realized by parametric excitation”“produces a phononic comb”等表述，表明工作以实验实现和观测为主。；研究对象：Meissner 悬浮微磁体的多模机械非线性动力学，具体包括其质心平动模式与转动模式之间的耦合，以及由此产生的机械频率梳和低频摆动模式的参量激发与锁相现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Meissner 悬浮微磁体因低耗散、磁可调性、强内禀 Duffing 非线性及非线性模间耦合，可作为研究非线性多模力学的平台；通过参量激发两个平动模式并经级联非线性频率混合，可产生间距可调的声子频率梳；在大振幅下，与低频摆动模式的非线性耦合会导致该模式的参量激发和锁相，在驱动频率的次谐波处形成密集的频谱精细结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Meissner 悬浮微磁体因低耗散、磁可调性、强内禀 Duffing 非线性及非线性模间耦合，可作为研究非线性多模力学的平台；通过参量激发两个平动模式并经级联非线性频率混合，可产生间距可调的声子频率梳；在大振幅下，与低频摆动模式的非线性耦合会导致该模式的参量激发和锁相，在驱动频率的次谐波处形成密集的频谱精细结构。；创新点：首次在 Meissner 悬浮微磁体平台上展示了机械频率梳的产生，利用其磁可调性实现梳间距可调；并揭示了大振幅下非线性模间耦合导致的低频摆动模式参量激发与锁相，产生驱动次谐波处的密集频谱精细结构。该工作将悬浮微磁体确立为非线性多模力学的新平台，并指出其在精密传感和量子极限计量中的潜在应用。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用 Meissner 悬浮微磁体体系，通过参量激发两个平动模式，并借助级联非线性频率混合实现机械频率梳；在大振幅条件下观测非线性耦合引发的低频摆动模式参量激发与锁相。摘要未明确说明具体的探测手段（如激光干涉、位移测量方案等）及磁悬浮的具体实验装置细节。

papers.title: Breaking Water at Graphene Defects
papers.abstract: Water dissociation at solid surfaces underpins processes ranging from corrosion and catalysis to electrochemistry and photovoltaics. Defects often serve as reactive sites for dissociation, yet how solvation influences water dissociation at such sites remains poorly understood. Here, we use state-of-the-art machine-learned interatomic potentials to explore water dissociation at defective graphene-water interfaces. We show that solvation qualitatively changes the reaction mechanism at a graphene single vacancy (SV), opening pathways that are absent for an isolated water molecule. Whereas the gas-phase process proceeds via a single concerted channel, the solvated SV splits water through two competing pathways: a basic route forming SV-H and OH-(aq), and an acidic route forming SV-OH and H3O+(aq). These lower-barrier pathways produce distinct chemisorbed intermediates that enhance graphene-water adsorption. Accordingly, even a simple carbon vacancy gives rise to unexpectedly rich interfacial chemistry, coupling surface chemistry to interfacial charge and wettability, with implications for carbon functionalization and nanofluidic transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：machine-learned interatomic potentials（机器学习原子间势）、explore water dissociation at defective graphene-water interfaces，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：缺陷石墨烯-水界面上的水分解反应。具体涉及石墨烯单空位（single vacancy, SV）缺陷处水分子在溶剂化环境下的解离机制，以及解离产生的化学吸附中间体对石墨烯-水吸附的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 溶剂化定性地改变了石墨烯单空位处水分解的反应机制：气相中水分解仅通过单一协同通道进行，而在溶剂化环境下，单空位通过两条竞争路径分解水——碱性路径生成 SV-H 和 OH⁻(aq)，酸性路径生成 SV-OH 和 H₃O⁺(aq)。这些低势垒路径产生不同的化学吸附中间体，增强了石墨烯-水的吸附。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：溶剂化定性地改变了石墨烯单空位处水分解的反应机制：气相中水分解仅通过单一协同通道进行，而在溶剂化环境下，单空位通过两条竞争路径分解水——碱性路径生成 SV-H 和 OH⁻(aq)，酸性路径生成 SV-OH 和 H₃O⁺(aq)。这些低势垒路径产生不同的化学吸附中间体，增强了石墨烯-水的吸附。；创新点：揭示了溶剂化对石墨烯单空位处水分解机制的定性改变——从气相的单一协同通道转变为溶剂化下的两条竞争路径（碱性和酸性），并表明即使是简单的碳空位也能产生出乎意料的丰富界面化学，将表面化学与界面电荷和润湿性耦合起来。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 使用先进的机器学习原子间势（machine-learned interatomic potentials）进行模拟计算，研究缺陷石墨烯-水界面的水分解过程。摘要未明确说明具体的机器学习势方法细节或是否结合其他计算框架。

papers.title: Antimony for broadband nanophotonics across the ultraviolet, visible and infrared
papers.abstract: Semimetal elemental antimony (Sb) nanostructures show great potential for applications where nanophotonic properties play a key role, such as phase-change optical memories, non-linear optical elements, photothermal therapy agents, photodetectors and photocatalysts. However, designing advanced Sb-based photonic devices critically requires an accurate and reliable knowledge of the optical response of bulk and nanoscale Sb. Herein, we report for the first time a fully consistent and accurately measured dielectric function for Sb nanoscale films in a wide spectral range from the ultraviolet to the far infrared (4 - 0.04 eV, i.e. ~ 0.3 - 30 $μ$m), surpassing previous reports that explored a limited spectral range. It is found that the Sb spectral response is driven exclusively by giant interband transitions in the visible up to mid infrared (4 - 0.4 eV, i.e. ~ 0.3 - 3 $μ$m), and that their contribution dominates over that of free carriers down to 0.12 eV (i.e. ~ 10 $μ$m). Such spectral response enables Sb nanostructures to display spectrally selective and tunable nanophotonic resonances. First, we showcase interband plasmonic resonances in the visible-to-near infrared for Sb nanogratings. Second, we report giant refractive index dielectric resonances in the mid infrared for nanostructured Sb/dielectric/metal resonant cavities. These findings open a pathway to optimized planar Sb nanoscale designs enabling a tailored light-matter interaction, which will be useful for integrated data, telecom, medical, optoelectronic and energy conversion devices operating in a broad spectral range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：“accurately measured dielectric function”（精确测量的介电函数）、“we report for the first time a fully consistent and accurately measured dielectric function for Sb nanoscale films”，表明核心工作是实验测量。；研究对象：半金属元素锑（Sb）的纳米尺度薄膜及其纳米结构（Sb纳米光栅、Sb/介质/金属谐振腔），研究其在紫外到远红外宽光谱范围内的光学响应（介电函数）及纳米光子学共振现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次报道了Sb纳米薄膜在4–0.04 eV（约0.3–30 μm）宽光谱范围内完全自洽且精确测量的介电函数；发现Sb的光谱响应完全由可见光至中红外的巨大带间跃迁主导，且其贡献在低至0.12 eV（约10 μm）仍超过自由载流子贡献；基于此实现了可见-近红外带间等离激元共振和中红外巨型折射率介质共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次报道了Sb纳米薄膜在4–0.04 eV（约0.3–30 μm）宽光谱范围内完全自洽且精确测量的介电函数；发现Sb的光谱响应完全由可见光至中红外的巨大带间跃迁主导，且其贡献在低至0.12 eV（约10 μm）仍超过自由载流子贡献；基于此实现了可见-近红外带间等离激元共振和中红外巨型折射率介质共振。；创新点：首次提供了Sb纳米薄膜在紫外到远红外（4–0.04 eV）宽光谱范围内完全自洽且精确测量的介电函数，超越了此前仅覆盖有限光谱范围的报道；并基于此展示了Sb纳米结构的光谱选择性和可调谐纳米光子学共振（带间等离激元共振与巨型折射率介质共振）。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量Sb纳米薄膜的介电函数（光谱范围4–0.04 eV）；制备Sb纳米光栅并观测可见-近红外带间等离激元共振；构建纳米结构化的Sb/介质/金属谐振腔并观测中红外介质共振。摘要未明确说明具体的测量设备（如椭偏仪等）和制备手段。

papers.title: Local decoders for fault-tolerant quantum computation and translation-invariant stabilizer codes
papers.abstract: We construct the first fully spatially local fault-tolerant quantum computer based on topological codes in fewer than four spatial dimensions. Our construction is a two-dimensional architecture that uses only geometrically local quantum and classical operations, bounded-speed classical communication and computation, and a constant density of quantum and classical resources. The core component is a new time-translation-invariant cellular-automaton decoder for the surface code. This decoder preserves logical information for a time stretched-exponential in the code distance and operates continuously during state injection, stabilizer-state preparation, lattice surgery, and transversal readout. We also prove that every translation-invariant topological Pauli stabilizer code is locally decodable under phenomenological noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：论文以构造（construct）、证明（prove）为核心，提出新的解码器架构与定理，不涉及具体实验测量或数值模拟数据。；研究对象：容错量子计算体系，具体为拓扑码（topological codes），特别是表面码（surface code），以及平移不变拓扑 Pauli 稳定子码（translation-invariant topological Pauli stabilizer codes）。涉及的现象包括逻辑信息在噪声下的保持、态注入、稳定子态制备、晶格手术（lattice surgery）和横向读出等量子计算操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者构造了首个基于拓扑码、在少于四维空间维度下完全空间局域的容错量子计算机：这是一个二维架构，仅使用几何局域的量子与经典操作、有界速度的经典通信与计算，以及常数密度的量子与经典资源。其核心是一个新的时间平移不变元胞自动机解码器，能在码距的拉伸指数（stretched-exponential）时间内保持逻辑信息，并可在态注入、稳定子态制备、晶格手术和横向读出过程中持续运行。此外，作者证明了每个平移不变拓扑 Pauli 稳定子码在唯象噪声（phenomenological noise）下都是局域可解码的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者构造了首个基于拓扑码、在少于四维空间维度下完全空间局域的容错量子计算机：这是一个二维架构，仅使用几何局域的量子与经典操作、有界速度的经典通信与计算，以及常数密度的量子与经典资源。其核心是一个新的时间平移不变元胞自动机解码器，能在码距的拉伸指数（stretched-exponential）时间内保持逻辑信息，并可在态注入、稳定子态制备、晶格手术和横向读出过程中持续运行。此外，作者证明了每个平移不变拓扑 Pauli 稳定子码在唯象噪声（phenomenological noise）下都是局域可解码的。；创新点：首次实现了在少于四维空间维度下完全空间局域的容错量子计算架构（此前通常需要四维或更高维度才能实现完全局域性）；提出了新的时间平移不变元胞自动机表面码解码器，并证明其可在码距的拉伸指数时间内保持逻辑信息且支持多种操作流程；同时证明了所有平移不变拓扑 Pauli 稳定子码在唯象噪声下的局域可解码性。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与数学证明。具体包括：构造时间平移不变的元胞自动机解码器（cellular-automaton decoder）；基于拓扑码设计二维容错量子计算架构；证明关于平移不变拓扑 Pauli 稳定子码局域可解码性的定理。摘要未明确说明是否使用了数值模拟或具体计算工具。

papers.title: Gauss Law, Monodromy Defect, Magnetic Lattice Translation, and Lattice Duality
papers.abstract: In a Hamiltonian lattice gauge theory, the physical Hilbert space is fixed by the Gauss law, by choosing an eigenspace of the Gauss law operator which generates the gauge transformation. Choosing a non-trivial eigenspace is referred to as the modified Gauss law. In 2+1d dynamical U(1) pure gauge theory, we show that these physical Hilbert spaces are defect Hilbert spaces associated with non-topological monodromy defects for monopole operators and topological defects for U(1) 1-form symmetry, inserted along the time direction. We also construct the corresponding lattice translation operators. Under a nontrivially modified Gauss law, these translations obey a magnetic translation algebra. Finally, we discuss how the modified Gauss laws are manifested in 2+1d compact bosons, via exact duality on the lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：标题与摘要中出现“Hamiltonian lattice gauge theory”“show that”“construct”“discuss”等表述，全文围绕格点规范理论的形式化推导与对偶论证展开，未涉及实验测量或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：2+1维动力学 U(1) 纯规范理论（dynamical U(1) pure gauge theory）中的物理希尔伯特空间，以及修改高斯定律（modified Gauss law）所对应的缺陷希尔伯特空间；同时涉及单极子算符的非拓扑单值缺陷、U(1) 1-形式对称性的拓扑缺陷，以及 2+1维紧致玻色子（compact bosons）的格点对偶表现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 2+1维动力学 U(1) 纯规范理论中，选取高斯定律算符的非平凡本征空间（即修改高斯定律）所得到的物理希尔伯特空间，等价于沿时间方向插入单极子算符的非拓扑单值缺陷和 U(1) 1-形式对称性拓扑缺陷所对应的缺陷希尔伯特空间；在非平凡修改的高斯定律下，所构造的格点平移算符满足磁平移代数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 2+1维动力学 U(1) 纯规范理论中，选取高斯定律算符的非平凡本征空间（即修改高斯定律）所得到的物理希尔伯特空间，等价于沿时间方向插入单极子算符的非拓扑单值缺陷和 U(1) 1-形式对称性拓扑缺陷所对应的缺陷希尔伯特空间；在非平凡修改的高斯定律下，所构造的格点平移算符满足磁平移代数。；创新点：将修改高斯定律所对应的物理希尔伯特空间识别为特定缺陷（单极子非拓扑单值缺陷与 1-形式对称性拓扑缺陷）的缺陷希尔伯特空间，并构造出在非平凡修改高斯定律下满足磁平移代数的格点平移算符，最后通过格点精确对偶联系到 2+1维紧致玻色子。
papers.method_zh: 哈密顿量格点规范理论框架；通过选取高斯定律算符的本征空间来固定物理希尔伯特空间；构造相应的格点平移算符并分析其代数结构；利用格点上的精确对偶（exact duality on the lattice）讨论修改高斯定律在 2+1维紧致玻色子中的体现。

papers.title: Influence of magnetic fields on the performance of spin-orbit torque magnetic random-access memory
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit torque magnetic random-access memory (SOT-MRAM) offers high speed, ultrahigh endurance, and compatibility with advanced semiconductor processes, making it a promising candidate for next-generation nonvolatile memory. However, intrinsic bias fields in magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs), originating from reference-layer stray fields and interlayer coupling, cause asymmetric critical switching currents and increased energy consumption. Existing compensation approaches usually introduce additional magnetic layers into the MTJ stack, which increases fabrication complexity and limits wafer-scale integration. Here, we propose a bias-compensation strategy without modifying the MTJ stack by engineering local stray magnetic fields through magnetic filling materials in vertical interconnect access (VIA) channels during the back-end-of-line process. Micromagnetic simulations show that the proposed magnetic filling layer can provide the required auxiliary field for deterministic switching and significantly suppress write-current asymmetry. By optimizing the MTJ position relative to the magnetic filling structure, the write-current bias ratio is reduced from 21.6% in the conventional design to 1.3%. The approach is also applicable to in-plane magnetic anisotropy SOT-MTJs, reducing the bias ratio from 19.8% to -0.2%. Scaling analysis further demonstrates that the compensation effect remains effective when the device size is reduced to 20% of the original dimension (MTJ diameter approximately 10 nm), indicating its potential for high-density SOT-MRAM integration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：micromagnetic simulations（微磁学模拟）、propose a bias-compensation strategy、scaling analysis。摘要中未提及任何实验制备或测量，全部结论基于微磁学模拟。；研究对象：自旋轨道矩磁随机存取存储器（SOT-MRAM）中的磁隧道结（MTJ）。具体研究的是MTJ中由参考层杂散场和层间耦合引起的本征偏置场，以及该偏置场导致的临界翻转电流不对称和能耗增加问题。涉及垂直磁各向异性和面内磁各向异性两种SOT-MTJ体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在BEOL工艺的垂直互连通道（VIA）中引入磁性填充材料来工程化局部杂散磁场，可在不修改MTJ叠层的前提下提供确定性翻转所需的辅助场，显著抑制写电流不对称性。优化MTJ相对于磁性填充结构的位置后，写电流偏置比从传统设计的21.6%降至1.3%（垂直各向异性体系），面内各向异性体系从19.8%降至-0.2%。器件尺寸缩小至原来的20%（MTJ直径约10 nm）时补偿效果仍然有效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在BEOL工艺的垂直互连通道（VIA）中引入磁性填充材料来工程化局部杂散磁场，可在不修改MTJ叠层的前提下提供确定性翻转所需的辅助场，显著抑制写电流不对称性。优化MTJ相对于磁性填充结构的位置后，写电流偏置比从传统设计的21.6%降至1.3%（垂直各向异性体系），面内各向异性体系从19.8%降至-0.2%。器件尺寸缩小至原来的20%（MTJ直径约10 nm）时补偿效果仍然有效。；创新点：提出了一种不修改MTJ叠层本身的偏置补偿策略，而是通过在后道工序（BEOL）的垂直互连通道中填充磁性材料来工程化局部杂散磁场。相比现有通常需要额外引入磁性层的补偿方案，该方法不增加MTJ叠层的制备复杂度，有利于晶圆级集成。
papers.method_zh: 微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulations）。具体模拟工具和参数摘要未明确说明。此外进行了器件尺寸缩放分析（scaling analysis）。

papers.title: Physics of Information Geometry - Part II: Small-Step Active Inference on the Probability Simplex
papers.abstract: This paper is the second in a two-part investigation of the physics of information geometry. While Part I develops a physical foundation for distributional motion on the probability simplex, the present paper studies how that framework manifests in active inference. The treatment is fully self-contained and does not require familiarity with Part I. We focus in particular on active inference through small distributional steps and the geometric structure induced by such local motion. Starting from an initial distribution, an agent evolves its belief state toward a final target distribution through a sequence of constrained updates. We define a relative free energy functional with respect to the preferred distribution and extend it to a relative potential energy analogous to the Helmholtz/Gibbs free-energy decomposition. The evolution is subject to a per-step kinetic constraint expressed through the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between consecutive distributions, which serves as a discrete kinetic energy on the probability simplex. Using the information-geometric Pythagorean theorem on KL balls, we show that sufficiently small local moves dominate large direct jumps, and that greedy maximization of free-energy reduction is globally optimal under the kinetic constraint. This leads to a sequential variational principle in which the optimal trajectory minimizes the associated Lagrangian of the optimization problem. Similar to classical mechanics, the Lagrangian takes on the form as the difference between the kinetic and potential terms, establishing a least-action principle for distributional motion on the simplex. The resulting optimal update admits a closed form as an exponentially tilted version of the current distribution toward the preferred distribution, parametrized by an inverse-temperature-like multiplier. We further extend the framework to incorporate state-dependent geodesic...
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中未涉及任何实验或数值计算，全文围绕概率单纯形上的分布运动、相对自由能泛函、KL散度约束、信息几何勾股定理、变分原理与拉格朗日量等理论框架展开，属于纯理论/形式化研究。；研究对象：主动推断（active inference）框架下，智能体在概率单纯形上的信念状态演化过程。具体研究智能体从初始分布出发，通过一系列受约束的小步分布更新，逐步逼近目标（偏好）分布这一物理/信息几何现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在每步以KL散度作为离散动能约束的条件下，足够小的局部移动优于大的直接跳跃，且贪婪地最大化自由能减少在动能约束下是全局最优的；由此可导出一个序列变分原理，其最优轨迹最小化对应优化问题的拉格朗日量，该拉格朗日量呈动能与势能之差的形式，从而在单纯形上的分布运动中建立了一个最小作用量原理。最优更新具有闭式解，即当前分布朝偏好分布的指数倾斜形式，由一个类逆温度乘子参数化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在每步以KL散度作为离散动能约束的条件下，足够小的局部移动优于大的直接跳跃，且贪婪地最大化自由能减少在动能约束下是全局最优的；由此可导出一个序列变分原理，其最优轨迹最小化对应优化问题的拉格朗日量，该拉格朗日量呈动能与势能之差的形式，从而在单纯形上的分布运动中建立了一个最小作用量原理。最优更新具有闭式解，即当前分布朝偏好分布的指数倾斜形式，由一个类逆温度乘子参数化。；创新点：将主动推断中的小步分布更新置于信息几何与经典力学类比的理论框架下，提出以KL散度作为离散动能、相对自由能作为势能的拉格朗日量，建立了概率单纯形上分布运动的最小作用量原理，并证明在动能约束下贪婪自由能最大化具有全局最优性，同时给出最优更新的闭式指数倾斜解。摘要未明确说明该框架与Part I的具体差异细节及状态依赖测地线推广的完整内容。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：在概率单纯形上定义相对于偏好分布的相对自由能泛函，并推广为类似Helmholtz/Gibbs自由能分解的相对势能；以相邻分布间的KL散度作为离散动能约束；运用KL球上的信息几何勾股定理；构建序列变分原理与拉格朗日量；推导最优更新的闭式解（指数倾斜形式，含类逆温度乘子）；并进一步将框架推广至状态依赖的测地线情形（摘要在此处截断）。

papers.title: Detecting one-dimensional bosonic SPT phases via twisted entropic order parameter
papers.abstract: Entanglement asymmetry, introduced by F. Ares, S. Murciano and P. Calabrese, provides a density-matrix diagnostic of symmetry breaking and successfully captures the Landau data associated with a broken symmetry pattern. However, it is by now well established that gapped quantum many-body systems can exhibit phases which are not characterized solely by Landau symmetry breaking. A fundamental example is a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase, and the ordinary definition of entanglement asymmetry is insensitive to this topological information. In this work we introduce a refined quantity, which we call the twisted entropic order parameter, designed to detect SPT phases from reduced density matrices, particularly focusing on one-dimensional bosonic systems. The key ingredient in our construction is an ancilla degrees of freedom that coherently records the untwisted state and the twisted state associated to a one-ended topological defect of unbroken symmetry, so that the enlarged density matrix retains the charge carried by the defect endpoint. We demonstrate our proposal in concrete lattice models and further generalize it beyond ordinary group symmetries, establishing its ability to diagnose SPT phases. This provides a first step toward a unified entanglement-asymmetry framework for diagnosing quantum phases of matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提出新的物理量（twisted entropic order parameter）并给出构造方案，在具体晶格模型上做演示（demonstrate in concrete lattice models），属于理论框架构建与模型验证，未涉及实验测量或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：一维玻色子对称保护拓扑（SPT）相，以及用于诊断这些相的低维量子多体系统。具体研究的是如何从约化密度矩阵中探测SPT相，涉及未破缺对称性的一端点拓扑缺陷（one-ended topological defect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入了一个称为“twisted entropic order parameter”的精炼量，能够从约化密度矩阵中探测SPT相；其关键机制是通过一个辅助自由度（ancilla）相干地记录未扭曲态和与拓扑缺陷相关的扭曲态，使扩展后的密度矩阵保留缺陷端点所携带的电荷，从而实现对SPT相的诊断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入了一个称为“twisted entropic order parameter”的精炼量，能够从约化密度矩阵中探测SPT相；其关键机制是通过一个辅助自由度（ancilla）相干地记录未扭曲态和与拓扑缺陷相关的扭曲态，使扩展后的密度矩阵保留缺陷端点所携带的电荷，从而实现对SPT相的诊断。；创新点：已有的纠缠不对称性仅能诊断朗道对称破缺，对SPT相的拓扑信息不敏感；本文提出的twisted entropic order parameter通过引入辅助自由度记录拓扑缺陷端点的电荷，首次将纠缠不对称性框架扩展到能够诊断SPT相，并推广至超越普通群对称性的情形，为统一的纠缠不对称性诊断量子物相框架迈出第一步。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架基于纠缠不对称性（entanglement asymmetry）的推广，构造包含辅助自由度的扩展密度矩阵，在具体晶格模型上进行演示，并将方案推广到超出普通群对称性的情形。摘要未明确说明具体使用了哪些数值方法（如DMRG、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: Recurrence and transience of random walks with drift $ρx^α/t^β$
papers.abstract: Menshikov and Volkov [Electron. J. Probab. 13 (2008)] studied recurrence and transience of a class of Markovian random walks on $\mathbb R_+$ whose conditional drift depends on both time and position and is of order $ρx^αt^{-β}$ with $ρ>0$. The case on the critical line $2β-α=1$, with $α\in(-1,1)\setminus\{0\}$, remained open. We prove recurrence in this remaining case. Furthermore, we establish recurrence and transience criteria that complete the classification for $-1<α<1$ and $β\ge 0$, without assuming the Markov property and under weaker assumptions on the increments than those imposed by Menshikov and Volkov.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Markovian random walks、recurrence and transience、drift、critical line、classification criteria——属于概率论与随机过程的理论研究，不涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：研究 $\mathbb R_+$ 上一类马尔可夫随机游走的常返性与暂态性，其条件漂移同时依赖于时间和位置，量级为 $\rho x^\alpha t^{-\beta}$（$\rho>0$）。具体关注临界线 $2\beta-\alpha=1$ 上 $\alpha\in(-1,1)\setminus\{0\}$ 的未决情形，以及 $-1<\alpha<1$、$\beta\ge 0$ 范围内的完整分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了临界线 $2\beta-\alpha=1$（$\alpha\in(-1,1)\setminus\{0\}$）上此前遗留情形的常返性；并建立了完整的常返与暂态判定准则，从而完成了 $-1<\alpha<1$、$\beta\ge 0$ 范围内的分类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了临界线 $2\beta-\alpha=1$（$\alpha\in(-1,1)\setminus\{0\}$）上此前遗留情形的常返性；并建立了完整的常返与暂态判定准则，从而完成了 $-1<\alpha<1$、$\beta\ge 0$ 范围内的分类。；创新点：解决了 Menshikov 和 Volkov（2008）遗留的临界线 $2\beta-\alpha=1$、$\alpha\in(-1,1)\setminus\{0\}$ 的开放问题，证明该情形为常返；并将分类结果推广到不依赖马尔可夫性质、增量假设更弱的更一般情形。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：随机游走的常返/暂态判定，在比 Menshikov 和 Volkov 更弱的增量假设下进行，且不假设马尔可夫性质。摘要未明确说明具体使用的数学工具或技术手段。

papers.title: Phases in a class of associative memories via hidden neurons
papers.abstract: Associative memory in the Hopfield network is attractor dynamics in a disordered many-body system, and higher-order and exponential extensions turn its retrieval update into softmax attention. The polynomial and exponential regimes have been analyzed by different methods, with no common architecture in which to ask what fixes the storage scale. In this paper we study the bipartite architecture of Krotov and Hopfield, which we call the class $H$, whose model is fixed by a Lagrangian for each layer, taking the hidden neurons as the order parameter of retrieval. At polynomial load the replica method yields the replica-symmetric phase diagrams and closed-form capacities, and the crosstalk moment is common to Ising and spherical visible neurons, so their differences come from the visible entropy. With a softmax hidden layer the load is exponential, and a copy representation maps the thermodynamics onto random-energy-model counting, with paramagnetic, condensed, and frozen phases. Heating destabilizes retrieval by quantized reassignments of attention, and typical Gaussian patterns remain metastable at every load. The regimes differ in their crosstalk statistics, central-limit at polynomial load and large-deviation at exponential load, and the class $H$ splits retrieval into two roles, the visible Lagrangian fixing stability and the hidden one the storage scale, two axes that may also guide the design of new Lagrangians.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“replica method”“Lagrangian”“phase diagrams”“closed-form capacities”“thermodynamics”“random-energy-model counting”等理论物理与统计力学方法关键词，未涉及实验测量或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：一类联想记忆网络，即 Krotov-Hopfield 二分架构（文中称为 class H），包括多项式负载与指数负载（softmax 隐藏层）两种情形，研究其检索相图、存储容量及相变行为。属于无序多体系统/神经网络统计力学范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多项式负载下，复制方法给出复本对称相图和闭式容量，且 Ising 与球面可见神经元的串扰矩相同，二者差异仅来自可见熵；在 softmax 隐藏层下负载为指数级，通过 copy representation 将热力学映射为随机能量模型计数，出现顺磁、凝聚和冻结相；升温通过注意力的量子化重分配破坏检索，典型高斯模式在任何负载下都保持亚稳。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多项式负载下，复制方法给出复本对称相图和闭式容量，且 Ising 与球面可见神经元的串扰矩相同，二者差异仅来自可见熵；在 softmax 隐藏层下负载为指数级，通过 copy representation 将热力学映射为随机能量模型计数，出现顺磁、凝聚和冻结相；升温通过注意力的量子化重分配破坏检索，典型高斯模式在任何负载下都保持亚稳。；创新点：首次在统一的二分架构（class H）中比较多项式与指数两种负载情形，提出可见 Lagrangian 决定稳定性、隐藏 Lagrangian 决定存储尺度的“两个轴”图像，从而为理解存储尺度由什么决定以及设计新 Lagrangian 提供框架；并揭示两种负载 regime 在串扰统计上的本质差异（中心极限 vs 大偏差）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：统计力学中的复制方法（replica method）用于多项式负载下的相图与容量解析；copy representation 结合随机能量模型（random-energy-model）计数用于指数负载下的热力学分析；以 Lagrangian 描述每一层，将隐藏神经元作为检索序参量；区分多项式负载下的中心极限串扰统计与指数负载下的大偏差串扰统计。

papers.title: Timelike Entanglement from Spacetime Density Matrices: A Lattice Realization
papers.abstract: We investigate timelike entanglement in quantum field theory using spacetime density matrices and provide a microscopic lattice realization. For a two-dimensional free real scalar field, we extend Gaussian diagonalization methods to the generally non-Hermitian reduced spacetime density matrix and determine its complete nonzero spectrum in the generic regular case, together with all integer Rényi moments. The real-time replica construction identifies these moments with Lorentzian branch-point twist-operator correlation functions. We test this identification against the full four-point function on a circle, boundary two-point functions with Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions, and massive form-factor predictions, finding quantitative agreement in both magnitude and phase across distinct causal regimes. The boundary setup exhibits a finite causally connected window in which every integer Rényi entropy is real, showing that reality is not equivalent to causal disconnection. These results provide a microscopic lattice foundation for timelike entanglement and for Lorentzian twist-operator methods beyond equal-time regions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：quantum field theory、Gaussian diagonalization methods、lattice realization、replica construction、form-factor predictions——全文围绕理论框架与解析/数值验证展开，不涉及真实实验测量。；研究对象：二维自由实标量场（two-dimensional free real scalar field）中的类时纠缠（timelike entanglement），以及时空密度矩阵（spacetime density matrices）的谱性质与 Rényi 熵。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者将高斯对角化方法推广到一般非厄米的约化时空密度矩阵，得到了其完整的非零谱及所有整数阶 Rényi 矩；并发现边界设置下存在一个有限的因果连通窗口，其中每个整数阶 Rényi 熵都是实数，表明“熵为实数”与“因果不连通”并不等价。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者将高斯对角化方法推广到一般非厄米的约化时空密度矩阵，得到了其完整的非零谱及所有整数阶 Rényi 矩；并发现边界设置下存在一个有限的因果连通窗口，其中每个整数阶 Rényi 熵都是实数，表明“熵为实数”与“因果不连通”并不等价。；创新点：首次为类时纠缠提供了微观格点基础，将高斯对角化推广至非厄米时空密度矩阵并获得完整谱；建立了实时 replica 构造与洛伦兹 twist 算符关联函数的对应，并将 twist 算符方法推广到等时区域之外；指出 Rényi 熵为实数并不蕴含因果不连通。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为量子场论中的时空密度矩阵与实时 replica 构造（real-time replica construction），将 Rényi 矩与洛伦兹型分支点 twist 算符关联函数对应；技术上推广了高斯对角化方法以处理非厄米约化密度矩阵。验证手段包括：圆上完整四点函数、Dirichlet 与 Neumann 边界条件下的边界两点函数、以及有质量形状因子（form-factor）预言，并在不同因果区域比较幅度与相位。

papers.title: Symmetry-aware super-resolution of crystal orientation maps via invariant latent-space learning
papers.abstract: Crystal-orientation maps are physical fields defined only up to crystal symmetry; electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) resolves them experimentally, but acquisition-time constraints limit spatial resolution. Unlike conventional images, EBSD data lie on the quotient space $\mathrm{SO}(3)/G$, where $G$ is the crystal-symmetry group. Standard Euclidean interpolation can therefore mix symmetry-equivalent representations and blur grain boundaries. We introduce the Symmetry-Group-Aware Super-Resolution Attention Network (SG-SRAN), which incorporates crystal symmetry and boundary preservation by design. A frozen, locally isometric encoder maps equivalent orientations to a common latent representation in which Euclidean distance approximates misorientation. Super-resolution is performed in this space, with each high-resolution token restricted to a feature-consistent local support to prevent cross-boundary mixing. A dictionary-based decoder then recovers valid orientations. Across FCC and HCP benchmarks, SG-SRAN matches 15-16 million parameter backbones using only 27-49k trainable parameters, while achieving the lowest p68 errors, highest inverse-pole-figure fidelity, and zero-shot transfer to unseen alloys.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章（机器学习方法开发）。关键依据：提出神经网络架构（SG-SRAN）、在基准数据集上做对比评估，摘要未涉及具体实验测量或理论解析推导。；研究对象：晶体取向图（crystal-orientation maps），即电子背散射衍射（EBSD）测得的取向数据。这类数据位于商空间 SO(3)/G（G 为晶体对称群），研究目标是提升其空间分辨率（超分辨），涉及 FCC 和 HCP 两类晶体对称性体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SG-SRAN 通过将等价的晶体取向映射到统一的潜在表示并在该空间内做超分辨，能避免传统欧氏插值造成的晶界模糊；在 FCC 和 HCP 基准上，仅用 27–49k 可训练参数就达到 15–16M 参数骨干网络的性能，取得最低 p68 误差、最高极图保真度，并可零样本迁移到未见合金。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SG-SRAN 通过将等价的晶体取向映射到统一的潜在表示并在该空间内做超分辨，能避免传统欧氏插值造成的晶界模糊；在 FCC 和 HCP 基准上，仅用 27–49k 可训练参数就达到 15–16M 参数骨干网络的性能，取得最低 p68 误差、最高极图保真度，并可零样本迁移到未见合金。；创新点：将晶体对称性（SO(3)/G 商空间结构）和晶界保持显式地嵌入网络设计：用冻结等距编码器统一对称等价表示、用局部支撑约束防止跨晶界混合、用字典解码器保证输出为合法取向；从而以极少可训练参数（27–49k）匹配大模型性能，并具备零样本跨合金迁移能力。
papers.method_zh: 提出对称群感知超分辨注意力网络（SG-SRAN），包含三部分：冻结的局部等距编码器（将等价取向映射到欧氏距离近似错取向角的潜在空间）、在该潜在空间内进行超分辨且每个高分辨 token 限制在特征一致的局部支撑内（防止跨晶界混合）、基于字典的解码器恢复合法取向。评估在 FCC 与 HCP 基准上进行，指标包括 p68 误差、极图保真度和零样本迁移。

papers.title: A new generation of effective core potentials: Selected heavy 5d and 6p elements
papers.abstract: We expand the correlation-consistent effective core potentials (ccECPs) library by developing semi-local pseudopotentials and matching basis sets by heavy-elements from $5d$ (Hf, Os, Hg) and $6p$ (Tl, Po, At, Rn) blocks. In order to accurately capture scalar relativistic effects, spin-orbit coupling, and electron-electron correlation, we implement a tiered core-valence partitioning strategy across three distinct resolutions. This includes a small 60-core (Hf, Os, Hg) that explicitly correlates subvalence shells, a large 78-core definition for the main-group elements that rigorously accounts for core polarization and relaxation effects in sparse valence environments, and an intermediate 68-core partition for Hg and Tl. This 68-core architecture represents a unique development in the ccECP library, optimizing the balance between accuracy and computational efficiency in a manner unexplored for ligther elements. Optimized against relativistic all-electron CCSD(T) references, the ccECPs deliver outstanding atomic precision, achieving a global average atomic low-lying states deviation of just 0.045 eV. This accuracy translates directly to robust molecular transferability, systematically restricting dissociation energy discrepancies to under 0.03 eV, equilibrium bond lengths to within 0.005 Å. By enforcing a regularized, finite potential at the origin for enhanced numerical stability in stochastic quantum Monte Carlo methods, this library removes a critical methodological bottleneck for predictive many-body simulations of heavy-element systems and materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：developing semi-local pseudopotentials and matching basis sets、optimized against relativistic all-electron CCSD(T) references、quantum Monte Carlo methods。；研究对象：重元素体系，具体为5d块元素（Hf、Os、Hg）和6p块元素（Tl、Po、At、Rn）的有效核势（effective core potentials）及其匹配基组，以及这些元素在原子和分子层面的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 新开发的ccECP库在原子低激发态上达到全球平均偏差仅0.045 eV的高精度，分子解离能偏差控制在0.03 eV以内、平衡键长偏差在0.005 Å以内，并且通过在原点处施加正则化有限势提升了随机量子蒙特卡洛方法的数值稳定性，为重元素体系的多体模拟消除了关键方法瓶颈。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：新开发的ccECP库在原子低激发态上达到全球平均偏差仅0.045 eV的高精度，分子解离能偏差控制在0.03 eV以内、平衡键长偏差在0.005 Å以内，并且通过在原点处施加正则化有限势提升了随机量子蒙特卡洛方法的数值稳定性，为重元素体系的多体模拟消除了关键方法瓶颈。；创新点：首次在ccECP库中引入68-core划分架构（针对Hg和Tl），在精度与计算效率之间实现优化平衡，这一策略在较轻元素中未曾探索；同时通过强制原点处正则化有限势，解决了随机量子蒙特卡洛方法中重元素体系的关键方法瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 开发半局域赝势（semi-local pseudopotentials）和匹配基组，采用分层核-价划分策略（三种不同分辨率：60-core、68-core、78-core），以相对论全电子CCSD(T)为参考进行优化，并针对随机量子蒙特卡洛方法进行数值稳定性处理。

papers.title: Selected Coupled Cluster Guided by Selected Configuration Interaction
papers.abstract: Coupled Cluster (CC) theory is one of the most popular correlated wavefunction methods, yet the steep computational cost scaling of CC truncated at higher rank limits its application. Modern Selected Configuration Interaction (SCI) methods successfully exploit the sparsity of ground-state wavefunctions in the determinant space, motivating an analogous approach with the exponential CC ansatz. In this work, we introduce Selected Coupled Cluster (SCC), an arbitrary-order sparse CC method that explicitly solves the CC residual equations within a compact amplitude space guided by an SCI wavefunction. SCC optimizes the CC amplitudes in the sparse amplitude space. Using a pilot Just-in-Time (JIT) compiled implementation, we benchmark SCC against SCI, SCI+PT2, standard rank-truncated dense CC (CCSD, CCSDT), and DMRG across various chemical systems. We demonstrate that SCC exhibits fast, monotonic convergence with the SCI variational threshold, outperforming SCI and surpassing SCI+PT2 in the tight-threshold regime. SCC also provides accurate energies for high-dimensional topologies, where DMRG typically converges slowly with bond dimension. SCC thus presents an efficient drop-in enhancement for modern SCI workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：benchmark、implementation、JIT compiled implementation、across various chemical systems。；研究对象：关联波函数方法本身，具体为耦合簇（CC）理论及其在量子化学/多体电子结构问题中的应用。摘要中测试对象为“various chemical systems”（多种化学体系），但未具体指明是哪些分子或材料。摘要未明确说明具体研究的材料或物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了 Selected Coupled Cluster（SCC）方法，一种任意阶稀疏 CC 方法，在 SCI 波函数引导的紧凑振幅空间中显式求解 CC 残差方程。SCC 随 SCI 变分阈值表现出快速单调收敛，优于 SCI，在紧阈值区域超越 SCI+PT2，并在 DMRG 通常随键维数收敛缓慢的高维拓扑体系上给出准确能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了 Selected Coupled Cluster（SCC）方法，一种任意阶稀疏 CC 方法，在 SCI 波函数引导的紧凑振幅空间中显式求解 CC 残差方程。SCC 随 SCI 变分阈值表现出快速单调收敛，优于 SCI，在紧阈值区域超越 SCI+PT2，并在 DMRG 通常随键维数收敛缓慢的高维拓扑体系上给出准确能量。；创新点：将 SCI 利用行列式空间中基态波函数稀疏性的思想推广到指数型 CC 拟设，提出任意阶稀疏 CC 方法（SCC），在紧凑振幅空间内显式求解 CC 残差方程，作为现代 SCI 工作流程的高效增强工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为耦合簇（CC）理论结合 Selected Configuration Interaction（SCI）；具体做法是用 SCI 波函数引导，在稀疏振幅空间中优化 CC 振幅并求解 CC 残差方程；采用 pilot Just-in-Time（JIT）编译实现；基准对比方法包括 SCI、SCI+PT2、标准秩截断稠密 CC（CCSD、CCSDT）以及 DMRG。

papers.title: Floquet Majorana XYZ Codes with Tunable Logical Dynamics
papers.abstract: We construct Floquet codes from the Majorana XYZ subsystem code with local realizations both in qubits and directly in microscopic Majorana modes with lattice size $L\times L$. For a three-step cycle, odd $L$ supports one static logical qubit, whereas even $L$ supports two. For even $L$ with $L=4n+2$, both logical qubits admit time-independent Pauli representatives. For $L=4n$, by contrast, one Pauli of the second logical qubit remains fixed throughout the cycle, while every representative of its conjugate must evolve through the measurement cycle. This distinction follows from a parity-dependent algebraic obstruction and disappears when the cycle is reduced to two steps, which restores a fully static logical pair. Thus, the same encoded logical degree of freedom can be switched between static and partially dynamical forms by the measurement schedule. With one open direction, suitable protocols can be implemented using only local Majorana parity measurements. To our knowledge, this is the first Floquet-code family with both a local qubit representation and a direct microscopic Majorana realization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构造）、Floquet codes、algebraic obstruction、protocols can be implemented，摘要中未提及任何实验测量或数值计算细节，属于理论构造与代数分析。；研究对象：基于 Majorana XYZ 子系统码构造的 Floquet 码，研究体系为量子纠错码/拓扑量子计算中的逻辑量子比特，具体涉及方格晶格（$L\times L$）上的量子比特表示和微观 Majorana 模式实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于三步测量周期，奇数 $L$ 支持一个静态逻辑量子比特，偶数 $L$ 支持两个；其中 $L=4n+2$ 时两个逻辑量子比特均有不含时的 Pauli 代表，而 $L=4n$ 时第二个逻辑量子比特的一个 Pauli 固定、其共轭的所有代表必须随测量周期演化。这一区别源于宇称相关的代数阻碍，且当周期缩减为两步时消失，恢复完全静态的逻辑对——即同一编码逻辑自由度可通过测量调度在静态与部分动力学形式之间切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于三步测量周期，奇数 $L$ 支持一个静态逻辑量子比特，偶数 $L$ 支持两个；其中 $L=4n+2$ 时两个逻辑量子比特均有不含时的 Pauli 代表，而 $L=4n$ 时第二个逻辑量子比特的一个 Pauli 固定、其共轭的所有代表必须随测量周期演化。这一区别源于宇称相关的代数阻碍，且当周期缩减为两步时消失，恢复完全静态的逻辑对——即同一编码逻辑自由度可通过测量调度在静态与部分动力学形式之间切换。；创新点：据作者所述，这是首个同时具有局部量子比特表示和直接微观 Majorana 实现的 Floquet 码家族；此外，揭示了通过测量调度可调控同一逻辑自由度的静态/动力学行为，并指出该调控与晶格尺寸的宇称及周期步数密切相关。
papers.method_zh: 构造性理论方法：从 Majorana XYZ 子系统码出发构造 Floquet 码，给出量子比特和微观 Majorana 模式两种局部实现，通过分析三步测量周期下的代数结构（宇称相关的代数阻碍）来判定逻辑算符的静态/动力学性质。摘要未明确说明使用了具体的数值计算方法或实验手段。

papers.title: Krylov Edge Spectroscopy of Symmetry-Protected Topological Phases
papers.abstract: We introduce $Krylov$ $edge$ $spectroscopy$, a many-body operator-space protocol for detecting and classifying one-dimensional symmetry-protected topological phases from local boundary dynamics. A Hermitian boundary operator generates a semi-infinite Krylov hopping chain whose boundary weight obeys an exact zero-frequency normalizability criterion. Open-periodic, boundary-bulk, and symmetry-preserving boundary-perturbation tests identify protected boundary memory, while a finite-depth leakage residual certifies when an explicitly reconstructed operator is already near zero frequency. Classification minimizes the normalized commutator over symmetry-resolved boundary operators in fixed charge sectors. For bosonic $\mathbb{Z}_N \times \mathbb{Z}_N$ phases, the recovered endpoint charge gives the cohomology label. The method requires neither many-body exact diagonalization, an explicit ground-state wavefunction or entanglement spectrum, nor a guessed dressed edge or string operator. For finite-range Hamiltonians, locality organizes the thermodynamic limit at fixed Krylov depth before the depth limit. We demonstrate the protocol in cluster, clock, Haldane, and trivial spin-1 chains. In the exactly solvable cluster chain, the transition between the gapped topological and trivial phases manifests as a localization-delocalization transition of the Krylov edge mode on the Krylov chain. This transition occurs precisely at the bulk gap closing, and its localization-length exponent coincides with the Ising correlation-length exponent. Through operator Krylov dynamics, our work turns local boundary evolution into a direct spectroscopy of many-body topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提出的是“many-body operator-space protocol”“exact zero-frequency normalizability criterion”“Classification minimizes the normalized commutator”等理论框架与判据，并在多个自旋链模型上做演示，未涉及具体实验测量。；研究对象：一维对称保护拓扑相（symmetry-protected topological phases, SPT），特别是玻色型 \(\mathbb{Z}_N \times \mathbb{Z}_N\) 相；具体演示体系包括 cluster chain、clock chain、Haldane chain 和 trivial spin-1 chain。研究现象是拓扑相及其到平凡相的相变，以及边界局域动力学所反映的拓扑信息。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出 Krylov edge spectroscopy，可从局域边界动力学检测和分类一维对称保护拓扑相；边界权重满足严格的零频可归一化判据，开放-周期、边界-体、以及保对称边界微扰测试可识别受保护的边界记忆。在可精确求解的 cluster chain 中，拓扑相与平凡相之间的转变表现为 Krylov 链上 Krylov 边缘模的局域化-离域化转变，该转变恰好发生在体 gap 闭合处，且其局域化长度指数与 Ising 关联长度指数一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出 Krylov edge spectroscopy，可从局域边界动力学检测和分类一维对称保护拓扑相；边界权重满足严格的零频可归一化判据，开放-周期、边界-体、以及保对称边界微扰测试可识别受保护的边界记忆。在可精确求解的 cluster chain 中，拓扑相与平凡相之间的转变表现为 Krylov 链上 Krylov 边缘模的局域化-离域化转变，该转变恰好发生在体 gap 闭合处，且其局域化长度指数与 Ising 关联长度指数一致。；创新点：主要新意在于把局域边界演化转化为多体拓扑的直接谱学：通过算符 Krylov 动力学检测和分类一维 SPT，而不依赖多体精确对角化、基态波函数、纠缠谱或预先猜测的边缘/弦算符。另一个新点是给出零频可归一化判据、有限深度泄漏残差和对称分辨边界算符对易子最小化等具体判据，并在可解 cluster chain 中把拓扑-平凡转变映射为 Krylov 边缘模的局域化-离域化转变，且其临界指数与 Ising 关联长度指数一致。
papers.method_zh: 使用多体算符空间协议：由一个厄米边界算符生成半无限 Krylov 跳跃链，并以其边界权重满足的精确零频可归一化判据来检测边界模式；通过开放-周期、边界-体、保对称边界微扰测试识别受保护边界记忆；用有限深度泄漏残差判断显式重构算符是否已接近零频；分类时在固定电荷扇区中，对按对称性分辨的边界算符最小化归一化对易子；对玻色 \(\mathbb{Z}_N \times \mathbb{Z}_N\) 相，由恢复的端点电荷给出 cohomology label。方法不需要多体精确对角化、显式基态波函数或纠缠谱，也不需要猜测 dressed edge 或 string operator。对有限程哈密顿量，局域性在固定 Krylov 深度下先于深度极限组织热力学极限。

papers.title: 3d Ising Field Theory with Magnetic Deformation: Fuzzy Sphere Meets TCSA
papers.abstract: We study the magnetic deformation of the $(2+1)$d Ising CFT, also known as Ising Field Theory (IFT), on a spatial sphere. We use the Fuzzy Sphere (FS) Ising setup and compare it to the Truncated Conformal Space Approach (TCSA). Universal, infinite volume, IFT quantities are extracted by modeling the effects of curvature, as expected from a local effective theory on the sphere. We find evidence that IFT contains a bound-state with a small binding energy. Locality also allows us to extract the same IFT quantities from different angular momentum sectors, providing additional consistency checks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Fuzzy Sphere (FS) Ising setup、Truncated Conformal Space Approach (TCSA)、modeling the effects of curvature、local effective theory——均为数值计算与理论框架，无实验手段。；研究对象：(2+1)维 Ising 共形场论（Ising CFT）的磁性形变，即 Ising Field Theory (IFT)，研究其在空间球面上的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者找到了 IFT 中存在一个结合能很小的束缚态（bound-state）的证据；同时发现局域性使得可以从不同角动量扇区提取相同的 IFT 物理量，提供了额外的一致性检验。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者找到了 IFT 中存在一个结合能很小的束缚态（bound-state）的证据；同时发现局域性使得可以从不同角动量扇区提取相同的 IFT 物理量，提供了额外的一致性检验。；创新点：将 Fuzzy Sphere 方法应用于磁性形变的 (2+1)维 Ising 场论，并与 TCSA 进行交叉验证；通过曲率建模从有限球面几何中提取无限体积普适物理量，并利用不同角动量扇区的一致性检验结果，给出了 IFT 中存在小结合能束缚态的证据。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Fuzzy Sphere (FS) Ising 方案，并与截断共形空间方法（TCSA）进行对比；通过对球面上曲率效应进行建模（基于球面上的局域有效理论），提取无限体积下的普适 IFT 物理量。

papers.title: Entanglement entropy in topological tensor networks
papers.abstract: We derive an entropy formula for recently proposed tensor network models which prepare diffeomorphism invariant states of topological quantum field theories with non-compact and/or continuous gauge groups. We show that our entropy formula generalizes the notion of ``topological entanglement entropy'' to incorporate the infinite number of particle-like excitations in such theories. When our networks are endowed with gauge group $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$, we can interpret them as models of three-dimensional gravity with small Newton's constant and possibly non-invertible metrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“derive an entropy formula”“tensor network models”“topological quantum field theories”等理论推导与模型构建类表述，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：近期提出的张量网络模型，这类模型可制备具有非紧致和/或连续规范群（non-compact and/or continuous gauge groups）的拓扑量子场论的微分同胚不变态；当规范群取 SL(2,ℝ) 时，可解释为小牛顿常数、可能具有非可逆度规的三维引力模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了这类张量网络模型的熵公式，该公式将“拓扑纠缠熵”的概念推广到能够纳入此类理论中无限多个类粒子激发的情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了这类张量网络模型的熵公式，该公式将“拓扑纠缠熵”的概念推广到能够纳入此类理论中无限多个类粒子激发的情形。；创新点：将拓扑纠缠熵的概念推广到具有非紧致和/或连续规范群的拓扑量子场论中，使其能涵盖无限多个类粒子激发；并给出 SL(2,ℝ) 情形下与三维引力（小牛顿常数、可能非可逆度规）的对应解释。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：针对张量网络模型推导熵公式，并将其与拓扑量子场论、拓扑纠缠熵概念以及三维引力（SL(2,ℝ) 规范群）建立联系。摘要未明确说明是否涉及具体数值计算或具体张量网络算法。

papers.title: Post-fabrication trimming of a 1024-pixel, single-photon counting, Microwave Kinetic Inductance Detector array with a pixel pitch of 150 micron
papers.abstract: Microwave Kinetic Inductance Detectors are superconducting resonators capable of single-photon counting with energy resolving capability at visible and near-infrared wavelengths. Their zero read noise, extremely low dark counts, and compatibility with frequency-division multiplexing make them well suited for large imaging arrays. The detector yield of these arrays is often limited by the fabrication-induced frequency scatter leading to resonator collisions. We find that the tight packing of the pixels can add significant frequency scatter as well. We developed a post-fabrication correction method that is suitable for tightly packed arrays with a pixel pitch of $150\ \mathrm{μm}$. We demonstrate this method on a 1024-pixel array multiplexed on a single octave of readout bandwidth and show a reduction in frequency scatter from $1.1\times 10^{-2}$ to $3.5\times 10^{-4}$ and an increase in yield from $76\%$ to $94\%$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：post-fabrication correction method、demonstrate、fabrication-induced frequency scatter、yield 等，表明工作以器件制备与实验验证为主。；研究对象：微波动态电感探测器（Microwave Kinetic Inductance Detectors, MKID）阵列，具体为 1024 像素、像素间距 150 μm 的单光子计数 MKID 阵列，工作于可见光和近红外波段，采用频率分复用读出。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者开发了一种适用于紧密排列 MKID 阵列的后制备修正方法，将频率散射从 1.1×10⁻² 降低到 3.5×10⁻⁴，并将探测器良率从 76% 提升到 94%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者开发了一种适用于紧密排列 MKID 阵列的后制备修正方法，将频率散射从 1.1×10⁻² 降低到 3.5×10⁻⁴，并将探测器良率从 76% 提升到 94%。；创新点：针对紧密排列（150 μm 像素间距）阵列中因像素密集排布而额外引入的频率散射问题，提出并验证了一种后制备修正方法，在单倍频程读出带宽内实现了 1024 像素阵列的频率散射大幅降低与良率提升。
papers.method_zh: 后制备修正方法（post-fabrication correction/trimming），在单个倍频程读出带宽内对 1024 像素阵列进行频率分复用。摘要未明确说明具体的修正手段（如激光 trimming、材料沉积等）。

papers.title: Symplectic Hopf Insulator: Delicate Topology in Bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes Systems
papers.abstract: Recent advances in topological phases have highlighted the role of symplectic (Krein-space) topology in the classification of bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BBdG) systems. In this work, we construct a BBdG realization of Hopf topology, which we dub the symplectic Hopf insulator, starting from a microscopic Bose-Hubbard generalization of the Moore-Ran-Wen model with weak on-site interactions treated within a Bogoliubov approximation. The resulting BBdG system admits a symplectic Hopf invariant, which we show to be integer-quantized for isolated bands. We establish that this topology is intrinsically delicate, requiring exactly two bosonic modes per unit cell, while remaining robust against weak interactions over a range of mass parameters. Upon terminating the three-dimensional insulator at a boundary, we find topologically protected in-gap surface states at finite excitation energy, whose protection is itself delicate. Our results establish the symplectic Hopf insulator as a robust yet delicate topological phase in weakly interacting bosonic systems lying beyond the tenfold-way classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：论文通过构造微观模型（Bose-Hubbard 推广的 Moore-Ran-Wen 模型）并结合 Bogoliubov 近似进行理论分析，未涉及实验测量或数值计算方法的描述。；研究对象：玻色 Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BBdG）系统中的辛（Krein 空间）Hopf 拓扑相，即作者所称的“辛 Hopf 绝缘体”。具体体系为弱在位相互作用下的 Bose-Hubbard 推广的 Moore-Ran-Wen 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该 BBdG 系统具有辛 Hopf 不变量，在孤立能带下为整数量子化；该拓扑本质上是“脆弱的”（delicate），要求每个原胞恰好有两个玻色模式，但在一定质量参数范围内对弱相互作用保持稳健。将三维绝缘体截断后，在有限激发能处出现拓扑保护的带隙内表面态，其保护本身也是脆弱的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该 BBdG 系统具有辛 Hopf 不变量，在孤立能带下为整数量子化；该拓扑本质上是“脆弱的”（delicate），要求每个原胞恰好有两个玻色模式，但在一定质量参数范围内对弱相互作用保持稳健。将三维绝缘体截断后，在有限激发能处出现拓扑保护的带隙内表面态，其保护本身也是脆弱的。；创新点：首次构造了 Hopf 拓扑的 BBdG 实现（辛 Hopf 绝缘体），揭示了该拓扑在玻色系统中既稳健又脆弱的双重特性，并将其定位为超越十重分类的弱相互作用玻色系统中的一种拓扑相。
papers.method_zh: 从微观 Bose-Hubbard 推广的 Moore-Ran-Wen 模型出发，在 Bogoliubov 近似下处理弱在位相互作用，构造 BBdG 实现，并分析其辛 Hopf 不变量及边界态。

papers.title: Optimal Intermediate Hamiltonians for Non-Equilibrium Free Energy Calculations: A Numerical Study of Markov Models
papers.abstract: The Jarzynski relation enables the estimation of equilibrium free energy differences from non-equilibrium, finite-time switching simulations. These estimates usually converge poorly because rare trajectories dominate the exponential work average. Here, we numerically determined and explored the sequence of intermediate Hamiltonians connecting initial and final states that minimize the mean squared error (MSE) of the Jarzynski estimator and thereby enhance convergence. For discrete-time Markov models, an exact tilted-master-equation representation of the MSE in the large-sample limit, combined with automatic differentiation, enables efficient gradient-based minimization over all intermediate energies. We applied our approach to three model systems of increasing complexity: a two-state model, a double-well potential, and a shifted potential well. In all three systems, the optimal intermediate Hamiltonians jump at the initial and final times. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that optimal intermediates can reduce the MSE by more than an order of magnitude compared with linear and logarithmic interpolation, most strongly for large changes in the energy landscape. Remarkably, they need not dissipate less work than intermediates yielding larger errors. Our results suggest heuristics for more efficient non-equilibrium free energy calculations of realistic molecular systems: optimal intermediate Hamiltonians jump at the initial and final times; for barrier-crossing problems, the barrier should be lowered rapidly and raised again later; and minimizing dissipation does not guarantee faster convergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：numerical study、Markov models、tilted-master-equation representation、automatic differentiation、gradient-based minimization、Monte Carlo simulations。摘要中未涉及真实实验测量。；研究对象：非平衡自由能计算中的 Jarzynski 估计问题，具体研究连接初态与末态的最优中间哈密顿量序列。模型体系包括三个逐步复杂的系统：两态模型（two-state model）、双势阱势（double-well potential）和移位势阱（shifted potential well）。属于离散时间马尔可夫模型框架下的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优中间哈密顿量在初始和最终时刻会发生跳变（jump）；与线性插值和对数插值相比，最优中间量可将 Jarzynski 估计量的均方误差（MSE）降低一个数量级以上，且能量景观变化越大效果越显著。值得注意的是，最优中间量并不一定比误差更大的中间量耗散更少的功，即最小化耗散并不保证更快收敛。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优中间哈密顿量在初始和最终时刻会发生跳变（jump）；与线性插值和对数插值相比，最优中间量可将 Jarzynski 估计量的均方误差（MSE）降低一个数量级以上，且能量景观变化越大效果越显著。值得注意的是，最优中间量并不一定比误差更大的中间量耗散更少的功，即最小化耗散并不保证更快收敛。；创新点：首次数值确定并系统探索了使 Jarzynski 估计量 MSE 最小化的中间哈密顿量序列，而非仅关注耗散最小化；提出了基于梯度的高效优化框架，并给出对真实分子体系非平衡自由能计算的启发式策略（初始和最终时刻跳变、跨越势垒问题应快速降低势垒后再升高、最小化耗散不等于最快收敛）。
papers.method_zh: 对离散时间马尔可夫模型，在大样本极限下建立 MSE 的精确 tilted-master-equation 表示，结合自动微分（automatic differentiation）对所有中间能量进行高效的基于梯度的最小化；随后用大量 Monte Carlo 模拟验证结果。摘要未明确说明是否使用其他数值或解析方法。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic magnetotransport in a GaAs Corbino geometry
papers.abstract: We report the observation of positive magnetoresistance in high-mobility GaAs Corbino devices. Over a broad intermediate-temperature range, the resistance exhibits a quadratic dependence on perpendicular magnetic field. We analyze the data within hydrodynamic theories of magnetotransport in the Corbino geometry, which describe the crossover between the diffusive and viscous regimes, including finite-slip boundary conditions appropriate for current-penetrable contacts. The extracted relaxation rates are consistent with an approximately $T^2$ temperature dependence of the electron-electron scattering contribution. The extracted viscous relaxation parameters are consistent with those obtained from Hall-bar measurements. Comparison with theory indicates that the observed magnetoresistance is predominantly governed by the bulk hydrodynamic response, while finite slip modifies the Stokes--Ohm crossover quantitatively and the field-dependent boundary voltage provides a separate correction. These results show that Corbino magnetotransport can serve as a complementary bulk-sensitive probe of viscous electron flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼含理论分析）。判断依据关键词：报道了在高迁移率 GaAs Corbino 器件中的正磁阻观测（observation），并将数据与流体动力学理论进行对比分析（analyze the data within hydrodynamic theories）。；研究对象：高迁移率 GaAs Corbino 几何器件中的磁输运现象，具体为垂直磁场下的正磁阻及黏性电子流动（viscous electron flow）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高迁移率 GaAs Corbino 器件中观测到正磁阻，在较宽的中间温度范围内电阻对垂直磁场呈二次依赖关系；该磁阻主要由体态流体动力学响应主导，有限滑移边界条件定量修正 Stokes–Ohm 交叉行为，且场依赖的边界电压提供额外修正。提取的弛豫率与电子-电子散射贡献近似 T² 温度依赖一致，提取的黏性弛豫参数与 Hall-bar 测量结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高迁移率 GaAs Corbino 器件中观测到正磁阻，在较宽的中间温度范围内电阻对垂直磁场呈二次依赖关系；该磁阻主要由体态流体动力学响应主导，有限滑移边界条件定量修正 Stokes–Ohm 交叉行为，且场依赖的边界电压提供额外修正。提取的弛豫率与电子-电子散射贡献近似 T² 温度依赖一致，提取的黏性弛豫参数与 Hall-bar 测量结果一致。；创新点：表明 Corbino 磁输运可作为对黏性电子流动的互补性体敏感探针（bulk-sensitive probe），并展示了有限滑移对 Stokes–Ohm 交叉的定量修正以及场依赖边界电压的独立修正作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高迁移率 GaAs Corbino 器件进行磁输运测量；理论上采用 Corbino 几何中磁输运的流体动力学理论，描述扩散区与黏性区之间的交叉，并包含适用于电流可穿透接触的有限滑移边界条件。

papers.title: Phonon-Bottleneck-Governed Ultrafast Hot-Carrier Super-Diffusion in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are promising for low-power optoelectronics, yet their operational speed is widely considered constrained by low room-temperature mobilities and carrier transit delays. Here, by combining on-chip terahertz optoelectronic sampling with thermally evaporated Ohmic contacts, we eliminate external parasitic delays and directly capture the intrinsic interfacial photoresponse in unencapsulated TMDCs under zero bias. The devices achieve ultrafast relaxation lifetimes of 48.5 ps in MoS2/Au and 14.2 ps in MoSe2/Ag, translating to intrinsic 3-dB bandwidths of 4.4 GHz and 7.5 GHz, respectively. Spatial scanning and bias-dependent measurements show that this response is position-independent and bias-immune, ruling out conventional drift-limited transport and identifying hot-carrier super-diffusion driven by an interfacial electron temperature gradient as the operative mechanism. Furthermore, ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy reveals that the macroscopic response time is quantitatively synchronized with the microscopic optical-to-acoustic phonon scattering lifetime governed by the intrinsic phonon bottleneck. Our findings establish phonon engineering as a viable paradigm to tailor non-equilibrium optoelectronic dynamics, offering a blueprint for zero-bias, ultrafast, self-powered devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中明确提到“on-chip terahertz optoelectronic sampling”“thermally evaporated Ohmic contacts”“ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy”等实验手段，并报告了具体测量数值（如48.5 ps、14.2 ps、4.4 GHz、7.5 GHz），属于以实验测量为主的实验研究。；研究对象：二维过渡金属硫族化合物（TMDCs）中的本征界面光响应与热载流子超扩散现象，具体体系包括MoS₂/Au和MoSe₂/Ag界面器件，研究其在零偏压下的超快光电动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无封装TMDC器件中观测到由界面电子温度梯度驱动的热载流子超扩散，其宏观响应时间由本征声子瓶颈所控制的光学声子到声学声子散射寿命定量决定；该响应与位置无关且不受偏压影响，排除了传统漂移限制输运机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无封装TMDC器件中观测到由界面电子温度梯度驱动的热载流子超扩散，其宏观响应时间由本征声子瓶颈所控制的光学声子到声学声子散射寿命定量决定；该响应与位置无关且不受偏压影响，排除了传统漂移限制输运机制。；创新点：首次在无封装TMDC器件中通过消除外部寄生延迟直接捕获本征界面光响应，实验证明了热载流子超扩散机制而非传统漂移输运主导，并定量建立了宏观响应时间与声子瓶颈控制的微观散射寿命之间的对应关系，提出声子工程作为调控非平衡光电动力学的可行范式。
papers.method_zh: 结合片上太赫兹光电采样技术与热蒸发欧姆接触制备器件，在零偏压下直接测量本征界面光响应；通过空间扫描和偏压依赖性测量排除漂移限制输运；利用超快泵浦-探测光谱揭示宏观响应时间与微观光学声子-声学声子散射寿命的定量同步关系。

papers.title: Protected domains and the cost of cooperation on weighted networks
papers.abstract: A costly inherited trait can spread when its descendants create a favorable local environment. We ask which finite contact structures sustain such a collective competitor and what their advantage costs. Individuals play a donation game, conferring benefit $b$ at cost $c$. Reciprocal weighted contacts determine averaged payoffs and copying recipients, while sources are chosen globally according to payoff. Cooperation is favored when a uniformly introduced cooperator takes over more often than a defector in the complementary experiment. Exact fluctuation response and elimination of fast configurations identify the formation and competition of protected domains as the controlling processes. The sharp weak-selection threshold infima are $b/c=3$ on the four-cycle, $7$ on the five-site path, and $1$ on every fixed path with at least six sites. On the six-site path, a global bound forces near-barrier designs into this domain hierarchy. Polynomial relations among the contact ratios then control unrestricted optimization and imply eventual exact reflection symmetry. Reaching threshold $1+ε$ requires minimum contact contrast $656ε^{-2}[1+O(ε)]$ and neutral absorption time of order $ε^{-1}$. We determine their tradeoff and the associated design tolerance. Finite selection consumes the same margin. Within the controlled small-selection window, the maximal fixation advantage is of order $ε^{5/2}$ when the contrast exceeds its exact minimum by order $ε^{-1}$. Thus an improving invasion threshold can require increasing contact heterogeneity, precision and observation time.
