papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：donation game、reciprocal weighted contacts、averaged payoffs、exact fluctuation response、weak-selection threshold infima、polynomial relations、fixation advantage 等，均为理论建模与解析推导，摘要中未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：有限加权接触网络上的合作行为演化。具体研究个体在加权网络上进行捐赠博弈（donation game）时，合作者与背叛者的固定概率竞争，以及“受保护域”（protected domains）的形成与竞争过程。涉及的具体结构包括四环（four-cycle）、五点路径（five-site path）以及至少六个格点的固定路径（fixed path）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 合作在加权网络上被偏好存在尖锐的弱选择阈值：四环上 b/c=3，五点路径上为 7，而所有至少六格点的固定路径上为 1。达到阈值 1+ε 需要最小接触对比度约为 656ε⁻²[1+O(ε)]，且中性吸收时间量级为 ε⁻¹；在受控小选择窗口内，最大固定优势量级为 ε^{5/2}（当对比度超出精确最小值约 ε⁻¹ 时）。因此，改善入侵阈值可能需要增加接触异质性、精度和观测时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：合作在加权网络上被偏好存在尖锐的弱选择阈值：四环上 b/c=3，五点路径上为 7，而所有至少六格点的固定路径上为 1。达到阈值 1+ε 需要最小接触对比度约为 656ε⁻²[1+O(ε)]，且中性吸收时间量级为 ε⁻¹；在受控小选择窗口内，最大固定优势量级为 ε^{5/2}（当对比度超出精确最小值约 ε⁻¹ 时）。因此，改善入侵阈值可能需要增加接触异质性、精度和观测时间。；创新点：摘要中明确指出：识别出受保护域的形成与竞争是控制合作扩散的关键过程；给出了不同有限接触结构上尖锐的弱选择阈值下确界；揭示了接触比之间的多项式关系控制无限制优化并导致最终精确反射对称性；定量确定了达到阈值 1+ε 所需的最小接触对比度、中性吸收时间及其权衡与设计容差；并发现改善入侵阈值可能需要增加接触异质性、精度和观测时间。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为演化博弈论与随机过程分析。具体包括：捐赠博弈模型（收益 b、成本 c）、加权接触网络上的平均收益与复制动力学、全局按收益选择源节点、精确涨落响应（exact fluctuation response）方法、快速构型消除（elimination of fast configurations）、弱选择阈值下确界分析、多项式关系分析接触比、以及固定概率与吸收时间的渐近分析。

papers.title: Gauge mean-field theories of the underscreened Kondo lattice
papers.abstract: Various mean-field decoupling schemes have been introduced thus far to study the important and challenging problem of the spin-$1$ underscreened Kondo lattice where magnetic order can coexist with Kondo hybridization. We use a single control parameter $N$ and an unbiased variational ansatz to unify and connect the previously proposed decouplings to standard Read-Newns theory, where fluctuations are small in $1/N$. We compute the corrections around the large-$N$ limit. In particular, we make contact with Nozières strong-coupling theory by finding the residual ferromagnetic Hund interaction that decays logarithmically in the case of a heavy-fermion metal. We map out the ground state phase diagram as a function of $N$ and the Kondo coupling. We find crucial differences between the previously proposed mean-field theories in the strength of the hybridization and total magnetization of the coexistent phase. We show that, within our unifying variational theory, the previously proposed decouplings correspond to either taking $N=2$ from the start, or performing a $1/N$ expansion and then extrapolating to $N=2$. Finally, we summarize the generalization of our theory to $S>1$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：mean-field decoupling schemes、variational ansatz、large-N limit、1/N expansion、ground state phase diagram。；研究对象：自旋-1欠屏蔽Kondo晶格（spin-1 underscreened Kondo lattice）体系，其中磁序可以与Kondo杂化共存。摘要未明确说明具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者用单一控制参数N和无偏变分拟设统一了此前提出的各种平均场解耦方案，并将其与标准Read-Newns理论联系起来；发现在共存相中，不同平均场理论在杂化强度和总磁化强度上存在关键差异；同时找到了与Nozières强耦合理论的联系，即在重费米子金属情形下残余铁磁Hund相互作用呈对数衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者用单一控制参数N和无偏变分拟设统一了此前提出的各种平均场解耦方案，并将其与标准Read-Newns理论联系起来；发现在共存相中，不同平均场理论在杂化强度和总磁化强度上存在关键差异；同时找到了与Nozières强耦合理论的联系，即在重费米子金属情形下残余铁磁Hund相互作用呈对数衰减。；创新点：主要新意在于：用单一控制参数N和无偏变分拟设统一并联系了此前多种平均场解耦方案与标准Read-Newns理论；揭示了不同平均场理论在共存相杂化强度和总磁化强度上的关键差异；建立了与Nozières强耦合理论的联系，发现重费米子金属中残余铁磁Hund相互作用对数衰减；并指出此前解耦方案可归结为N=2取值或1/N展开后外推至N=2。摘要还提到将理论推广到S>1的情形。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：变分平均场理论、大N极限及围绕大N极限的1/N修正计算、Read-Newns理论、Nozières强耦合理论。具体手段包括：用单参数N统一不同解耦方案，计算大N极限附近的修正，绘制以N和Kondo耦合为参数的基态相图，并分析此前解耦方案对应于N=2取值或先做1/N展开再外推到N=2的情形。

papers.title: Overcoming Transport Layer Bottlenecks to Quantify Ionic Parameters from Transient Ion Current Measurements of Perovskite Solar Cells
papers.abstract: In perovskite solar cells (PSCs), voltage step-induced transient ion current (TIC) measurements, commonly referred to as bias-assisted charge extraction (BACE), are frequently used to quantify ion density. Drift-diffusion simulations predict that the ion density computed from TIC saturates once mobile ions screen the electric field in the perovskite. However, experimental studies often report ion densities orders of magnitude above this limit, whose physical origin remains incompletely explained in terms of transport layer (TL) properties. In this work, the capacitance of the TLs is identified to be the fundamental bottleneck: the maximum quantifiable ion density is limited to the charge that can accumulate at the perovskite/TL interfaces, so that TIC most often depends more strongly on TL properties than on the ionic properties of the perovskite. Experiments with systematically varied C$_{\rm 60}$ electron-TL thickness (p-i-n) and Spiro-OMeTAD hole-TL doping (n-i-p) confirm this dependence across architectures. To overcome this limitation, the importance of a correction based on the average ionic displacement is discussed, and it is shown how extrapolating the TL-thickness trend towards the TL-free situation yields the actual ionic conductivity of the absorber, alongside density and mobility, depending on the assumed ionic model. Simulations are also examined in which ion penetration into the TLs or initial accumulation under forward bias raise the capacitive limit and extend TIC sensitivity to higher ion densities. The slow release of trapped carriers is also discussed as a potential source of current which can inflate the TIC signal. Overall, the presented analysis provides important practical considerations for interpreting TIC and quantifying ionic properties in PSCs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算/模拟）。判断依据关键词：Drift-diffusion simulations（漂移-扩散模拟）、Experiments with systematically varied C₆₀ electron-TL thickness and Spiro-OMeTAD hole-TL doping（系统变化传输层厚度与掺杂的实验）、Simulations are also examined（模拟考察）。；研究对象：钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）中的瞬态离子电流（TIC）/偏压辅助电荷提取（BACE）测量，以及传输层（TL）性质对离子密度量化的影响。具体体系包括 p-i-n 结构中的 C₆₀ 电子传输层和 n-i-p 结构中的 Spiro-OMeTAD 空穴传输层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传输层的电容是限制 TIC 可量化离子密度的根本瓶颈：可量化的最大离子密度受限于钙钛矿/TL 界面可积累的电荷，因此 TIC 信号往往更强烈地依赖于传输层性质而非钙钛矿本身的离子性质。通过将 TL 厚度趋势外推到无 TL 情形，可提取吸收层的实际离子电导率、离子密度和迁移率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传输层的电容是限制 TIC 可量化离子密度的根本瓶颈：可量化的最大离子密度受限于钙钛矿/TL 界面可积累的电荷，因此 TIC 信号往往更强烈地依赖于传输层性质而非钙钛矿本身的离子性质。通过将 TL 厚度趋势外推到无 TL 情形，可提取吸收层的实际离子电导率、离子密度和迁移率。；创新点：首次将传输层电容识别为 TIC 量化离子密度的根本瓶颈，解释了实验中报道的离子密度远高于漂移-扩散模拟预测上限的现象；提出通过外推 TL 厚度趋势至无 TL 情形来提取吸收层真实离子参数的方法；并探讨了离子穿透 TL 和正向偏压初始积累可提高电容上限、扩展 TIC 对更高离子密度的灵敏度。
papers.method_zh: 漂移-扩散模拟（drift-diffusion simulations）；系统改变 C₆₀ 电子传输层厚度（p-i-n 结构）和 Spiro-OMeTAD 空穴传输层掺杂浓度（n-i-p 结构）的 TIC 实验；基于平均离子位移的修正方法；模拟离子穿透进入传输层或正向偏压下的初始积累对电容上限的影响；讨论被俘获载流子缓慢释放对 TIC 信号的贡献。

papers.title: WannierNLQG: A Julia package for nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry from Wannier tight-binding models
papers.abstract: Nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry are central to modern condensed matter physics and are deeply intertwined. We introduce WannierNLQG, an extensible Julia framework for computing nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometric quantities from Wannier tight-binding models. Its gauge-consistent, degeneracy-aware architecture accommodates perturbative responses at arbitrary order and additional quantum geometric quantities. The current release evaluates ordinary, spin, and photon-drag injection and shift currents, as Brillouin-zone integrals and on k slices. For shift current, a unified interface exposes four complementary formulations: the conventional method, projector trace, generalized Wilson loop, and a finite-momentum geometric loop, with the last three explicitly accommodating degenerate subspaces. The framework also provides k-resolved Berry curvature, quantum metric, their multipoles, and additional quantum geometric and mixed momentum-spin quantities. Experimental symmetry workflows additionally support symmetry-adapted Wannier construction, symmetrization of tight-binding models and real-space operators, and reduction of spatially uniform response integrals to irreducible k-point orbits and invariant tensor components. The documentation covers formula conventions, the TaskConfig interface, and auditable output formats, with GeS and bilayer MoS2 case studies illustrating method comparison, degeneracy handling, quantum geometric analysis, and photon-drag responses. Together, these capabilities enable first-principles calculations of nonlinear response and quantum geometry in realistic multiband materials, connecting quantum geometry with quantitative materials modeling for optoelectronic, spintronic, and photovoltaic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章（软件框架开发）。判断依据的关键词：Julia package、framework、Wannier tight-binding models、first-principles calculations、documentation、case studies。；研究对象：从 Wannier 紧束缚模型出发，计算非线性光学响应（普通、自旋、光子拖拽注入电流和位移电流）与量子几何量（Berry 曲率、量子度规及其多极矩等）。案例材料为 GeS 和双层 MoS₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论；该工作主要贡献是提供了一个可扩展的 Julia 框架 WannierNLQG，能够从 Wannier 紧束缚模型规范一致地、可处理简并地计算任意阶微扰响应及多种量子几何量，并支持对称性适配的 Wannier 构造与响应积分约化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论；该工作主要贡献是提供了一个可扩展的 Julia 框架 WannierNLQG，能够从 Wannier 紧束缚模型规范一致地、可处理简并地计算任意阶微扰响应及多种量子几何量，并支持对称性适配的 Wannier 构造与响应积分约化。；创新点：提供了一个规范一致、可处理简并、可扩展至任意阶微扰响应的统一 Julia 框架，将非线性光学响应与量子几何量计算结合；位移电流的四种互补形式统一接口（其中三种显式支持简并子空间）；并集成对称性工作流（对称性适配 Wannier 构造、模型对称化、响应积分约化）。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Wannier 紧束缚模型的 Julia 计算框架；位移电流提供四种互补形式（常规方法、投影迹、广义 Wilson 环、有限动量几何环），后三种显式处理简并子空间；支持布里渊区积分与 k 切片计算；提供 k 分辨 Berry 曲率、量子度规及其多极矩等；包含对称性适配 Wannier 构造、紧束缚模型与实空间算符对称化、均匀响应积分约化到不可约 k 点轨道与不变张量分量；文档涵盖公式约定、TaskConfig 接口与可审计输出格式；以 GeS 和双层 MoS₂ 为案例。

papers.title: A Sharpened Entropy Principle for Two-Fluid Polymer Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: A compressible, non-isothermal dilute polymer solution is formulated as a Class-II binary mixture with separate solvent and polymer mass and momentum balances and with total energy and entropy balances for the complete mixture. The entropy exploitation is sharpened by a balance-anchoring axiom introduced here: in a fixed balance representative, each selected binary dissipative product contains a constitutive factor from an unclosed balance flux or source. Polymer configuration is resolved first by a connector distribution and then by its conformation tensor. Population kinematics fix polymer transport and, by moments, yield a two-velocity upper-convected rate; objectivity verifies covariance rather than selecting it. Within the total entropy balance, configurational transport and deformation powers cancel their chemical-potential and elastic partial-stress counterparts when deformation and stress-decomposition weights match. A Gordon--Schowalter test independently requires the affine upper-convected choice for the stated dumbbell free energy and Kramers stress unless an additional reversible channel is supplied. Coordinated stress--interaction changes shift the local entropy flux/production pair by a divergence, exposing representation dependence of local mechanism-wise production. An entropy-invariant Class-II-to-Class-I reduction selects a descendant entropy flux preserving the parent production and yields thermo-chemical, configurational-stress and partial-viscous-stress diffusion terms. The omitted quadratic relative-inertia flux is paired with relative kinetic-energy storage and transport and is a reversible truncation, not missing entropy production. The resulting compressible non-isothermal Hookean stress and temperature equations reduce to Oldroyd-B/UCM only after one-velocity, incompressible and isothermal limits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键判断依据：摘要通篇为连续介质热力学/流体力学建模与公理化推导（“formulated as a Class-II binary mixture”“entropy exploitation”“balance-anchoring axiom”“conformation tensor”“Gordon–Schowalter test”），未涉及实验测量或数值计算。；研究对象：可压缩、非等温的稀聚合物溶液，被建模为具有独立溶剂与聚合物质量、动量平衡以及混合物总能量与总熵平衡的 Class-II 二元混合物；具体涉及聚合物构型（连接子分布与构象张量）、应力分解与熵产生/熵流等热力学-流体力学现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者提出“平衡锚定公理”来锐化熵利用过程，使每个二元耗散乘积都包含来自未闭合平衡通量或源的本构因子；在总熵平衡中，当形变与应力分解权重匹配时，构型输运与形变功率会同化学势及弹性偏应力对应项相消，且 Gordon–Schowalter 检验独立要求仿射上随体选择（除非额外引入可逆通道）。此外，Class-II 到 Class-I 的熵不变约化可给出保持母体熵产生的后代熵流，并导出热化学、构型应力与偏粘性应力扩散项；被略去的二次相对惯性通量与相对动能存储/输运配对，是可逆截断而非缺失的熵产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者提出“平衡锚定公理”来锐化熵利用过程，使每个二元耗散乘积都包含来自未闭合平衡通量或源的本构因子；在总熵平衡中，当形变与应力分解权重匹配时，构型输运与形变功率会同化学势及弹性偏应力对应项相消，且 Gordon–Schowalter 检验独立要求仿射上随体选择（除非额外引入可逆通道）。此外，Class-II 到 Class-I 的熵不变约化可给出保持母体熵产生的后代熵流，并导出热化学、构型应力与偏粘性应力扩散项；被略去的二次相对惯性通量与相对动能存储/输运配对，是可逆截断而非缺失的熵产生。；创新点：提出并运用“平衡锚定公理”来锐化二元混合物熵利用，使耗散乘积与本构因子挂钩；通过矩方法系统导出聚合物输运与双速度上随体速率，并强调客观性用于验证协变性而非选择协变性；揭示局部机制性熵产生对表示的依赖性（协调应力-相互作用变化仅使熵流/熵产生对相差一个散度）；给出保持母体熵产生的 Class-II→Class-I 熵不变约化及相应扩散项；并澄清被省略的二次相对惯性项是可逆截断而非遗漏熵产生。
papers.method_zh: 连续介质热力学与理性力学框架：Class-II 二元混合物平衡方程（溶剂/聚合物分别的质量与动量平衡，混合物总能量与总熵平衡）；熵利用/熵原理分析；引入“平衡锚定公理”；用连接子分布及其矩得到构象张量与双速度上随体速率；客观性检验协变性；Gordon–Schowalter 客观性检验；应力-相互作用协调变换与散度重定义分析；Class-II 到 Class-I 的熵不变约化；最后取单速、不可压、等温极限。

papers.title: The Arithmetic of Spectra: Factorization, Statistics, and Symmetric Functions
papers.abstract: We study factorizations of the single-particle spectrum of non-interacting quantum systems and their consequences for many-particle statistics. Representing the single-particle partition function by a spectral alphabet, tensor factorizations become multiplicative factorizations of the alphabet, which can be lifted to canonical Bose and Fermi partition functions using standard symmetric-function and $λ$-ring identities. We show how product spectra arise from different factorizations, how antisymmetrization can be assigned across an odd number of factors, and which tensor factorizations are compatible with a fixed spectrum. The paper therefore studies spectral factorization and provides a consolidated combinatorial framework for canonical Bose and Fermi partition functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“We study factorizations”“Representing...by a spectral alphabet”“using standard symmetric-function and λ-ring identities”“provides a consolidated combinatorial framework”，全文围绕数学/理论框架展开，不涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：非相互作用量子系统的单粒子谱（single-particle spectrum）及其谱分解（spectral factorization），以及这些分解对多粒子统计（Bose 和 Fermi 统计）的影响。具体材料体系摘要未明确说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将单粒子配分函数表示为“谱字母表”（spectral alphabet），张量分解可转化为字母表的乘法分解，并可借助对称函数与 λ-ring 恒等式提升为标准的 Bose 和 Fermi 配分函数；论文展示了乘积谱如何由不同分解产生、反对称化如何分配到奇数个因子上，以及哪些张量分解与固定谱相容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将单粒子配分函数表示为“谱字母表”（spectral alphabet），张量分解可转化为字母表的乘法分解，并可借助对称函数与 λ-ring 恒等式提升为标准的 Bose 和 Fermi 配分函数；论文展示了乘积谱如何由不同分解产生、反对称化如何分配到奇数个因子上，以及哪些张量分解与固定谱相容。；创新点：将单粒子谱的分解问题与多粒子统计（Bose/Fermi 配分函数）通过对称函数和 λ-ring 语言统一起来，提供了一个整合性的组合学框架，并讨论了反对称化在奇数个因子上的分配以及与固定谱相容的张量分解问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：对称函数（symmetric functions）、λ-ring 恒等式、谱字母表表示、张量分解与乘法分解的对应、Bose/Fermi 正则配分函数的组合构造。摘要未涉及具体数值方法或实验手段。

papers.title: A First-Principles Multiscale Framework for Topological Superconductivity
papers.abstract: A microscopic understanding of topological superconductivity (TSC) in real materials requires a materials-informed approach that integrates first-principles electronic structure, superconductivity, and topology within a unified computational framework. Here, we develop such an approach by combining density functional theory, Wannier-based low-energy Hamiltonians, Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory, and Matsubara Green's-function-based Chern number calculations performed directly on realistic multiorbital superconducting Hamiltonians. We apply this framework to bulk-like and monolayer FeTeSe and to FeSe/GaAs heterostructures, enabling a unified investigation of both intrinsic and proximity-induced topological superconductivity. We identify key electronic-structure ingredients that promote robust TSC, including Rashba-active states near the Fermi level, strong induced superconducting pairing, and substantial orbital hybridization between spin-orbit-active and superconducting sectors. Guided by these design principles, we predict multiple topological superconducting phases in Fe-based materials and demonstrate that FeSe/GaAs heterostructures are particularly promising, exhibiting topological transitions at experimentally accessible chemical potentials and low Zeeman fields. Complementing the theoretical predictions, we demonstrate the growth and structural characterization of FeSe/GaAs heterostructures, establishing the experimental feasibility of the proposed materials platform. Our results provide a quantitative route for engineering and screening candidate Majorana materials and heterostructures directly from realistic electronic structures and establish a foundation for future materials-by-design approaches to topological superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：摘要以第一性原理计算框架的构建与应用为主（DFT、Wannier、BdG、Chern数计算），同时包含FeSe/GaAs异质结的生长与结构表征实验。；研究对象：拓扑超导（TSC）材料平台，具体包括块体和单层FeTeSe，以及FeSe/GaAs异质结；研究其中的本征拓扑超导和近邻诱导拓扑超导现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出促进稳健TSC的关键电子结构要素——费米能级附近的Rashba活性态、强诱导超导配对、自旋轨道活性区与超导区之间显著的轨道杂化；据此在Fe基材料中预测了多个拓扑超导相，并证明FeSe/GaAs异质结尤为有前景，可在实验可及的化学势和低Zeeman场下发生拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出促进稳健TSC的关键电子结构要素——费米能级附近的Rashba活性态、强诱导超导配对、自旋轨道活性区与超导区之间显著的轨道杂化；据此在Fe基材料中预测了多个拓扑超导相，并证明FeSe/GaAs异质结尤为有前景，可在实验可及的化学势和低Zeeman场下发生拓扑相变。；创新点：建立了一个统一的第一性原理多尺度计算框架，将电子结构、超导与拓扑整合在一起，可直接在真实多轨道超导哈密顿量上计算Chern数；并在此基础上提出了促进TSC的设计原则，预测了多个拓扑超导相，同时通过异质结生长实验验证了材料平台的实验可行性。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）+ 基于Wannier的低能哈密顿量 + Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论 + 基于Matsubara格林函数的Chern数计算（直接在实际多轨道超导哈密顿量上进行）；实验方面进行了FeSe/GaAs异质结的生长与结构表征。

papers.title: Quantifying translational and bond-orientational order metrics in hyperuniform and nonhyperuniform many-particle systems
papers.abstract: Quantifying the degree of order/disorder in many-particle systems remains an outstanding problem in physics, materials science, and mathematics. To this end, we consider the translational order metric $τ_T$, defined as the squared $L^2$ norm of the total correlation function $h(\mathbf{r})$, and introduce its bond-orientational analogue $τ_O$, defined from the weighted total correlation function $h_{\mathbf{f}}(\mathbf{r})$ using local orientational weights (S. Torquato et al., Phys. Rev. X 16, 011042 (2026)). The pair $(τ_T,τ_O)$ places both forms of order on a common two-point statistical footing. We compute both metrics for two nonhyperuniform sphere-packing models in 2D and 3D as functions of packing fraction $φ$: 1) equilibrium hard particles and 2) nonequilibrium random sequential addition (RSA) packings. For the nonhyperuniform systems, bond-orientational order remains subdominant along the equilibrium-fluid and RSA configurations; however, its magnitude relative to the translational metric increases near the upper end of the equilibrium-fluid branches, much more strongly in 2D than in 3D, and the two metrics become comparable along the sampled crystal branches. At common packing fractions, equilibrium fluids and RSA packings trace distinct $(τ_T,τ_O)$ trajectories, revealing preparation-dependent differences in structural order. As a representative hyperuniform family, we study 2D disordered stealthy hyperuniform (SHU) ground states for $0<χ<1/2$, where $χ$ is the stealthiness parameter. Within the disordered SHU phase, bond-orientational order remains subdominant, but its magnitude relative to the translational metric increases toward the disorder-to-order threshold. In all three models, $τ_T$ and $τ_O$ are positively correlated beyond the Poisson-reference regime: $τ_O$ increases monotonically with $τ_T$ across the sampled state points.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：定义并计算序参量（translational order metric τ_T、bond-orientational analogue τ_O）、对多种多粒子模型（平衡硬粒子、RSA、SHU 基态）进行数值计算与比较，属于统计物理/材料科学的理论与计算研究，摘要中未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：多粒子体系中的平移序与键取向序的定量刻画。具体研究的体系包括：2D 和 3D 的非超均匀球堆积模型（1. 平衡硬粒子；2. 非平衡随机顺序吸附 RSA 堆积），以及作为超均匀代表的 2D 无序 stealthy hyperuniform（SHU）基态（0<χ<1/2，χ 为 stealthiness 参数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者将平移序度量 τ_T 与键取向序度量 τ_O 置于统一的两点统计框架下，发现对上述三类模型，在泊松参考区之外 τ_T 与 τ_O 正相关，τ_O 随 τ_T 单调增加；在非超均匀体系中键取向序总体处于次要地位，但在平衡流体分支上端其相对强度显著上升（2D 比 3D 更明显），在晶体分支上两者量级相当；相同堆积分数下平衡流体与 RSA 堆积给出不同的 (τ_T, τ_O) 轨迹，表明结构序依赖于制备历史；在无序 SHU 相中键取向序仍次要，但越接近无序-有序阈值其相对强度越大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者将平移序度量 τ_T 与键取向序度量 τ_O 置于统一的两点统计框架下，发现对上述三类模型，在泊松参考区之外 τ_T 与 τ_O 正相关，τ_O 随 τ_T 单调增加；在非超均匀体系中键取向序总体处于次要地位，但在平衡流体分支上端其相对强度显著上升（2D 比 3D 更明显），在晶体分支上两者量级相当；相同堆积分数下平衡流体与 RSA 堆积给出不同的 (τ_T, τ_O) 轨迹，表明结构序依赖于制备历史；在无序 SHU 相中键取向序仍次要，但越接近无序-有序阈值其相对强度越大。；创新点：提出了键取向序的两点统计度量 τ_O，与平移序度量 τ_T 构成统一配对 (τ_T, τ_O)，从而在同一两点统计基础上同时量化平移序与键取向序；并系统比较了非超均匀（平衡硬粒子、RSA）与超均匀（SHU）体系中的这两类序，揭示了制备依赖的结构序差异及两者在泊松参考区之外的正相关关系。
papers.method_zh: 定义 τ_T 为总关联函数 h(r) 的 L² 范数平方，并引入其键取向类似物 τ_O（基于带局域取向权重的加权总关联函数 h_f(r)）；对 2D/3D 平衡硬粒子与 RSA 堆积计算 τ_T、τ_O 随堆积分数 φ 的变化，对 2D 无序 SHU 基态在 0<χ<1/2 范围内进行计算，并比较不同模型的 (τ_T, τ_O) 轨迹与相关性。

papers.title: Spectroscopic signatures of mode-selective electron-phonon coupling in transient reflectivity change on charge-density-wave TiSe$_2$
papers.abstract: We report on time- and spectrally resolved pump-probe spectroscopy measurement on the charge-density wave (CDW) state of TiSe$_2$ at helium temperatures. The non-oscillatory component of the spectrally resolved signals exhibit a sign reversal near 1.5 eV, which was interpreted as a redshift of the optical transition energy originated from the interband transition between the Se $p$-based valence band to the Ti $d$-derived conduction band. Furthermore, the oscillatory components exhibit distinct spectral dependences between the optical phonons and the CDW-derived modes, suggesting the mode-selective coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“time- and spectrally resolved pump-probe spectroscopy measurement”（时间与光谱分辨的泵浦-探测光谱测量），属于实验测量手段。；研究对象：电荷密度波（CDW）态的 TiSe₂ 单晶材料，研究其在氦温度下的 CDW 态中电子-声子耦合的光谱学特征，具体关注瞬态反射率变化中的光谱信号。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光谱分辨信号的非振荡分量在约 1.5 eV 附近出现符号反转，被解释为从 Se p 基价带到 Ti d 衍生导带的带间跃迁光学跃迁能量的红移；振荡分量中光学声子与 CDW 衍生模式表现出不同的光谱依赖关系，表明存在模式选择性耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光谱分辨信号的非振荡分量在约 1.5 eV 附近出现符号反转，被解释为从 Se p 基价带到 Ti d 衍生导带的带间跃迁光学跃迁能量的红移；振荡分量中光学声子与 CDW 衍生模式表现出不同的光谱依赖关系，表明存在模式选择性耦合。；创新点：摘要中通过光谱分辨的瞬态反射率测量，揭示了光学声子与 CDW 衍生模式在光谱依赖上的差异，从而提出模式选择性电子-声子耦合的光谱学证据；相对于已有研究的具体新意，摘要未进一步明确说明。
papers.method_zh: 在氦温度下对 TiSe₂ 的 CDW 态进行时间分辨与光谱分辨的泵浦-探测光谱测量，分析瞬态反射率变化中的非振荡分量和振荡分量。

papers.title: Quench dynamics in nonreciprocal Aubry-André-Harper model
papers.abstract: The critical phase of a non-Hermitian quasicrystal can support stronger transport than its surrounding delocalized phase. We demonstrate this anomalous behavior in the one-dimensional nonreciprocal Aubry-André-Harper model through a combined study of dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) and wavepacket diffusion. Using a parity-sorted energy-spectrum classification that directly encodes the generalized $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry, we find that DQPTs in this system are energy-resolved, in contrast to the energy-independent DQPTs of Hermitian quasicrystals. The energy-resolved features are most pronounced when the initial and final Hamiltonians belong to different phases (localized or extended), and they are tied to the even-odd index structure of the spectrum, which we exploit to organize the quench-dynamical landscape. For wavepacket dynamics after a single-site quench, the diffusion exponent $β$, extracted from the long-time power-law scaling of the root-mean-square displacement $σ(τ)$, partitions the phase diagram into four distinct regimes. In the Hermitian limit the extended phase is ballistic ($β=1$), the critical phase is normally diffusive ($β=0.5$), and the localized phase yields $β\to 0$. Nonreciprocity reverses this hierarchy: the extended phase becomes normally diffusive, while the critical phase turns ballistic. We trace the anomalous $β=1$ at criticality to the self-similar multifractal structure of the critical eigenstates, whose nodal positions are organized by the golden ratio. A finite-size scaling ansatz built on the wave-front propagation yields $σ(τ)\proptoτ$. The parity-resolved DQPTs and the $β$-phase diagram establish two complementary dynamical diagnostics of nonreciprocal quasicrystals, in which nonreciprocity promotes transport at the critical point and suppresses it in the delocalized phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：combined study of dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) and wavepacket diffusion、parity-sorted energy-spectrum classification、finite-size scaling ansatz。摘要中未出现具体实验平台或实验测量手段，属于理论/数值计算研究。；研究对象：一维非互易 Aubry-André-Harper（AAH）准晶模型，研究其中的淬火动力学（dynamical quantum phase transitions, DQPTs）与波包扩散行为，涉及非厄米准晶的局域化、扩展与临界相及其输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米准晶的临界相可以比其周围的离域相具有更强的输运：非互易性反转了厄米情形下的扩散指数层级——扩展相变为正常扩散，临界相变为弹道输运（β=1），而局域相仍趋于 β→0。此外，该系统中的 DQPT 是能量分辨的（与厄米准晶中能量无关的 DQPT 形成对比），且这一特征在初末哈密顿量属于不同相时最为显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米准晶的临界相可以比其周围的离域相具有更强的输运：非互易性反转了厄米情形下的扩散指数层级——扩展相变为正常扩散，临界相变为弹道输运（β=1），而局域相仍趋于 β→0。此外，该系统中的 DQPT 是能量分辨的（与厄米准晶中能量无关的 DQPT 形成对比），且这一特征在初末哈密顿量属于不同相时最为显著。；创新点：揭示了非互易准晶中临界相输运强于离域相的反常行为，并将该反常 β=1 归因于临界本征态的自相似多重分形结构（其节点位置由黄金比例组织）；同时发现该系统的 DQPT 具有能量分辨特征，与厄米准晶的能量无关 DQPT 不同，且与谱的奇偶指标结构相关。宇称分辨的 DQPT 与 β 相图构成了非互易准晶的两种互补动力学诊断手段。
papers.method_zh: 通过动力学量子相变（DQPT）与波包扩散的联合研究；采用按宇称排序的能量谱分类方法，直接编码广义 PT 对称性；从均方位移 σ(τ) 的长时间幂律标度中提取扩散指数 β；并基于波前传播建立有限尺寸标度假设，得到 σ(τ)∝τ。

papers.title: Constrained Optimization of Higher-Order Cluster-Expansion Hamiltonians for Alloys Using Simulated Bifurcation
papers.abstract: Identifying ground-state and low-energy atomic configurations is a central problem in alloy design. The cluster-expansion (CE) method represents configurational energetics on a fixed lattice as an effective Hamiltonian; for binary alloys, higher-order CE models become polynomial Ising Hamiltonians. Using Au-Cu as a model binary alloy, we formulate cubic and quartic cluster-expansion Hamiltonians as penalty-augmented polynomial unconstrained binary optimization (PUBO) problems under fixed-composition constraints. We optimize these PUBO problems using SQBM+, a simulated-bifurcation-based solver that can treat higher-order polynomial binary objectives directly. This direct PUBO treatment avoids the need to construct an explicit quadratic reformulation with auxiliary variables. Composition constraints are imposed through quadratic penalty terms, whose weights are estimated from derivative coefficients of the continuous relaxation of the CE objective. Benchmark calculations for systems up to 2048 atoms show that SQBM+ robustly obtains low-energy feasible configurations for cubic CE models and remains effective for many quartic instances. Formation-energy convex hulls constructed from the optimized configurations recover the CuAu and Cu3Au ordering trends and reveal finite-size effects at off-stoichiometric compositions. These results demonstrate simulated bifurcation as a practical route to constrained higher-order CE optimization for alloy configuration search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：cluster-expansion (CE) method、polynomial Ising Hamiltonians、penalty-augmented PUBO、simulated-bifurcation-based solver (SQBM+)、benchmark calculations。摘要中未涉及实验合成或表征，属于以数值优化和哈密顿量建模为核心的计算研究。；研究对象：二元合金（以 Au-Cu 为模型体系）的原子构型搜索与基态/低能构型识别问题。具体涉及立方（cubic）和四次（quartic）高阶团簇展开哈密顿量在固定成分约束下的优化，以及由此构建的形成能凸包（formation-energy convex hull）和 CuAu、Cu3Au 有序化趋势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SQBM+ 能够稳健地为立方 CE 模型获得低能可行构型，并在许多四次 CE 实例中仍然有效；由优化构型构建的形成能凸包再现了 CuAu 和 Cu3Au 的有序化趋势，并揭示了非化学计量比成分下的有限尺寸效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SQBM+ 能够稳健地为立方 CE 模型获得低能可行构型，并在许多四次 CE 实例中仍然有效；由优化构型构建的形成能凸包再现了 CuAu 和 Cu3Au 的有序化趋势，并揭示了非化学计量比成分下的有限尺寸效应。；创新点：主要新意在于使用模拟分岔求解器 SQBM+ 直接处理高阶多项式 PUBO 形式的 CE 哈密顿量，从而避免构造带辅助变量的显式二次重构；并将固定成分约束通过基于连续松弛导数系数估计权重的二次惩罚项实现，用于合金构型搜索。
papers.method_zh: 将立方和四次团簇展开哈密顿量表述为固定成分约束下的惩罚增强多项式无约束二元优化（PUBO）问题；使用基于模拟分岔的求解器 SQBM+ 直接处理高阶多项式二元目标函数，避免构建带辅助变量的显式二次重构；成分约束通过二次惩罚项施加，惩罚权重由 CE 目标连续松弛的导数系数估计；对最多 2048 个原子的体系进行了基准计算。

papers.title: Structural and Electronic Properties of Bulk $β$(2H)-GaSe from First-Principles DFT Calculations with van der Waals Corrections
papers.abstract: Gallium selenide (GaSe) is a layered III-VI semiconductor whose bulk crystal serves as the essential energetic reference for modeling the isolated monolayer. We present a systematic density-functional-theory (DFT) study of the centrosymmetric $β$(2H)-GaSe polymorph, employing the GGA-PBE functional supplemented with a semiempirical Grimme DFT-D2 dispersion correction to accurately capture the weak van der Waals interlayer coupling. The optimized in-plane lattice parameter agrees well with experimental values (within about 1.3%), while the out-of-plane parameter c is overestimated by the DFT-D2 correction relative to experiment, a known limitation of this dispersion scheme when the pairwise $C_6$ coefficients are not specifically fitted for the compound class under study. Electronic structure calculations confirm a non-magnetic, direct-gap profile (1.12 eV). Although this magnitude reflects the well-known underestimation of semilocal functionals, the qualitative band topology accurately captures the intrinsic two-dimensional carrier confinement within the bulk material. Consequently, this optimized three-dimensional framework provides a consistent energetic baseline for quantifying exfoliation processes, offering a reliable starting point for future theoretical explorations of the two-dimensional limit, such as surface functionalization for potential spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：First-Principles DFT Calculations、GGA-PBE functional、Grimme DFT-D2 dispersion correction、optimized lattice parameter、electronic structure calculations。；研究对象：体相中心对称 β(2H)-GaSe 多型体（一种层状 III-VI 族半导体）的结构与电子性质，作为模拟孤立单层的能量参考基准。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 优化后的面内晶格参数与实验值吻合良好（偏差约 1.3%），但面外参数 c 被 DFT-D2 修正高估；电子结构计算确认该材料为非磁性、直接带隙（1.12 eV），带隙数值虽因半局域泛函而偏小，但能带拓扑准确反映了体相材料中固有的二维载流子限域特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：优化后的面内晶格参数与实验值吻合良好（偏差约 1.3%），但面外参数 c 被 DFT-D2 修正高估；电子结构计算确认该材料为非磁性、直接带隙（1.12 eV），带隙数值虽因半局域泛函而偏小，但能带拓扑准确反映了体相材料中固有的二维载流子限域特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要主要强调该工作为体相 β(2H)-GaSe 提供了一个优化后的三维框架，可作为量化剥离过程和未来二维极限理论探索（如表面功能化用于自旋电子学应用）的一致能量基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT），使用 GGA-PBE 泛函并辅以半经验 Grimme DFT-D2 色散修正来捕捉弱范德华层间耦合；进行了晶格参数优化和电子结构计算。

papers.title: Characterizing particle rearrangements in sheared highly polydisperse materials
papers.abstract: We compare three particle-scale measures of rearrangement in highly polydisperse materials under driven flow: (a) nonaffine motion defined relative to the time-averaged mean flow, (b) changes in nearest-neighbor connectivity, and (c) $D^2_{\min}$, which measures nonaffine motion relative to an affine deformation fitted locally in space and time [Falk and Langer, Phys. Rev. E 57, 7192 (1998)]. We apply these measures to previously published two-dimensional simulations [Jiang, Sussman, and Weeks, Phys. Rev. E 108, 054605 (2023)] and granular-flow experiments [Illing and Weeks, Phys. Rev. E 111, 045422 (2025)] with polydispersities up to $δ\approx0.50$. Changes in connectivity and $D^2_{\min}$ both require a definition of neighboring particles, making the choice of neighborhood nontrivial in highly polydisperse systems. For detecting changes in connectivity, we recommend radical Delaunay triangulation, which provides a size-aware topological definition of neighbors. For calculating $D^2_{\min}$, we recommend a size-aware pairwise cutoff distance method. We further show that changing the neighborhood definition can reverse the apparent dependence of $D^2_{\min}$ on particle size in experimental data. Thus, trends in $D^2_{\min}$ cannot be interpreted independently of the neighborhood used to calculate it. Overall, the three measures presented provide complementary information about rearrangements in highly polydisperse systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与实验混合型（comparison of simulations and experiments）。关键依据：论文将三种粒子重排度量应用于“previously published two-dimensional simulations”和“granular-flow experiments”，属于对已有模拟与实验数据的对比分析。；研究对象：高多分散性（polydispersity 高达 δ≈0.50）材料在驱动流动下的粒子重排行为，具体包括二维模拟体系和颗粒流实验体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三种度量（非仿射运动、最近邻连接性变化、D²_min）提供关于高多分散体系中重排的互补信息；连接性变化和 D²_min 都需要定义近邻粒子，而在高多分散体系中近邻选择非平凡。推荐使用 radical Delaunay 三角剖分来检测连接性变化，推荐使用尺寸感知的成对截断距离方法来计算 D²_min。此外，改变近邻定义可以逆转实验数据中 D²_min 对粒子尺寸的表观依赖关系，因此 D²_min 的趋势不能脱离所用近邻定义来解读。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三种度量（非仿射运动、最近邻连接性变化、D²_min）提供关于高多分散体系中重排的互补信息；连接性变化和 D²_min 都需要定义近邻粒子，而在高多分散体系中近邻选择非平凡。推荐使用 radical Delaunay 三角剖分来检测连接性变化，推荐使用尺寸感知的成对截断距离方法来计算 D²_min。此外，改变近邻定义可以逆转实验数据中 D²_min 对粒子尺寸的表观依赖关系，因此 D²_min 的趋势不能脱离所用近邻定义来解读。；创新点：系统比较了三种重排度量在高多分散体系中的适用性，明确指出近邻定义在高多分散体系中的非平凡性，并给出了具体推荐方案（radical Delaunay 三角剖分、尺寸感知截断距离）；特别揭示了 D²_min 对粒子尺寸的表观依赖可因近邻定义改变而逆转，强调 D²_min 趋势必须结合近邻定义来解读。
papers.method_zh: 对已发表的二维模拟和颗粒流实验数据进行对比分析，采用三种粒子尺度重排度量：(a) 相对于时间平均平均流的非仿射运动；(b) 最近邻连接性变化；(c) D²_min（相对于局部时空仿射拟合的非仿射运动，Falk-Langer 方法）。针对高多分散体系，分别推荐 radical Delaunay 三角剖分（用于连接性变化）和尺寸感知成对截断距离方法（用于 D²_min）。

papers.title: Italian Business-to-Business Invoicing Data: A Network Analysis
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive description of the network of Italian Business-to-Business commercial relationships, based on the universe of electronic invoices collected by the Italian Tax Office. The firm-to-firm detail of the data is exploited to describe the distribution of the numbers of buyers (customers) and sellers (suppliers) per firm, the centrality of each firm in the production network, and the average distance between firms. We characterize for the first time the firm-to-firm network describing the Italian production system, and present its geographic and sectoral breakdown. The analysis reveals heavy tailed distributions for the numbers of buyers and sellers per firm, implying a scale-free structure of the network. The distributions of centrality values display heavy tails as well, indicating a strong concentration of importance in a relatively small number of firms. We estimate the tail exponents for all these distributions, finding in all cases lower exponents for downstream (buyer-side) distributions than for the upstream (seller-side) ones.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析文章。关键依据：基于意大利税务局收集的电子发票全量数据，进行网络分析，属于数据驱动的实证计算研究，不涉及实验测量或理论模型构建。；研究对象：意大利企业间（Business-to-Business）商业关系网络，具体包括企业间的买卖关系、每个企业的买方（客户）和卖方（供应商）数量分布、企业在生产网络中的中心性以及企业间的平均距离。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 企业买方和卖方数量分布均呈现重尾特征，表明该网络具有无标度结构；中心性分布同样呈重尾，说明重要性高度集中于少数企业；所有分布的尾部指数在下游（买方侧）均低于上游（卖方侧）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：企业买方和卖方数量分布均呈现重尾特征，表明该网络具有无标度结构；中心性分布同样呈重尾，说明重要性高度集中于少数企业；所有分布的尾部指数在下游（买方侧）均低于上游（卖方侧）。；创新点：首次刻画了描述意大利生产体系的企业间网络，并提供了其地理和行业分解，同时发现下游分布尾部指数系统性低于上游分布这一规律。
papers.method_zh: 基于意大利税务局收集的电子发票全量数据进行网络分析，刻画企业间网络拓扑性质，包括买方/卖方数量分布、中心性分布、企业间平均距离，并给出地理和行业分解，同时估计各分布的尾部指数。

papers.title: Nonlinear Edelstein effect in Rashba superconductors
papers.abstract: We formulate a quasiclassical theory of the Edelstein effect in superconductors that incorporates both intraband and interband contributions. To describe the interband contribution, which is absent from the conventional leading-order quasiclassical formulation, we derive augmented Eilenberger equations in the presence of antisymmetric spin-orbit coupling. The intraband contribution is evaluated using multiband Eilenberger equations. We apply these formulations to supercurrent-induced surface spin magnetization in $s$-wave Rashba superconductors and investigate its dependence on temperature, distance from the surface, spin-orbit coupling strength, and supercurrent. The intraband contribution originates from a supercurrent-induced asymmetry of quasiparticles with opposite momenta and spin polarizations, whereas the interband contribution arises from the anomalous-velocity term generated by the momentum derivative of the Rashba spin-orbit potential. In the helicity basis, this anomalous-velocity term is expressed in terms of the Berry connection associated with the momentum dependence of the Rashba eigenstates. The intraband contribution increases linearly with the spin-orbit coupling strength, whereas the interband contribution exhibits a nonmonotonic dependence and is maximized when the Rashba spin splitting is comparable to the superconducting gap. Moreover, within the clean $s$-wave Rashba model considered here, we find that the nonlinear dependence of magnetization on the supercurrent arises solely from the interband contribution. Thus, although the intraband contribution dominates the linear Edelstein effect, the nonlinear Edelstein effect can serve as a useful probe of the interband contribution originating from quantum geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键判断依据：摘要明确写“We formulate a quasiclassical theory…”“we derive augmented Eilenberger equations…”，属于理论推导与计算分析，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：超导体中的 Edelstein 效应，具体应用于 s 波 Rashba 超导体中由超电流诱导的表面自旋磁化现象。研究关注其随温度、距表面距离、自旋轨道耦合强度和超电流的变化规律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了包含带内和带间贡献的超导体 Edelstein 效应准经典理论；带内贡献随自旋轨道耦合强度线性增加，而带间贡献呈非单调依赖，并在 Rashba 自旋劈裂与超导能隙相当时达到最大。在所考虑的清洁 s 波 Rashba 模型中，磁化对超电流的非线性依赖仅来自带间贡献，因此非线性 Edelstein 效应可作为探测源于量子几何的带间贡献的有用手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了包含带内和带间贡献的超导体 Edelstein 效应准经典理论；带内贡献随自旋轨道耦合强度线性增加，而带间贡献呈非单调依赖，并在 Rashba 自旋劈裂与超导能隙相当时达到最大。在所考虑的清洁 s 波 Rashba 模型中，磁化对超电流的非线性依赖仅来自带间贡献，因此非线性 Edelstein 效应可作为探测源于量子几何的带间贡献的有用手段。；创新点：传统领先阶准经典理论缺少带间贡献，本文通过推导增广 Eilenberger 方程将其纳入，从而建立了同时包含带内与带间贡献的超导体 Edelstein 效应准经典理论；并指出非线性 Edelstein 效应可专门探测来自量子几何的带间贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用准经典理论框架，推导了存在反对称自旋轨道耦合时的增广 Eilenberger 方程以描述带间贡献，并使用多带 Eilenberger 方程计算带内贡献；随后将其应用于 s 波 Rashba 超导体中的超电流诱导表面自旋磁化。在螺旋基下，带间贡献中的反常速度项用与 Rashba 本征态动量依赖相关的 Berry 联络表示。

papers.title: Beyond Impedance Additivity: A Systematic Nonlinear Perspective on Memristor Associations
papers.abstract: We investigate the validity of the superposition principle and impedance additivity in AC circuits containing a memristive device connected in series with a resistor, capacitor, or inductor. While the series association of impedances is a cornerstone of linear circuit theory, its applicability to memory-bearing nonlinear systems remains largely unexplored. Using a state-dependent memristive model, we numerically analyze the stationary current response under sinusoidal excitation and characterize the resulting harmonic spectra, Bode diagrams, and Nyquist plots. To assess whether the fundamental response can still be interpreted through an equivalent-circuit framework, we introduce the concept of an apparent memristor, whose effective parameters are extracted directly from the composite impedance. We show that, although the fundamental harmonic can be accurately reproduced by an apparent equivalent circuit over selected parameter ranges, the effective parameters differ substantially from those of the isolated memristor, revealing a renormalization induced by the coupling to the passive element. More importantly, we identify parameter regimes in which the apparent-circuit description breaks down altogether, particularly for capacitor and inductor-coupled systems, demonstrating that the composite impedance cannot generally be expressed as the sum of independent impedances. These results establish boundaries for the use of equivalent-circuit models in memory-enabled electronic systems and provide practical guidelines for the interpretation of impedance spectroscopy in nonlinear devices exhibiting memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：numerically analyze、state-dependent memristive model、harmonic spectra、Bode diagrams、Nyquist plots。摘要中未提及实验测量，全部基于数值分析。；研究对象：含忆阻器（memristive device）的交流电路，具体为忆阻器与电阻、电容或电感串联组成的复合系统，研究其在正弦激励下的稳态电流响应及阻抗叠加原理的适用性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 忆阻器与无源元件串联时，复合阻抗一般不能表示为各独立阻抗之和；虽然在某些参数范围内可用“表观忆阻器”（apparent memristor）等效电路准确再现基频响应，但其有效参数与孤立忆阻器显著不同，且在与电容、电感耦合的系统中表观电路描述会完全失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：忆阻器与无源元件串联时，复合阻抗一般不能表示为各独立阻抗之和；虽然在某些参数范围内可用“表观忆阻器”（apparent memristor）等效电路准确再现基频响应，但其有效参数与孤立忆阻器显著不同，且在与电容、电感耦合的系统中表观电路描述会完全失效。；创新点：首次系统研究了忆阻器与无源元件串联时阻抗叠加原理的有效性，提出“表观忆阻器”概念来量化耦合导致的有效参数重正化，并明确识别出等效电路描述失效的参数区域，为记忆型非线性器件中阻抗谱的解读划定了等效电路模型的适用边界。
papers.method_zh: 采用状态依赖的忆阻器模型（state-dependent memristive model），对正弦激励下的稳态电流响应进行数值分析，表征谐波频谱、Bode图和Nyquist图，并引入“表观忆阻器”概念从复合阻抗中提取有效参数以检验等效电路框架的适用性。

papers.title: pyeCE: A Python Implementation of the Embedded Cluster Expansion
papers.abstract: The cluster expansion is a widely used approach for predicting the finite-temperature thermodynamics of alloys from zero-kelvin first-principles calculations, but its conventional formulation becomes intractable for materials with more than three or four chemical species. High-entropy alloys have therefore remained largely out of reach. We present pyeCE, an open-source Python library that implements the embedded cluster expansion (eCE), in which machine learning maps many chemical species onto a smaller set of effective species and thereby limits the growth in the number of cluster functions. pyeCE provides the complete modeling workflow, including the construction of symmetry-adapted descriptors with a learnable per-sublattice chemical embedding, a neural-network energy model, ladder-based training, uncertainty quantification, and finite-temperature simulations through Monte Carlo sampling. Built on the PyTorch and pymatgen libraries, it supports systems with multiple species on multiple sublattices and runs on graphics processing units. We demonstrate the package on two material systems. In the first, a single model spanning the full composition space of a 9-component refractory alloy resolves short-range order and order--disorder behavior. This model enables rapid screening for compositions with strong Cr clustering, a feature linked to the formation of a continuous, corrosion-resistant oxide scale. In the second, a model of hydrogen dissolution in a Mo--Nb--W alloy reproduces the composition dependence of hydrogen uptake and resolves the interstitial environments that hydrogen occupies. The modular design of pyeCE allows it to be extended to problems beyond alloy thermodynamics, including kinetics, defect energetics, and the coupling of chemical order to magnetic and vibrational degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章（开源软件工具开发）。判断依据的关键词：open-source Python library、implements the embedded cluster expansion、machine learning、neural-network energy model、Monte Carlo sampling、PyTorch、pymatgen、GPU。；研究对象：合金的有限温度热力学性质，特别是高熵合金（多化学组分体系）。具体演示了两个材料体系：(1) 9组分难熔合金（refractory alloy）的全成分空间，关注短程有序与有序-无序行为，以及Cr团簇与耐腐蚀氧化层形成的关系；(2) Mo–Nb–W合金中的氢溶解行为，关注氢吸收的成分依赖性与氢占据的间隙环境。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: pyeCE 实现了嵌入式团簇展开（eCE），通过机器学习将多种化学物种映射到较少的有效物种上，从而抑制团簇函数数量的增长，使传统团簇展开难以处理的多组分（超过三、四种化学物种）高熵合金体系变得可行。在演示体系中，单一模型可覆盖9组分难熔合金全成分空间并解析短程有序与有序-无序行为，且能快速筛选出具有强Cr团簇（与连续耐腐蚀氧化层形成相关）的成分；Mo–Nb–W中的氢溶解模型重现了氢吸收的成分依赖性并解析了氢占据的间隙环境。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：pyeCE 实现了嵌入式团簇展开（eCE），通过机器学习将多种化学物种映射到较少的有效物种上，从而抑制团簇函数数量的增长，使传统团簇展开难以处理的多组分（超过三、四种化学物种）高熵合金体系变得可行。在演示体系中，单一模型可覆盖9组分难熔合金全成分空间并解析短程有序与有序-无序行为，且能快速筛选出具有强Cr团簇（与连续耐腐蚀氧化层形成相关）的成分；Mo–Nb–W中的氢溶解模型重现了氢吸收的成分依赖性并解析了氢占据的间隙环境。；创新点：将机器学习嵌入（有效物种映射）引入团簇展开框架，克服传统团簇展开在超过三、四种化学物种时团簇函数数量爆炸的困难，从而将高熵合金纳入可处理范围；提供完整建模工作流（描述符构建、神经网络能量模型、阶梯式训练、不确定性量化、蒙特卡洛有限温度模拟）的开源实现；模块化设计可扩展至合金热力学之外的问题，如动力学、缺陷能量学以及化学有序与磁性、振动自由度的耦合。
papers.method_zh: 基于 PyTorch 和 pymatgen 构建的 Python 库；核心方法为嵌入式团簇展开（eCE），包含：具有可学习逐子晶格化学嵌入（learnable per-sublattice chemical embedding）的对称适配描述符构建、神经网络能量模型、ladder-based training、不确定性量化，以及通过蒙特卡洛采样进行有限温度模拟；支持多子晶格多物种体系并可在GPU上运行。

papers.title: Topology-dependent mixing of knots in flexible polymer chains
papers.abstract: The organization of multiple knots along a polymer contour can depend sensitively on the topology of the constituent knots. Using coarse-grained Brownian-dynamics simulations, we investigate topology-dependent mixing of two knots in a flexible polymer at controlled normalized wall separation. We compare homogeneous ($3_1\otimes 3_1$) and heterogeneous ($3_1\otimes 5_1$) knot pairs using a contour-based coordinate that distinguishes mixed and demixed configurations. Starting from partially overlapping configurations, the $3_1\otimes 5_1$ pair is observed in mixed configurations more frequently over the simulation time window than the $3_1\otimes 3_1$ pair at intermediate wall separation. We further find that, over the intermediate range of normalized wall separation, mixing of the $3_1\otimes5_1$ pair produces a composite knotted region that occupies substantially less polymer contour than the two constituent knots collectively occupy in demixed configurations. The corresponding reduction in contour occupancy is much smaller for the $3_1\otimes3_1$ pair. This indicates that the heterogeneous constituent topologies can be accommodated within a smaller portion of the polymer contour in the composite configuration. These results establish that constituent topology can strongly influence multiple-knot organization in flexible polymers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要明确说明使用“coarse-grained Brownian-dynamics simulations”（粗粒化布朗动力学模拟）进行研究。；研究对象：柔性聚合物链中两个纽结（knot）沿聚合物轮廓的组织与混合行为，具体比较均质纽结对（3₁⊗3₁）与异质纽结对（3₁⊗5₁）在受控归一化壁间距下的混合与去混合构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等壁间距下，异质纽结对（3₁⊗5₁）比均质纽结对（3₁⊗3₁）更频繁地处于混合构型；且3₁⊗5₁混合后形成的复合纽结区域所占的聚合物轮廓长度显著小于两个组成纽结在去混合状态下各自占据的轮廓长度之和，而3₁⊗3₁对的相应轮廓缩减则小得多。这表明异质纽结拓扑可以在更小的聚合物轮廓范围内被容纳，组成纽结的拓扑类型能强烈影响柔性聚合物中多纽结的组织方式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等壁间距下，异质纽结对（3₁⊗5₁）比均质纽结对（3₁⊗3₁）更频繁地处于混合构型；且3₁⊗5₁混合后形成的复合纽结区域所占的聚合物轮廓长度显著小于两个组成纽结在去混合状态下各自占据的轮廓长度之和，而3₁⊗3₁对的相应轮廓缩减则小得多。这表明异质纽结拓扑可以在更小的聚合物轮廓范围内被容纳，组成纽结的拓扑类型能强烈影响柔性聚合物中多纽结的组织方式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但摘要指出该工作建立了组成纽结拓扑可强烈影响柔性聚合物中多纽结组织这一结论，并揭示了异质纽结对在复合构型中占据更少聚合物轮廓的特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用粗粒化布朗动力学模拟（coarse-grained Brownian-dynamics simulations），在受控归一化壁间距条件下，使用基于轮廓的坐标（contour-based coordinate）来区分混合与去混合构型，从部分重叠的初始构型出发进行模拟。

papers.title: Fast, Accurate, and Scalable Fermionic Neural Networks via Translation Equivariance
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that designing a neural quantum state to be an exact eigenstate of the Hamiltonian's symmetries significantly improves both training speed and final variational energy. For the 2D electron gas, we design TorFormer, a neural network wavefunction which is an exact eigenstate of the total momentum. TorFormer describes both the Fermi liquid and Wigner crystal with no supervision and significantly outperforms Psiformer-based references up to large system sizes. For $r_s = 30.0$ and $40.0$ at $N=91$, we compare TorFormer trained for $8\mathrm{K}$ steps against the previous best NQS, which required $100\mathrm{K}$ training steps. Our improvement to the total energy at $r_s = 40.0$, excluding the trivial Madelung part, is $0.12\%$---enormous compared to the tiny differences separating phases. Relative to Slater-Jastrow-backflow diffusion Monte Carlo, TorFormer's energy decrease is roughly $9.8$ times that of the previous best NQS. Our work demonstrates that neural quantum states can both accurately and efficiently solve large-scale problems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：neural quantum state、neural network wavefunction、variational energy、training steps、diffusion Monte Carlo 对比。；研究对象：二维电子气（2D electron gas），包括其费米液体（Fermi liquid）和维格纳晶体（Wigner crystal）两种物相，以及不同密度参数（$r_s = 30.0$、$40.0$）和系统尺寸（$N=91$）下的基态能量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将神经网络量子态设计为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态（此处为总动量的精确本征态），可显著提升训练速度和最终变分能量；所设计的 TorFormer 无需监督即可同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，在大系统尺寸下显著优于基于 Psiformer 的参考结果，且仅用 8K 训练步即超越此前需要 100K 步的最佳 NQS。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将神经网络量子态设计为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态（此处为总动量的精确本征态），可显著提升训练速度和最终变分能量；所设计的 TorFormer 无需监督即可同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，在大系统尺寸下显著优于基于 Psiformer 的参考结果，且仅用 8K 训练步即超越此前需要 100K 步的最佳 NQS。；创新点：核心新意在于将哈密顿量的对称性（总动量）作为精确约束嵌入神经网络量子态的架构设计中（translation equivariance），从而同时获得训练效率和精度的提升；相比此前最佳 NQS，在 $r_s = 40.0$ 处（排除 Madelung 项）总能量改进 $0.12\%$，相对 Slater-Jastrow-backflow DMC 的能量降低约为此前最佳 NQS 的 $9.8$ 倍。
papers.method_zh: 设计了名为 TorFormer 的神经网络波函数（neural quantum state），使其为总动量的精确本征态；通过变分蒙特卡洛优化训练，并与 Slater-Jastrow-backflow 扩散蒙特卡洛（diffusion Monte Carlo）及此前最佳 NQS（Psiformer 类）进行能量对比。

papers.title: Anizotropic Ising Model on 2D Kagomé Lattice as an Inhomogeneous XYZ Integrable Model
papers.abstract: We investigate a generalized inhomogeneous two-dimensional Ising model on the kagomé lattice with two alternating couplings $J_i$ and $J'_i$, $i=1,2,3$, along the three lattice directions. The local Boltzmann weights are mapped onto a non-symmetric eight-vertex $R$-matrix satisfying the free-fermion condition for arbitrary values of the six couplings. We analyze the Yang--Baxter structure for the cases $J'_i=J_i$ and $J'_i=-J_i$ and derive the corresponding one-dimensional quantum spin chains in the anisotropic limit. The first case yields a transverse-field Ising-type Hamiltonian, while the second leads to a modified chain with a graded permutation structure and shifted partition-function zeros. For a partially anisotropic model, we also obtain the free energy and specific heat.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：Yang–Baxter structure、R-matrix、free-fermion condition、integrable model、partition function、free energy and specific heat 等，均为理论/数学物理推导，摘要中未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：二维 kagomé 晶格上的各向异性/非均匀 Ising 模型，沿三个晶格方向具有两组交替耦合 $J_i$ 和 $J'_i$（$i=1,2,3$），以及由其所导出的各向异性极限下的一维量子自旋链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域 Boltzmann 权重可映射到满足自由费米子条件的非对称八顶点 $R$-矩阵（对六个耦合的任意取值均成立）；在 $J'_i=J_i$ 情形下，各向异性极限给出横场 Ising 型哈密顿量，而在 $J'_i=-J_i$ 情形下给出具有分级置换结构、且配分函数零点发生移动的修正链；对部分各向异性模型还得到了自由能和比热。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域 Boltzmann 权重可映射到满足自由费米子条件的非对称八顶点 $R$-矩阵（对六个耦合的任意取值均成立）；在 $J'_i=J_i$ 情形下，各向异性极限给出横场 Ising 型哈密顿量，而在 $J'_i=-J_i$ 情形下给出具有分级置换结构、且配分函数零点发生移动的修正链；对部分各向异性模型还得到了自由能和比热。；创新点：将 kagomé 晶格上具有两组交替耦合的广义非均匀 Ising 模型映射为满足自由费米子条件的非对称八顶点 $R$-矩阵，并揭示 $J'_i=\pm J_i$ 两种情形分别对应横场 Ising 型链与带分级置换结构、配分函数零点移动的修正链。摘要未明确说明与已有研究相比更具体的创新性对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将局域 Boltzmann 权重映射为非对称八顶点 $R$-矩阵，利用自由费米子条件；分析 $J'_i=J_i$ 与 $J'_i=-J_i$ 两种情形下的 Yang–Baxter 结构；取各向异性极限导出一维量子自旋链；对部分各向异性模型计算自由能与比热。

papers.title: Reconfigurable field-free spin Hall nano-oscillators enabled by crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt
papers.abstract: Spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) are nanoscale microwave sources for wireless communication, neuromorphic computing and oscillator-based Ising machines, but conventional devices require a global magnetic bias. Here we replace this bias through crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt. Growth of hcp Co with its c-axis in the film plane produces an anisotropy field of about 0.36 T and enables field-free auto-oscillations above 10 GHz in nanoconstriction SHNOs. The active current polarity is selected by the remanent magnetization, providing nonvolatile reconfiguration of the oscillation state. Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering confirms that the nonlinear response is confined to the nanoconstriction region. Lithographic control of the angle between the current and anisotropy axes tunes the excitation threshold and drives two spectral branches from separated modes to a dominant single branch, consistent with mutual synchronization. These results establish epitaxial crystallographic anisotropy as a route to reconfigurable field-free spintronic oscillators and oscillator networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：论文使用分子束外延类外延生长（epitaxial growth）、微聚焦布里渊光散射（micro-focused Brillouin light scattering）等实验手段，并报道了器件制备与测量结果（如自振荡、阈值调控等），属于以实验为主的凝聚态物理研究。；研究对象：外延生长的 Co/Pt 体系（hcp Co 外延薄膜与 Pt 构成的纳米收缩自旋霍尔纳米振荡器，SHNO）。研究的具体物理现象是：利用 Co 的晶体各向异性（c 轴在膜面内）替代传统全局磁场偏置，实现无外场自振荡，并研究电流极性、电流方向与各向异性轴夹角对振荡模式与阈值的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外延 hcp Co/Pt 中 c 轴在膜面内产生约 0.36 T 的各向异性场，可在纳米收缩 SHNO 中实现 10 GHz 以上的无外场自振荡；剩余磁化方向决定有效电流极性，从而实现振荡状态的非易失可重构；通过光刻控制电流与各向异性轴夹角可调节激发阈值，并使两个谱支从分离模式转变为占主导的单一支，与相互同步一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外延 hcp Co/Pt 中 c 轴在膜面内产生约 0.36 T 的各向异性场，可在纳米收缩 SHNO 中实现 10 GHz 以上的无外场自振荡；剩余磁化方向决定有效电流极性，从而实现振荡状态的非易失可重构；通过光刻控制电流与各向异性轴夹角可调节激发阈值，并使两个谱支从分离模式转变为占主导的单一支，与相互同步一致。；创新点：用外延 Co/Pt 的晶体各向异性（约 0.36 T 各向异性场）替代传统 SHNO 所需的全局磁场偏置，实现无外场自振荡；并利用剩余磁化选择有效电流极性，实现振荡状态的非易失可重构；同时展示通过光刻设定电流与各向异性轴夹角来调控阈值并驱动谱支从分离模式到主导单支（与相互同步一致），为可重构无场自旋电子振荡器及振荡器网络提供路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用外延生长制备 hcp Co/Pt（Co 的 c 轴在膜面内）；制备纳米收缩 SHNO 器件；进行电学驱动的自振荡测量（>10 GHz）；使用微聚焦布里渊光散射（micro-focused Brillouin light scattering）确认非线性响应局限于纳米收缩区域；通过光刻控制电流方向与各向异性轴夹角，测量激发阈值与频谱分支行为。

papers.title: Infinite ergodic theory and functional statistics of non-confined Feller process
papers.abstract: We study additive observables of a non-confined Feller process characterized by a non- normalizable stationary probability density and return times with infinite mean. The process is equivalent, after a deterministic rescaling, to a squared Bessel process, but we focus here on a question: the spatial structure of its local-time field. We show that the local time admits a fac- torization in the long time limit. Its spatial profile is governed by the non-normalizable stationary density, whereas its temporal fluctuations are controlled by a single Mittag-Leffler random ampli- tude. As a consequence, normalized spatial correlations of the local time converge to a universal constant independent of the two observation levels. Occupation times of finite intervals follow as corollaries and display Darling-Kac fluctuations. In contrast, non-integrable power observables exhibit self-similar squared-Bessel-type limits rather than Mittag-Leffler statistics. This spatial- field perspective provides a unifying framework for infinite ergodic theory under state-dependent multiplicative noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“We study”“We show”“provides a unifying framework”等表述，全文围绕数学/理论推导展开，未涉及实验测量或数值计算细节。；研究对象：一类非受限 Feller 过程（non-confined Feller process）的可加可观测量，其特征是具有不可归一化的稳态概率密度和无限均值的返回时间。该过程经确定性重标度后等价于平方 Bessel 过程（squared Bessel process）。具体关注的物理量是局部时场（local-time field）的空间结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局部时在长时间极限下可因式分解：其空间轮廓由不可归一化的稳态密度决定，而时间涨落由单个 Mittag-Leffler 随机振幅控制。因此，局部时的归一化空间关联收敛到一个与两个观测水平无关的普适常数。有限区间的占据时间服从 Darling-Kac 涨落；而非可积的幂次可观测量则表现出自相似的平方 Bessel 型极限，而非 Mittag-Leffler 统计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局部时在长时间极限下可因式分解：其空间轮廓由不可归一化的稳态密度决定，而时间涨落由单个 Mittag-Leffler 随机振幅控制。因此，局部时的归一化空间关联收敛到一个与两个观测水平无关的普适常数。有限区间的占据时间服从 Darling-Kac 涨落；而非可积的幂次可观测量则表现出自相似的平方 Bessel 型极限，而非 Mittag-Leffler 统计。；创新点：从局部时场的空间结构视角出发，为状态依赖乘性噪声下的无限遍历理论提供了一个统一框架。具体新意在于揭示了局部时的空间-时间因式分解结构，以及区分了可积占据时间（Darling-Kac 涨落）与非可积幂次可观测量（自相似平方 Bessel 型极限）两类不同的统计行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为无限遍历理论（infinite ergodic theory）与 Feller 过程的泛函统计（functional statistics）。具体手段包括：对过程进行确定性重标度以建立与平方 Bessel 过程的等价性；对局部时场进行长时间极限下的因式分解分析；利用 Mittag-Leffler 随机振幅刻画时间涨落；推导占据时间的 Darling-Kac 涨落；分析非可积幂次可观测量的自相似极限。摘要未明确说明是否使用了数值模拟或具体计算技术。

papers.title: Observation of Magnetic-Anisotropy Crossover and High-Temperature Skyrmions in the Dirac Magnet Fe3Ge with a Distorted Kagome Lattice
papers.abstract: Topological materials that simultaneously host robust high-temperature skyrmions and nontrivial electronic band structures have attracted tremendous interest owing to their distinctive advantages for both fundamental research and prospective technological applications. Here, we report the observation of robust skyrmions in the Dirac kagome magnet Fe3Ge, which exhibits a high Curie temperature of ~ 650 K. At room temperature, Fe3Ge shows a large intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity of ~ 380 Ω-1cm-1, originating from its nontrivial electronic band topology. Systematic magnetization measurements reveal a spin reorientation transition at ~ 375 K, indicating a crossover from easy-plane to easy-axis magnetic anisotropy. Below the spin reorientation temperature, a large topological Hall effect is observed, arising from microscopic noncoplanar spin structures. Lorentz transmission electron microscopy shows that mesoscopic skyrmions are stabilized in the easy-axis magnetic anisotropy regime and persist over an exceptionally wide temperature window of 375-650 K, far exceeding that of most previously reported skyrmion-hosting materials. These results establish Fe3Ge as a promising platform for exploring diverse topological properties, with strong potential for advancing future high-temperature spintronic applications, ranging from next-generation information storage to logic computing devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：Observation、systematic magnetization measurements、Lorentz transmission electron microscopy 等实验观测手段。；研究对象：Dirac kagome magnet Fe3Ge（具有畸变 kagome 晶格的狄拉克磁体），研究其磁各向异性交叉（自旋重取向转变）及高温斯格明子（skyrmions）现象，同时涉及反常霍尔效应和拓扑霍尔效应等输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe3Ge 在约 375 K 发生从易面到易轴磁各向异性的自旋重取向转变，在易轴各向异性区间内可稳定存在斯格明子，且斯格明子持续存在于 375–650 K 的极宽温度窗口，远超此前大多数斯格明子宿主材料。此外，室温下该材料表现出约 380 Ω⁻¹cm⁻¹ 的大本征反常霍尔电导，来源于其非平庸电子能带拓扑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe3Ge 在约 375 K 发生从易面到易轴磁各向异性的自旋重取向转变，在易轴各向异性区间内可稳定存在斯格明子，且斯格明子持续存在于 375–650 K 的极宽温度窗口，远超此前大多数斯格明子宿主材料。此外，室温下该材料表现出约 380 Ω⁻¹cm⁻¹ 的大本征反常霍尔电导，来源于其非平庸电子能带拓扑。；创新点：在具有高居里温度（约 650 K）的狄拉克 kagome 磁体 Fe3Ge 中观测到斯格明子，其稳定温区（375–650 K）远超大多数已报道的斯格明子宿主材料，同时该材料兼具非平庸能带拓扑导致的大本征反常霍尔电导，将高温斯格明子与非平庸电子能带结构统一于同一平台。
papers.method_zh: 系统磁化测量（systematic magnetization measurements）用于探测自旋重取向转变；Lorentz 透射电子显微镜（Lorentz transmission electron microscopy）用于观测介观斯格明子；输运测量用于获得反常霍尔电导和拓扑霍尔效应。摘要未明确说明是否使用第一性原理计算等方法。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium dissipative stabilization of s- and d-wave superconductivity
papers.abstract: Stabilizing superconductivity beyond its equilibrium regime has been one of the quests of nonequilibrium state engineering. We report the presence of nonthermal pairing gap in BCS superconductors coupled to two thermal baths, where one of the baths can be at a temperature well above the equilibrium $T_c$. Superconducting state is enabled by a highly non-equilibrium steady state stabilized by weak coupling to baths that break detailed balance condition. The steady-state is well described by a generalized Gibbs ensemble parametrized with chemical potentials for associated Bogoliubov quasiparticle. A strong, non-perturbative effect is reported for both $s$-wave and $d$-wave superconductors, and its possible realization in cavity-based experiments is discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“We report the presence of nonthermal pairing gap”“well described by a generalized Gibbs ensemble”“A strong, non-perturbative effect is reported”等表述，属于理论建模与预言，且提到“possible realization in cavity-based experiments is discussed”，说明实验实现仅为讨论，并非本文实际完成。；研究对象：BCS超导体（具体涵盖 s-wave 和 d-wave 超导体）在非平衡条件下的超导配对态，特别是与两个热库耦合、其中一个热库温度远高于平衡 Tc 时仍能稳定存在的非热配对能隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当 BCS 超导体与两个热库耦合且破坏细致平衡条件时，可形成一个高度非平衡稳态，从而稳定出非热配对能隙，即使其中一个热库温度远高于平衡临界温度 Tc；该稳态可用广义 Gibbs 系综描述，其中 Bogoliubov 准粒子带有相应的化学势；这种强非微扰效应在 s-wave 和 d-wave 超导体中均存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当 BCS 超导体与两个热库耦合且破坏细致平衡条件时，可形成一个高度非平衡稳态，从而稳定出非热配对能隙，即使其中一个热库温度远高于平衡临界温度 Tc；该稳态可用广义 Gibbs 系综描述，其中 Bogoliubov 准粒子带有相应的化学势；这种强非微扰效应在 s-wave 和 d-wave 超导体中均存在。；创新点：提出并论证了通过破坏细致平衡的双热库耦合，可在远高于平衡 Tc 的条件下稳定非热超导配对能隙，且该机制同时适用于 s-wave 和 d-wave 超导体；强调这是强非微扰效应，并指出可用广义 Gibbs 系综刻画该非平衡稳态。摘要未明确说明与既有非平衡超导稳定方案的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡稳态理论框架，将 BCS 超导体耦合到两个热库，并引入破坏细致平衡的条件；用广义 Gibbs 系综（generalized Gibbs ensemble）描述稳态，其中为 Bogoliubov 准粒子引入化学势；分析中给出非微扰效应，并讨论了基于腔的实验实现可能性。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法或材料参数。

papers.title: A machine-learned dynamical phase diagram of the one-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation with quasiperiodic disorder and a static field
papers.abstract: We map the transport regimes of a wave packet evolving under the one-dimensional discrete nonlinear Schrödinger (Gross-Pitaevskii) equation with a quasiperiodic Aubry-André potential and a static (Stark) field, as a function of self-interaction $g$, field $F$, and quasiperiodic strength $λ$, for two initial states (delta and Gaussian). Instead of one expensive long-time simulation per grid point, we run 3600 short simulations, reduce each to eight dynamical features, and cluster parameter space with a Gaussian mixture model. Clustering finds the boundaries between regimes unsupervised; each cluster's name is then assigned by a hand-calibrated rule, and an ablation shows clustering measurably smooths those boundaries rather than merely relabeling them. The five resulting regimes (ballistic, localized, oscillatory-localized, subdiffusive, and self-trapped) are validated against 100 long runs on a lattice eight times larger than the short sweep, so the validation window is longer than the training window even for the fastest-spreading regime. The short-time clusters predict the long-time asymptotic spreading exponent ($α_\infty = 2.01\pm0.07$ ballistic, $0.28\pm0.16$ subdiffusive, consistent with the weak-chaos prediction $α=1/3$) and, independently, a long-time retention $Π_0=0.72\pm0.32$ for the self-trapped cluster, whose exponent alone is not diagnostic. The initial-state contrast is striking: the delta state develops a broad self-trapping wedge (onset at $g=3.907\pm0.017$ at $λ=0$) that invades the ballistic and localized regions as $g$ grows, while the Gaussian state shows no self-trapping, instead opening a subdiffusive corridor along the Aubry-André critical line that widens with $g$. The scheme yields a full $15\times15$ phase map in minutes per slice, where direct asymptotic simulation ($t\gtrsim10^6$ per point) is prohibitive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learned、short simulations、clustering、Gaussian mixture model、ablation、validated against long runs——全文为数值模拟与机器学习分析，无实验成分。；研究对象：一维离散非线性薛定谔（Gross-Pitaevskii）方程中的波包输运，体系同时具有准周期 Aubry-André 势与静态（Stark）场，研究参数为自相互作用 g、场强 F、准周期强度 λ，并对比 delta 与 Gaussian 两种初始态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 短时动力学特征聚类可无监督地划分出五个输运区域（弹道、局域、振荡局域、亚扩散、自囚禁），并能预测长时渐近扩散指数（弹道 α∞=2.01±0.07，亚扩散 0.28±0.16，与弱混沌预言 α=1/3 一致）；初始态影响显著：delta 态随 g 增大形成宽的自囚禁楔形区并侵入弹道与局域区，而 Gaussian 态不出现自囚禁，反而沿 Aubry-André 临界线打开随 g 变宽的亚扩散通道。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：短时动力学特征聚类可无监督地划分出五个输运区域（弹道、局域、振荡局域、亚扩散、自囚禁），并能预测长时渐近扩散指数（弹道 α∞=2.01±0.07，亚扩散 0.28±0.16，与弱混沌预言 α=1/3 一致）；初始态影响显著：delta 态随 g 增大形成宽的自囚禁楔形区并侵入弹道与局域区，而 Gaussian 态不出现自囚禁，反而沿 Aubry-André 临界线打开随 g 变宽的亚扩散通道。；创新点：用「大量短时模拟＋动力学特征＋高斯混合聚类」的机器学习方案，在数分钟内生成完整 15×15 相图（每切片），而直接渐近模拟（每点 t≳10^6）不可行；聚类被证明可测量地平滑区域边界而非仅重新贴标签；并揭示自囚禁的出现强烈依赖初始态（delta 态有、Gaussian 态无），以及 Gaussian 态沿 Aubry-André 临界线出现随 g 增宽的亚扩散走廊。
papers.method_zh: 对 15×15 参数网格每点运行 3600 次短时模拟（替代每点一次昂贵长时模拟），将每条轨迹约化为八个动力学特征，用高斯混合模型对参数空间聚类；聚类边界由无监督方式确定，簇名由人工标定规则赋予，并通过消融实验验证聚类确实平滑了边界；结果用 8 倍大晶格上的 100 次长时模拟验证，并额外提取自囚禁簇的长时保持率 Π0=0.72±0.32。

papers.title: Effect of Spherical Confinement on the 2-TIPS of Soft Repulsive Spherocylinders
papers.abstract: We studied the 2-Temperature induced phase separation (2-TIPS) in a system of soft repulsive sphe rocylinders (SRS), confined on the surface of a sphere. We used two different anchoring conditions for the SRS on the spherical surface- free and tangential. For the free anchoring, increasing either the packing fraction or the rod aspect ratio suppresses phase separation between the active and passive subsystems, and the system corresponds to a dense-dilute phase co-existence. These phenomena can be explained via the trapping effect and are emergent due to the confinement. For the tangential anchoring, the system phase separates from its initial isotropic state into a locally ordered dense region and a disordered dilute region. Our work provides useful insights into phase separation in binary mixtures under spherical confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：研究了……系统、使用了两种锚定条件、现象可通过捕获效应解释——摘要中未提及具体实验手段，以模型体系研究为主，倾向于计算/模拟研究。；研究对象：软排斥球柱状粒子（soft repulsive spherocylinders, SRS）在球面受限条件下的双温度诱导相分离（2-TIPS）现象，以及不同锚定条件（自由锚定与切向锚定）对相分离行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自由锚定条件下，增大填充率或棒状粒子的长径比会抑制活性与被动子系统之间的相分离，系统表现为稠密-稀疏相共存，这一现象可由捕获效应解释并源于受限效应；在切向锚定条件下，系统从初始各向同性态相分离为局部有序的稠密区域和无序的稀疏区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自由锚定条件下，增大填充率或棒状粒子的长径比会抑制活性与被动子系统之间的相分离，系统表现为稠密-稀疏相共存，这一现象可由捕获效应解释并源于受限效应；在切向锚定条件下，系统从初始各向同性态相分离为局部有序的稠密区域和无序的稀疏区域。；创新点：研究了球面受限条件下软排斥球柱状粒子的双温度诱导相分离，揭示了锚定条件对相分离行为的调控作用，以及自由锚定下捕获效应导致的相分离抑制现象，为二元混合物在球面受限下的相分离提供了新见解。
papers.method_zh: 采用软排斥球柱状粒子模型，将其限制在球面上，设置两种锚定条件（自由锚定和切向锚定）进行研究。摘要未明确说明具体的计算或模拟方法（如分子动力学、蒙特卡洛模拟等）。

papers.title: SIM-GRAPH: A universal guide to symmetric interactions
papers.abstract: Symmetry plays a central role throughout physics, from Fourier analysis on discrete lattices to the classification of elementary particles in the standard model. In finite quantum systems, symmetries are often discrete, such as reflection and rotational symmetries. Here, we present the SIM-GRAPH method (Symmetric Ising Models - Graph Reduction And Projected Hamiltonians), which uses such symmetries to efficiently calculate ground-state observables of interacting quantum systems. By projecting all interactions onto a symmetric subset of the system, the method effectively reduces the number of sites, thus providing an exponential speedup over standard exact diagonalization. Furthermore, we introduce two extensions that broaden the applicability of the method and allow for a controlled trade-off between computational cost and accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键依据：摘要中提出的是计算方法（SIM-GRAPH），用于高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量，属于方法论和算法层面的工作，未涉及具体实验。；研究对象：有限量子系统（finite quantum systems），特别是具有离散对称性（如反射对称性和旋转对称性）的相互作用量子系统。摘要中未指定具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将所有相互作用投影到系统的对称子集上，SIM-GRAPH 方法能有效减少格点数，从而相比标准精确对角化实现指数级加速，可高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将所有相互作用投影到系统的对称子集上，SIM-GRAPH 方法能有效减少格点数，从而相比标准精确对角化实现指数级加速，可高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量。；创新点：提出了一种利用离散对称性进行图约化和投影哈密顿量的通用方法，实现了对标准精确对角化的指数级加速；同时提供了两种可扩展方案，允许在计算代价与精度之间进行可控折衷。
papers.method_zh: 提出了 SIM-GRAPH 方法（Symmetric Ising Models - Graph Reduction And Projected Hamiltonians），基于对称性将相互作用投影到对称子集上以减少格点数目。此外引入两种扩展方法，可在计算成本和精度之间实现可控权衡。摘要未明确说明是否结合了其他具体数值方法（如 DMRG、QMC 等）。

papers.title: Efficient protocol for the Markovian Mpemba effect in $N$-level systems
papers.abstract: The Mpemba effect is an anomalous phenomenon in which the time to thermalize does not depend monotonically on the distance from equilibrium, allowing systems with an initially larger temperature difference to thermalize before those with a smaller one. The rarity of the effect makes it hard to find parameters that produce it, complicating the design of experiments and the development of applications. Here, we find necessary and sufficient conditions for the Markovian Mpemba effect in three-level systems and explain its underlying physical mechanisms. Based on our understanding of the three-level case, we develop an efficient algorithm to determine the parameters for the effect in $N$-level systems. This protocol could open the door for the realization of Mpemba experiments and related applications in large systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“find necessary and sufficient conditions”“explain its underlying physical mechanisms”“develop an efficient algorithm”，属于理论推导与算法开发，未提及具体实验测量。；研究对象：马尔可夫 Mpemba 效应（Markovian Mpemba effect），具体研究三能级系统（three-level systems）及推广至 N 能级系统（N-level systems）中的该效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 找到了三能级系统中马尔可夫 Mpemba 效应发生的充要条件，并阐明了其背后的物理机制；基于对三能级情形的理解，发展出可在 N 能级系统中确定该效应参数的高效算法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：找到了三能级系统中马尔可夫 Mpemba 效应发生的充要条件，并阐明了其背后的物理机制；基于对三能级情形的理解，发展出可在 N 能级系统中确定该效应参数的高效算法。；创新点：首次给出三能级系统中马尔可夫 Mpemba 效应的充要条件并解释其物理机制；进而提出可推广至 N 能级系统的高效参数确定算法，有望推动大系统中 Mpemba 实验的实现及相关应用。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数学推导（充要条件推导、物理机制阐释），并在此基础上开发算法（efficient algorithm）用于确定 N 能级系统中产生 Mpemba 效应的参数。摘要未明确说明是否涉及数值模拟或具体计算技术细节。

papers.title: Strong Impact of Halide Ordering on Structural Phase Transitions in Mixed Perovskites
papers.abstract: Mixed halide perovskites are highly versatile semiconductors with applications in photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, and photodetectors. Understanding their thermodynamic phase behavior is central to guiding compositional design and improving device stability. Here, we train machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) on density functional theory reference data for CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y, CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y, and CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y halide perovskites, enabling large-scale hybrid Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics simulations that sample both configurational and vibrational degrees of freedom. All three binary halide systems exhibit a miscibility gap, the extent of which correlates with halide ion size mismatch. The gaps in Br-Cl and Br-I close at low temperatures, while the Cl-I gap extends above room temperature. At temperatures above the miscibility gap (200 K to 500 K), all systems show a tendency toward layered halide ordering, with halide species preferentially occupying apical or equatorial octahedral sites. In CsPbBr3yI3-3y, this ordering occurs in a device-relevant temperature regime and is linked to the structural phase transitions, shifting transition temperatures by up to 100 K relative to randomly mixed structures. We attribute the strongly non-linear composition dependence of the orthorhombic-tetragonal phase boundary observed experimentally (a linear decrease followed by a plateau) to halide ordering. Introducing Rb on the A-site weakens halide ordering and eliminates the non-linear behavior, while narrowing the miscibility gap in both the Br-I and Br-Cl systems. These results establish halide ordering as a key determinant of structural phase stability in mixed-halide perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、density functional theory reference data、hybrid Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics simulations。；研究对象：混合卤化物钙钛矿体系 CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y 和 CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y，研究其热力学相行为、混溶间隙（miscibility gap）、卤化物有序化以及结构相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 卤化物有序化对混合卤化物钙钛矿的结构相稳定性有重要影响：三种二元卤化物体系均存在混溶间隙，其范围与卤素离子尺寸失配相关；在混溶间隙以上温度（200–500 K），所有体系倾向于层状卤化物有序化，卤素优先占据八面体的顶点或赤道位置；在 CsPbBr3yI3-3y 中，这种有序化与结构相变相关联，可使相变温度相对于随机混合结构偏移达 100 K，并解释了实验观测到的正交-四方相界强烈的非线性组分依赖关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：卤化物有序化对混合卤化物钙钛矿的结构相稳定性有重要影响：三种二元卤化物体系均存在混溶间隙，其范围与卤素离子尺寸失配相关；在混溶间隙以上温度（200–500 K），所有体系倾向于层状卤化物有序化，卤素优先占据八面体的顶点或赤道位置；在 CsPbBr3yI3-3y 中，这种有序化与结构相变相关联，可使相变温度相对于随机混合结构偏移达 100 K，并解释了实验观测到的正交-四方相界强烈的非线性组分依赖关系。；创新点：通过机器学习原子间势结合混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟，在大尺度上同时处理构型与振动自由度，揭示了卤化物有序化对混合卤化物钙钛矿结构相变的关键决定作用，并将实验观测到的正交-四方相界非线性行为归因于卤化物有序化；同时发现 A 位引入 Rb 会削弱卤化物有序化、消除非线性行为并缩小 Br-I 和 Br-Cl 体系的混溶间隙。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）参考数据训练机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），并利用大规模混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟，同时采样构型自由度和振动自由度。

papers.title: Configurational-space separation and structure selection in three hard squares
papers.abstract: Self-assembly of hard particles with diverse shapes gives rise to a rich variety of structures through excluded-volume constraints alone. Here we show that even a minimal system of three hard squares confined in a two-dimensional periodic box exhibits nontrivial configurational behavior relevant to structure selection. As the packing fraction increases, radial distribution functions obtained from Markov-chain Monte Carlo and uniform non-overlapping insertion sampling agree at low densities, deviate markedly over an intermediate range, and converge again at higher densities. Pressure measurements provide strong numerical evidence that the discrepancy originates from the separation of the allowed configurational space into two disconnected regions above a characteristic density. We identify the separation density as $φ_{\rm sep}=3/5$, construct explicit overlap-free transition pathways connecting the two regions immediately below it, and quantify their relative configurational-space volumes. At higher packing fractions, an approximately L-shaped arrangement of the particle centers becomes strongly favored over a staggered one, revealing a structural motif characteristic of tetratic and square-lattice ordering in larger hard-square systems. These results show that excluded-volume geometry can govern both configurational connectivity and local structure selection even in a three-particle system, revealing how signatures of many-particle self-assembly can already emerge in the few-particle limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：Markov-chain Monte Carlo、uniform non-overlapping insertion sampling、压力测量、数值证据（numerical evidence）。；研究对象：三个硬方块（hard squares）限制在二维周期性盒子中的最小体系，研究其构型空间行为与结构选择现象，涉及排除体积约束下的自组装。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着堆积分数增加，允许的构型空间在一个特征密度以上分离为两个不连通的区域，分离密度为 φ_sep = 3/5；在高堆积分数下，粒子中心近似 L 形排列比交错排列更受青睐，揭示了与更大硬方块体系中四方（tetratic）和正方晶格有序相关的结构基元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着堆积分数增加，允许的构型空间在一个特征密度以上分离为两个不连通的区域，分离密度为 φ_sep = 3/5；在高堆积分数下，粒子中心近似 L 形排列比交错排列更受青睐，揭示了与更大硬方块体系中四方（tetratic）和正方晶格有序相关的结构基元。；创新点：表明即使在仅三个硬方块的最小体系中，排除体积几何就能同时支配构型连通性和局部结构选择，揭示了多粒子自组装的特征可以在少粒子极限中已经涌现。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Markov-chain Monte Carlo 和均匀非重叠插入采样（uniform non-overlapping insertion sampling）计算径向分布函数；通过压力测量提供构型空间分离的数值证据；构建了在分离密度以下连接两个区域的显式无重叠转变路径，并量化了它们的相对构型空间体积。

papers.title: Dimensional Control of Excitonic Interactions in Exfoliated 2D Molecular Crystals
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) materials provide unique opportunities to tailor excited-state properties through reduced dimensionality, altered dielectric screening and layer-dependent structural reconstruction. While such effects have been widely explored in norganic systems, their realization in molecular crystals has been limited by the difficulty of controlling thickness at the atomic scale while preserving crystalline order. Here we show that tetracene and three other molecular crystals can be mechanically exfoliated into mono-, few- or multilayer flakes, while retaining crystalline order. This capability enables new studies of molecular crystals across a well defined thickness range within the same structural organization. Thickness-dependent spectra of these samples reveal how out-of-plane confinement modifies the excited-state energy landscape of tetracene: With decreasing thickness, the Davydov splitting diminishes, the Stokes shift increases, and signatures of more delocalized excitons emerge. Electron diffraction and exciton model-based analyses correlate these trends to changes in molecular packing, intermolecular coupling and dielectric screening. Our results also demonstrate that key features of molecular excitons can be systematically tuned by layer number, extending dimensional control from inorganic 2D materials to molecular crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼含基于激子模型的分析）。关键判断依据：机械剥离（mechanical exfoliation）、厚度依赖光谱（thickness-dependent spectra）、电子衍射（electron diffraction）等实验手段；理论部分仅为“exciton model-based analyses”用于关联实验趋势，非独立计算/理论工作。；研究对象：可机械剥离的分子晶体，具体为并四苯（tetracene）及另外三种分子晶体；研究其在单层、少层到多层厚度下的激子相互作用与激发态性质，以及层数（维度）对 Davydov 分裂、Stokes 位移、激子离域等的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子晶体可被机械剥离为保持晶序的单层、少层或多层薄片；随厚度减小，并四苯的 Davydov 分裂减弱、Stokes 位移增大，并出现更离域激子的特征，这些趋势与分子堆积、分子间耦合和介电屏蔽的变化相关。由此证明分子激子的关键特征可通过层数系统调控，将维度调控从无机二维材料拓展到分子晶体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子晶体可被机械剥离为保持晶序的单层、少层或多层薄片；随厚度减小，并四苯的 Davydov 分裂减弱、Stokes 位移增大，并出现更离域激子的特征，这些趋势与分子堆积、分子间耦合和介电屏蔽的变化相关。由此证明分子激子的关键特征可通过层数系统调控，将维度调控从无机二维材料拓展到分子晶体。；创新点：首次（据摘要所述）实现并四苯等分子晶体的原子级厚度可控机械剥离，同时保持晶序，从而在相同结构组织下跨越确定厚度范围研究分子晶体；并据此揭示面外限域对分子激发态能量景观（Davydov 分裂、Stokes 位移、激子离域）的系统调控，把二维材料的维度调控概念推广到分子晶体体系。
papers.method_zh: 机械剥离制备单层/少层/多层分子晶体薄片；厚度依赖光谱测量；电子衍射表征结构；基于激子模型的分析，将光谱趋势与分子堆积、分子间耦合及介电屏蔽变化相关联。摘要未明确说明具体光谱类型（如吸收/荧光）、具体衍射技术细节及所用理论模型的具体形式。

papers.title: Apparent Zero-Momentum Signals from Magnon--Magnon Interference in Near-Field Spin-Wave Imaging
papers.abstract: Spatially resolved measurements of coherent waves are commonly read as direct maps of the underlying eigenmode spectrum. We show that this interpretation fails in near-field imaging of multimode spin-wave transport. Scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry of yttrium iron garnet reveals pronounced apparent low-wave-vector signals at frequencies for which no propagating spin-wave mode exists. By tuning the probe-sample distance and modeling the anisotropic near-field response, we identify their origin as coherent mixing between directly excited Damon-Eshbach waves and defect- or transducer-scattered spin waves: the measured signal acquires spatial Fourier components at the difference wave vector $\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{exc}}-\mathbf{k}_{\mathrm{scat}}$, which can vanish even though both constituent waves carry finite momentum. These results establish that near-field spectra of coherent excitations are interferometric field spectra rather than eigenmode maps, providing both a caution and a framework for identifying scattering processes in nanoscale magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论建模相结合的混合型文章。关键依据：论文包含扫描氮-空位磁强计（scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry）的实验测量，同时结合了各向异性近场响应的建模分析。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（yttrium iron garnet, YIG）中的多模自旋波输运，具体研究近场自旋波成像中出现的表观零动量信号现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近场自旋波成像中，空间分辨测量并不能直接映射本征模谱；实验观察到在不存在传播自旋波模式的频率处出现了显著的表观低波矢信号，其起源是直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射的自旋波之间的相干混合，测量信号获得了差分波矢 **k**_exc − **k**_scat 处的空间傅里叶分量，该分量即使在两列组成波均携带有限动量时也可以消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近场自旋波成像中，空间分辨测量并不能直接映射本征模谱；实验观察到在不存在传播自旋波模式的频率处出现了显著的表观低波矢信号，其起源是直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射的自旋波之间的相干混合，测量信号获得了差分波矢 **k**_exc − **k**_scat 处的空间傅里叶分量，该分量即使在两列组成波均携带有限动量时也可以消失。；创新点：揭示了近场相干激发谱本质上是干涉场谱而非本征模映射，纠正了将空间分辨测量直接解读为本征模谱的常见误解，并为纳米尺度磁子器件中识别散射过程提供了警示和理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扫描氮-空位（NV）磁强计对钇铁石榴石进行近场自旋波成像测量；理论上通过调节探针-样品距离并建立各向异性近场响应模型来分析信号起源。

papers.title: Quantifying cell shape and density fluctuations in epithelial tissue in vivo
papers.abstract: Controlling changes in cell shape are crucial for many biological processes, such as tissue development and wound healing. Tissues typically are heterogeneous with a variety of cell shapes and sizes. Of particular interest are local deviations from an average cell shape and size. These fluctuations may extend and transmit across tissues, potentially offering valuable insights into tissue characteristics such as variations in effective "stiffness" or rigidity. In this study, we present a theoretical framework that captures the dynamics of epithelial cell shapes within tissue, incorporating both their average behaviour and fluctuation patterns. We model cells as interacting soft ellipsoids of varying size and aspect ratio. Coarse-graining our model, we obtain a set of continuum stochastic differential equations from which we derive spatial-temporal correlation functions. These correlation functions fit with our experimental data from the developmental process of the \textit{Drosophila} pupal wing. From the correlation functions, critical parameters representing active cell shape changes and effective tissue "stiffness" can be determined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含与实验数据对比）。判断依据关键词：theoretical framework、model cells as interacting soft ellipsoids、coarse-graining、continuum stochastic differential equations、derive spatial-temporal correlation functions、fit with our experimental data。；研究对象：上皮组织（epithelial tissue）中细胞形状与密度的涨落，具体体系为果蝇蛹翅（Drosophila pupal wing）发育过程中的上皮细胞。研究关注细胞形状和尺寸相对平均值的局域偏离及其在组织中的传播，以及由此反映的组织有效“刚度”或刚性特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了一个可描述上皮细胞形状动力学的理论框架，能同时刻画细胞的平均行为和涨落模式；由粗粒化得到的时空关联函数可与果蝇蛹翅发育实验数据吻合，并从中提取出表征活性细胞形状变化和有效组织“刚度”的关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了一个可描述上皮细胞形状动力学的理论框架，能同时刻画细胞的平均行为和涨落模式；由粗粒化得到的时空关联函数可与果蝇蛹翅发育实验数据吻合，并从中提取出表征活性细胞形状变化和有效组织“刚度”的关键参数。；创新点：提出了一个统一描述上皮细胞形状平均行为与涨落动力学的理论框架，并通过粗粒化连续随机微分方程导出时空关联函数，进而与活体果蝇蛹翅实验数据定量对比，从涨落中提取活性细胞形状变化与有效组织“刚度”参数。摘要未明确说明其相对于已有研究的具体新颖性对比。
papers.method_zh: 将细胞建模为大小和长宽比可变的相互作用软椭球体；对模型进行粗粒化，得到一组连续随机微分方程，并由此推导时空关联函数；随后用这些关联函数拟合果蝇蛹翅发育过程的实验数据，以确定活性细胞形状变化和有效组织“刚度”等关键参数。

papers.title: Photo-induced Wavelength-tuning of Telecom-band Quantum Dot Nanowires Embedded in a Phase Change Material
papers.abstract: Scalable quantum-photonic technologies require spatially separated emitters to emit at the same wavelength, yet epitaxially grown quantum dots naturally exhibit emitter-to-emitter variations in their emission energies. Here, we demonstrate a contact-free post-growth tuning approach for InAs quantum dots embedded in InP nanowires using the photo-induced transformation of an amorphous Sb2S3 shell. This photoinduced effect leads to a progressive relaxation of the strain imposed on the InP core, enabling controlled spectral tuning of the quantum-dot emission. The effect is observed both at room temperature and under cryogenic conditions for quantum dots emitting in the O-band of the telecommunications spectrum. Strain-induced redshifts of approximately 7 meV at room temperature and 28 meV under cryogenic conditions are observed, respectively. The use of an amorphous chalcogenide shell therefore provides a route to achieve local wavelength tuning at the single quantum-dot-in-a-nanowire level after growth. This approach could enable spectrally matched emitters for scalable quantum-photonic architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate a contact-free post-growth tuning approach”“photo-induced transformation”“observed both at room temperature and under cryogenic conditions”等表述，表明工作以实验观测与实验演示为主，未提及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：嵌入非晶Sb₂S₃壳层中的InP纳米线内的InAs量子点，研究其光致波长调谐行为，具体涉及光诱导非晶Sb₂S₃壳层转变对InP核所施加应变的弛豫，以及由此引起的量子点发光光谱调控，发射波长位于通信O波段。
