papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在高质量PdTe单晶中观测到温度依赖的非饱和线性磁阻和显著的平面霍尔效应；分析表明LMR源于无序驱动的迁移率涨落而非Abrikosov量子极限机制，PHE主要来源于各向异性轨道磁阻而非手性反常。尽管Dirac点靠近费米能级，这些输运现象仍可在半经典输运框架内理解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在高质量PdTe单晶中观测到温度依赖的非饱和线性磁阻和显著的平面霍尔效应；分析表明LMR源于无序驱动的迁移率涨落而非Abrikosov量子极限机制，PHE主要来源于各向异性轨道磁阻而非手性反常。尽管Dirac点靠近费米能级，这些输运现象仍可在半经典输运框架内理解。；创新点：首次在PdTe中观测到线性磁阻和平面霍尔效应，填补了该材料磁输运现象此前未被探索的空白；并明确指出其LMR和PHE的起源分别为无序驱动的迁移率涨落和各向异性轨道磁阻，而非拓扑相关的Abrikosov量子极限或手性反常，强调了在拓扑材料中区分拓扑输运机制与常规经典输运机制的重要性。
papers.method_zh: 对高质量PdTe单晶进行磁输运测量，包括面内（B ∥ I）和面外（B ⊥ I）构型下的磁阻测量，以及通过面内旋转磁场测量平面霍尔效应；对MR、PHE振幅的场依赖和温度依赖进行详细分析，并采用参数化作图（parametric plot）进行判断。摘要未明确说明具体生长方法或其他辅助手段（如ARPES、DFT等）。

papers.title: Wafer-Level 1/f Noise Characterization of Scaled P-Type Nanosheets and Comparison with Planar HKMG Transistors
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive wafer-level 1/f noise study of scaled Gate-All-Around (GAA) p-type nanosheet transistors and benchmark them against large-area planar High- \k{appa} Metal Gate (HKMG) devices to assess the impact of device architecture on reliability. By statistically analyzing noise data from 188 nanosheets, we extract the effective trap density in the dielectric and compare it to that of planar transistors with identical gate stack, comparable processing thermal budgets, and no specific reliability anneals. The effective trap density extracted from 1/f noise is comparable in planar and nanosheet architectures. This indicates that transitioning to GAA nanosheets does not increase noise, which remains governed by gate stack quality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：wafer-level 1/f noise study、statistically analyzing noise data from 188 nanosheets、extract the effective trap density、benchmark against planar devices。；研究对象：晶圆级（wafer-level）的缩放型环栅（GAA）p 型纳米片晶体管（nanosheet transistors），并与大面积平面 HKMG（高κ金属栅）晶体管进行对比；研究的物理现象是 1/f 噪声（闪烁噪声）及由其提取的介质有效陷阱密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从 1/f 噪声提取的有效陷阱密度在平面器件与纳米片架构中相当，表明向 GAA 纳米片架构的转变不会增加噪声，噪声仍由栅堆叠质量主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从 1/f 噪声提取的有效陷阱密度在平面器件与纳米片架构中相当，表明向 GAA 纳米片架构的转变不会增加噪声，噪声仍由栅堆叠质量主导。；创新点：在晶圆级对缩放型 GAA p 型纳米片进行统计性 1/f 噪声表征，并与栅堆叠相同、热预算可比的平面 HKMG 器件直接基准对比，从而评估器件架构（平面 vs. GAA 纳米片）对噪声与可靠性的影响。
papers.method_zh: 晶圆级 1/f 噪声测量与统计分析（对 188 个纳米片器件的噪声数据进行统计），并从中提取介质中的有效陷阱密度；对比对象为具有相同栅堆叠、可比工艺热预算且未做特定可靠性退火的平面晶体管。

papers.title: Exciton-polariton condensates in epsilon-near-zero cavities
papers.abstract: We propose an epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) artificial cavity that can enhance light-matter coupling around the ENZ frequency and theoretically show the possibility of exciton-polariton condensation in the suggested platform. By using a rate equation model based on the driven-dissipative reservoir approach, we calculate the pump threshold for condensation and then compare the suggested platform's advantages/disadvantages with distributed Bragg reflector cavities. We also discuss the validity of the mean field theory within our model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：propose（提出）、theoretically show（理论证明）、rate equation model（速率方程模型）、mean field theory（平均场理论）。摘要中未提及任何实验测量或数值计算细节，属于纯理论建模与论证。；研究对象：一种 epsilon-near-zero（ENZ）人工微腔中的激子-极化激元凝聚（exciton-polariton condensation）现象。研究体系为 ENZ 腔结构，涉及光-物质耦合增强及极化激元凝聚相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出 ENZ 人工腔可在 ENZ 频率附近增强光-物质耦合，并从理论上证明了在该平台中实现激子-极化激元凝聚的可能性；同时通过速率方程模型计算了凝聚的泵浦阈值，并与分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）腔进行了优劣比较。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出 ENZ 人工腔可在 ENZ 频率附近增强光-物质耦合，并从理论上证明了在该平台中实现激子-极化激元凝聚的可能性；同时通过速率方程模型计算了凝聚的泵浦阈值，并与分布式布拉格反射镜（DBR）腔进行了优劣比较。；创新点：提出将 ENZ 人工腔作为增强光-物质耦合、实现激子-极化激元凝聚的新平台，并系统比较其相对于传统 DBR 腔的优势与劣势。摘要未明确说明该方案相对于已有 ENZ 相关研究的具体增量新意。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于驱动-耗散库方法（driven-dissipative reservoir approach）的速率方程模型，计算凝聚的泵浦阈值；并将 ENZ 腔与 DBR 腔进行对比分析；此外还讨论了模型内平均场理论的有效性。

papers.title: Pulse-Burst Excitation Reveals Time-Dose Reciprocity Breakdown in Mixed-Halide Perovskites
papers.abstract: Time-dose reciprocity, commonly associated with the Bunsen-Roscoe law, states that the response of a photosensitive system depends only on the total exposure dose, regardless of how that energy is delivered over time. Light-sensitive processes in mixed-halide perovskites, such as photoinduced halide segregation, often exhibit threshold-like behavior that may violate this principle and enable material-state control by photon timing. We test this using pulse-burst excitation, which introduces an additional temporal control dimension beyond conventional parameters such as pulse fluence, repetition rate, and average power. By redistributing the same photon dose over microsecond-to-millisecond timescales, we create distinct nonequilibrium excitation conditions and show that mixed-halide perovskites can evolve into different metastable states, revealing a breakdown of time-dose reciprocity in the combined processes of halide segregation and remixing. This additional temporal degree of freedom not only enables control of the material state but also provides a new experimental framework for disentangling the competing processes underlying photoinduced halide redistribution. Our findings establish photon timing as a control parameter for perovskite photochemistry and open additional opportunities for optical memory and neuromorphic photonic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中使用“We test this using pulse-burst excitation”“we create distinct nonequilibrium excitation conditions”“show that mixed-halide perovskites can evolve into different metastable states”等表述，表明工作以实验测试与观测为主。；研究对象：混合卤化物钙钛矿（mixed-halide perovskites）中的光诱导卤化物偏析与再混合过程，以及时间-剂量互易性（time-dose reciprocity / Bunsen-Roscoe law）是否成立的问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相同总光子剂量下，仅通过改变脉冲在微秒到毫秒时间尺度上的分布方式，混合卤化物钙钛矿即可演化到不同的亚稳态，表明在卤化物偏析与再混合的联合过程中时间-剂量互易性被打破。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相同总光子剂量下，仅通过改变脉冲在微秒到毫秒时间尺度上的分布方式，混合卤化物钙钛矿即可演化到不同的亚稳态，表明在卤化物偏析与再混合的联合过程中时间-剂量互易性被打破。；创新点：通过脉冲串激发引入光子时序作为新的控制维度，实验证明了混合卤化物钙钛矿中时间-剂量互易性的破缺，为区分光诱导卤化物再分布背后的竞争过程提供了新的实验框架，并指出光子时序可作为钙钛矿光化学的调控参数，为光学存储和神经形态光子学应用提供新机会。
papers.method_zh: 采用脉冲串激发（pulse-burst excitation），在脉冲通量、重复频率和平均功率等常规参数之外引入额外的时间调控维度，将相同光子剂量在微秒至毫秒时间尺度上重新分布，从而产生不同的非平衡激发条件并观测材料亚稳态的演化。摘要未明确说明具体的光谱探测或结构表征手段。

papers.title: Polymorph Engineering of the Layered Rare-Earth Magnet GdAlGe
papers.abstract: The recent advances in research on layered magnets have established them as invaluable materials for spintronic applications and precursors to 2D magnets. The problem is that the number of such materials available for experimentation is still low. To tackle the problem, one may employ phase engineering; in particular, the interplay between the phase stability and dimensionality provides great opportunities for design of layered magnets. Here, this interrelation is harnessed to produce epitaxial films of an overlooked layered polymorph of GdAlGe. The compound is formed by alternating triangular Gd and honeycomb AlGe lattices. It is stable in ultrathin films, up to 5 monolayers. In thicker films, an additional unwanted phase emerges. The structural quality of the ultrathin films is witnessed by electron and X-ray diffraction as well as electron microscopy. Magnetization measurements detect an anisotropic ferromagnetic state. The GdAlGe magnetism is corroborated by a study of electron transport revealing the anomalous Hall effect and negative magnetoresistance. The material is naturally integrated with Ge, a technological semiconductor, which should facilitate applications. The present study can serve as a blueprint for design of layered magnets via polymorph engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中明确提到“epitaxial films”（外延薄膜）的制备、“electron and X-ray diffraction”（电子衍射和X射线衍射）、“electron microscopy”（电子显微镜）、“Magnetization measurements”（磁化测量）以及“electron transport”（电子输运）等实验手段。；研究对象：层状稀土磁体GdAlGe的一种被忽视的层状多型体（polymorph），该化合物由交替的三角形Gd晶格和蜂窝状AlGe晶格构成，研究其超薄外延薄膜的稳定性、结构与磁性/输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该层状GdAlGe多型体可在超薄薄膜中稳定存在（最厚至5个单层），更厚的薄膜中会出现额外的非目标相；该材料表现出各向异性铁磁态，并通过输运测量观测到反常霍尔效应和负磁阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该层状GdAlGe多型体可在超薄薄膜中稳定存在（最厚至5个单层），更厚的薄膜中会出现额外的非目标相；该材料表现出各向异性铁磁态，并通过输运测量观测到反常霍尔效应和负磁阻。；创新点：通过相工程（polymorph engineering）利用相稳定性与维度之间的相互作用，成功制备了此前被忽视的层状GdAlGe多型体的外延超薄薄膜，并证明其可自然集成到Ge（技术半导体）上，为通过多型体工程设
papers.method_zh: 外延薄膜制备；电子衍射和X射线衍射以及电子显微镜进行结构表征；磁化测量探测磁性；电子输运测量（观测到反常霍尔效应和负磁阻）。

papers.title: The Hidden Cost of Alloying: Disorder-Driven Transport Collapse in TMDs
papers.abstract: Alloying in two dimensional semiconductors is widely used to tune bandgaps, yet its implications for charge and energy transport remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate MoS2xSe2(1-x) alloys as a model system to study the interplay between composition, thickness, and disorder. Optical transitions and valence band dispersions evolve continuously with both stoichiometry and number of layers, with negligible bandgap bowing and a composition dependent attenuation of thickness driven renormalization. In contrast, time resolved spatial mapping of photoexcited carriers reveals a pronounced and asymmetric collapse of carrier diffusivity at intermediate compositions, which cannot be accounted for by changes in effective mass or band alignment, and instead emerges from strong real space fluctuations in the local energetic landscape generated by random chalcogen substitution. Microscopic simulations reproduce the experimental trends and show that the character of disorder depends critically on the direction of alloying, producing either scattering barriers or deep trapping sites. Together, these results demonstrate that transport in TMD alloys is governed by disorder physics, overlooked by conventional optical and photoemission probes at equilibrium. Our findings establish transport as a stringent metric of electronic quality and high-light intrinsic limitations in the usage of TMD alloys for layered semiconductor devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算/模拟）。判断依据：摘要中既有光学跃迁、价带色散、时间分辨空间 mapping 等实验观测，又有微观模拟（microscopic simulations）来复现实验趋势。；研究对象：二维半导体合金 MoS₂ₓSe₂₍₁₋ₓ₎，研究其组分、层数与无序之间的相互作用，以及无序对电荷和能量输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中间组分处，光激发载流子的扩散系数出现显著且不对称的塌缩，这一现象无法用有效质量变化或能带对齐解释，而是源于随机硫族元素取代引起的局域能量景观的强实空间涨落；无序的性质关键取决于合金化的方向，可产生散射势垒或深陷阱位点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中间组分处，光激发载流子的扩散系数出现显著且不对称的塌缩，这一现象无法用有效质量变化或能带对齐解释，而是源于随机硫族元素取代引起的局域能量景观的强实空间涨落；无序的性质关键取决于合金化的方向，可产生散射势垒或深陷阱位点。；创新点：揭示了 TMD 合金中输运由无序物理主导，而这一效应被常规平衡态光学和光电子探测手段所忽视；提出输运是衡量电子质量的严格指标，并凸显了 TMD 合金在层状半导体器件应用中的内在局限性。
papers.method_zh: 光学跃迁测量、价带色散测量（摘要未明确说明具体实验技术如 ARPES 等）、时间分辨空间 mapping 技术追踪光激发载流子扩散；微观模拟复现实验趋势。

papers.title: Magnetic phases of Kondo lattice materials Ce$_5$RhGe$_2$ and Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$
papers.abstract: Single crystals of Ce$_5$RhGe$_2$ and Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$ have been systematically investigated by electrical resistivity, specific heat, and magnetization measurements. Together with Ce$_5$CoGe$_2$, all three compounds crystallize in the orthorhombic \emph{Pnma} structure, with the lattice parameters increasing monotonically from Co to Rh to Ir, consistent with the effect of negative chemical pressure. Magnetization measurements along the three principal crystallographic axes identify the \emph{a} axis as the easy magnetization direction throughout the series. Ce$_5$RhGe$_2$ exhibits ferromagnetic ordering with a Curie temperature of approximately 11.5 K and shows magnetic behavior closely resembling that of Ce$_5$CoGe$_2$. In contrast, Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$ undergoes two successive magnetic transitions at $T_{\rm M1}=12.7$ K and $T_{\rm M2}=11.8$ K, and there are multiple metamagnetic transitions under magnetic fields, giving rise to magnetization plateaus at fractions of the saturation magnetization $M_{\rm s}$ of approximately $M_{\rm s}/5$ and $M_{\rm s}/3$. The low-field metamagnetic transition along the easy axis shifts to lower field with decreasing temperature, and eventually a pronounced hysteresis loop is observed about zero-field, establishing that Ce$_5$IrGe$_2$ exhibits a ferrimagnetic ground state at the lowest measured temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：single crystals、electrical resistivity、specific heat、magnetization measurements。；研究对象：Kondo晶格材料 Ce₅RhGe₂ 和 Ce₅IrGe₂ 单晶，并与 Ce₅CoGe₂ 进行对比；研究其磁性相、磁有序转变及 metamagnetic transitions（变磁转变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ce₅RhGe₂ 在约 11.5 K 发生铁磁有序，磁行为与 Ce₅CoGe₂ 相似；Ce₅IrGe₂ 在 \(T_{\rm M1}=12.7\) K 和 \(T_{\rm M2}=11.8\) K 经历两次连续磁转变，并在磁场下出现多个变磁转变，形成约 \(M_{\rm s}/5\) 和 \(M_{\rm s}/3\) 的磁化平台，其最低测量温度下呈现亚铁磁基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ce₅RhGe₂ 在约 11.5 K 发生铁磁有序，磁行为与 Ce₅CoGe₂ 相似；Ce₅IrGe₂ 在 \(T_{\rm M1}=12.7\) K 和 \(T_{\rm M2}=11.8\) K 经历两次连续磁转变，并在磁场下出现多个变磁转变，形成约 \(M_{\rm s}/5\) 和 \(M_{\rm s}/3\) 的磁化平台，其最低测量温度下呈现亚铁磁基态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对单晶进行了电阻率、比热和磁化测量；磁化测量沿三个主要晶轴方向进行。

papers.title: Fabrication And Characterization Of High-Quality Nb/Al-AlO$_x$/Nb Cross-Type Josephson Tunnel Junctions Utilising CMP-based Planarisation Techniques
papers.abstract: Josephson tunnel junctions (JJs) are the fundamental building blocks of today's most advanced superconducting electronic components, such as qubits and superconducting quantum interference devices (SQUIDs). Given the ongoing demand for scalability of these devices on the wafer-scale, it is crucial to control the fabrication process as precisely as possible to ensure uniform quality and reproducibility. Today, window-type JJs are often used in the production of DC SQUIDs and while they are reliable and reproducible, they suffer from alignment inaccuracies caused by photolithography and unavoidable parasitic capacitances, thus limiting the energy sensitivity of DC SQUIDs. These problems can be circumvented by producing JJs with cross-type geometry, which allows for smaller junction areas and eliminates parasitic capacitances. Here we discuss the fabrication of Nb/Al-AlOx/Nb-based cross-type JJs, where the trilayer is embedded in sputter-deposited SiO$_2$ to allow for planarisation of the structures and to ensure the reliable insulation of the sidewalls of the bottom electrode. Instead of lift-off processes that require a lot of time and potentially leave unwanted wings along the edges of microstructures behind that might compromise subsequent layers, we use chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP) for the removal of excess SiO$_2$. This is not only much faster, but produces smooth and uniform surfaces, which in turn effectively improves the reliability of our JJ production process resulting in a high yield of over $90\,\%$ on wafer-scale. In addition, we discuss the influence of fabrication details on the quality and electrical properties of our JJs with different junction areas down to $1\,\mathrm{μm} \times 1\,\mathrm{μm}$ distributed across the wafer and extract the junction specific quality parameters from their IV-characteristics and their Fraunhofer patterns.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：fabrication、characterization、sputter-deposited、chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP)、IV-characteristics、Fraunhofer patterns、yield 等，均为实验制备与测量相关术语。；研究对象：Nb/Al-AlO$_x$/Nb 交叉型（cross-type）约瑟夫森隧道结（JJs），以及其在晶圆级制备中的工艺与电学特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用 CMP 平坦化技术替代剥离工艺制备的交叉型 Nb/Al-AlO$_x$/Nb 约瑟夫森结，可获得光滑均匀的表面，晶圆级良率超过 90%，并成功制备了面积小至 1 μm × 1 μm 的结；从 IV 特性和 Fraunhofer 图案中提取了结的质量参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用 CMP 平坦化技术替代剥离工艺制备的交叉型 Nb/Al-AlO$_x$/Nb 约瑟夫森结，可获得光滑均匀的表面，晶圆级良率超过 90%，并成功制备了面积小至 1 μm × 1 μm 的结；从 IV 特性和 Fraunhofer 图案中提取了结的质量参数。；创新点：用 CMP 平坦化替代传统的剥离（lift-off）工艺来去除多余 SiO$_2$，不仅速度更快，还能产生光滑均匀的表面，从而有效提高 JJ 制备工艺的可靠性，实现晶圆级超过 90% 的高良率；同时采用交叉型几何结构以减小结面积并消除寄生电容。
papers.method_zh: 制备方面：将 Nb/Al-AlO$_x$/Nb 三明治结构嵌入溅射沉积的 SiO$_2$ 中实现平坦化并确保底电极侧壁绝缘，使用化学-机械抛光（CMP）去除多余 SiO$_2$（而非剥离工艺）。表征方面：测量结的 IV 特性曲线和 Fraunhofer 图案，提取结的质量参数；在晶圆上分布的不同结面积样品上进行电学性质分析。

papers.title: Schwinger boson perturbation theory for spin-$S$ Kitaev-Heisenberg magnets: phase diagram and dynamical response near Kitaev spin liquids
papers.abstract: We develop a Schwinger boson perturbative framework for the spin-$S$ Kitaev-Heisenberg model. The spin-liquid saddle point of the pure Kitaev model is used as the unperturbed state, and magnetic instabilities and dynamical spin correlations are evaluated around this saddle point. We decompose the Hamiltonian exactly into two parts by exploiting the Klein duality intrinsic to the Kitaev-Heisenberg model. We perform the random-phase approximation by taking the part invariant under the duality transformation as the unperturbed term and treating the remaining term, which changes sign under it, as the perturbation. We determine the phase boundaries separating the quantum spin-liquid regimes from the adjacent magnetically ordered phases for $S=1/2$, $1$, $3/2$, and $2$. The spin-liquid regions shrink rapidly with increasing $S$ and become very narrow at $S=2$. We also compute the spin dynamics of the spin-$S$ Kitaev-Heisenberg model, focusing on $S=1$, and find that the dressed dynamical spin structure factor retains a broad two-spinon continuum at finite energies, while the low-energy spectral weight softens at the ordering wave vectors of the adjacent magnetic phases. Our framework thus enables thermodynamic-limit calculations of spin dynamics near magnetic instabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“develop a Schwinger boson perturbative framework”“random-phase approximation”“determine the phase boundaries”“compute the spin dynamics”等，属于理论推导与数值计算，而非实验测量。；研究对象：自旋-$S$ 的 Kitaev-Heisenberg 模型（$S=1/2, 1, 3/2, 2$），关注其量子自旋液体相与相邻磁有序相之间的相图，以及靠近 Kitaev 自旋液体时的动力学自旋响应；重点计算了 $S=1$ 的自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着自旋 $S$ 增大，自旋液体区域迅速缩小，在 $S=2$ 时变得非常窄；对 $S=1$，修饰后的动力学自旋结构因子在有限能量处保留了宽泛的双自旋子连续谱，而低能谱权重在相邻磁有序相的序波矢处软化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着自旋 $S$ 增大，自旋液体区域迅速缩小，在 $S=2$ 时变得非常窄；对 $S=1$，修饰后的动力学自旋结构因子在有限能量处保留了宽泛的双自旋子连续谱，而低能谱权重在相邻磁有序相的序波矢处软化。；创新点：提出了基于 Klein 对偶性分解 + Schwinger boson 鞍点 + RPA 的微扰框架，用于在自旋液体鞍点附近计算自旋-$S$ Kitaev-Heisenberg 模型的相图和自旋动力学，并声称该框架可实现磁性不稳定性附近自旋动力学的热力学极限计算。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一套 Schwinger boson 微扰框架：以纯 Kitaev 模型的自旋液体鞍点作为未微扰态；利用 Kitaev-Heisenberg 模型内禀的 Klein 对偶性将哈密顿量精确分解为两部分；在随机相近似（RPA）中，把在对偶变换下不变的部分作为未微扰项，把在对偶变换下变号的部分作为微扰项，从而评估磁性不稳定性和动力学自旋关联。

papers.title: Equivalent Circuit Representation and Thermodynamic Limitations of Non-Adiabatic Spin-Transfer Torque effect
papers.abstract: We present an equivalent circuit representation of the Thiele equation for the current-driven domain walls. We show that the non-adiabatic spin-transfer torque (β-term) cannot be represented by passive elements alone (such as resistors, inductors, and capacitors) and necessarily requires active elements, corresponding to negative dissipation. Consequently, assuming that the driving current is the only power source for the texture dynamics, directly incorporating the β-term introduces a fundamental contradiction with thermodynamic principles. This equivalent circuit theory indicates that the interpretation of experiments solely through the β-term does not fully capture the underlying physics, highlighting the need to account for effects distinct from the spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：equivalent circuit representation、Thiele equation、thermodynamic principles、fundamental contradiction——全文基于理论推导与电路类比分析，摘要中未提及任何实验或数值计算。；研究对象：电流驱动的磁畴壁（current-driven domain walls）的动力学，具体聚焦于非绝热自旋转移矩（β-term）的等效电路描述及其热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非绝热自旋转移矩（β-term）无法仅用无源元件（电阻、电感、电容）表示，必须引入对应负耗散的有源元件；因此若假设驱动电流是织构动力学的唯一能源，直接纳入β-term会与热力学原理产生根本矛盾。仅用β-term解释实验不能完全捕捉底层物理，需考虑自旋动力学之外的其他效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非绝热自旋转移矩（β-term）无法仅用无源元件（电阻、电感、电容）表示，必须引入对应负耗散的有源元件；因此若假设驱动电流是织构动力学的唯一能源，直接纳入β-term会与热力学原理产生根本矛盾。仅用β-term解释实验不能完全捕捉底层物理，需考虑自旋动力学之外的其他效应。；创新点：首次给出电流驱动畴壁Thiele方程的等效电路表示，并据此揭示β-term必然对应有源元件与负耗散，指出其与热力学原理的根本矛盾，从而说明仅靠β-term解释实验的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 基于Thiele方程的等效电路表示（equivalent circuit representation）进行理论分析，将方程中的各项映射为电路元件，并据此讨论热力学限制。摘要未明确说明是否涉及具体材料参数的数值计算或微观模型。

papers.title: Memory Control of Ice Growth During Non-Equilibrium Freezing of Water
papers.abstract: Freezing of supercooled water is a classic non-equilibrium problem, yet the influence of thermal history on crystallization remains unclear. Using molecular dynamics simulations with the TIP4P/Ice model, we investigate how the initial temperature $T_i$ shapes freezing following rapid quenching to 250 K. By monitoring the evolution of hydrogen-bonded ring structures, we find a non-monotonic dependence of the freezing time $t_F$ on $T_i$, with the slowest crystallization occurring near 300 K. Remarkably, this means that initially hotter water can freeze faster than cooler water, a molecular-scale analogue of the Mpemba effect. A non-stationary generalized Langevin equation framework shows that two-time memory kernels retain information about the system's thermal past, directly influencing crystallization dynamics. Structural analysis further reveals that five-membered rings act as kinetic traps, while correlations among ring types regulate the accessibility of ice-like motifs. These results uncover a molecular origin of memory-driven freezing and establish structural memory as a key driver of non-equilibrium phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键判断依据：使用分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations）和 TIP4P/Ice 模型，属于纯计算/模拟研究。；研究对象：过冷水的非平衡冻结过程，具体关注初始温度（热历史）如何影响水的结晶动力学，以及氢键环结构的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 冻结时间 t_F 对初始温度 T_i 呈非单调依赖关系，结晶最慢发生在 T_i ≈ 300 K 附近；这意味着初始温度更高的水反而可以比更冷的水冻结得更快，是 Mpemba 效应在分子尺度上的类似现象。此外，五元环充当动力学陷阱，环类型之间的关联调控冰态结构基元的可及性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：冻结时间 t_F 对初始温度 T_i 呈非单调依赖关系，结晶最慢发生在 T_i ≈ 300 K 附近；这意味着初始温度更高的水反而可以比更冷的水冻结得更快，是 Mpemba 效应在分子尺度上的类似现象。此外，五元环充当动力学陷阱，环类型之间的关联调控冰态结构基元的可及性。；创新点：揭示了热历史通过双时记忆核保留系统热过去的信息，并直接调控结晶动力学，从而提出“结构记忆”是非平衡相变关键驱动因素的新机制；同时从分子层面为 Mpemba 效应提供了微观解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用 TIP4P/Ice 水模型的分子动力学模拟，将体系快速淬火至 250 K 后监测氢键环结构的演化；并使用非稳态广义朗之万方程（non-stationary generalized Langevin equation）框架分析双时记忆核（two-time memory kernels）对结晶动力学的影响。

papers.title: Thomas-Fermi screening of electrostatic fields in a type-I superconductor
papers.abstract: The empirical London equations make distinct predictions for a superconductor's longitudinal and transverse electrodynamic response. Conventionally, this framework attributes the Meissner effect to the transverse component, with the longitudinal response predicted to remain unchanged on entering the superconducting state, i.e. a static electric field is screened over the Thomas-Fermi length ($λ_{\mathrm{TF}} \sim 1$~Å), just as in the nonsupercondcuting metal. J.~E.~Hirsch~[\textit{Phys.~ Rev.~B}~\textbf{69},~214515~(2004)] has developed an alternative formalism, which predicts that the longitudinal screening length should instead be governed by the London penetration depth as the system is cooled below the superconducting transition temperature ($T_{\mathrm{c}}$). Here we use a combination of qPlus atomic force microscopy and scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy of single-crystal Pb(111) at $\sim$~340~mK~ \mbox{($T/T_{\mathrm{c}}\sim0.05$)} in an attempt to detect any modifications in electrostatic screening of the longitudinal tip field upon entering the superconducting phase. We quench superconductivity using a magnetic field of 200 mT normal to the Pb(111) surface. By measuring force-distance curves and local field-emission resonance spectra at the same sample position in the presence and absence of the magnetic field, we constrain the change in screening between the normal and superconducting state to less than $\sim 1 \%$. This is between two to three orders of magnitude smaller than that predicted by Hirsch's theory, and entirely consistent with unmodified Thomas-Fermi screening across the superconducting transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：qPlus atomic force microscopy、scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy、force-distance curves、field-emission resonance spectra、quench superconductivity using a magnetic field。；研究对象：单晶 Pb(111) 表面在极低温（约340 mK，T/Tc约0.05）下，进入超导态时纵向静电屏蔽行为是否发生改变，即纵向电场屏蔽长度是否从正常态的 Thomas-Fermi 长度变为由 London 穿透深度主导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验将正常态与超导态之间纵向屏蔽的变化限制在约1%以内，比 Hirsch 理论的预测小两到三个数量级，与超导转变前后 Thomas-Fermi 屏蔽不变的图像完全一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验将正常态与超导态之间纵向屏蔽的变化限制在约1%以内，比 Hirsch 理论的预测小两到三个数量级，与超导转变前后 Thomas-Fermi 屏蔽不变的图像完全一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要仅说明该工作以实验方式检验了 Hirsch 关于超导态纵向屏蔽长度应由 London 穿透深度主导的替代理论预言，并给出了与 Thomas-Fermi 屏蔽不变图像一致的实验约束。
papers.method_zh: 在约340 mK 下对单晶 Pb(111) 使用 qPlus 原子力显微镜与扫描隧道显微镜/谱联合测量；通过施加垂直于 Pb(111) 表面的 200 mT 磁场来抑制超导；在同一样品位置分别测量有磁场和无磁场下的力-距离曲线和局域场发射共振谱，以比较正常态与超导态的屏蔽差异。

papers.title: High-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy with tunable magnetic field
papers.abstract: The control and perturbation of quantum phenomena with magnetic fields is an indispensable tool in materials research. Recently, in-situ field tuning was implemented into angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (magneto-ARPES), which provides direct momentum and energy-resolved information of the field-dependent electronic structure. However, aberrations of the electron trajectories were shown to be substantial, leading to significant spectral distortions and broadening even in small fields. Here we show that the electronic structure can be recovered from magneto-ARPES spectra with high accuracy while maintaining high momentum resolution even when strong trajectory aberrations are present. We studied Bi$_2$Se$_3$ in a dipole field of a coil using a laser-based ARPES system. The electronic structure was reconstructed in post-processing using detailed electron trajectory simulations. We identify two-dimensional (2D) momentum mapping, a micron beam spot size, and precise numerical field simulations as critical technical requirements for high-resolution magneto-ARPES. We show how circular dichroism can provide additional information about the coupling of the magnetic field to the spin. The experimental achievements and the scaling laws from our simulations provide a road map towards magneto-ARPES in larger fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合数值模拟）。关键依据：摘要中明确使用“laser-based ARPES system”进行测量，并配合“detailed electron trajectory simulations”进行后处理重建，属于实验为主、模拟辅助的工作。；研究对象：Bi₂Se₃（硒化铋）在磁场下的电子结构，具体为利用磁体线圈偶极场进行磁角分辨光电子能谱（magneto-ARPES）测量，研究磁场对电子轨迹及能谱的影响，并涉及自旋-磁场耦合（通过圆二色性探测）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使存在强烈的电子轨迹畸变，仍可通过详细的电子轨迹模拟在后处理中高精度地重建电子结构，并保持高动量分辨率；二维动量映射、微米级束斑和精确的数值磁场模拟是实现高分辨率 magneto-ARPES 的关键技术条件；圆二色性可提供磁场与自旋耦合的额外信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使存在强烈的电子轨迹畸变，仍可通过详细的电子轨迹模拟在后处理中高精度地重建电子结构，并保持高动量分辨率；二维动量映射、微米级束斑和精确的数值磁场模拟是实现高分辨率 magneto-ARPES 的关键技术条件；圆二色性可提供磁场与自旋耦合的额外信息。；创新点：已有 magneto-ARPES 中电子轨迹畸变会导致显著谱线畸变和展宽，即使在弱磁场下也很严重；本工作证明在强轨迹畸变存在时仍可通过轨迹模拟后处理恢复高动量分辨率的电子结构，并明确了实现高分辨率 magneto-ARPES 的关键技术条件，同时展示了圆二色性在探测磁场-自旋耦合方面的作用，为向更大磁场扩展提供了路线图。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用基于激光的 ARPES 系统，在磁体线圈的偶极场中对 Bi₂Se₃ 进行测量；数据处理上使用详细的电子轨迹模拟进行后处理重建；此外还通过圆二色性测量探测自旋-磁场耦合，并基于模拟给出向更大磁场扩展的标度律。

papers.title: Phonon-Programmable Hidden Unconventional Magnetism in Two-Dimensional Spin-Degenerate Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Spin-degenerate antiferromagnets can host hidden unconventional magnetism in their lattice degrees of freedom. We show that coherent phonons activate this magnetism by removing the spin-layer operations that enforce equilibrium band degeneracy without changing the collinear Néel order. The frequency and polarization of a pump electric field select a resonant \(Γ\)-point optical phonon and, within a doublet, its coordinate direction. This choice fixes the residual spin-layer symmetry. In monolayer MnPSe$_3$, an \(A_{2u}\) mode produces \(i\)-wave splitting odd in the mass-weighted phonon coordinate $Q$, reversing sign under $Q\to-Q$, whereas two orthogonal directions of the same doubly degenerate \(E_u\) doublet produce \(d\)- and \(s\)-wave splitting at a common resonance. Rotating the in-plane pump field \(\bm E_\parallel\) therefore programs both the spin-splitting texture and the thermoelectric spin current, continuously tuning the response between transverse pure-spin and longitudinal spin-polarized currents. A complete classification of two-dimensional collinear spin layer groups identifies the \(Γ\)-point coordinates that remove the degeneracy-enforcing operations and activate such unconventional magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要以理论推导和分类为主（"We show that..."、"A complete classification of two-dimensional collinear spin layer groups identifies..."），未提及任何实验测量手段或具体实验平台，核心结论基于对称性分析和模型计算。；研究对象：二维自旋简并反铁磁体中的隐藏非常规磁性，具体材料为单层 MnPSe₃。研究涉及声子（Γ点光学声子）如何激活这类隐藏磁性，以及由此产生的自旋劈裂织构和热电自旋流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相干声子通过移除强制自旋-层简并的对称操作（而不改变共线 Néel 序）来激活隐藏的非常规磁性；泵浦电场的频率和偏振可选择特定的 Γ 点光学声子及其坐标方向，从而决定残余自旋-层对称性，在 MnPSe₃ 中分别产生 i 波、d 波和 s 波自旋劈裂，并可连续调控热电自旋流在横向纯自旋流与纵向自旋极化流之间切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相干声子通过移除强制自旋-层简并的对称操作（而不改变共线 Néel 序）来激活隐藏的非常规磁性；泵浦电场的频率和偏振可选择特定的 Γ 点光学声子及其坐标方向，从而决定残余自旋-层对称性，在 MnPSe₃ 中分别产生 i 波、d 波和 s 波自旋劈裂，并可连续调控热电自旋流在横向纯自旋流与纵向自旋极化流之间切换。；创新点：提出通过相干声子（其频率和偏振）可编程地激活和调控自旋简并反铁磁体中的隐藏非常规磁性，揭示了声子坐标方向对残余自旋-层对称性的决定作用，并给出二维共线自旋层群的完整分类以系统识别可激活此类磁性的 Γ 点坐标；在 MnPSe₃ 中展示了通过旋转面内泵浦电场可连续调控自旋劈裂织构和热电自旋流类型。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析的理论框架，包括对二维共线自旋层群的完整分类，以识别移除简并强制操作的 Γ 点坐标；结合具体材料单层 MnPSe₃ 的声子模式分析（A₂ᵤ 模和双重简并 Eᵤ 双重态）进行论证。摘要未明确说明是否使用了第一性原理计算（如 DFT）或其他数值方法。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium stochastic thermodynamics of boundary functionals: From Zubarev's ensemble to stochastic particle separation
papers.abstract: This paper develops a generalization of Zubarev's nonequilibrium statistical operator method for the case of simultaneous inclusion of additive and nonlocal boundary functionals of trajectories. Using a unified thermodynamic approach, a three-parameter model of nonequilibrium systems is constructed, including the first-passage time, the dwell time above a given level, and the absolute extremum of the process. A correspondence is demonstrated between the maximum information entropy method for trajectories and the Donsker-Varadan large deviation formalism. Using the Doob`s h-transform, it is demonstrated that fixing extremal functionals of history induces efficient non-Markovian transport in the system with dynamic adaptation to historical records. Criteria for the applicability of the developed apparatus in the "large time" domain and the possibilities of its use for optimizing stochastic particle separation in periodic potentials are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中明确提到“develops a generalization of Zubarev's nonequilibrium statistical operator method”“a unified thermodynamic approach”“demonstrated”等理论构建与形式推导类表述，未涉及具体实验测量或数值计算细节。；研究对象：非平衡随机热力学中的边界泛函问题，具体包括轨迹的加性与非局域边界泛函、非平衡系统的三参数模型（首次通过时间、高于给定水平的停留时间、过程的绝对极值），以及周期势中随机粒子分离的优化问题。摘要未明确说明具体材料或实验体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作将Zubarev非平衡统计算符方法推广至同时包含加性与非局域边界泛函的情形，构建了包含首次通过时间、停留时间和绝对极值的三参数非平衡系统模型；并证明固定历史的极值泛函会通过Doob h变换诱导出具有对历史记录动态适应能力的有效非马尔可夫输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作将Zubarev非平衡统计算符方法推广至同时包含加性与非局域边界泛函的情形，构建了包含首次通过时间、停留时间和绝对极值的三参数非平衡系统模型；并证明固定历史的极值泛函会通过Doob h变换诱导出具有对历史记录动态适应能力的有效非马尔可夫输运。；创新点：将Zubarev系综方法推广到同时处理加性与非局域边界泛函；建立最大信息熵轨迹方法与Donsker-Varadan大偏差形式之间的对应关系；利用Doob h变换揭示固定极值泛函诱导非马尔可夫输运及动态历史适应的机制；讨论了该理论在“大时间”域的适用条件及优化周期势中随机粒子分离的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：Zubarev非平衡统计算符方法的推广、最大信息熵方法、Donsker-Varadan大偏差形式、Doob h变换。摘要未明确说明具体数值计算方法或实验手段。

papers.title: Thermal response of an in-situ STEM MEMS chip under rapid pulse heating
papers.abstract: In-situ rapid solidification studies demand measurements of thermal histories with high temporal resolution. We present a simple, effective setup to quantify the cooling response of an uncoated commercial Protochips Fusion MEMS chip in an in-situ scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) context. We drive user-defined temperature programs via an arbitrary waveform generator (AWG), while recording the voltage drops across a series shunt to reconstruct chip resistance and temperature at sub-millisecond resolution. We confirm the response times inferred from the current; however, the temperature obtained from the physically linked resistance, $T(R)$, evolves more slowly. Analysis of the maximum cooling step reveals an exponential-like relaxation with time constant $τ=1.80$ ms, consistent with reported thermal lag constants for fast scanning calorimetry. From the time to reach $95\%$ of the temperature difference $ΔT$, we measure an average cooling rate of $\approx 7.9\times 10^{4}$ K/s. Robustness checks include repeated $R(T)$ measurements (revealing a modest downward drift approaching an asymptote), a 10 k$Ω$ test load, and characterization of small off-duty arbitrary waveform generator leakage/offsets. These findings define practical bounds on achievable thermal-path rates when planning in-situ electron microscopy experiments with this chip platform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：论文搭建并测试了一套用于原位 STEM 的脉冲加热/测温装置，涉及对商用 MEMS 芯片的冷却响应进行测量、稳健性检验（测试负载、波形发生器泄漏/偏置表征）等，属于实验测量与装置表征工作。；研究对象：研究对象是商用 Protochips Fusion MEMS 芯片（未涂层）在原位扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）环境下的热响应/冷却行为，具体涉及快速脉冲加热下的温度演化与冷却速率，背景应用是原位快速凝固研究中的热历史测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从物理关联的电阻得到的温度 T(R) 比从电流推断的响应时间演化更慢；对最大冷却步骤的分析显示其呈类指数弛豫，时间常数 τ=1.80 ms，与快速扫描量热法报道的热滞后常数一致；从达到温差 ΔT 的 95% 所需时间测得平均冷却速率约为 7.9×10^4 K/s。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从物理关联的电阻得到的温度 T(R) 比从电流推断的响应时间演化更慢；对最大冷却步骤的分析显示其呈类指数弛豫，时间常数 τ=1.80 ms，与快速扫描量热法报道的热滞后常数一致；从达到温差 ΔT 的 95% 所需时间测得平均冷却速率约为 7.9×10^4 K/s。；创新点：提出了一套简单有效的装置方案，用于量化未涂层商用 Protochips Fusion MEMS 芯片在原位 STEM 中的冷却响应，并给出了该芯片平台可实现的热路径速率的实际边界；摘要未突出说明其相对于已有研究在方法或结论上的具体新颖性对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过任意波形发生器（AWG）驱动用户自定义温度程序，同时记录分流电阻上的电压降以重建芯片电阻和温度，实现亚毫秒时间分辨的温度测量；并进行了重复 R(T) 测量、10 kΩ 测试负载以及 AWG 小占空比泄漏/偏置表征等稳健性检验。

papers.title: Laser Shock Peening in Hydrogen Environments: Coupled Stress Transport Trapping Mechanisms and Application Gaps
papers.abstract: Hydrogen embrittlement limits the deployment of high-strength steels and advanced alloys in hydrogen infrastructure. Laser shock peening (LSP) is increasingly considered as a mitigation route because it combines deep compressive residual stresses with near-surface microstructural modification. This review critically assesses LSP not as an isolated strengthening treatment, but as a surface layer design strategy governed by coupled stress, hydrogen transport and trapping mechanisms. Evidence from steels, nickel based alloys and additively manufactured materials shows that compressive residual stresses may suppress stress assisted hydrogen transport and delay crack initiation, while LSP-induced nanostructuring, dislocations, twins and interfaces can either redistribute hydrogen beneficially or promote localized plasticity and damage. Reported trends are frequently confounded by hydrogen charging mode, surface roughness, contamination, residual stress depth profiling and limited structure performance correlations. Two design critical gaps are identified: the lack of quantitative links between post-LSP stress/defect architectures and hydrogen assisted fatigue crack growth, and the near absence of impact toughness data after LSP under hydrogen exposure. The review proposes mechanism informed qualification routes combining residual stress mapping, hydrogen characterization, service representative mechanical testing and modelling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（review）。判断依据的关键词：标题中的"Review"、摘要中"critically assesses"、"Evidence from...shows"、"The review proposes"等表述，表明是对已有文献的批判性总结与展望，而非单一原创实验或计算工作。；研究对象：激光冲击强化（LSP）处理后的高强度钢、镍基合金及增材制造材料在氢环境下的氢脆行为，具体关注LSP引入的残余压应力、微观结构缺陷（位错、孪晶、界面）与氢输运/捕获之间的耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LSP产生的深层压缩残余应力可抑制应力辅助氢输运并延迟裂纹萌生，但LSP诱导的纳米结构化、位错、孪晶和界面既可能有益地重新分布氢，也可能促进局部塑性和损伤；目前报道的趋势常受充氢方式、表面粗糙度、污染、残余应力深度剖面等因素干扰。摘要指出两个关键设计空白：缺乏LSP后应力/缺陷架构与氢辅助疲劳裂纹扩展之间的定量关联，以及几乎缺乏氢暴露下LSP后的冲击韧性数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LSP产生的深层压缩残余应力可抑制应力辅助氢输运并延迟裂纹萌生，但LSP诱导的纳米结构化、位错、孪晶和界面既可能有益地重新分布氢，也可能促进局部塑性和损伤；目前报道的趋势常受充氢方式、表面粗糙度、污染、残余应力深度剖面等因素干扰。摘要指出两个关键设计空白：缺乏LSP后应力/缺陷架构与氢辅助疲劳裂纹扩展之间的定量关联，以及几乎缺乏氢暴露下LSP后的冲击韧性数据。；创新点：将LSP从孤立的强化处理重新定位为由应力、氢输运和捕获机制共同主导的表面层设计策略，并明确指出现有研究在定量关联和冲击韧性数据方面的两大空白，提出机理导向的认证路径。
papers.method_zh: 综述性分析，汇总来自钢、镍基合金和增材制造材料的已有实验证据。摘要未明确说明综述所涵盖的具体实验手段或计算框架，但提出应结合残余应力映射、氢表征、服役代表性力学测试和建模的机理导向认证路线。

papers.title: Theory of Kondo hybridization wave in Kondo lattice
papers.abstract: Recent scanning tunneling microscopy experiments have discovered emergent spatially modulated Kondo hybridization wave (KHW) order in the heavy fermion superconductor UTe$_2$ and the artificial Kondo lattice system 1T/1H-TaS$_2$, challenging the conventional paradigm of spatially uniform Kondo hybridization in heavy fermion physics. Here, we develop a microscopic theory for KHW order based on the canonical square-lattice Kondo lattice model within the large-$N$ fermionic mean-field approximation. We systematically identify stable modulated KHW phases and establish their ground-state phase diagram. The prominent $\boldsymbol{Q}=(0,π)$ KHW phase yields uniaxial stripe modulation of the Kondo hybridization gap, which faithfully reproduces the spatial modulation pattern observed in UTe$_2$. Moreover, its inherent unit-cell-doubling modulation precisely accounts for the spectroscopic features measured in 1T/1H-TaS$_2$. We further predict a characteristic in-plane conductivity anisotropy that serves as a definitive transport fingerprint to discriminate KHW states with distinct ordering wavevectors. Our work provides a microscopic foundation for the newly observed KHW order and establishes a unified theoretical framework for understanding emergent modulated hybridization phenomena in heavy fermion materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：develop a microscopic theory、large-$N$ fermionic mean-field approximation、establish their ground-state phase diagram、predict。；研究对象：重费米子物理中的空间调制近藤杂化波（KHW）序。具体涉及重费米子超导体 UTe$_2$ 和人工近藤晶格体系 1T/1H-TaS$_2$ 中实验观测到的 KHW 序，理论模型为正方晶格近藤晶格模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正方晶格近藤晶格模型的大-$N$ 费米子平均场框架下，系统性地识别出稳定的调制 KHW 相并建立了基态相图；其中显著的 $\boldsymbol{Q}=(0,\pi)$ KHW 相给出近藤杂化能隙的单轴条纹调制，能忠实再现 UTe$_2$ 中观测到的空间调制图案，其固有的晶胞加倍调制也精确解释了 1T/1H-TaS$_2$ 的光谱特征；此外预测了可作为区分不同有序波矢 KHW 态的面内电导各向异性输运指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正方晶格近藤晶格模型的大-$N$ 费米子平均场框架下，系统性地识别出稳定的调制 KHW 相并建立了基态相图；其中显著的 $\boldsymbol{Q}=(0,\pi)$ KHW 相给出近藤杂化能隙的单轴条纹调制，能忠实再现 UTe$_2$ 中观测到的空间调制图案，其固有的晶胞加倍调制也精确解释了 1T/1H-TaS$_2$ 的光谱特征；此外预测了可作为区分不同有序波矢 KHW 态的面内电导各向异性输运指纹。；创新点：首次为近期实验发现的 KHW 序提供微观理论基础，建立了理解重费米子材料中涌现调制杂化现象的统一理论框架，并提出面内电导各向异性作为区分不同 KHW 态的确定性输运指纹。
papers.method_zh: 基于正则正方晶格近藤晶格模型，采用大-$N$ 费米子平均场近似进行微观理论计算，系统识别稳定调制 KHW 相并建立基态相图，并预测输运性质。

papers.title: Impurity as a probe of Berry curvature and wavefunction winding in gapped two-band models
papers.abstract: We explore the possibility of using quasiparticle interference near impurities to extract non-local properties of bands. Focusing on the minimal two-band description of a system with multiple valleys, we show that the local density of states (LDOS) induced by non-magnetic impurities can effectively probe both the Berry curvature and the wavefunction winding, locally in each valley. We analyze gapped models based on Dirac, semi-Dirac, quadratic touching, and higher-order touching energy dispersions, in presence of a point-like potential scatterer. We find that for strong enough impurity potentials the LDOS along a contour around the impurity unambiguously shows the wavefunction winding number, in contrast to the case of gapless Dirac-like dispersions where the winding can be precluded by LDOS oscillations in the radial direction. We also establish a general connection between, on the one hand, the Berry curvature as a function of momentum locally in a valley, and on the other hand, the wavefunction winding number and the energy dispersion parameters, making hence the local Berry curvature directly observable from spectroscopic LDOS information.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：探索可能性（explore the possibility）、理论分析（analyze gapped models）、建立一般性联系（establish a general connection），摘要中未提及具体实验或数值计算细节，属于理论模型分析工作。；研究对象：具有多能谷的 gapped 两带模型体系，具体包括基于 Dirac、semi-Dirac、二次接触（quadratic touching）和更高阶接触（higher-order touching）色散关系的各种有能隙模型，研究非磁性杂质附近的准粒子干涉现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非磁性杂质诱导的局域态密度（LDOS）可以有效地局域探测每个能谷中的 Berry 曲率与波函数绕数（winding number）；对于足够强的杂质势，围绕杂质的等能轮廓上的 LDOS 能够明确显示波函数绕数，而在无能隙 Dirac 型色散中径向 LDOS 振荡会掩盖绕数信息。此外，作者建立了 Berry 曲率与波函数绕数及能量色散参数之间的一般性联系，使得局域 Berry 曲率可直接从光谱 LDOS 信息中观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非磁性杂质诱导的局域态密度（LDOS）可以有效地局域探测每个能谷中的 Berry 曲率与波函数绕数（winding number）；对于足够强的杂质势，围绕杂质的等能轮廓上的 LDOS 能够明确显示波函数绕数，而在无能隙 Dirac 型色散中径向 LDOS 振荡会掩盖绕数信息。此外，作者建立了 Berry 曲率与波函数绕数及能量色散参数之间的一般性联系，使得局域 Berry 曲率可直接从光谱 LDOS 信息中观测。；创新点：提出利用杂质附近的准粒子干涉 LDOS 来局域探测 Berry 曲率和波函数绕数的新方案；揭示了有能隙体系中强杂质势下 LDOS 等能轮廓可明确显示绕数，区别于无能隙 Dirac 色散中径向振荡掩盖绕数的情况；建立了局域 Berry 曲率与波函数绕数及色散参数之间的一般性联系，使 Berry 曲率可从光谱 LDOS 直接观测。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于多能谷最小两带模型，在点状势散射体（point-like potential scatterer）存在下，计算非磁性杂质诱导的局域态密度（LDOS）。分析了 Dirac、semi-Dirac、二次接触及高阶接触等多种有能隙色散模型。摘要未明确说明是否使用了具体数值方法（如 T 矩阵方法、格林函数方法等）。

papers.title: From London to Morse via Binnig, Quate, and Gerber
papers.abstract: In their landmark paper introducing the atomic force microscope [Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{56}, 930 (1986)], Binnig, Quate, and Gerber presciently anticipated that the technique would ultimately be capable of probing interactions running the gamut from weak van der Waals interactions to strong covalent bonding. They also highlighted that the tip-sample forces central to AFM are present, and often highly influential, in scanning tunnelling microscopy; indeed, this realisation directly inspired the invention of the force microscope. In this perspective for the \textit{Forty Years of AFM} special issue, we review selected aspects of two decades of work from our group at the University of Nottingham that span the force range highlighted by BQG and are united by a common, central theme: the probe as active participant rather than passive observer. Our selection of results also covers length- and correlation-scales from the microscopic right down to the single chemical bond limit, tracking a spectrum of interactions from van der Waals/Hamaker forces, through hydrogen bonding, to covalent bonds and, finally, atom-by-atom assembly of metal clusters via vertical tip-sample transfer. Echoing BQG's own observations on the prevalence of probe-sample forces in STM, we also discuss recent evidence that tip-induced heterogeneity underpins first-passage dynamics in molecular diffusion and highlight the challenges in acquiring non-invasive measurements of diffusion barriers for adsorbed molecules that are readily perturbed by the probe. We close with a perspective on machine learning's growing role in automating tip-driven atomic and molecular manipulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/展望类文章（perspective）。判断依据关键词：“In this perspective for the *Forty Years of AFM* special issue, we review selected aspects of two decades of work from our group”。属于对课题组已有工作的回顾性综述，而非单一原创实验或计算文章。；研究对象：原子力显微镜（AFM）中探针-样品之间的相互作用力，涵盖从弱范德华力/Hamaker力、氢键、共价键，直到通过垂直针尖-样品转移实现金属团簇的原子级组装；同时涉及STM中探针-样品力的影响、探针诱导的异质性对分子扩散中首次通过动力学的作用，以及吸附分子扩散势垒的非侵入测量问题。研究对象跨越微观到单化学键尺度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文的核心主题是“探针作为主动参与者而非被动观察者”（the probe as active participant rather than passive observer）。摘要指出，BQG当年已预见AFM能探测从弱范德华相互作用到强共价键的整个力程，并强调STM中同样存在且常具重要影响的针尖-样品力；作者综述的工作表明探针-样品力在STM中普遍存在，且近期证据显示针尖诱导的异质性支撑了分子扩散中的首次通过动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文的核心主题是“探针作为主动参与者而非被动观察者”（the probe as active participant rather than passive observer）。摘要指出，BQG当年已预见AFM能探测从弱范德华相互作用到强共价键的整个力程，并强调STM中同样存在且常具重要影响的针尖-样品力；作者综述的工作表明探针-样品力在STM中普遍存在，且近期证据显示针尖诱导的异质性支撑了分子扩散中的首次通过动力学。；创新点：作为综述，其新意在于以“探针作为主动参与者”为统一主线，串联起诺丁汉大学课题组二十年间跨越范德华力到共价键、从微观尺度到单化学键极限的一系列工作，并呼应BQG关于STM中探针-样品力普遍性的观察，讨论了针尖诱导异质性对分子扩散首次通过动力学的作用，以及探针扰动下吸附分子扩散势垒非侵入测量的挑战，最后展望了机器学习在自动化针尖驱动操纵中的角色。相对于已有研究的具体新意，摘要未突出说明单一原创发现。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或计算方法。文中提及的研究涉及原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描隧道显微镜（STM）、垂直针尖-样品转移、以及机器学习在自动化针尖驱动原子/分子操纵中的应用，但未给出具体的实验技术细节或理论框架（如DFT等）。

papers.title: A thermally grown SiO2 diffusion barrier enabling high-temperature investigation of Ag-Au-Pd-Pt thin films
papers.abstract: Combinatorial processing platforms (CPPs), integrating Si microtip arrays with combinatorial thin film synthesis and atom probe tomography (APT), enable near-atomic-scale characterization of compositionally complex solid solutions (CCSSs) under diverse processing and reaction conditions, including oxidation, thermal phase stability and electrocatalytic reactions. Their application at elevated temperatures, however, can be limited when CCSS constituents such as Pd and Pt react with the Si support to form silicides. Although thermally grown SiO2 has proven effective as a diffusion barrier between pure Pt and Si, its performance for multicomponent CCSS thin films is unclear. Here, using Ag-Au-Pd-Pt as a model system, we compare a 25 nm thermally grown SiO2 barrier with native Si oxide during annealing using APT and transmission electron microscopy. Native Si oxide prevents detectable interfacial reactions up to 300°C, but at 400°C Pd and Pt react with Si, causing silicide formation and substantial redistribution of the film constituents. At 600°C, extensive substrate reactions disrupt the CCSS film and produce a pronounced needle-shaped silicide morphology. In contrast, thermally grown SiO2 suppresses CCSS thin film-substrate reactions up to 600°C and retains the CCSS composition. The thermally grown SiO2 thus extends the applicable temperature range of Si-based CPPs to at least 600°C for near-atomic-scale characterization of CCSS thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中明确使用 APT（原子探针层析）和透射电子显微镜进行退火对比实验，属于实验表征研究。；研究对象：Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 多组分固溶体（CCSS）薄膜与 Si 基底之间的界面反应，以及热生长 SiO₂ 作为扩散阻挡层对高温下薄膜-基底反应的抑制效果。具体对比了 25 nm 热生长 SiO₂ 与天然 Si 氧化物两种阻挡层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 天然 Si 氧化物仅在 300°C 以下能阻止可检测的界面反应，400°C 时 Pd 和 Pt 与 Si 反应生成硅化物并导致薄膜成分大幅重新分布，600°C 时严重基底反应破坏薄膜并形成针状硅化物形貌；而 25 nm 热生长 SiO₂ 可将 CCSS 薄膜-基底反应抑制到至少 600°C，并保持薄膜成分不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：天然 Si 氧化物仅在 300°C 以下能阻止可检测的界面反应，400°C 时 Pd 和 Pt 与 Si 反应生成硅化物并导致薄膜成分大幅重新分布，600°C 时严重基底反应破坏薄膜并形成针状硅化物形貌；而 25 nm 热生长 SiO₂ 可将 CCSS 薄膜-基底反应抑制到至少 600°C，并保持薄膜成分不变。；创新点：此前仅证实热生长 SiO₂ 对纯 Pt 与 Si 之间是有效扩散阻挡层，但其对多组分 CCSS 薄膜的性能尚不明确。本工作以 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 为模型体系，证明热生长 SiO₂ 可将 Si 基 CPP 的适用温度范围扩展至至少 600°C，从而实现 CCSS 薄膜的近原子尺度高温表征。
papers.method_zh: 将 Si 微尖端阵列与组合薄膜合成及原子探针层析（APT）结合的组合处理平台（CPP）；使用 APT 和透射电子显微镜（TEM）对退火后的 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 薄膜/阻挡层/Si 界面进行表征对比。

papers.title: Davydov Splitting Without a Davydov Pair and Highly Mobile Singlet Excitons in Perylene Red Microcrystals
papers.abstract: We investigate the excitonic properties of perylene red microcrystals, whose unit cell contain eight molecules, using both experimental and theoretical methods. Only two of the nominal eight Davydov transitions are experimentally observed, with an apparent splitting of 610 cm$^{-1}$ that is reasonably reproduced by a Frenkel-Holstein exciton model parametrized from density functional theory. A symmetry-based analysis of the eigenstates reveals that the two observed transitions do not belong to the same Davydov pair, so the splitting does not directly report on the Coulomb coupling within the unit cell. The complex mixture of local excitations produces a J-like band for the dominant transitions, favouring exciton transfer through increased spectral overlap. Consistent with this picture, time-correlated single-photon counting of the emission and ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy show that the dynamics is dominated by highly mobile singlet Frenkel excitons. The exciton mobility extracted from experiment agrees very well with that obtained from Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations, supporting a picture of incoherent hopping transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据关键词：experimental and theoretical methods、Frenkel-Holstein exciton model parametrized from density functional theory、time-correlated single-photon counting、ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy、Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：苝红（perylene red）微晶的激子性质，其晶胞含八个分子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验仅观察到八个名义Davydov跃迁中的两个，表观分裂为610 cm⁻¹；对称性分析表明这两个观测跃迁不属于同一个Davydov对，因此该分裂并不直接反映晶胞内的库仑耦合。主导跃迁形成J-like能带，有利于通过增加光谱重叠实现激子转移；动力学由高迁移率的单重态Frenkel激子主导，表现为非相干跳跃输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验仅观察到八个名义Davydov跃迁中的两个，表观分裂为610 cm⁻¹；对称性分析表明这两个观测跃迁不属于同一个Davydov对，因此该分裂并不直接反映晶胞内的库仑耦合。主导跃迁形成J-like能带，有利于通过增加光谱重叠实现激子转移；动力学由高迁移率的单重态Frenkel激子主导，表现为非相干跳跃输运。；创新点：揭示了苝红微晶中观测到的Davydov分裂并非来自同一Davydov对，因此不能直接用于推断晶胞内库仑耦合；同时通过实验与动力学蒙特卡洛模拟的定量一致，支持了高迁移率单重态Frenkel激子的非相干跳跃输运图像。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：时间相关单光子计数（TCSPC）测量发射、超快瞬态吸收光谱；理论/计算方面：基于密度泛函理论（DFT）参数化的Frenkel-Holstein激子模型、本征态的对称性分析、动力学蒙特卡洛（Kinetic Monte Carlo）模拟。

papers.title: Geometry-induced current decrowding in superconducting 3D constrictions
papers.abstract: Current crowding is a ubiquitous limitation in nanoscale devices, where confinement and sharp features distort current flow, generating localized current-density hotspots and premature failure. In superconductors, this effect suppresses the order parameter and promotes vortex nucleation, reducing the critical current below the intrinsic depairing limit. Here, we demonstrate that 3D shaping of superconducting nanoarchitectures overcomes geometric current crowding through spatial current redistribution, establishing a geometry-induced decrowding effect. Using finite-element modeling based on the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equation, we reveal that 3D constrictions exhibit a pronounced and tunable response to moderate in-plane magnetic fields---a functionality absent in planar geometries. This field-controlled geometry enables critical-current modulation and unveils new vortex-dynamics regimes, including a non-reciprocal critical current. Furthermore, curvature and finite thickness fundamentally alter vortex nucleation by enabling apex-mediated entry of single vortex lines, followed by their 3D splitting into two vortex filaments---a mechanism that does not occur in 2D manifolds. Our findings demonstrate 3D geometric engineering as a design paradigm for superconducting nanoarchitectures, offering control over current distribution and vortex dynamics in devices approaching the depairing limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：finite-element modeling、time-dependent Ginzburg–Landau equation。摘要中未提及任何实验测量，全部结果基于数值建模。；研究对象：超导三维纳米收缩结构（superconducting 3D constrictions）中的电流拥挤效应、临界电流调控及涡旋动力学。具体材料未在摘要中指明，摘要未明确说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维几何整形可通过空间电流再分布克服几何电流拥挤，产生“几何诱导的去拥挤效应”；三维收缩结构对中等面内磁场表现出显著且可调响应（平面几何中不存在），可实现临界电流调制并出现非互易临界电流，同时曲率和有限厚度使涡旋成核机制发生本质改变——单根涡旋线可经顶点进入并三维分裂为两根涡旋丝。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维几何整形可通过空间电流再分布克服几何电流拥挤，产生“几何诱导的去拥挤效应”；三维收缩结构对中等面内磁场表现出显著且可调响应（平面几何中不存在），可实现临界电流调制并出现非互易临界电流，同时曲率和有限厚度使涡旋成核机制发生本质改变——单根涡旋线可经顶点进入并三维分裂为两根涡旋丝。；创新点：提出“几何诱导去拥挤”这一新效应，证明三维（而非平面）超导纳米结构可通过面内磁场调控临界电流并产生非互易输运；揭示了二维流形中不存在的涡旋成核与三维分裂机制，将三维几何工程确立为超导纳米结构的设计范式。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时 Ginzburg–Landau 方程（time-dependent Ginzburg–Landau equation）的有限元建模（finite-element modeling）。

papers.title: The First Magic Angle Beyond the Chiral Limit in Twisted Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: We develop a squared-Hamiltonian description of twisted bilayer graphene beyond the chiral limit to explain why the first magic angle remains robust under lattice relaxation, while higher-order magic angles are strongly destabilized. Starting from the non-chiral Bistritzer--MacDonald model with finite same-sublattice tunneling, we show that lattice relaxation reshapes the effective confinement landscape rather than acting as a simple perturbation of the chiral theory. A central result is that the realistic relaxation-renormalized tunneling ratio lies close to a special confinement point where the oscillatory part of the symmetric confinement potential nearly cancels. This places realistic twisted bilayer graphene near a nearly uniform confinement regime. At the same time, finite same-sublattice tunneling activates an additional inter-sublattice current-like channel that competes with the chiral orbital channel. The first magic angle survives because these confinement and current-like contributions remain balanced, whereas higher-order magic angles lose this balance through stronger remote-band hybridization and enhanced real-space localization around AA regions. Our results provide a single-particle mechanism for the breakdown of the chiral magic-angle hierarchy and clarify why the experimentally relevant first magic angle remains the most stable remnant of the chiral flat-band structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We develop a squared-Hamiltonian description”“Starting from the non-chiral Bistritzer–MacDonald model”“Our results provide a single-particle mechanism”等表述，说明工作以理论建模与机制分析为主，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：扭转双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene）中的魔角（magic angle）现象，特别是第一个魔角在晶格弛豫下保持稳健、而高阶魔角被强烈破坏的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶格弛豫并非对手性理论的简单微扰，而是重塑了有效束缚势景观；实际弛豫重整化的隧穿比接近一个特殊束缚点，使对称束缚势的振荡部分近乎抵消，体系处于近均匀束缚区间。同时，有限同亚晶格隧穿激活了额外的亚晶格间类电流通道，与手性轨道通道竞争。第一个魔角因束缚贡献与类电流贡献保持平衡而存活，高阶魔角则因更强的远带杂化和围绕AA区域的实空间局域化增强而失去这种平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶格弛豫并非对手性理论的简单微扰，而是重塑了有效束缚势景观；实际弛豫重整化的隧穿比接近一个特殊束缚点，使对称束缚势的振荡部分近乎抵消，体系处于近均匀束缚区间。同时，有限同亚晶格隧穿激活了额外的亚晶格间类电流通道，与手性轨道通道竞争。第一个魔角因束缚贡献与类电流贡献保持平衡而存活，高阶魔角则因更强的远带杂化和围绕AA区域的实空间局域化增强而失去这种平衡。；创新点：提出了超越手性极限的平方哈密顿量框架，揭示了晶格弛豫通过重塑有效束缚势（而非简单微扰）来稳定第一个魔角的机制；指出实际扭转双层石墨烯接近近均匀束缚区间，并识别出类电流通道与手性轨道通道的竞争与平衡是第一个魔角稳健、高阶魔角不稳定的统一单粒子机制。
papers.method_zh: 从非手性Bistritzer–MacDonald模型出发（包含有限同亚晶格隧穿），发展了平方哈密顿量描述（squared-Hamiltonian description），用于分析超越手性极限的扭转双层石墨烯。摘要未明确说明是否结合了具体数值计算方法（如紧束缚计算、DFT等）。

papers.title: EBSDmagus: Managing Multi-Stage Dynamical Electron Backscatter Diffraction Simulations
papers.abstract: Dynamical electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) simulations increasingly support systematic studies of how material and experimental parameters affect diffraction patterns. Investigations that combine composition and crystal structure, including changes in atomic order, with accelerating voltage, temperature, and many orientations or detector conditions can require large sets of related calculations. Several packages provide dynamical EBSD simulation; we use the open-source, scriptable EMsoft programs because they are well suited to large studies on high-performance computing systems. An EMsoft investigation nevertheless spans separate configuration, structure, scattering, and orientation files and several dependent calculation stages. As variations multiply, manual preparation becomes difficult to check, interruptions obscure which results remain usable, and the origin of individual patterns becomes laborious to reconstruct. With EBSDmagus, researchers define fixed and varying parameters once. The software prepares the required EMsoft calculations, reuses compatible intermediate results, and checks that the generated files represent the requested investigation before execution. After execution, it checks the expected outputs and, following an interruption, resumes only unresolved calculations while preserving completed work. A portable run record links each output to its inputs and calculation history, providing the provenance needed when the results are deposited as findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable (FAIR) data. We assess this approach using a completed representative calculation, a larger study prepared and checked before submission, two observed cluster interruptions, and a controlled job cancellation. During recovery, EBSDmagus retained completed calculations and resubmitted only incomplete work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工具类文章（偏向计算工作流与数据管理，非物理论证型）。判断依据关键词：dynamical EBSD simulations、EMsoft programs、high-performance computing、configuration/structure/scattering/orientation files、calculation stages、FAIR data、run record、provenance。；研究对象：动力学电子背散射衍射（EBSD）模拟的计算工作流管理问题，具体针对使用开源可脚本化 EMsoft 程序开展的大规模、多阶段、多参数（成分与晶体结构、原子有序度、加速电压、温度、取向、探测器条件等）EBSD 模拟研究。摘要未明确说明具体研究的某种材料或体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: EBSDmagus 通过一次性定义固定与变化参数，自动准备所需 EMsoft 计算、复用兼容的中间结果、在执行前校验生成文件是否符合研究设定，并在执行后校验预期输出；在中断后仅恢复未完成计算、保留已完成工作。其可移植运行记录将每个输出与其输入及计算历史关联，为结果作为 FAIR 数据存储提供溯源信息。在代表性计算、提交前准备与检查的更大规模研究、两次实际集群中断以及一次受控作业取消中，EBSDmagus 在恢复时保留了已完成计算，仅重新提交未完成工作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：EBSDmagus 通过一次性定义固定与变化参数，自动准备所需 EMsoft 计算、复用兼容的中间结果、在执行前校验生成文件是否符合研究设定，并在执行后校验预期输出；在中断后仅恢复未完成计算、保留已完成工作。其可移植运行记录将每个输出与其输入及计算历史关联，为结果作为 FAIR 数据存储提供溯源信息。在代表性计算、提交前准备与检查的更大规模研究、两次实际集群中断以及一次受控作业取消中，EBSDmagus 在恢复时保留了已完成计算，仅重新提交未完成工作。；创新点：针对 EMsoft 研究中配置/结构/散射/取向文件分散、计算阶段相互依赖、参数变化增多导致人工准备难以核查、中断后难以判断哪些结果仍可用、单个衍射图来源难以重建等问题，EBSDmagus 提供了参数一次定义、自动准备计算、复用兼容中间结果、执行前后校验、中断后断点续算以及输出到输入与计算历史的溯源记录，并支持将结果作为 FAIR 数据存储。摘要未突出说明与已有工作流管理工具的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于开源、可脚本化的 EMsoft 动力学 EBSD 模拟程序，构建名为 EBSDmagus 的软件工具来管理多阶段计算流程；涉及配置、结构、散射、取向等多类文件与相互依赖的计算阶段，并在高性能计算系统上运行。评估方式包括：一个已完成代表性计算、一个提交前准备并检查的更大规模研究、两次观测到的集群中断、一次受控作业取消。

papers.title: Band Structure Modulation of ZrO2 Nanoparticles for Control of CO Adsorption Properties: A Combined Density Functional Theory - Density Functional Tight Binding Study
papers.abstract: We present a combined density functional theory (DFT) and density functional tight binding (DFTB) study of zirconia (ZrO2) nanoparticles of experimentally relevant sizes of several nanometers and their interactions with the CO molecule. A hybrid DFTB - Force Field (DFTB-FF) framework is developed, whereby band structure calculations rely on an existing Slater-Koster framework, while the accuracy of structural optimization and adsorption properties is controlled by the introduction of classical long-range interatomic potentials into DFTB instead of the traditional repulsive potentials. Additionally, coordination-dependent Zr-C potentials are introduced to account for the distinct local chemical environments of bulk-like facet sites and under-coordinated tip and edge sites, thereby improving the description of CO adsorption. This hybrid DFTB-FF approach substantially improves the robustness of geometry optimization and provides a practical strategy for extending the applicability of DFTB to complex oxide nanostructures. The calculations reveal that termination stoichiometry can be used to engineer intrinsic, p-type, or n-type electronic structures and thereby tune the adsorption activity of zirconia nanoparticles. While stoichiometric nanoparticles do not activate the C-O bond, low-coordinated sites in Zr-rich (n-type) nanoparticles exhibit chemisorption accompanied by charge donation into a CO antibonding LUMO-derived orbital, resulting in C-O bond activation. These results demonstrate that stoichiometry-controlled electronic structure and under-coordinated surface sites introduced by nanostructuring play a key role in governing the adsorption strength and reactivity of zirconia nanoparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：combined density functional theory (DFT) and density functional tight binding (DFTB) study、band structure calculations、structural optimization、adsorption properties 等，全文以计算方法为主，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：实验相关尺寸（数纳米）的氧化锆（ZrO₂）纳米颗粒及其与 CO 分子的相互作用，重点关注纳米颗粒的电子能带结构（化学计量、p 型、n 型）与 CO 吸附性质之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 终止化学计量比可用于调控 ZrO₂ 纳米颗粒的本征、p 型或 n 型电子结构，从而调节其吸附活性；化学计量的纳米颗粒不活化 C-O 键，而富 Zr（n 型）纳米颗粒中的低配位位点发生化学吸附，伴随电荷向 CO 反键 LUMO 衍生轨道转移，导致 C-O 键活化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：终止化学计量比可用于调控 ZrO₂ 纳米颗粒的本征、p 型或 n 型电子结构，从而调节其吸附活性；化学计量的纳米颗粒不活化 C-O 键，而富 Zr（n 型）纳米颗粒中的低配位位点发生化学吸附，伴随电荷向 CO 反键 LUMO 衍生轨道转移，导致 C-O 键活化。；创新点：发展了混合 DFTB-FF 框架，用经典长程原子间势替代传统排斥势，并引入配位依赖的 Zr-C 势，显著提高了几何优化的稳健性，为将 DFTB 推广到复杂氧化物纳米结构提供了实用策略；同时揭示了终止化学计量比调控电子结构进而调节 ZrO₂ 纳米颗粒 CO 吸附活性的机制，以及纳米结构化引入的欠配位表面位点在决定吸附强度和反应性中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 联合使用密度泛函理论（DFT）与密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）；开发了混合 DFTB-力场（DFTB-FF）框架：能带结构计算基于已有的 Slater-Koster 框架，结构优化和吸附性质的精度通过将经典长程原子间势引入 DFTB 替代传统排斥势来控制；此外引入配位依赖的 Zr-C 势以区分体相类晶面位点与欠配位的尖端和边缘位点的不同局域化学环境，从而改进对 CO 吸附的描述。

papers.title: $1/3$-Flux Bound States in Multicomponent Superconductor Exhibiting Non-Abelian Statistics of $\mathbb {Z}_3$ Parafermions
papers.abstract: Multicomponent superconductors (MSCs) are predicted to host magnetic flux quanta carrying arbitrary fractions of the superconducting flux quantum. Recent advances have raised the expectation that $1/3$ flux quanta may emerge in MSCs with $C_3$ rotational symmetry. Electrons bound to such fractional flux are long regarded to form anyons, yet their explicit braiding statistics remain unexplored. We propose that these 1/3-flux bound states (1/3-FBSs) exhibit the intriguing non-Abelian statistics of $\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermions. Under no-double-occupancy constraint, two successive braiding operations of 1/3-FBSs are equivalent to a single $\mathbb Z_3$ parafermion braiding operation. The parafermion parity encoding the braiding outcome can be read out via the fermionic occupation number of the 1/3-FBSs. Combined with a crossed-Andreev-reflection-induced Hadamard gate, one can realize the complete set of $\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion braiding operations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：We propose、are predicted、equivalent to、can be realized 等，摘要中未提及具体实验或计算结果，属于理论预言与方案提出。；研究对象：多组分超导体（MSCs）中具有 C₃ 旋转对称性的 1/3 磁通束缚态（1/3-FBSs），以及其携带的 Z₃ 仲费米子（parafermion）非阿贝尔统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 1/3 磁通束缚态表现出 Z₃ 仲费米子的非阿贝尔统计；在无双重占据约束下，对 1/3-FBSs 连续两次编织操作等价于一次 Z₃ 仲费米子编织操作；编码编织结果的仲费米子宇称可通过 1/3-FBSs 的费米子占据数读出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：1/3 磁通束缚态表现出 Z₃ 仲费米子的非阿贝尔统计；在无双重占据约束下，对 1/3-FBSs 连续两次编织操作等价于一次 Z₃ 仲费米子编织操作；编码编织结果的仲费米子宇称可通过 1/3-FBSs 的费米子占据数读出。；创新点：此前人们长期认为束缚在分数磁通上的电子形成任意子，但其具体编织统计尚未被探索；本文首次提出 1/3-FBSs 具有 Z₃ 仲费米子非阿贝尔统计，并给出通过费米子占据数读出宇称、结合交叉安德烈夫反射诱导的 Hadamard 门实现完整 Z₃ 仲费米子编织操作集的方案。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段或计算方法；从摘要内容看属于理论框架分析，涉及无双重占据约束、编织操作（braiding）、交叉安德烈夫反射（crossed-Andreev-reflection）诱导的 Hadamard 门等理论工具。

papers.title: Flexoelectric Polarization in Wrinkled Janus Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Monolayers
papers.abstract: Strain-gradient engineering via out-of-plane wrinkling offers a powerful route to tune electronic and electromechanical properties in two-dimensional (2D) materials. Here, we systematically investigate the electronic and flexoelectric response of wrinkled Janus MoSSe/MoSeS monolayers using density functional theory (DFT) calculations coupled with continuum elastica modeling. Exploring varying wrinkle sizes and compressive strain levels ($5\%-20\%$), we show that the global out-of-plane polarization follows a linear behavior when parameterized by the projected aspect ratio of the nanowrinkles. On this basis, we develop a physically grounded geometric model incorporating an effective 2D flexoelectric coefficient, which accurately predicts DFT polarizations without requiring higher-order nonlinear parameters. Atom- and orbital-resolved charge density analyses reveal the microscopic origin of this behavior: while the central Mo $4d$-orbital manifold acts as a robust, linear flexoelectric core, local curvature drives continuous, chemically asymmetric charge transfer between the S $3p$ and Se $4p$ sublayer manifolds. Our findings establish clear geometric design rules for harnessing Janus-based flexoelectricity for flexible nanoelectronics and optoelectronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要明确使用“density functional theory (DFT) calculations coupled with continuum elastica modeling”进行研究，属于第一性原理计算与连续介质模型结合的理论计算工作，未涉及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：褶皱（面外起皱）的 Janus 过渡金属硫族化合物单层 MoSSe/MoSeS，研究其电子结构与挠曲电（flexoelectric）响应，即面外褶皱引起的应变梯度如何产生全局面外极化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 褶皱 Janus MoSSe/MoSeS 单层的全局面外极化在以纳米褶皱的投影纵横比（projected aspect ratio）为参数时呈线性行为；作者据此建立了一个包含有效二维挠曲电系数的几何模型，无需高阶非线性参数即可准确预测 DFT 计算的极化。微观上，中心 Mo 4d 轨道流形表现为稳健的线性挠曲电核心，而局部曲率驱动 S 3p 与 Se 4p 亚层流形之间连续且化学不对称的电荷转移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：褶皱 Janus MoSSe/MoSeS 单层的全局面外极化在以纳米褶皱的投影纵横比（projected aspect ratio）为参数时呈线性行为；作者据此建立了一个包含有效二维挠曲电系数的几何模型，无需高阶非线性参数即可准确预测 DFT 计算的极化。微观上，中心 Mo 4d 轨道流形表现为稳健的线性挠曲电核心，而局部曲率驱动 S 3p 与 Se 4p 亚层流形之间连续且化学不对称的电荷转移。；创新点：提出了一个物理上合理的几何模型，引入有效二维挠曲电系数，仅用投影纵横比即可线性预测褶皱 Janus 单层的面外极化，且不需要高阶非线性参数；同时从原子/轨道分辨的电荷密度层面揭示了该挠曲电行为的微观起源（Mo 4d 线性核心与 S 3p/Se 4p 曲率驱动的不对称电荷转移）。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，结合连续介质弹性杆（elastica）建模；考察了不同褶皱尺寸和 5%–20% 的压缩应变水平；并进行了原子与轨道分辨的电荷密度分析。

papers.title: Néel-Vector Control of the Josephson Diode Effect in $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: The interplay of superconductivity and magnetism gives rise to rich phenomena in Josephson junctions. In this Letter, we study Josephson junctions formed by conventional $s$-wave superconductors and a $\PT$-symmetric collinear antiferromagnet modeled on CuMnAs. Using microscopic modeling and symmetry analysis, we show that these junctions exhibit both the Josephson diode effect and $\varphi_{0}$-junction states. Remarkably, both effects are controlled by the Néel vector: rotating it by $90^{\circ}$ switches off both, while reversing it switches the diode polarity. To reveal the microscopic mechanism, we develop a channel-resolved scattering theory that accurately captures the anomalous phases and establishes the exact condition for the diode effect. The interplay of the channel current-phase relations yields a sizable diode efficiency, tunable by both the magnitude and direction of the exchange field. Furthermore, a Green-function reduction identifies a single renormalized $\PT$-degenerate band as the transport carrier and precisely reproduces the full current amplitudes. Our work establishes $\PT$-symmetric antiferromagnets as versatile platforms for field-free, highly tunable Josephson diodes and $\varphi_{0}$ junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：microscopic modeling、symmetry analysis、channel-resolved scattering theory、Green-function reduction——均为理论/计算手段，摘要中未提及任何实验测量。；研究对象：由常规 s-wave 超导体与 PT 对称共线反铁磁体（以 CuMnAs 为模型材料）构成的 Josephson 结，研究其中的 Josephson 二极管效应和 φ₀ 结态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该 Josephson 结同时表现出 Josephson 二极管效应和 φ₀ 结态，且两者均由 Néel 矢量控制：将 Néel 矢量旋转 90° 可同时关闭这两种效应，而反转 Néel 矢量则可切换二极管极性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该 Josephson 结同时表现出 Josephson 二极管效应和 φ₀ 结态，且两者均由 Néel 矢量控制：将 Néel 矢量旋转 90° 可同时关闭这两种效应，而反转 Néel 矢量则可切换二极管极性。；创新点：建立了 PT 对称反铁磁体作为无场、高度可调 Josephson 二极管和 φ₀ 结平台的可行性；揭示了 Néel 矢量对二极管效应和 φ₀ 态的控制机制；发展了通道分辨散射理论，给出了二极管效应的精确条件，并通过格林函数约化将输运归结为单一重整化 PT 简并带。
papers.method_zh: 微观建模与对称性分析；发展了通道分辨的散射理论（channel-resolved scattering theory）来捕捉反常相位并建立二极管效应的精确条件；通过格林函数约化（Green-function reduction）识别出单一重整化的 PT 简并带作为输运载流子，并精确重现了完整电流振幅。

papers.title: Light-facilitated ferroelectric switching in wurtzite crystals
papers.abstract: Wurtzite ferroelectrics combine large remanent polarization with full CMOS compatibility, positioning them as a leading platform for next-generation non-volatile memory. Their practical deployment, however, is hindered by an intrinsically large coercive field, rooted in the high energy barrier separating the polar wurtzite phase from the nonpolar hexagonal phase that mediates polarization switching. Here, using first-principles calculations, we propose an alternative, field-free strategy for lowering this barrier: above-bandgap electronic photoexcitation. Taking LaN as a representative wurtzite ferroelectric, we show that light induced carriers dramatically reduce the energy difference between the hexagonal intermediate phase and the wurtzite ground state, sharply reducing the energy barrier to ferroelectric switching. This effect originates from a photoinduced partial metallization of the polar phase, which screens the dipole-dipole interactions that stabilize ferroelectric order and thereby favors the competing nonpolar structure. The robustness of this mechanism is further confirmed for the rocksalt polymorph. Our results establish light as a powerful, non-invasive route to controlling ferroelectric switching in wurtzites, opening a path toward faster, lower-voltage, and more energy-efficient non-volatile memory technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：纤锌矿结构铁电体（wurtzite ferroelectrics），以 LaN 为代表性材料，研究其铁电极化翻转过程中从极性纤锌矿相经由非极性六方中间相的相变势垒问题；同时验证了岩盐（rocksalt）多型中的该机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高于带隙的光激发（电子光激发）可显著降低六方中间相与纤锌矿基态之间的能量差，从而大幅降低铁电翻转势垒，实现无外场的铁电翻转调控。其物理起源是光诱导的极性相部分金属化，屏蔽了稳定铁电序的偶极-偶极相互作用，从而有利于竞争性的非极性结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高于带隙的光激发（电子光激发）可显著降低六方中间相与纤锌矿基态之间的能量差，从而大幅降低铁电翻转势垒，实现无外场的铁电翻转调控。其物理起源是光诱导的极性相部分金属化，屏蔽了稳定铁电序的偶极-偶极相互作用，从而有利于竞争性的非极性结构。；创新点：提出了一种无外场（field-free）降低纤锌矿铁电体翻转势垒的新策略——利用高于带隙的光激发来降低势垒，而非传统依赖外加电场克服高矫顽场；并揭示了其微观机制（光诱导部分金属化屏蔽偶极-偶极相互作用）。摘要未明确说明与已有光调控铁电研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。摘要未明确说明具体泛函或计算细节（如是否使用 DFT+U、杂化泛函等）。

papers.title: Kane-Lubensky phonons in Maxwell lattice frustrated Mott insulators
papers.abstract: We show that zero-energy gapless Weyl-line phonons of the Kane-Lubensky's type can arise in the three-dimensional Maxwell lattice frustrated Mott insulators through the magnetopological mechanics. In a pyrochlore antiferromagnet with the spin-lattice coupling, a magnetic field selects the spin state whose lattice distortion generates a $P4_3 32$ topological lattice. More crucially, the spin-lattice coupling and the spin configuration cause the bending of the neighbouring bonds, and converts the system into the topological Maxwell lattice. Remarkably, the resulting system is found to host the bulk zero-frequency Weyl-line phonons protected topologically, and these gapless phonons are not Goldstone modes. Unlike the conventional ${C_{\rm ph}\sim T^3}$ for the Goldstone phonons, these one-dimensional zero-mode manifolds yield a characteristic low-temperature phonon specific heat ${C_{\rm ph}\sim T^2}$. Our results could find applications in the Cr-based spinel systems, and moreover, we establish a low-energy platform where an extensive number of topological zero-frequency phonons can strongly couple to other degrees of freedom, opening a route to exotic phonon-mediated phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要以理论推导和机制提出为主（“We show that…can arise”“through the magnetopological mechanics”“we establish a low-energy platform”），未提及具体实验测量或第一性原理计算细节。；研究对象：三维 Maxwell 晶格阻挫 Mott 绝缘体中的 Kane-Lubensky 型声子；具体体系为具有自旋-晶格耦合的烧绿石反铁磁体（pyrochlore antiferromagnet），并提及可能应用于 Cr 基尖晶石体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋-晶格耦合的烧绿石反铁磁体中，磁场会选择特定自旋态，其晶格畸变产生 P4₃32 拓扑晶格，并因自旋-晶格耦合与自旋构型导致相邻键弯曲，使系统转变为拓扑 Maxwell 晶格，从而在体态中承载受拓扑保护的零频 Weyl-line 声子；这些无能隙声子不是 Goldstone 模式，其低温柔声子比热为 C_ph ∼ T²，而非 Goldstone 声子的 C_ph ∼ T³。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋-晶格耦合的烧绿石反铁磁体中，磁场会选择特定自旋态，其晶格畸变产生 P4₃32 拓扑晶格，并因自旋-晶格耦合与自旋构型导致相邻键弯曲，使系统转变为拓扑 Maxwell 晶格，从而在体态中承载受拓扑保护的零频 Weyl-line 声子；这些无能隙声子不是 Goldstone 模式，其低温柔声子比热为 C_ph ∼ T²，而非 Goldstone 声子的 C_ph ∼ T³。；创新点：提出在三维 Maxwell 晶格阻挫 Mott 绝缘体中通过磁拓扑力学产生 Kane-Lubensky 型零能无能隙 Weyl-line 声子；关键新意在于自旋-晶格耦合与自旋构型引起的键弯曲将系统转化为拓扑 Maxwell 晶格，且这些无能隙声子非 Goldstone 模式，并给出区别于常规 Goldstone 声子的 T² 低温比热特征；同时提出一个大量拓扑零频声子可与其他自由度强耦合的低能平台。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段、计算方法或理论框架，仅提及“magnetopological mechanics”这一理论机制框架。

papers.title: Magnetochiral anisotropy of thermally activated phase slips in noncentrosymmetric superconductors
papers.abstract: Resistive tails of narrow superconducting wires below the critical temperature are governed by phase slips, thermally activated near the transition and quantum at lower temperatures. We develop the theory of thermally activated phase slips in wires lacking inversion symmetry, modeled microscopically as a diffusive wire formed from a two-dimensional electron gas with Rashba spin-orbit coupling in an in-plane magnetic field. The phase-slip resistance acquires magnetochiral anisotropy: at fixed current it changes upon reversal of the field, and at fixed field upon reversal of the current, while the linear-response resistance remains field symmetric as required by Onsager reciprocity. The nonreciprocity originates from an asymmetry of the phase-slip activation barrier that is odd in both current and field. It is generated by the Lifshitz invariants of the free energy, the cubic gradient term and the momentum-odd quartic vertex, together with even gradient terms promoted to odd ones by the helical ground state, precisely the combination that determines the superconducting diode effect. The barrier asymmetry is therefore fixed by the diode efficiency of the same wire through a universal numerical ratio, with no adjustable parameters. The kinetic Lifshitz invariant, which makes relaxation and noise of the order parameter nonreciprocal, affects only the fluctuation prefactor at a parametrically subleading level. Because the asymmetry resides in the activation exponent, the magnetochiral signal is amplified relative to the diode asymmetry by the ratio of barrier height to temperature, and appears as a field-antisymmetric splitting of the exponential slopes of differential-resistance traces routinely used to identify thermally activated phase slips.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中明确写“We develop the theory of thermally activated phase slips”，并构建微观模型进行理论推导，未涉及具体实验测量或数值计算方法的描述。；研究对象：缺乏反演对称性的超导窄线中热激活相滑移（thermally activated phase slips）的磁手性各向异性。具体模型体系为：由二维电子气（2DEG）构成的扩散型导线，具有Rashba自旋轨道耦合，并处于面内磁场中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在缺乏反演对称性的超导导线中，热激活相滑移电阻会出现磁手性各向异性：固定电流下反转磁场、或固定磁场下反转电流，电阻均发生改变；而线性响应电阻仍保持磁场对称性（满足Onsager倒易关系）。该非互易性源于相滑移激活势垒中同时关于电流和磁场为奇函数的反对称分量，其大小由同一导线的超导二极管效率通过一个普适数值比固定，无自由参数。由于不对称性存在于激活指数中，磁手性信号相对于二极管不对称性被势垒高度与温度之比放大，表现为微分电阻曲线上指数斜率的场反对称劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在缺乏反演对称性的超导导线中，热激活相滑移电阻会出现磁手性各向异性：固定电流下反转磁场、或固定磁场下反转电流，电阻均发生改变；而线性响应电阻仍保持磁场对称性（满足Onsager倒易关系）。该非互易性源于相滑移激活势垒中同时关于电流和磁场为奇函数的反对称分量，其大小由同一导线的超导二极管效率通过一个普适数值比固定，无自由参数。由于不对称性存在于激活指数中，磁手性信号相对于二极管不对称性被势垒高度与温度之比放大，表现为微分电阻曲线上指数斜率的场反对称劈裂。；创新点：首次理论研究了非中心对称超导窄线中热激活相滑移的磁手性各向异性，揭示了相滑移电阻的非互易性来源于激活势垒的不对称性，并发现该势垒不对称性与超导二极管效率之间存在普适数值比关系（无可调参数）；同时指出由于不对称性位于激活指数中，磁手性信号被势垒高度与温度之比放大，表现为微分电阻指数斜率的场反对称劈裂，为实验识别热激活相滑移提供了新特征。
papers.method_zh: 微观理论框架：将导线建模为二维电子气中的扩散型导线，包含Rashba自旋轨道耦合和面内磁场；基于Ginzburg-Landau自由能中的Lifshitz不变量（三次梯度项和动量奇数次四阶顶点）以及螺旋基态将偶梯度项提升为奇梯度项来分析相滑移激活势垒的不对称性；并讨论了动力学Lifshitz不变量对涨落前因子的影响。

papers.title: A unified description of flow-induced scission of wormlike micelles under shear and extensional flows
papers.abstract: We investigate flow-induced scission of wormlike micelles under different flow kinematics using dissipative particle dynamics simulations of surfactant solutions in shear, uniaxial extensional, planar extensional, and biaxial extensional flows. The average lifetime of wormlike micelles is used to quantify the degree of scission. While flow-induced scission occurs in all flow types when the deformation rate is sufficiently high, the dependence of the average lifetime on the deformation rate differs among flow types. To provide a unified description, we introduce an effective extension rate determined by the velocity gradient tensor and micellar orientation. When expressed in terms of this effective extension rate, the average lifetimes obtained under all flow types considered collapse onto a single curve. These results demonstrate that a unified description of flow-induced scission requires not only the strength and kinematics of the imposed flow, but also the micellar orientation relative to the extensional direction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要明确使用“dissipative particle dynamics simulations”（耗散粒子动力学模拟）研究表面活性剂溶液，属于计算机模拟研究。；研究对象：表面活性剂溶液中的蠕虫状胶束（wormlike micelles）在剪切流、单轴拉伸流、平面拉伸流和双轴拉伸流等不同流动运动学条件下的流动诱导断裂（flow-induced scission）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有流动类型在变形率足够高时都会发生流动诱导断裂，但平均寿命对变形率的依赖关系因流动类型而异；引入由速度梯度张量和胶束取向共同决定的有效拉伸率后，所有流动类型下得到的平均寿命坍缩到同一条曲线上，表明统一描述流动诱导断裂不仅需要流动的强度和运动学，还需要胶束相对于拉伸方向的取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有流动类型在变形率足够高时都会发生流动诱导断裂，但平均寿命对变形率的依赖关系因流动类型而异；引入由速度梯度张量和胶束取向共同决定的有效拉伸率后，所有流动类型下得到的平均寿命坍缩到同一条曲线上，表明统一描述流动诱导断裂不仅需要流动的强度和运动学，还需要胶束相对于拉伸方向的取向。；创新点：提出了“有效拉伸率”这一概念，将速度梯度张量与胶束取向结合起来，首次实现了不同流动运动学条件下流动诱导断裂的统一描述，证明胶束取向是统一描述中不可或缺的要素。
papers.method_zh: 耗散粒子动力学（dissipative particle dynamics, DPD）模拟，对表面活性剂溶液在四种流动类型（剪切流、单轴拉伸流、平面拉伸流、双轴拉伸流）下进行研究，以蠕虫状胶束的平均寿命量化断裂程度。

papers.title: Large-Chern-number flat bands, anomalous Dirac cones, and unconventional superfluidity in square-lattice systems with SU(N) non-Abelian gauge fields
papers.abstract: We study topological band structures and superfluid phases in two-dimensional square-lattice systems with homogeneous SU($N$) non-Abelian gauge fields. Starting from an SU(4) gauge-field model related to the Hofstadter model with flux $α=1/4$, we show that the lowest and highest bands are isolated Chern bands that carry Chern numbers $C=-4$ and give rise to four chiral edge modes in a strip geometry. Remarkably, although the two middle bands touch and form $16$ gapless Dirac cones, their combined Chern number is $C=8$. We then generalize the construction to SU($N$) systems and reveal an even--odd structure of the band topology: when $N$ is odd, all bands are isolated and carry nonzero Chern numbers; when $N$ is even, the two middle bands touch at $N^{2}$ Dirac points, while all other bands remain isolated and topologically nontrivial. We find that the uppermost and lowermost bands become increasingly flat and their Berry curvature becomes more uniform as $N$ increases, providing a promising platform for realizing fractional Chern insulating phases. We further examine the spin-$3/2$ SU(4) model with on-site attractive Hubbard interactions, exploring its superfluid phases at partial filling. We find that the non-Abelian gauge field breaks the hidden SO(5) degeneracy of the quintet pairing and selects distinct nematic superfluid states. For fillings in the middle-band regime, the resulting spectrum can host topologically protected Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. Our results provide a starting point for exploring both topological band physics and unconventional superfluidity in synthetic SU($N$) cold-atom systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：摘要以“We study…”“we show…”“we generalize…”“We further examine…”等理论建模与解析推导式表述为主，未提及任何实验测量手段或实验平台数据。；研究对象：二维方格子系统中的 SU(N) 非阿贝尔规范场模型，具体包括与通量 α=1/4 的 Hofstadter 模型相关的 SU(4) 规范场模型，以及推广的 SU(N) 系统；并进一步研究带在位吸引 Hubbard 相互作用的 spin-3/2 SU(4) 模型中的超流相。涉及拓扑能带结构（陈能带、狄拉克锥、边缘态）与非常规超流/配对态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 SU(4) 模型中，最低和最高能带是携带陈数 C=-4 的孤立陈能带（对应四条手性边缘模），而中间两个能带虽相互接触形成 16 个无隙狄拉克锥，其组合陈数为 C=8；推广到 SU(N) 后呈现奇偶结构：N 为奇数时所有能带孤立且带非零陈数，N 为偶数时中间两带在 N² 个狄拉克点接触而其余能带仍孤立且拓扑非平庸。随 N 增大，最上/最下能带趋于平坦且贝里曲率更均匀，有利于分数量子陈绝缘相；在 SU(4) 吸引 Hubbard 模型中，非阿贝尔规范场破坏五重态配对的隐藏 SO(5) 简并并选出不同的向列超流态，中间带填充区可出现拓扑保护的 Bogoliubov 费米面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 SU(4) 模型中，最低和最高能带是携带陈数 C=-4 的孤立陈能带（对应四条手性边缘模），而中间两个能带虽相互接触形成 16 个无隙狄拉克锥，其组合陈数为 C=8；推广到 SU(N) 后呈现奇偶结构：N 为奇数时所有能带孤立且带非零陈数，N 为偶数时中间两带在 N² 个狄拉克点接触而其余能带仍孤立且拓扑非平庸。随 N 增大，最上/最下能带趋于平坦且贝里曲率更均匀，有利于分数量子陈绝缘相；在 SU(4) 吸引 Hubbard 模型中，非阿贝尔规范场破坏五重态配对的隐藏 SO(5) 简并并选出不同的向列超流态，中间带填充区可出现拓扑保护的 Bogoliubov 费米面。；创新点：提出并刻画了方格子 SU(N) 非阿贝尔规范场系统中的大陈数平坦能带、反常狄拉克锥（中间带接触但组合陈数非零）以及能带拓扑的奇偶结构；指出随 N 增大能带更平坦、贝里曲率更均匀，可作为分数量子陈绝缘相的平台；并揭示非阿贝尔规范场破坏五重态配对的隐藏 SO(5) 简并、选择向列超流态，以及在中间带填充区产生拓扑保护的 Bogoliubov 费米面。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为二维方格子上的 SU(N) 非阿贝尔规范场模型构造与能带拓扑分析（陈数计算、边缘态分析、狄拉克锥计数、贝里曲率与能带平坦度分析），并在此基础上对 spin-3/2 SU(4) 模型加入在位吸引 Hubbard 相互作用，通过超流相分析研究配对态与 Bogoliubov 激发谱。摘要未明确说明是否采用具体数值方法（如精确对角化、DMRG、平均场等）。

papers.title: Speed Limit for Information Acquisition in Stochastic Learning Dynamics
papers.abstract: Neural networks acquire internal representations through learning. In this work, we formulate stochastic gradient descent (SGD) as a Markovian stochastic process and derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit that bounds the rate at which trainable parameters can acquire information about latent variables in the data-generating process. The resulting inequality decomposes the information flow into drift and noise contributions, thereby quantifying the roles of deterministic learning forces and SGD-induced fluctuations from an information-theoretic perspective. We verify the bound in analytically tractable basis-function linear regression, where the information budget predicted by the bound reproduces the ordering and characteristic time scales with which different latent variables are encoded in the learned parameters. These results establish Fisher-information speed limits as a quantitative framework for diagnosing when and how different aspects of the data-generating mechanism are acquired during stochastic learning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：formulate...as a Markovian stochastic process、derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit、analytically tractable basis-function linear regression、verify the bound。；研究对象：随机梯度下降（SGD）驱动的神经网络学习动力学，具体关注可训练参数在训练过程中获取数据生成过程中潜在变量信息的过程与速率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文推导出一个 Fisher 信息流速度极限，该不等式限制了可训练参数获取数据生成过程中潜在变量信息的速率，并将信息流分解为漂移项和噪声项，从信息论角度量化了确定性学习力与 SGD 诱导涨落各自的作用；在可解析处理的基函数线性回归中验证了该界限，其预测的信息预算再现了不同潜在变量被编码进学习参数时的排序和特征时间尺度。
