papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 T=100 的短预测时域内，虚拟节点（VN）方法在 τ=18 和 τ=21 时分别达到 90.4% 和 89.7% 的自主预测精度，非 VN 方法分别为 81.5% 和 76.2%；在 T=500 的长时域分析中，两种方法都能再现真实 MG 信号的定性吸引子结构和主导频谱成分，且轨迹始终保持有界。结果表明神经形态纳米线网络的固有动力学足以支持有意义的自主混沌时间序列预测，无需虚拟节点增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 T=100 的短预测时域内，虚拟节点（VN）方法在 τ=18 和 τ=21 时分别达到 90.4% 和 89.7% 的自主预测精度，非 VN 方法分别为 81.5% 和 76.2%；在 T=500 的长时域分析中，两种方法都能再现真实 MG 信号的定性吸引子结构和主导频谱成分，且轨迹始终保持有界。结果表明神经形态纳米线网络的固有动力学足以支持有意义的自主混沌时间序列预测，无需虚拟节点增强。；创新点：首次对 τ=21 这一更复杂的混沌区域（此前未在此类物理储备池中评估过）进行了预测研究；证明了无需虚拟节点增强，神经形态纳米线网络的固有动力学即可支持自主混沌时间序列预测；并指出随着物理网络规模扩展至硬件可实现的数百万节点，性能可能进一步提升。摘要未明确说明其他更具体的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理储备池计算（PRC）框架，以模拟的神经形态纳米线网络作为物理储备池，对 MG 混沌时间序列进行完全自主的闭环预测。评估了两种策略：一是虚拟节点（VN）方法，通过储备池状态的时间复用扩展特征空间；二是非 VN 方法，直接使用所有物理节点读出而不进行时间复用。

papers.title: First-Principles Study of Magnetism, Electronic Structure, and Bonding in Nb-Mn-Ge Kagome Compounds
papers.abstract: In this work, we systematically investigate the magnetic ground states, electronic structures, and bonding characteristics of the computationally predicted stable NbMn6Ge6, NbMn6Ge5, and NbMn6Ge4 using first-principles calculations. Our results show that structurally stable NbMn6Ge6 has a collinear antiferromagnetic configuration, while the metastable rhombohedral NbMn6Ge5 and NbMn6Ge4 favor ferromagnetic ground states. Magnetic moments on Mn atoms are nearly localized, suggesting the applicability of a generalized spin Hamiltonian. Magnetic anisotropy in AFM NbMn6Ge6 and FM NbMn6Ge5 has uniaxial behavior, while FM NbMn6Ge4 has in-plane anisotropy. Charge density difference and electron localization function analyses further show charge redistribution and bonding features within the Mn-Ge Kagome network and between adjacent structural layers. Electronic structures near the Fermi level show no features suitable for topological magnetism studies. Experimental synthesis, structural characterization, and magnetic measurements are required to verify our predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：标题含“First-Principles Study”，摘要明确使用“first-principles calculations”，且文末指出“Experimental synthesis, structural characterization, and magnetic measurements are required to verify our predictions”，说明本文为纯计算预测，实验验证尚未进行。；研究对象：计算预测的稳定 Kagome 化合物 NbMn6Ge6、NbMn6Ge5 和 NbMn6Ge4，研究其磁性基态、电子结构与成键特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结构稳定的 NbMn6Ge6 为共线反铁磁基态，而亚稳的菱方相 NbMn6Ge5 和 NbMn6Ge4 倾向铁磁基态；Mn 原子磁矩近局域化，支持广义自旋哈密顿量的适用性；AFM NbMn6Ge6 与 FM NbMn6Ge5 的磁各向异性为单轴型，FM NbMn6Ge4 为面内各向异性；费米能级附近电子结构不适合拓扑磁性研究。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结构稳定的 NbMn6Ge6 为共线反铁磁基态，而亚稳的菱方相 NbMn6Ge5 和 NbMn6Ge4 倾向铁磁基态；Mn 原子磁矩近局域化，支持广义自旋哈密顿量的适用性；AFM NbMn6Ge6 与 FM NbMn6Ge5 的磁各向异性为单轴型，FM NbMn6Ge4 为面内各向异性；费米能级附近电子结构不适合拓扑磁性研究。；创新点：系统比较了 NbMn6Ge6、NbMn6Ge5、NbMn6Ge4 三种 Kagome 化合物的磁性基态、电子结构与成键特征，揭示了不同化学计量比与结构稳定性对磁基态和磁各向异性的调控，并明确指出其费米面附近电子结构不适合拓扑磁性研究。摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算。摘要未明确说明具体是否使用 DFT+U、杂化泛函等细节；文中提及通过电荷密度差和电子局域函数（ELF）分析成键特征。

papers.title: Continuum Limit of Nonlocal Electrostatics in Random Media
papers.abstract: We derive a two-scale continuum limit for the electrostatic energy of random charge density fields that are stationary and ergodic under lattice translations. Each microscopic cell is charge neutral in every realization, while its dipole moment may fluctuate and have a nonzero mean. Under assumptions on the stationary microscopic potential and the finite-volume fields, the local and nonlocal energies converge almost surely to deterministic limits. The local limit consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic Coulomb energy and a cell-depolarization term, whereas the effective polarization determines the nonlocal limit. The cell-depolarization terms cancel in the total energy, which consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic cell energy and the macroscopic electrostatic field energy. The deterministic specialization recovers the periodic two-scale limit. For an independent-cell random-displacement model, we verify the assumptions of the continuum-limit theorem and show that centered microscopic fluctuations can change the local energy without changing the effective polarization or the nonlocal energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要以“derive a two-scale continuum limit”“theorem”“assumptions”“verify the assumptions”等理论推导与严格数学论证为主，未涉及实验或数值模拟主导。；研究对象：随机介质中随机电荷密度场的非局域静电学，具体为在晶格平移下平稳且遍历的随机电荷密度场的静电能量连续极限；每个微观胞在每次实现中电荷中性，但偶极矩可涨落且可有非零平均值。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在关于平稳微观势和有限体积场的假设下，局域与非局域能量几乎必然收敛到确定性极限；局域极限由系综平均的微观库仑能和胞退极化项组成，有效极化决定非局域极限；胞退极化项在总能量中相消，总能量由系综平均的微观胞能和宏观静电场能构成。对独立胞随机位移模型，验证了连续极限定理的假设，并表明中心化微观涨落可改变局域能量而不改变有效极化或非局域能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在关于平稳微观势和有限体积场的假设下，局域与非局域能量几乎必然收敛到确定性极限；局域极限由系综平均的微观库仑能和胞退极化项组成，有效极化决定非局域极限；胞退极化项在总能量中相消，总能量由系综平均的微观胞能和宏观静电场能构成。对独立胞随机位移模型，验证了连续极限定理的假设，并表明中心化微观涨落可改变局域能量而不改变有效极化或非局域能量。；创新点：建立了随机介质中非局域静电学的双尺度连续极限理论，给出局域与非局域能量的确定性收敛结果及总能量中胞退极化项相消的结构；确定性特例可恢复周期双尺度极限；并通过独立胞随机位移模型展示中心化微观涨落对局域能量与有效极化/非局域能量的不同影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为双尺度连续极限推导与严格数学分析（几乎必然收敛、确定性极限、定理假设验证）；并针对独立胞随机位移模型进行假设验证。摘要未明确说明使用具体数值计算方法或实验手段。

papers.title: Barrierless Water Dissociation on Rare-Earth Sesquioxide Surfaces from First Principles
papers.abstract: Water dissociation on metal oxide surfaces is a key elementary step in heterogeneous catalysis, photocatalysis, and radiation chemistry, yet its mechanistic details on rare-earth (RE) sesquioxides remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate water dissociation on the (110) surfaces of three cubic bixbyite oxides, Sc$_2$O$_3$, Y$_2$O$_3$, and Lu$_2$O$_3$, using molecular dynamics combining ab initio calculations with on-the-fly machine-learning force field acceleration. By sampling 25 independent trajectories per material, we obtain an unbiased picture of the reaction landscape inaccessible to conventional static calculations. Two distinct dissociation pathways are identified: a conventional proximal mechanism with a small but finite barrier of $\sim$0.1 eV, and a previously unreported distal mechanism that is effectively barrierless and energetically preferred at both the adsorption and dissociation stages. The low barriers are consistent with the periodic array of inherently undercoordinated RE$^{3+}$ sites in the bixbyite lattice, suggesting that ordered intrinsic coordination defects play a role analogous to stochastic oxygen vacancies in conventional oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：first principles、molecular dynamics combining ab initio calculations、on-the-fly machine-learning force field acceleration、sampling 25 independent trajectories。；研究对象：三种立方双钙钛矿（bixbyite）结构稀土倍半氧化物——Sc₂O₃、Y₂O₃、Lu₂O₃的(110)表面上的水分解反应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出两条不同的解离路径：一条是常规的近端机制，具有约0.1 eV的小但有限的势垒；另一条是此前未报道的远端机制，实际上无势垒，且在吸附和解离两个阶段都更具能量优势。低势垒与双钙钛矿晶格中固有的配位不饱和RE³⁺位点周期性阵列一致，表明有序的本征配位缺陷发挥了类似于传统氧化物中随机氧空位的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出两条不同的解离路径：一条是常规的近端机制，具有约0.1 eV的小但有限的势垒；另一条是此前未报道的远端机制，实际上无势垒，且在吸附和解离两个阶段都更具能量优势。低势垒与双钙钛矿晶格中固有的配位不饱和RE³⁺位点周期性阵列一致，表明有序的本征配位缺陷发挥了类似于传统氧化物中随机氧空位的作用。；创新点：首次报道了稀土倍半氧化物表面上一条此前未报道的远端解离机制，该机制实际上无势垒且在能量上优于常规路径；同时提出双钙钛矿晶格中有序的本征配位缺陷可类比传统氧化物中的随机氧空位发挥作用。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学结合从头算（ab initio）计算，并采用在线机器学习力场加速（on-the-fly machine-learning force field acceleration）；每种材料采样25条独立轨迹。

papers.title: Single Dirac Fermions on a Lattice: A Unified View of Chiral and Parity Anomalies in Condensed Matter
papers.abstract: Quantum anomalies are usually formulated in continuum field theory, where regularization may violate a classical symmetry. In a crystal, the compact Brillouin zone and the high-energy bands make that ultraviolet completion physical. This Perspective develops a unified lattice view of chiral and parity anomalies through the problem of realizing a single massless Dirac fermion. The central motif is a finite low-energy region in which the relevant symmetry is restored, embedded in a high-energy sector that breaks the symmetry and completes the lattice theory. In $1+1$ and $3+1$ dimensions, the quantized chiral response is protected by local chiral symmetry near the Fermi surface. In $2+1$ dimensions, the half-integer Hall response belongs to a single massless Dirac band with mirror symmetry, not to a generic massive Dirac insulator that breaks the symmetry explicitly. In both cases the lattice perspective reveals how the low-energy symmetry emerges from the high-energy sector and protects the anomalous and quantized response. Recent experimental progress in quantum materials is discussed in light of this unified view.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（Perspective/综述性理论文章）。判断依据的关键词：Perspective、develops a unified lattice view、continuum field theory、lattice theory 等，摘要中未提及具体实验测量或数值计算细节。；研究对象：晶格上单个无质量狄拉克费米子的实现问题，以及由此统一描述的手性反常（chiral anomaly）和宇称反常（parity anomaly）。涉及 1+1 维、2+1 维和 3+1 维的量子反常现象，并联系到量子材料中的相关实验进展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出一个统一的晶格视角：低能区域中相关对称性恢复，而高能区破坏该对称性并补全晶格理论。在 1+1 和 3+1 维中，量子化的手性响应由费米面附近的局域手性对称性保护；在 2+1 维中，半整数霍尔响应属于具有镜像对称性的单个无质量狄拉克能带，而非显式破缺对称性的一般有质量狄拉克绝缘体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出一个统一的晶格视角：低能区域中相关对称性恢复，而高能区破坏该对称性并补全晶格理论。在 1+1 和 3+1 维中，量子化的手性响应由费米面附近的局域手性对称性保护；在 2+1 维中，半整数霍尔响应属于具有镜像对称性的单个无质量狄拉克能带，而非显式破缺对称性的一般有质量狄拉克绝缘体。；创新点：将手性反常和宇称反常统一在晶格框架下理解，强调低能对称性如何从高能区涌现并保护反常量子化响应；特别指出 2+1 维半整数霍尔响应来源于具有镜像对称性的单个无质量狄拉克能带，而非有质量狄拉克绝缘体。摘要未明确说明与已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于晶格场论的统一视角，结合连续场论中量子反常的正规化问题，分析紧致布里渊区和高能能带对紫外完备化的物理意义。摘要未明确说明是否使用具体计算方法（如 DFT、DMRG 等）。

papers.title: First Principles Thermodynamics of Zr B Segregation at Grain Boundaries in Recycled Nd2Fe14B
papers.abstract: Grain-boundary chemistry is central to the coercivity and thermal stability of Nd2Fe14B permanent magnets, particularly in recycled magnets where recovery of the hard-magnetic phase does not by itself restore the intergranular microstructure. Our recent experimental study showed that nanoscale ZrB2 precipitates can emerge at grain boundaries and triple junctions during recycling despite an overall Zr concentration of only about 0.1 at.%, where they are associated with boundary stabilization and suppression of grain coarsening. Here we use spin-polarized density-functional theory with a Hubbard correction (DFT+U) to determine the atomistic thermodynamics underlying this preferential localization. A systematic set of composition-matched bulk/grain-boundary DFT+U supercells provides a common correlated-electron description across boundary chemistries. We compare B, Zr, Dy, and ZrB2-like local configurations in bulk and grain-boundary environments of Nd2Fe14B. Excess B is strongly stabilized at the boundary, while Zr also shows an independent thermodynamic preference for the interfacial region. When Zr and B are combined in a ZrB2-like configuration, the boundary preference is retained, indicating that the interface remains favorable as Zr-B coordination develops. These results establish a thermodynamic pathway for the co-localization of Zr and B prior to ZrB2 formation. Magnetic-state analysis further shows that all compared structures remain within the same high-moment Fe-sublattice regime, and boundary-localized defects generally perturb the normalized magnetization less than their matrix counterparts. The calculations therefore provide a first-principles explanation for why Zr-B chemistry concentrates at intergranular regions and how such boundary-localized states can support the microstructural stability required for high-coercivity recycled Nd-Fe-B magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：spin-polarized density-functional theory with a Hubbard correction (DFT+U)、composition-matched bulk/grain-boundary DFT+U supercells、first-principles explanation。摘要中虽提及“our recent experimental study”作为背景动机，但本文工作本身为第一性原理计算。；研究对象：回收 Nd2Fe14B 永磁体中晶界处的 Zr-B 偏析行为，具体比较 B、Zr、Dy 以及类 ZrB2 局域构型在 Nd2Fe14B 体相与晶界环境中的热力学稳定性，以及相关的磁性状态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过量 B 在晶界处被强烈稳定，Zr 也独立地表现出对界面区域的热力学偏好；当 Zr 与 B 以类 ZrB2 构型组合时，晶界偏好仍然保留，从而确立了 Zr 与 B 在形成 ZrB2 之前共同局域化于晶界的热力学路径。磁性分析表明所有比较结构均处于同一高磁矩 Fe 亚晶格区间，且晶界局域缺陷对归一化磁化的扰动通常小于其在基体中的对应结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过量 B 在晶界处被强烈稳定，Zr 也独立地表现出对界面区域的热力学偏好；当 Zr 与 B 以类 ZrB2 构型组合时，晶界偏好仍然保留，从而确立了 Zr 与 B 在形成 ZrB2 之前共同局域化于晶界的热力学路径。磁性分析表明所有比较结构均处于同一高磁矩 Fe 亚晶格区间，且晶界局域缺陷对归一化磁化的扰动通常小于其在基体中的对应结构。；创新点：从第一性原理层面给出了 Zr-B 化学为何在晶间区域富集的热力学解释，揭示了 Zr 和 B 在形成 ZrB2 之前先共同局域于晶界的热力学路径，并表明晶界局域缺陷对磁化的扰动通常小于基体对应结构，为高矫顽力回收 Nd-Fe-B 磁体所需的微观结构稳定性提供了理论支持。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化密度泛函理论结合 Hubbard 修正（DFT+U）；构建组成匹配的体相/晶界 DFT+U 超胞，以在不同晶界化学环境下提供统一的关联电子描述；比较 B、Zr、Dy 和类 ZrB2 局域构型在体相与晶界环境中的行为；并进行磁性状态分析。

papers.title: Chemical and interface confinement effects in promoting plastic co-deformation in high-strength nano-scale eutectics
papers.abstract: Eutectics offer a route to overcome plastic incompatibility in disparate-phase heterostructures by coupling microstructural refinement with phase-specific chemical and crystallographic hierarchy. Here, we investigate laser-rapid-solidified Al-(Si,Ge) eutectic composites designed along the univariant ternary eutectic path, solidifying with an Al-rich face-centered cubic (fcc) matrix and (Si,Ge)-rich diamond-cubic (dc) fibers as constituent eutectic phases with faceted interfaces. The microstructure was hierarchical in nature with finer structures within eutectic phases: nanoscale (Si,Ge) clusters in the Al phase and growth twins within the (Si,Ge) fibers with some Al retention. Although increasing Ge content coarsens the eutectic spacing, the yield strength is slightly enhanced compared to the relatively finer Al-Si, and tensile ductility of Al-(Si,Ge) is higher than that of Al-Si. In situ SEM micromechanical testing combined with post-mortem STEM and TEM showed that in the Al-rich phase, Ge segregated to the deformation-induced sub-grain boundaries that confined glide dislocations. Simultaneously, the (Si,Ge)-rich fibers remain crack-resistant at large plastic strain and exhibit deformation-induced planar faults, consistent with localized partial-dislocation activity at highly stressed interfaces and twin boundaries. These coupled mechanisms due to interface confinement and hard phase chemistry enable co-deformation of the metallic and covalent phases, providing a pathway for designing high-tensile-strength and ductile hierarchical eutectics beyond conventional length-scale-controlled strengthening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：论文使用激光快速凝固制备样品，并结合原位 SEM 微力学测试、post-mortem STEM 和 TEM 表征，属于以实验为主的研究。；研究对象：沿单变量三元共晶路径设计的激光快速凝固 Al-(Si,Ge) 共晶复合材料。其凝固组织为富 Al 的面心立方（fcc）基体与富 (Si,Ge) 的金刚石立方（dc）纤维相，具有小平面界面；同时存在层级结构，包括 Al 相中的纳米尺度 (Si,Ge) 团簇，以及 (Si,Ge) 纤维中的生长孪晶并伴随部分 Al 保留。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增加 Ge 含量虽然会粗化共晶间距，但相比更细的 Al-Si，Al-(Si,Ge) 的屈服强度略有提高，且拉伸延性更高。其原因是界面约束与硬相化学共同作用：Ge 偏聚到 Al 相中变形诱导的亚晶界并限制滑移位错，同时富 (Si,Ge) 纤维在大塑性应变下抗开裂，并出现变形诱导的平面缺陷，表明高应力界面和孪晶界处存在局域部分位错活动，从而促进金属相与共价相协同变形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增加 Ge 含量虽然会粗化共晶间距，但相比更细的 Al-Si，Al-(Si,Ge) 的屈服强度略有提高，且拉伸延性更高。其原因是界面约束与硬相化学共同作用：Ge 偏聚到 Al 相中变形诱导的亚晶界并限制滑移位错，同时富 (Si,Ge) 纤维在大塑性应变下抗开裂，并出现变形诱导的平面缺陷，表明高应力界面和孪晶界处存在局域部分位错活动，从而促进金属相与共价相协同变形。；创新点：该工作展示了通过界面约束效应和硬相化学效应，而非仅依赖传统长度尺度控制强化，来实现高强度层级共晶中金属相与共价相的塑性协同变形。其新意在于将 Ge 合金化、纳米团簇、生长孪晶、界面约束和局域部分位错活动耦合起来，为设计高拉伸强度且具延性的层级共晶材料提供路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用激光快速凝固制备 Al-(Si,Ge) 共晶复合材料；使用原位 SEM 微力学测试研究变形行为；结合 post-mortem STEM 和 TEM 进行微观结构表征，包括变形诱导亚晶界、Ge 偏聚、纤维中的平面缺陷等分析。摘要未明确说明是否使用计算或理论模拟方法。

papers.title: Exploring causal relationships in elastomeric fracture
papers.abstract: The conventional interpretation of elastomeric fracture treats the tearing energy G as an output determined by tear speed, taken to equal crack velocity vc, concluding that higher vc produced greater viscoelastic dissipation to increase G. Based on spatially and temporally resolved polarized optical microscopic (str-POM) measurements of tip stress tip stress, we use prenotched pure shear experiments to clarify the causality: Local crack-tip stress determines the network lifetime, making vc the passive kinetic output. In the elastic limit that can be readily achieved for a well crosslinked elastomer in a wide range of temperatures, Rivlin-Thomas scaling holds, and vc depends only on the applied strain, independent of stretch rate, indicating one-to-one correspondence between vc and tip stress. In a highly stretchable elastomer made with reduced crosslink density, vc no longer correlates well with the far-field load as rate-dependent viscoelastic processes emerge to affect network lifetime. Because of the rheological effects on how chain tension builds in the elastomeric network, vc is higher at a common nominal strain when it is imposed with higher stretch rate. confirm that different stretch rates produce different levels of tip stress. The same tip stress still produces the same vc. With str-POM measurements we are also able to elucidate the nature of temperature dependence: at a given tip stress,, crack growth is slower at lower temperatures; conversely it requires higher tip stress to produce the same vc at lower temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要明确提到基于空间和时间分辨的偏振光学显微镜（str-POM）测量，以及预切口纯剪切（pure shear）实验，属于实验测量与机理分析结合的工作。；研究对象：弹性体（elastomer）的断裂行为，具体为预切口纯剪切试样中裂纹尖端应力与裂纹扩展速度之间的关系，涉及两种弹性体：一种为良好交联的弹性体（在弹性极限内），另一种为降低交联密度的高可拉伸弹性体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局部裂纹尖端应力决定网络寿命，裂纹速度 vc 是被动的动力学输出，而非传统认为的由撕裂能 G 作为输出、vc 作为原因的关系；在弹性极限内 vc 仅依赖于施加应变而与拉伸速率无关，且相同尖端应力始终产生相同 vc，温度降低时裂纹扩展更慢、需要更高尖端应力才能达到相同 vc。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局部裂纹尖端应力决定网络寿命，裂纹速度 vc 是被动的动力学输出，而非传统认为的由撕裂能 G 作为输出、vc 作为原因的关系；在弹性极限内 vc 仅依赖于施加应变而与拉伸速率无关，且相同尖端应力始终产生相同 vc，温度降低时裂纹扩展更慢、需要更高尖端应力才能达到相同 vc。；创新点：澄清了弹性体断裂中撕裂能 G 与裂纹速度 vc 之间的因果方向：传统观点认为 vc 是因、G 是果，本文通过直接测量尖端应力表明尖端应力才是决定网络寿命的关键因素，vc 是被动输出；并进一步揭示了温度依赖性的本质以及拉伸速率通过影响链张力建立方式（流变效应）来影响 vc 的机制。
papers.method_zh: 空间和时间分辨的偏振光学显微镜（str-POM）测量裂纹尖端应力；预切口纯剪切（pure shear）实验；在不同温度和不同拉伸速率下进行测量；采用 Rivlin-Thomas 标度分析。

papers.title: Magnetization processes and spin dynamics across field-induced phase transitions in the quasi-two-dimensional quantum magnet Cu$_2$(OH)$_3$Br
papers.abstract: We present magnetic-field-dependent evolution of magnetization and spin dynamics in the quasi-two-dimensional spin-$1/2$ magnet $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_3Br}$, consisting of alternately coupled ferromagnetic Cu1 and antiferromagnetic Cu2 spin chains. Terahertz spectroscopy reveals a pronounced field-direction dependence of the low-energy magnetic excitation spectrum. For magnetic fields applied perpendicular to the spin chains, $B\parallel a$ and $B\parallel c^*$, the spectra undergo abrupt reconstructions at the spin-flop transitions identified independently by high-field magnetization measurements. For $B\parallel b$, by contrast, no spin-flop occurs; instead, the excitation spectrum evolves continuously with field and exhibits a strong terahertz radiation polarization dependence as the ferromagnetic Cu1 subsystem becomes progressively polarized. At higher fields, the complex low-field spectrum is replaced by a reduced set of broad excitations, consistent with a weakening of the coupling between the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic chain subsystems. Complementary Raman spectroscopy resolves magnon and spinon excitations alongside several phonon modes and traces the characteristic temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent evolution of the magnetic excitations. The combined spectroscopic and magnetization results map out how a magnetic field reorganizes the coupled ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic subsystems in $\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_3Br}$ across field-induced phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“Terahertz spectroscopy reveals”“high-field magnetization measurements”“Complementary Raman spectroscopy resolves”等表述，说明工作以实验测量为主，未提及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：准二维自旋-1/2量子磁体 Cu₂(OH)₃Br，其由交替耦合的铁磁 Cu1 自旋链和反铁磁 Cu2 自旋链构成；研究其在磁场诱导相变过程中的磁化过程与自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料的低能磁激发谱对磁场方向有显著依赖：当磁场垂直于自旋链（B∥a 和 B∥c*）时，谱在自旋翻转转变处发生突然重构；而当 B∥b 时不自旋翻转，激发谱随磁场连续演化，并随铁磁 Cu1 子系统逐渐极化而表现出强烈的太赫兹辐射偏振依赖。在高场下，复杂的低场谱被一组减少的宽激发所取代，与铁磁和反铁磁链子系统之间耦合减弱相一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料的低能磁激发谱对磁场方向有显著依赖：当磁场垂直于自旋链（B∥a 和 B∥c*）时，谱在自旋翻转转变处发生突然重构；而当 B∥b 时不自旋翻转，激发谱随磁场连续演化，并随铁磁 Cu1 子系统逐渐极化而表现出强烈的太赫兹辐射偏振依赖。在高场下，复杂的低场谱被一组减少的宽激发所取代，与铁磁和反铁磁链子系统之间耦合减弱相一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹光谱、高场磁化测量、拉曼光谱。拉曼光谱分辨了磁振子和自旋子激发以及若干声子模式，并追踪了磁激发随温度和磁场的变化。

papers.title: Effect of non-homogeneous non-magnetic Impurities in Superconductors: A comparison between Microscopic and Macroscopic theories
papers.abstract: Non-homogeneous, non-magnetic impurities in superconductivity have recently gained traction as a promising approach to reduce surface resistance and increase the superheating field. We aim to deepen the understanding of impurities' role from a theoretical perspective by utilizing Eilenberger's equation, and to investigate the validity of a more phenomenological approach based on London's equation for determining the magnetic field profile within the superconductor. We show that the microscopic and macroscopic theories produce identical electromagnetic field distributions for any spatial distributions of impurities inside the superconductors. However, the two approaches provide different magnetic field-related quantities. The macroscopic model only gives the Bean-Livingston barrier, while the microscopic theory provides the experimentally-relevant superheating field. Based on the microscopic formalism, we determine a family of impurity profiles that make the superheating field $H_{\rm{sh}}$ equal to the critical field $H_c$, which is the maximum achievable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：使用 Eilenberger 方程和 London 方程进行理论推导与比较，无实验或数值计算细节描述。；研究对象：超导体中非均匀、非磁性杂质对电磁场分布及磁场相关物理量的影响，具体涉及表面电阻、过热场、Bean-Livingston 势垒和临界场等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微观理论（Eilenberger 方程）与宏观理论（London 方程）对任意杂质空间分布给出完全相同的电磁场分布，但两者给出的磁场相关物理量不同：宏观模型仅给出 Bean-Livingston 势垒，而微观理论才能给出实验相关的过热场；基于微观形式，确定了一类使过热场 \(H_{\rm{sh}}\) 等于临界场 \(H_c\)（可达到的最大值）的杂质分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微观理论（Eilenberger 方程）与宏观理论（London 方程）对任意杂质空间分布给出完全相同的电磁场分布，但两者给出的磁场相关物理量不同：宏观模型仅给出 Bean-Livingston 势垒，而微观理论才能给出实验相关的过热场；基于微观形式，确定了一类使过热场 \(H_{\rm{sh}}\) 等于临界场 \(H_c\)（可达到的最大值）的杂质分布。；创新点：首次系统比较了微观与宏观理论在非均匀非磁性杂质超导体中的适用性，明确了两种理论在电磁场分布上一致但在磁场相关物理量上的差异，并基于微观理论确定了一类可实现 \(H_{\rm{sh}} = H_c\) 最大值的杂质分布。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Eilenberger 方程（微观理论框架）和 London 方程（宏观唯象框架）进行理论分析与比较。

papers.title: Purely Electric-Field Control of Topological Magnetism in Two-Dimensional Magnets
papers.abstract: Electrical control of topological magnetism is central to realizing energy-efficient topological spintronics. Yet most electric-field approaches modify the competing magnetic interactions through a nonselective rearrangement of low-energy electronic states, yielding coarse magnetic phase control that often requires external magnetic fields to stabilize topological quasiparticles, while few schemes solely based on electric fields are restricted to specific conducting materials. Here, we establish a general approach for purely electric-field control of topological magnetism, in which an applied electric field electrostatically dopes a selected orbital-angular-momentum-polarized band edge of a two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnetic semiconductor via proximity to an adjacent nonmagnetic vdW metal. We show that the resulting electrostatic doping predominantly tunes magnetic anisotropy of the 2D magnet, while leaving exchange interaction and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction nearly unchanged, thereby reversibly driving the system through ferromagnetic, skyrmion, spiral, and bimeron phases. We demonstrate this mechanism for CrBr3/graphene and Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2 vdW heterostructures hosting electron and hole pockets of different orbital characters. These results establish a broadly applicable strategy for purely electric-field control in topological spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（摘要中未提及具体实验手段，主要通过机制提出与异质结构演示来建立方案；关键词如“establish a general approach”“We show that”“We demonstrate this mechanism”偏向理论与计算建模）。；研究对象：二维范德华磁性半导体与相邻非磁性范德华金属构成的异质结中的拓扑磁性，具体示例为 CrBr3/graphene 和 Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2 异质结构；研究现象包括电场调控下的铁磁、skyrmion、spiral 和 bimeron 相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过邻近非磁性范德华金属对二维磁性半导体中选定轨道角动量极化带边进行静电掺杂，可以主要调控磁各向异性，而交换相互作用和 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用几乎不变，从而仅靠电场可逆地驱动体系在铁磁、skyrmion、spiral 和 bimeron 相之间转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过邻近非磁性范德华金属对二维磁性半导体中选定轨道角动量极化带边进行静电掺杂，可以主要调控磁各向异性，而交换相互作用和 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用几乎不变，从而仅靠电场可逆地驱动体系在铁磁、skyrmion、spiral 和 bimeron 相之间转变。；创新点：提出一种纯电场控制拓扑磁性的通用策略：不是非选择性地重排低能电子态来粗调磁相互作用，而是通过邻近非磁性 vdW 金属对二维磁性半导体中选定轨道角动量极化带边进行静电掺杂，从而主要调节磁各向异性并保持交换相互作用与 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用近乎不变；该方案不依赖特定导电材料，也无需外磁场稳定拓扑准粒子。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段、计算方法或理论框架（如 DFT+U、DMRG、ARPES、分子束外延等均未提及）；仅说明提出了一种通过邻近非磁性 vdW 金属进行静电掺杂、调控选定轨道角动量极化带边的通用机制，并在 CrBr3/graphene 与 Cr2Ge2Te6/TaS2 异质结构中演示该机制。

papers.title: Zonal dislocations in Laves phases: A coupled synchro-shear slip mechanism
papers.abstract: Synchro-shear is the primary plastic deformation mechanism in Laves phases at elevated temperatures, mediated by synchro-Shockley partial dislocations-zonal dislocations that proceed via localized events such as kink-pair nucleation and propagation. Using atomistic simulations, we identified a novel slip mechanism in Laves phases, namely coupled synchro-shear slip, involving the synchronized glide of two synchro-Shockley partial dislocations on adjacent slip planes, leading to the formation of extrinsic stacking faults. High-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy revealed the extended core structures consistent with coupled synchro-Shockley partial dislocations bounded by extrinsic stacking faults in C15 NbCr2 and their involvement in twinning. These results highlight the critical role of coupled synchro-shear slip in enabling phase transformations between Laves polytypes and in governing twinning behavior, providing new atomistic insight into the kinetic nature of plasticity in topologically close-packed intermetallic phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据关键词：atomistic simulations（原子尺度模拟）、high-resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy（高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜）。；研究对象：Laves 相金属间化合物中的塑性变形机制，具体涉及 C15 NbCr₂ 中的同步剪切（synchro-shear）滑移、带状位错（zonal dislocations）以及孪晶行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新的滑移机制——耦合同步剪切滑移（coupled synchro-shear slip），即两个同步 Shockley 分位错在相邻滑移面上同步滑移，导致外禀层错（extrinsic stacking faults）的形成；该机制在 Laves 多型体之间的相变和孪晶行为中起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新的滑移机制——耦合同步剪切滑移（coupled synchro-shear slip），即两个同步 Shockley 分位错在相邻滑移面上同步滑移，导致外禀层错（extrinsic stacking faults）的形成；该机制在 Laves 多型体之间的相变和孪晶行为中起关键作用。；创新点：首次提出并证实了"耦合同步剪切滑移"这一新滑移机制，揭示了两个同步 Shockley 分位错在相邻滑移面上协同滑移形成外禀层错的过程，并阐明了其在 Laves 多型体相变和孪晶行为中的关键作用，为拓扑密堆金属间化合物的塑性动力学本质提供了新的原子尺度认识。
papers.method_zh: 原子尺度模拟（atomistic simulations）结合高分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（HR-STEM）表征。摘要未明确说明模拟的具体方法（如分子动力学、DFT 等）及实验的具体样品制备细节。

papers.title: A Transport Framework for Evaluating Nanoscale Interconnect Materials
papers.abstract: As CMOS technology continues to scale, metallic interconnects increasingly limit circuit performance through rising resistivity, self-heating, and reliability degradation. Although several alternative metals have been proposed, a quantitative framework for evaluating their transport performance under nanoscale confinement remains unavailable. Here, we establish a transport framework by combining independently measured thermal and electrical conductivities with normalized and unnormalized transport figures of merit. We apply this framework to Cu, Ru, W, Co, Ir, and Mo thin films using new steady-state thermoreflectance measurements of Mo, Co, and Ir together with previously reported Cu, Ru, and W data. While Cu exhibits the highest intrinsic transport performance, its effective performance is substantially reduced by thickness scaling and Ta liner resistance. In contrast, Ru and Mo maintain favorable transport properties while enabling barrierless integration, identifying them as promising candidates for next-generation CMOS interconnects
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，结合框架构建与数据分析）。判断依据关键词：new steady-state thermoreflectance measurements（新稳态热反射测量）、combining independently measured thermal and electrical conductivities（结合独立测量的热导率和电导率）、previously reported Cu, Ru, and W data（引用已有数据）、establish a transport framework（建立输运框架）。；研究对象：纳米尺度互连材料，具体为 Cu、Ru、W、Co、Ir、Mo 六种金属薄膜，研究其在纳米尺度受限条件下的电学与热学输运性能，以及作为 CMOS 互连材料的适用性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cu 具有最高的本征输运性能，但其有效性能因厚度缩小和 Ta 阻挡层电阻而大幅下降；Ru 和 Mo 在保持良好输运性能的同时可实现无阻挡层集成，是下一代 CMOS 互连的有前景候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cu 具有最高的本征输运性能，但其有效性能因厚度缩小和 Ta 阻挡层电阻而大幅下降；Ru 和 Mo 在保持良好输运性能的同时可实现无阻挡层集成，是下一代 CMOS 互连的有前景候选材料。；创新点：首次建立了一个结合独立测量的热导率与电导率、并采用归一化与非归一化输运品质因数的定量输运评估框架，用于在纳米尺度受限条件下系统比较多种互连金属材料的输运性能。
papers.method_zh: 采用稳态热反射（steady-state thermoreflectance）技术新测量了 Mo、Co、Ir 薄膜的热导率，结合独立测量的电导率，并整合此前已报道的 Cu、Ru、W 数据；通过归一化和非归一化的输运品质因数（figures of merit）构建评估框架。

papers.title: Altermagnetism from the viewpoint of chemistry
papers.abstract: Magnetism has been a central theme of research in chemistry, physics, and materials science, with chemical composition and bonding playing key roles in determining magnetic behavior. Altermagnets are a newly identified class of magnetic materials that combine features of conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets, arising from specific symmetry and electronic structure motifs. In this review, we present a chemistry-driven viewpoint on altermagnetism, highlighting how crystal chemistry, bonding, and electronic structure enable this unconventional magnetic order. We begin by introducing the fundamental concepts required to understand altermagnets, with an emphasis on symmetry considerations, orbital character, and electronic structure signatures. We then survey the diverse material families in which altermagnetism has been identified, drawing attention to coordination environments and structure-property relationships that favor altermagnetic order. We subsequently present experimental approaches which are useful for the characterization of altermagnetic materials. We examine ab initio materials discovery as a promising strategy for identifying new altermagnets, emphasizing how chemical constraints, such as symmetry and bonding, can guide computational searches. Other than their intrinsic importance, altermagnets provide interesting possibilities for technology. For this reason, we highlight possible applications that may be enabled through altermagnetic materials, along with their coupling with existing orders such as ferroelectricity and superconductivity. In conclusion, we point out some challenges and prospects, where chemically-based design guidelines can play an important role towards advancing altermagnetism research. In summary, this review offers an account of recent developments in altermagnetism, from basic concepts to the current state-of-the-art.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。判断依据的关键词：标题中的“viewpoint”、摘要中的“In this review”“we present”“we survey”“we examine”“we highlight”“In conclusion, we point out some challenges and prospects”。；研究对象：交替磁性（altermagnetism）这一新型磁性有序类型，以及已发现交替磁性的多种材料家族；关注其晶体化学、成键、电子结构、配位环境与结构-性质关系，并涉及与铁电性、超导性等已有有序态的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交替磁体是一类新识别的磁性材料，兼具传统铁磁体与反铁磁体的特征，源于特定的对称性和电子结构基元；从化学驱动的视角看，晶体化学、成键和电子结构能够促成这种非常规磁有序，且化学约束（如对称性和成键）可指导从头计算材料搜索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交替磁体是一类新识别的磁性材料，兼具传统铁磁体与反铁磁体的特征，源于特定的对称性和电子结构基元；从化学驱动的视角看，晶体化学、成键和电子结构能够促成这种非常规磁有序，且化学约束（如对称性和成键）可指导从头计算材料搜索。；创新点：从化学驱动的新视角综述交替磁性，强调晶体化学、成键和电子结构如何促成交替磁有序，突出配位环境和结构-性质关系，并强调化学约束可指导计算搜索，同时指出基于化学的设计准则对推进交替磁性研究的重要作用。
papers.method_zh: 综述性总结，涉及对称性分析、轨道特征和电子结构特征等基本概念；调查已发现交替磁性的材料家族及其配位环境和结构-性质关系；介绍用于表征交替磁体的实验方法；讨论从头计算材料发现策略。摘要未明确说明具体使用了哪些实验手段或计算框架（如 DFT+U、ARPES 等）。

papers.title: Nanothermodynamics: stable thermal equilibrium and nanoscale fluctuations
papers.abstract: Nanothermodynamics describes the process where large systems subdivide into equilibrium distributions of small subsystems. A key ingredient is Hill's subdivision potential (E) that ensures adherence to the 1st and 2nd laws of thermodynamics in systems of any size. In this review and reassessment, it is emphasized that nanothermodynamics gives new insight into many measurements, theories, and simulations. Measurements establishing the need for nanothermodynamics show thermodynamic heterogeneity from multiple effective temperatures (T_i) inside most types of materials. One theoretical result that requires E=0 is the stable solution of Ising's original model for finite chains of interacting spins, a solution Ising could not have found 40 years before Hill's work. Another result is a novel solution to Gibbs' paradox that makes the entropy of the semiclassical ideal gas exactly extensive. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal how a standard fluctuation relation is modified when local degrees of freedom fluctuate faster than their coupling to the heat bath, consistent with the measured thermodynamic heterogeneity. Simulations of a Creutz-like model, comprised of Ising spins coupled to an explicit heat bath of Einstein oscillators, are used to study the 2nd law. It is found that maximizing the total entropy (S_t) requires an intrinsically irreversible step, providing a counterexample to the usual claim that statistical mechanics emerges from reversible dynamics. Furthermore, fluctuations of this model are best described by Einstein's reversal of Boltzmann's relation and the 2nd-law, not by recent fluctuation theorems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章（含计算模拟）。判断依据关键词：review and reassessment、theoretical result、molecular dynamics simulations、simulations of a Creutz-like model。摘要以理论框架（nanothermodynamics、Hill's subdivision potential）和模拟为主，未提及具体实验测量手段，但引用了已有测量结果作为论据。；研究对象：纳米热力学（nanothermodynamics）框架本身，具体涉及：大系统细分为小平衡子系统的过程、Hill细分势（E）、有限自旋链Ising模型、半经典理想气体的Gibbs佯谬、分子动力学中的涨落关系、以及由Ising自旋与Einstein振子热浴耦合构成的Creutz-like模型中的第二定律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米热力学中的Hill细分势E对于正确描述任意尺寸系统的热力学定律至关重要；E=0是有限自旋链Ising模型稳定解的必要条件；该框架还给出了使半经典理想气体熵严格广延的Gibbs佯谬新解；Creutz-like模型模拟表明最大化总熵需要一个内在不可逆步骤，构成对"统计力学源于可逆动力学"这一通常主张的反例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米热力学中的Hill细分势E对于正确描述任意尺寸系统的热力学定律至关重要；E=0是有限自旋链Ising模型稳定解的必要条件；该框架还给出了使半经典理想气体熵严格广延的Gibbs佯谬新解；Creutz-like模型模拟表明最大化总熵需要一个内在不可逆步骤，构成对"统计力学源于可逆动力学"这一通常主张的反例。；创新点：强调纳米热力学为大量测量、理论和模拟提供新见解；指出E=0是Ising有限链稳定解的要求（Ising本人早于Hill 40年未能找到）；给出使半经典理想气体熵严格广延的Gibbs佯谬新解；揭示分子动力学中标准涨落关系在特定条件下的修正；通过Creutz-like模型模拟发现最大化总熵需要内在不可逆步骤，挑战了统计力学可从可逆动力学涌现的传统观点，并指出该模型的涨落更适合用Einstein对Boltzmann关系和第二定律的逆转来描述，而非近期涨落定理。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Hill的纳米热力学（含细分势E）；具体工作包括：对有限自旋链Ising模型的理论求解、对Gibbs佯谬的理论分析、分子动力学模拟（研究局域自由度涨落快于其与热浴耦合时标准涨落关系的修正）、以及对Creutz-like模型（Ising自旋耦合到Einstein振子显式热浴）的模拟研究。

papers.title: Coupled self-charging and self-propulsion of evaporating sessile droplets
papers.abstract: Evaporating sessile water droplets universally deposit surface charges while simultaneously becoming self-charged---a phenomenon that remains under-appreciated despite its potentially important consequences. Here, we investigate one such consequence: droplet self-propulsion driven by self-charging. This self-propulsion arises spontaneously in the absence of external stimuli and produces self-avoiding trajectories that can displace droplets by many times their own diameter. Our results have important practical implications for processes requiring spatial precision, such as inkjet printing. The coupling between self-charging and self-propulsion produces mosaic surface charge patterns characterized by alternating polarities, which we explain with a physical model based on properties of the electric double layer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论建模）。判断依据的关键词：蒸发液滴、自充电、自推进、自回避轨迹、表面电荷图案、基于双电层性质的物理模型。摘要以实验观察到的现象为主，并辅以物理模型解释。；研究对象：蒸发中的固着水滴（evaporating sessile water droplets）体系，具体研究其自充电（self-charging）与自推进（self-propulsion）耦合的物理现象，以及由此产生的表面电荷图案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蒸发中的固着水滴会自发自充电，并由此驱动液滴自推进，产生自回避轨迹，可使液滴位移达到自身直径的多倍；自充电与自推进的耦合还会产生极性交替的马赛克状表面电荷图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蒸发中的固着水滴会自发自充电，并由此驱动液滴自推进，产生自回避轨迹，可使液滴位移达到自身直径的多倍；自充电与自推进的耦合还会产生极性交替的马赛克状表面电荷图案。；创新点：揭示了蒸发固着液滴自充电所导致的一个此前未被充分认识的重要后果——自推进，且该自推进无需外部刺激即可自发产生，并产生自回避轨迹；同时将自充电与自推进的耦合与马赛克状交替极性表面电荷图案联系起来，并给出基于双电层性质的物理解释。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段、计算方法或理论框架，仅提到用基于双电层（electric double layer）性质的物理模型来解释马赛克表面电荷图案。

papers.title: Multiplicity of surface polariton configurations in bi-isotropic media with anomalous Hall current
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate surface polaritons (SPs) arising at the interface between a simple dielectric and a bi-isotropic medium, in the lossless regime and in the presence of small losses. For the former, non-Dyakonov surface polaritons can arise for positive permittivities and magnetoelectric parameters. General restrictions on the permittivities and bi-isotropic parameter (existence conditions) are derived. For the latter, the effect of small losses is considered, and the characteristic surface plasmon-polariton lengths are discussed. The propagation length can exhibit a local maximum for specific values of the magnetoelectric parameter, an unusual new behavior that can be regarded as a signature of these chiral surface polaritons. Surface waves in an interface involving a bi- isotropic medium with an anomalous Hall effect (AHE) are also examined. Multiple configurations for their occurrence are obtained, revealing a richer scenario with distinct regimes of propagation and coexistence in the parameter space. The presence of a non-null AHE contribution creates a magnetoelectric range for which the surface wave propagation is forbidden, providing an additional signature of surface-polariton propagation in bi-isotropic media with an AHE contribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：investigate、derived（推导存在条件）、examined（考察 AHE 界面表面波），摘要中未出现具体实验测量或数值计算方法的描述，以解析理论分析为主。；研究对象：简单介质与双各向同性介质（bi-isotropic medium）界面上的表面极化激元（surface polaritons, SPs），包括无损情形、含小损耗情形，以及含反常霍尔效应（AHE）贡献的双各向同性介质界面上的表面波。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正介电常数和正磁电参数下可出现非 Dyakonov 型表面极化激元，并给出了介电常数与双各向同性参数的存在条件限制；含小损耗时传播长度可在特定磁电参数值处出现局部极大，被视为这类手性表面极化激元的特征；引入非零 AHE 贡献后，表面波存在多种传播配置与共存区域，并出现表面波传播被禁止的磁电参数区间，可作为含 AHE 双各向同性介质中表面极化激元传播的额外特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正介电常数和正磁电参数下可出现非 Dyakonov 型表面极化激元，并给出了介电常数与双各向同性参数的存在条件限制；含小损耗时传播长度可在特定磁电参数值处出现局部极大，被视为这类手性表面极化激元的特征；引入非零 AHE 贡献后，表面波存在多种传播配置与共存区域，并出现表面波传播被禁止的磁电参数区间，可作为含 AHE 双各向同性介质中表面极化激元传播的额外特征。；创新点：揭示了双各向同性介质界面表面极化激元的多重配置：正介电常数与正磁电参数下非 Dyakonov 型 SPs 的出现及其存在条件；小损耗下传播长度随磁电参数出现局部极大的新行为；以及含 AHE 贡献时更丰富的传播与共存相图，并发现 AHE 导致的表面波传播禁戒磁电区间。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段或计算方法；从摘要内容看，采用理论框架进行解析研究，包括推导介电常数与双各向同性参数的存在条件（existence conditions）、分析无损与小损耗两种情形下的表面极化激元，并讨论特征表面等离激元-极化激元长度（characteristic surface plasmon-polariton lengths）。

papers.title: Momentum-Resolved Electronic Structure for Quasicrystals: Full-Band Spectra and Chern Number
papers.abstract: Quasicrystals lack the translational symmetry that underlies Bloch decomposition and Brillouin-zone integration, making full-band momentum-resolved electronic structure difficult to formulate and compute. We develop a systematically convergent reciprocal-space tight-binding framework for a broad class of quasicrystals. The method combines two systematically refinable components: a Fourier-module scattering-channel Hamiltonian that yields local spectral and current-current correlation quantities at each physical momentum, and an expanding hierarchy of pseudo-Brillouin zones that converts the resulting local quantities into bulk thermodynamic observables through an exact local-to-global relation. Applied to the Penrose and Ammann-Beenker models, the framework uncovers full-band momentum-resolved quasibands and a multichannel mechanism for pseudogap formation, both beyond the scope of low-energy effective models. It further resolves Zeeman-driven gap closings and reopenings, quantized Chern plateaus, and the phason invariance of bulk spectral and topological observables. This framework provides a unified reciprocal-space route to full-band spectral and topological properties of quasicrystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键依据：摘要中提出“reciprocal-space tight-binding framework”（倒空间紧束缚框架），并应用于 Penrose 和 Ammann-Beenker 模型进行计算，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：准晶（quasicrystals）体系，具体包括 Penrose 模型和 Ammann-Beenker 模型；研究其动量分辨的全能带电子结构、赝能隙形成机制以及拓扑性质（Chern 数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架揭示了准晶中全能带动量分辨的准能带（quasibands）和多通道赝能隙形成机制，并解析了 Zeeman 驱动的能隙闭合与重开、量子化 Chern 平台以及体态谱学和拓扑可观测量对 phason 的不变性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架揭示了准晶中全能带动量分辨的准能带（quasibands）和多通道赝能隙形成机制，并解析了 Zeeman 驱动的能隙闭合与重开、量子化 Chern 平台以及体态谱学和拓扑可观测量对 phason 的不变性。；创新点：首次为准晶建立了统一的倒空间路径来获取全能带谱学和拓扑性质；所揭示的全能带动量分辨准能带和多通道赝能隙形成机制超出了低能有效模型的范围；同时解析了 Zeeman 驱动能隙闭合/重开、量子化 Chern 平台及 phason 不变性等此前难以系统处理的物理现象。
papers.method_zh: 发展了系统收敛的倒空间紧束缚框架，包含两个可系统精化的组成部分：(1) Fourier-module scattering-channel Hamiltonian，用于在每一物理动量处给出局域谱学和电流-电流关联量；(2) 扩展的赝布里渊区层级（pseudo-Brillouin zones），通过精确的局域到全局关系将局域量转换为体态热力学可观测量。

papers.title: One-dimensional quasicrystals with tensor-network finite-state automata
papers.abstract: Quasicrystals occupy a distinctive position between the translational order of crystals and the disordered amorphous matter. Simulating this physics has remained challenging, since quasiperiodic structures lack the translational symmetry exploited for crystals and generally require costly diagonalization of large finite approximants. Quasicrystalline order admits two equivalent descriptions, a cut-and-project scheme from a higher-dimensional periodic crystal, and a discrete set of substitution rules acting on a finite alphabet. We show that the latter, written in a numeration system adapted to the substitution, defines a deterministic finite automaton with output, the digits of a site index are fed, and the automaton returns the letter occupying that site. We further exploit another equivalence to a different construction, the transition matrices are exactly the tensors of a matrix product state, whose bond dimension is the number of automaton states and is independent of system size. This allows efficient representation of extremely large tight-binding Hamiltonians in the tensor-train language, thereby yielding an exact matrix product operator for the quasicrystal Hamiltonian at any system size. We show how this framework works for two families of one-dimensional quasicrystals, the metallic-mean and $k$-bonacci families and we explicitly construct the Fibonacci, silver-mean, and Tribonacci quasicrystals. By leveraging efficient tensor-network compression and the kernel polynomial method, we compute spectral densities for chains with more than $10^9$ sites and directly resolve the hierarchical structure of the spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键依据：摘要中提出用张量网络有限状态自动机框架表示准晶紧束缚哈密顿量，并利用张量网络压缩与核多项式方法计算谱密度，属于理论框架构建与数值计算，未涉及实验。；研究对象：一维准晶体系，具体包括金属均值（metallic-mean）家族和 k-bonacci 家族，并明确构造了 Fibonacci、银均值（silver-mean）和 Tribonacci 准晶的紧束缚哈密顿量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准晶的替换规则在适配的记数系统下可定义确定性有限自动机，其转移矩阵恰好对应矩阵乘积态的张量，键维等于自动机状态数且与系统尺寸无关；由此可对任意尺寸的准晶哈密顿量给出精确的矩阵乘积算符表示，并计算了超过 10^9 个格点链的谱密度，直接分辨出谱的分层结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准晶的替换规则在适配的记数系统下可定义确定性有限自动机，其转移矩阵恰好对应矩阵乘积态的张量，键维等于自动机状态数且与系统尺寸无关；由此可对任意尺寸的准晶哈密顿量给出精确的矩阵乘积算符表示，并计算了超过 10^9 个格点链的谱密度，直接分辨出谱的分层结构。；创新点：首次将一维准晶的替换规则描述与张量网络有限状态自动机联系起来，证明转移矩阵即矩阵乘积态张量且键维与系统尺寸无关，从而避免了对大有限近似体进行昂贵对角化，实现了对任意尺寸准晶哈密顿量的精确矩阵乘积算符表示，并可在超过 10^9 格点的链上直接解析谱的分层结构。
papers.method_zh: 将准晶的替换规则用适配的记数系统写成带输出的确定性有限自动机；利用其与矩阵乘积态/张量列语言的等价性构造精确矩阵乘积算符；结合高效张量网络压缩与核多项式方法（kernel polynomial method）计算大尺寸链的谱密度。

papers.title: Elucidating Guest-Host Mechanisms in ZIF-L for Tuneable Highly Luminescent 2D Materials
papers.abstract: 3D metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are well known effective hosts for luminescent guests that improve tuneability, photostability and material fabricability. 2D guest@MOF systems, while less explored, offer competitive advantages over 3D guest@MOF systems due to their optical transparency, inter-layer spacing, and vertical thinness. This work examines luminescent organic dyes@ZIF-L to establish the underlying mechanisms of guest incorporation in ZIF-L and demonstrate the advantages of the 2D ZIF-L architecture for the material's functional luminescence. Analysing a case study system, fluorescein@ZIF-L (F@ZIF-L), using nanoscale FTIR, diffraction, and topology mapping, confirmed that fluorescein (F) resided in the ZIF-L framework cavities. Supported by surface energy simulations, the extent of guest incorporation was found to be indicated by a morphological continuum, from the characteristic leaf-shaped ZIF-L to rectangular F@ZIF-L. By modifying synthesis temperature and solvent ratios, the luminescent properties of F@ZIF-L could be rationally tuned in terms of guest loading (% mol) and arrangement (i.e. guest monomer to aggregate ratio). When optimised, F@ZIF-L exhibited tuneable emission chromaticity, 99.7% photoluminescent quantum yield, minimal guest leaching in solution over 12 months, and high photostability. Perylene@ZIF-L exhibited unique white light emitting properties, with CIE coordinates (0.33, 0.34) arising from a combination of yellow alpha-phase excimer and blue monomeric perylene emission. Finally, oriented luminescent thin films of guest@ZIF-L materials were grown on malleable Zn foils, demonstrating an in situ fabrication technique. Together, the work highlights the potential for luminescent dye@ZIF-L systems in developing tuneable and resilient luminescent components of next-generation optoelectronics, sensors, and lighting systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章为主，结合计算模拟。关键判断依据：摘要中使用了“nanoscale FTIR, diffraction, and topology mapping”等实验表征手段，以及“surface energy simulations”计算支持，整体以实验合成与表征为核心，辅以模拟验证。；研究对象：二维金属-有机框架 ZIF-L 作为主体材料，封装发光有机染料客体（荧光素 fluorescein 和苝 perylene），形成 guest@ZIF-L 体系，研究其客体-主体相互作用机制及可调发光性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 荧光素（F）位于 ZIF-L 框架空腔内，客体掺入程度可通过形貌连续变化（从叶形 ZIF-L 到矩形 F@ZIF-L）来指示；通过调控合成温度和溶剂比例可理性调节客体的负载量和排列方式（单体/聚集体比例），优化后的 F@ZIF-L 实现了 99.7% 的光致发光量子产率、可调发射色度、12 个月内极低的客体泄漏和高光稳定性；苝@ZIF-L 则展现出独特的白光发射（CIE 坐标 0.33, 0.34），来源于黄色 α 相激基缔合物与蓝色单体苝发射的组合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：荧光素（F）位于 ZIF-L 框架空腔内，客体掺入程度可通过形貌连续变化（从叶形 ZIF-L 到矩形 F@ZIF-L）来指示；通过调控合成温度和溶剂比例可理性调节客体的负载量和排列方式（单体/聚集体比例），优化后的 F@ZIF-L 实现了 99.7% 的光致发光量子产率、可调发射色度、12 个月内极低的客体泄漏和高光稳定性；苝@ZIF-L 则展现出独特的白光发射（CIE 坐标 0.33, 0.34），来源于黄色 α 相激基缔合物与蓝色单体苝发射的组合。；创新点：首次系统研究了二维 ZIF-L 作为发光客体主体的 guest@MOF 体系，揭示了客体掺入机制并展示了二维架构在光学透明性、层间距和垂直薄度方面的优势；实现了高量子产率（99.7%）、长期稳定性（12 个月）和可调发光；发现了苝@ZIF-L 的白光发射特性；并开发了在 Zn 箔上原位生长取向发光薄膜的制备技术。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：纳米尺度 FTIR（纳米红外光谱）、衍射（diffraction）、拓扑映射（topology mapping）用于确认客体在框架空腔中的位置；通过改变合成温度和溶剂比例进行条件调控；在可延展的 Zn 箔上原位生长取向发光薄膜。计算方法为表面能模拟（surface energy simulations），用于支持客体掺入程度的形貌分析。

papers.title: Oxidation of Tantalum Nano-Film by Microwave Exposure
papers.abstract: Oxidation and ablation of 200 nm tantalum films were carried out by three routes: (i) femtosecond (fs-)laser direct write, (ii) high-temperature annealing (HTA) in a tube furnace, and (iii) annealing in a 2.45 GHz microwave cavity. Complete conversion of the 200 nm Ta layer into 409 nm of Ta2O5 required one hour at 600 C in the furnace, but only minutes at ~ 50 W of microwave power. Fs-laser (515 nm/200 fs) oxidation of the Ta nano-film set in at an average single-pulse fluence of ~ 0.1 J/cm2 under strong pulse-to-pulse overlap (900 pulses per focal spot), i.e. within a narrow window bounded from above by the onset of ablation. Under microwave annealing, both the cavity resonance frequency and the quality factor Q changed markedly at the metal-to-oxide transition, reflecting the collapse of the real and imaginary parts of the permittivity at 2.45 GHz. This dielectric contrast turns the cavity into a sensor: the oxidation can be followed in real time from the shift of the cavity resonance, providing a non-invasive, in-situ diagnostic tool.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：femtosecond laser direct write、high-temperature annealing、microwave cavity annealing、cavity resonance frequency、quality factor Q 等均为实验手段与实验观测量的描述。；研究对象：200 nm 钽（Ta）纳米薄膜的氧化与烧蚀行为，具体涉及 Ta 薄膜向 Ta₂O₅ 的转化过程，以及微波腔中金属-氧化物转变引起的介电响应变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 200 nm Ta 层完全转化为 409 nm Ta₂O₅，在管式炉中 600 °C 需一小时，而在约 50 W 微波功率下仅需数分钟；微波退火过程中，腔共振频率和品质因子 Q 在金属-氧化物转变时显著变化，反映 2.45 GHz 下介电常数实部与虚部的塌缩，从而可将腔用作实时监测氧化的传感器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：200 nm Ta 层完全转化为 409 nm Ta₂O₅，在管式炉中 600 °C 需一小时，而在约 50 W 微波功率下仅需数分钟；微波退火过程中，腔共振频率和品质因子 Q 在金属-氧化物转变时显著变化，反映 2.45 GHz 下介电常数实部与虚部的塌缩，从而可将腔用作实时监测氧化的传感器。；创新点：利用微波腔退火实现 Ta 纳米薄膜的快速氧化，并发现金属-氧化物转变引起的介电对比度可将微波腔转化为传感器，从而提供一种非侵入、原位实时跟踪氧化的诊断工具。
papers.method_zh: 三条氧化/烧蚀路径：(i) 飞秒激光直写（515 nm/200 fs，平均单脉冲通量约 0.1 J/cm²，每个焦点 900 个脉冲的强脉冲重叠）；(ii) 管式炉高温退火（600 °C，一小时）；(iii) 2.45 GHz 微波腔退火（约 50 W）。通过监测微波腔共振频率和品质因子 Q 的变化进行原位诊断。

papers.title: Microscopic calculation of coherence lengths and magnetic penetration depth in multiband superconductors
papers.abstract: We present an extended Ginzburg-Landau (GL) method for calculating the superconducting coherence length and magnetic penetration depth at temperatures well below the transition temperature $T_{\mathrm c}$. In contrast to conventional GL theory, which expands the free energy in both the order parameters and their gradients, our method applies a perturbative expansion only to the covariant-gradient terms, while retaining the full dependence on the superconducting order parameters. The coefficients of these terms are determined from finite differences of microscopic free energies evaluated at small imposed pair momenta. The method applies to both single-band and multiband superconductors and therefore provides a framework for incorporating more realistic electronic structures. For the models examined here, the extended GL method agrees well with real-space Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) calculations over a wide temperature range, while requiring substantially less computational effort.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：extended Ginzburg-Landau (GL) method、perturbative expansion、microscopic free energies、real-space Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) calculations、computational effort。属于发展理论方法并进行数值计算验证的工作。；研究对象：多带超导体（multiband superconductors）中的超导相干长度（coherence length）和磁穿透深度（magnetic penetration depth），同时也适用于单带超导体。研究温度远低于转变温度 \(T_{\mathrm c}\) 的情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种扩展的 Ginzburg-Landau 方法，能够计算远低于 \(T_{\mathrm c}\) 时的相干长度和磁穿透深度；在所检验的模型上，该方法在较宽温度范围内与实空间 BdG 计算符合良好，同时计算量显著更小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种扩展的 Ginzburg-Landau 方法，能够计算远低于 \(T_{\mathrm c}\) 时的相干长度和磁穿透深度；在所检验的模型上，该方法在较宽温度范围内与实空间 BdG 计算符合良好，同时计算量显著更小。；创新点：相对于传统 GL 理论（对序参量和梯度均展开），本方法只对协变梯度项做微扰展开、保留序参量的完整依赖，从而可应用于单带和多带超导体，为纳入更真实的电子结构提供框架；且在所检验模型中与 BdG 结果吻合良好而计算成本大幅降低。
papers.method_zh: 扩展的 Ginzburg-Landau 方法：与传统 GL 理论对序参量及其梯度都做展开不同，该方法仅对协变梯度项做微扰展开，而保留对超导序参量的完整依赖；这些项的系数通过在小施加配对动量下对微观自由能做有限差分来确定。并与实空间 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 计算进行对比验证。

papers.title: Controlling pair dynamics of rotating magnetic microparticles through radial and transverse interactions
papers.abstract: Rotating magnetic microparticles are building blocks for field-driven assembly and microrobotic control. As the elementary interaction rule for larger assemblies, pair motion in these systems is governed not only by magnetic forcing, but also by hydrodynamic coupling and other long-range interactions. Here we develop a reduced framework for two synchronized rotating magnetic particles by resolving the interactions into radial components that change the interparticle distance and transverse components that rotate the line of centers. The competition between magnetic dipolar interaction, additional radial repulsion, and rotation-induced transverse coupling selects three pair-motion modes: rigid-body rotation, contact-separation rotation, and irreversible separation. We derive transition criteria for the rigid-body state, reversed orbital motion, and the separation boundary, and obtain an asymptotic solution for the separation dynamics. Lattice Boltzmann simulations of particles rotating near a wall provide a hydrodynamic realization of the model, in which inertial secondary flow generates radial repulsion and rotational flow produces transverse coupling. The resulting phase diagram in the physical $(\mathrm{Re},C_m)$ plane is consistent with the reduced-model predictions. These results provide design rules for programming elementary pair interactions in rotating magnetic-particle systems and may help guide the control of microrobotic assemblies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论 + 计算）。判断依据：论文发展了约化理论框架（reduced framework），推导了转变判据和渐近解，同时采用格子玻尔兹曼方法（Lattice Boltzmann simulations）进行数值模拟验证。；研究对象：旋转磁性微粒对（two synchronized rotating magnetic particles）的配对运动动力学，包括其径向相互作用（改变粒子间距）和横向相互作用（旋转连心线），以及由此产生的三种配对运动模式：刚体旋转、接触-分离旋转和不可逆分离。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁性偶极相互作用、额外径向排斥和旋转诱导的横向耦合三者之间的竞争，决定了旋转磁性微粒对呈现三种运动模式（刚体旋转、接触-分离旋转、不可逆分离）；研究推导了刚体态、反向轨道运动和分离边界的转变判据，并获得了分离动力学的渐近解；在近壁面旋转的格子玻尔兹曼模拟中，惯性二次流产生径向排斥、旋转流产生横向耦合，得到的（Re, Cm）相图与约化模型预测一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁性偶极相互作用、额外径向排斥和旋转诱导的横向耦合三者之间的竞争，决定了旋转磁性微粒对呈现三种运动模式（刚体旋转、接触-分离旋转、不可逆分离）；研究推导了刚体态、反向轨道运动和分离边界的转变判据，并获得了分离动力学的渐近解；在近壁面旋转的格子玻尔兹曼模拟中，惯性二次流产生径向排斥、旋转流产生横向耦合，得到的（Re, Cm）相图与约化模型预测一致。；创新点：提出了一个将旋转磁性微粒对相互作用分解为径向和横向分量的约化理论框架，统一解释了三种配对运动模式的竞争机制，并给出了刚体态、反向轨道运动和分离边界的定量转变判据及分离动力学渐近解；同时通过格子玻尔兹曼模拟提供了流体力学实现，建立了物理参数（Re, Cm）相图与理论预测的对应关系，为编程旋转磁性粒子系统中的基本配对相互作用提供了设计规则。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：建立约化模型，将相互作用分解为径向分量和横向分量，推导转变判据和分离动力学的渐近解。计算方面：采用格子玻尔兹曼方法（Lattice Boltzmann simulations）模拟粒子在壁面附近的旋转行为，其中惯性二次流提供径向排斥、旋转流提供横向耦合。

papers.title: Static and Ensemble-Dependent Thermodynamics of the Strain-Induced Parity Anomaly in Gapped Graphene
papers.abstract: A static deformation of graphene can act on its Dirac electrons as a valley-odd magnetic field. In sublattice-gapped graphene this field makes the two valleys add in the parity-odd response rather than cancel. We derive the equilibrium thermodynamics of this effect and separate it from the finite-frequency transport response. At fixed electrochemical potential, reversing the pseudomagnetic field removes every nonzero pseudo-Landau level in the continuum theory. The remaining grand-potential difference is fixed by the spectrally asymmetric zeroth level. The static charge response is a thermally broadened plateau confined to the gap and has no metallic $m/|μ|$ tail. Near a band edge, pseudofield reversal transfers $\mathrm{B}\ln2$ of entropy per unsplit zero-mode state in the low-temperature window. The fixed-$μ$ heat capacity has two side lobes per edge and a universal peak $0.439229\,D_B k_{\mathrm B}$. We then formulate a definite constant-gate-voltage circuit and show that the measured sheet heat capacity depends on the electrical boundary condition. The full massive-Dirac density of states and an exact finite-field pseudo-Landau-level calculation give the same gate crossover in their common limit. At fixed carrier number, the low-temperature edge value is $-2(\ln2)^2 D_B k_{\mathrm B}$, rather than a node. A finite geometric capacitance gives a continuous and experimentally tunable interpolation. Finally, we give a trace-free triaxial strain geometry, a disorder--interaction window, and realistic calorimetric and quantum-capacitance scales. The field-reversal protocol isolates an equilibrium electromechanical anomaly without a real magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive the equilibrium thermodynamics、continuum theory、exact finite-field pseudo-Landau-level calculation、formulate a definite constant-gate-voltage circuit。摘要中未提及任何实验测量，全部为理论推导与计算。；研究对象：石墨烯中由静态形变（应变）诱导的宇称反常（parity anomaly）效应。具体涉及：有亚晶格能隙（sublattice-gapped）的石墨烯、其两个狄拉克谷、应变作为谷奇（valley-odd）赝磁场、赝朗道能级、以及该效应的平衡态热力学（巨势、熵、热容、电荷响应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在亚晶格能隙石墨烯中，应变诱导的赝磁场使两个谷在宇称奇响应中相加而非相消；反转赝磁场会移除连续理论中所有非零赝朗道能级，剩余的巨势差由谱不对称的零能级决定。该静态电荷响应是局限于能隙内的热展宽平台（无金属性 m/|μ| 尾），且在固定载流子数下低温边缘值为 −2(ln2)² D_B k_B 而非节点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在亚晶格能隙石墨烯中，应变诱导的赝磁场使两个谷在宇称奇响应中相加而非相消；反转赝磁场会移除连续理论中所有非零赝朗道能级，剩余的巨势差由谱不对称的零能级决定。该静态电荷响应是局限于能隙内的热展宽平台（无金属性 m/|μ| 尾），且在固定载流子数下低温边缘值为 −2(ln2)² D_B k_B 而非节点。；创新点：将应变诱导的宇称反常的平衡态热力学与有限频率输运响应分离开来；提出场反转协议来隔离无真实磁场的平衡电机械反常；指出测量到的薄片热容依赖于电学边界条件；给出固定电化学势下热容的普适峰值 0.439229 D_B k_B 及固定载流子数下的低温边缘值 −2(ln2)² D_B k_B；并提供有限几何电容下的连续可调插值。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：连续理论（continuum theory）分析赝朗道能级；推导平衡态热力学（巨势、熵、热容）；完整的大质量狄拉克态密度计算；精确的有限场赝朗道能级计算；构建恒定栅压电路模型以区分电学边界条件下的可测热容；给出无迹三轴应变几何、无序—相互作用窗口以及量热与量子电容的尺度估计。

papers.title: In situ local learning of dynamic network materials
papers.abstract: Functional materials realize functionalities through pre-designed structures, whereas physical neural networks are trained by prescribing input-output behavior. Unifying these views would allow materials to acquire functions directly from dynamical tasks. Here we introduce an in situ local learning framework for dynamic network materials. A forward drive and a time-reversed adjoint error drive are applied to the same mechanical network, enabling the material to compute gradients of a time-domain loss through its own dynamics. The resulting update rules are local, compatible with the principle of physical learning. Each bond or node requires only co-located forward and adjoint fields. The method trains spring constants, nodal masses, bond damping coefficients and nodal damping coefficients, and programs dynamical functions including broadband wave cloaking, evanescent-wave imaging, passive transient output enhancement and vowel classification. These examples involve distinct physical mechanisms, such as wave scattering, near-field information transfer, dissipative non-normal dynamics and machine learning, but are obtained by simply changing the loss function, rather than leveraging expert knowledge. Therefore, dynamic network materials can act both as programmable matter and as physical neural networks, providing a route to material systems that learn temporal responses in situ.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（混合倾向）。判断依据关键词：提出“in situ local learning framework”、对同一机械网络施加 forward drive 与 time-reversed adjoint error drive、通过自身动力学计算梯度、得到局部更新规则，并用于训练弹簧常数、节点质量、键阻尼系数和节点阻尼系数；摘要未明确说明有具体实验制备或测量。；研究对象：动态网络材料（dynamic network materials），具体为机械网络/弹簧-节点-键阻尼体系；研究其作为可编程物质与物理神经网络，学习并实现时间响应功能，包括宽带波隐身、倏逝波成像、被动瞬态输出增强和元音分类等动力学任务。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在同一机械网络上施加正向驱动和时间反演伴随误差驱动，材料可利用自身动力学计算时域损失梯度，并得到与物理学习原则兼容的局部更新规则；每个键或节点只需共位的正向场和伴随场。该方法可训练多种动力学功能，且这些功能来自改变损失函数而非依赖专家知识。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在同一机械网络上施加正向驱动和时间反演伴随误差驱动，材料可利用自身动力学计算时域损失梯度，并得到与物理学习原则兼容的局部更新规则；每个键或节点只需共位的正向场和伴随场。该方法可训练多种动力学功能，且这些功能来自改变损失函数而非依赖专家知识。；创新点：将功能材料通过预设计结构实现功能与物理神经网络通过规定输入-输出行为训练统一起来，提出一种可直接从动态任务中让材料获得功能的原位局部学习框架；其更新规则是局部的，符合物理学习原则，并且仅需共位的正向与伴随场。该方法无需依赖专家知识，只需改变损失函数即可获得涉及不同物理机制的动力学功能。
papers.method_zh: 理论/计算框架：in situ local learning framework；对动态网络材料施加 forward drive 与 time-reversed adjoint error drive；利用材料自身动力学计算 time-domain loss 的梯度；采用局部更新规则训练 spring constants、nodal masses、bond damping coefficients、nodal damping coefficients；涉及波散射、近场信息传递、耗散非正规动力学和机器学习等机制。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法、实验平台或材料参数。

papers.title: Reusable Operators for Irreducible Cartesian Tensor Decomposition and Coupling
papers.abstract: Molecular and material properties, from the polarizability to the elastic constants, are described by tensors. Their behavior under rotations is made explicit when a tensor is decomposed into irreducible parts that transform independently. In Cartesian form these parts are the symmetric and traceless irreducible Cartesian tensors (ICTs), whose decomposition and coupling underlie selection rules, orientational averages, and the use of symmetry. The decomposition is a textbook result at rank two, but higher rank and the intrinsic symmetry of physical tensors make it nontrivial. What has been lacking, unlike in the well-established spherical formalism, is a general construction for a given intrinsic symmetry, together with reusable operators that extract the ICTs and rebuild the original tensor exactly. Here, we develop such a construction and obtain these operators explicitly. These operators depend on rank and symmetry alone, and therefore each need only be built once and then applied to any tensor of that class. Building on them, we further obtain the Cartesian harmonics of a vector and the operators that couple two ICTs into a third, both central to equivariant machine learning. The construction is demonstrated on the elastic tensor, in both its second-order form of rank four and its third-order form of rank six. The ICTs of the rank-4 tensor also define a rotation- and scale-invariant measure of anisotropy, which we evaluate across the first-principles elastic tensors of crystalline materials from the Materials Project. The construction is implemented in the open-source package natto, which produces the operators in both exact symbolic and numerical form.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：develop such a construction、obtain these operators explicitly、implemented in the open-source package natto、exact symbolic and numerical form，以及用第一性原理弹性张量数据（Materials Project）进行评估。；研究对象：分子与材料性质所对应的张量（从极化率到弹性常数），特别是笛卡尔形式下的对称无迹不可约笛卡尔张量（ICTs）的分解与耦合；具体演示对象为弹性张量（四阶 rank-4 形式和六阶 rank-6 形式），并评估了 Materials Project 中晶体材料的第一性原理弹性张量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发展出了一种针对给定内禀对称性的一般性构造方法，并显式获得了可复用的算符，这些算符仅依赖于阶数和对称性，因此对每一类张量只需构建一次即可应用于任意该类张量，从而精确提取 ICTs 并重建原始张量；基于此还得到了矢量的笛卡尔谐函数以及将两个 ICTs 耦合为第三个的算符；rank-4 张量的 ICTs 还定义了一个旋转和尺度不变的各向异性度量，并在 Materials Project 的晶体弹性张量上进行了评估。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发展出了一种针对给定内禀对称性的一般性构造方法，并显式获得了可复用的算符，这些算符仅依赖于阶数和对称性，因此对每一类张量只需构建一次即可应用于任意该类张量，从而精确提取 ICTs 并重建原始张量；基于此还得到了矢量的笛卡尔谐函数以及将两个 ICTs 耦合为第三个的算符；rank-4 张量的 ICTs 还定义了一个旋转和尺度不变的各向异性度量，并在 Materials Project 的晶体弹性张量上进行了评估。；创新点：相对于球形式中已有成熟形式体系，此前缺乏针对给定内禀对称性的一般性构造以及可复用算符；本工作填补了这一空白，给出了显式算符，且这些算符仅依赖阶数和对称性、可复用；并进一步提供了笛卡尔谐函数与 ICT 耦合算符（对等变机器学习重要），以及由 rank-4 ICTs 定义的旋转和尺度不变各向异性度量，并通过开源包 natto 实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造方法：针对给定内禀对称性构建可复用算符以提取 ICTs 并精确重建原张量；进一步推导矢量的笛卡尔谐函数与 ICT 耦合算符；在弹性张量的 rank-4 和 rank-6 形式上演示该构造；用 Materials Project 的第一性原理弹性张量评估各向异性度量；实现于开源软件包 natto，可输出精确符号形式和数值形式。摘要未明确说明具体的第一性原理计算方法细节（如是否使用 DFT+U 等）。

papers.title: The electromagnetic stress tensor in cubic crystals and amorphous solids
papers.abstract: The electromagnetic vacuum stress tensor in a system consisting of classical point-like atoms on a cubic lattice is derived directly from the electric field and, alternatively, using the known more phenomenological formula involving the (usually unknown) derivative of the dielectric tensor. The results agree. The stress tensor contains a nontrivial constant and therefore cannot be obtained from macroscopic electrodynamics alone. A system consisting of a mosaic of randomly oriented grains of a cubic crystal is used as a model of an amorphous solid. The electromagnetic stress tensor in this system is deduced by averaging the corresponding quantity in a cubic crystal over all orientations. Two components remain: the component in the direction of the electric field and the component perpendicular to it. The transverse component agrees with the analogous quantity for liquids derived by Peierls in an entirely different way.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：derived directly from the electric field、phenomenological formula、averaging、deduced。摘要中未提及任何实验手段或数值计算细节，属于解析推导与理论建模工作。；研究对象：立方晶格上经典点状原子组成的系统中的电磁真空应力张量；以及由随机取向的立方晶体晶粒镶嵌而成的非晶固体模型中的电磁应力张量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 从电场直接推导的电磁真空应力张量与通过介电张量导数得到的唯象公式结果一致；该应力张量包含一个非平凡的常数项，因此无法仅从宏观电动力学获得。在非晶固体模型中，对各取向立方晶体的应力张量取平均后仅剩两个分量：沿电场方向的分量和垂直于电场方向的分量，其中横向分量与 Peierls 用完全不同方法导出的液体对应量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：从电场直接推导的电磁真空应力张量与通过介电张量导数得到的唯象公式结果一致；该应力张量包含一个非平凡的常数项，因此无法仅从宏观电动力学获得。在非晶固体模型中，对各取向立方晶体的应力张量取平均后仅剩两个分量：沿电场方向的分量和垂直于电场方向的分量，其中横向分量与 Peierls 用完全不同方法导出的液体对应量一致。；创新点：首次（据摘要所述）将立方晶体中电磁应力张量的两种推导途径进行对比并验证一致，指出应力张量含有非平凡常数项、不能仅由宏观电动力学得到；并通过对随机取向晶粒取平均构建非晶固体的电磁应力张量，发现其横向分量与 Peierls 关于液体的结果一致，建立了非晶固体与液体在该物理量上的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为经典电动力学：一方面从经典点状原子在立方晶格上的电场直接推导电磁真空应力张量；另一方面使用涉及介电张量导数的唯象公式进行对比验证。对非晶固体模型，采用将立方晶体的对应量对所有取向取平均的方法。

papers.title: Large Nernst effect in chemically derived multilayer graphene at millitesla magnetic fields
papers.abstract: Simple synthesis of graphitic compounds, their high conductivity, and integrability with other materials motivate the effort toward graphite-based thermoelectric generators. At the same time, semimetallic nature of graphite and graphene results in nearly-zero thermopower due to electron-hole compensation. Here, we observe large transverse thermopower in chemically derived multilayer graphene films with strong fluctuations of thickness and carrier density at low magnetic fields $B$. Using the scanning laser-induced heating of macroscopic film, we find that transverse (Nernst) thermoelectric voltage becomes comparable to the longitudinal thermoelectric voltage at the metal-doped graphene contact at $B^*\approx4$ mT and ambient conditions. Estimates of transverse thermopower $S_{xy}$ based on the known laser-induced temperature show that it is as large as $\sim 10$ $μ$V/K at $B^*$, and raises in a sub-linear fashion to 250 $μ$V/K at $B\approx315$ mT, the maximum field we reach with centimeter-sized permanent magnet. Extra increase in thermoelectric signal is achieved upon voltage measurement at Hall probes when the dc field lines are co-directional with local Nernst current. Our results show the promise of large-scale multilayer graphene for thermoelectricity generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：摘要中出现“we observe”“scanning laser-induced heating”“voltage measurement at Hall probes”等实验观测与测量手段的描述，未提及计算方法或理论框架。；研究对象：化学法制备的多层石墨烯薄膜（chemically derived multilayer graphene films），其厚度和载流子密度存在强烈涨落；研究的是低磁场下的横向热电势（Nernst 效应）及热电器件应用潜力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在环境条件下、约 4 mT 的低磁场下，化学法制备多层石墨烯薄膜的横向（Nernst）热电压可与金属掺杂石墨烯接触处的纵向热电压相当；横向热电势在 4 mT 时约为 10 μV/K，并随磁场亚线性增长，在 315 mT 时达到 250 μV/K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在环境条件下、约 4 mT 的低磁场下，化学法制备多层石墨烯薄膜的横向（Nernst）热电压可与金属掺杂石墨烯接触处的纵向热电压相当；横向热电势在 4 mT 时约为 10 μV/K，并随磁场亚线性增长，在 315 mT 时达到 250 μV/K。；创新点：在化学法制备的多层石墨烯薄膜中，于毫特斯拉量级的极低磁场下观察到显著的 Nernst 效应，且横向热电压可与纵向热电压相比拟；并展示了利用厘米级永磁体实现较大横向热电势的可行性，表明大规模多层石墨烯在热发电方面具有前景。
papers.method_zh: 采用扫描激光诱导加热（scanning laser-induced heating）对宏观薄膜进行加热，测量横向（Nernst）热电压与纵向热电压；基于已知的激光诱导温度估算横向热电势 S_xy；在霍尔探针处进行电压测量，并使用厘米尺寸永磁体提供最大约 315 mT 的直流磁场。

papers.title: Foundations of Many-Body Theory of Quantum Unified Statistics: Green functions and Linear Response Theory
papers.abstract: We develop a comprehensive many-body theory for systems of particles obeying quantum unified statistics, or quons. After exploring the properties of the Fock space of this system, we formulate a systematic S-matrix expansion and a generalized Wick's theorem. A consistent Green-function formalism is constructed at both zero and finite temperatures, accompanied by a generalized Wick's theorem appropriate for infinite-statistics operator algebras. Within this framework, we establish diagrammatic rules for interacting quon systems. Employing the random phase approximation, we derive the dielectric function and reveal the emergence of anomalous plasmon modes that have no direct counterpart in conventional Bose or Fermi systems. We further analyze the ground-state energy, energy-loss function, generalized Thomas-Fermi screening wave vectors, and Friedel oscillations, elucidating how infinite statistics qualitatively modifies collective behavior and screening properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：摘要中出现“develop a comprehensive many-body theory”“formulate a systematic S-matrix expansion”“generalized Wick's theorem”“Green-function formalism”“diagrammatic rules”“random phase approximation”等，均为理论框架构建与解析推导，未涉及实验测量或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：服从量子统一统计（quantum unified statistics）的粒子系统，即 quons（夸子）。研究的具体物理现象包括：该系统的多体理论框架、介电函数、等离激元模式、基态能量、能量损失函数、广义 Thomas-Fermi 屏蔽波矢以及 Friedel 振荡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 quon 系统中建立了完整的多体理论框架后，通过随机相近似推导出介电函数，发现存在常规玻色或费米系统中没有对应物的反常等离激元模式；并揭示无限统计（infinite statistics）会定性改变集体行为和屏蔽性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 quon 系统中建立了完整的多体理论框架后，通过随机相近似推导出介电函数，发现存在常规玻色或费米系统中没有对应物的反常等离激元模式；并揭示无限统计（infinite statistics）会定性改变集体行为和屏蔽性质。；创新点：将多体理论（S-matrix、Wick 定理、Green 函数、费曼图规则、RPA）系统性地推广到服从量子统一统计的 quon 系统，特别是建立了适用于无限统计算符代数的广义 Wick 定理，并由此预言了常规玻色/费米系统中不存在的反常等离激元模式，以及无限统计对集体行为和屏蔽性质的定性修正。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：Fock 空间性质分析、S-matrix 展开、广义 Wick 定理、零温与有限温下的 Green 函数形式体系、适用于无限统计算符代数的广义 Wick 定理、相互作用 quon 系统的费曼图规则，以及随机相近似（RPA）。基于这些工具解析推导了介电函数、基态能量、能量损失函数、广义 Thomas-Fermi 屏蔽波矢和 Friedel 振荡。

papers.title: Extended strange metal regime in a pure nematic quantum critical superconductor
papers.abstract: High-temperature superconductivity often emerges from a strange metallic state, where the electrical resistivity exhibits a linear-in-temperature dependence over an anomalously extended temperature range. The prevailing belief is that magnetic critical fluctuations gives rise to strange metallicity, enhancing the superconducting transition temperature. Here, using high pulsed magnetic fields, we have uncovered the strange metallic ground state hidden below the superconducting dome of nonmagnetic FeSe$_{1-x}$Te$_{x}$, which harbors a quantum critical point (QCP) of pure electronic nematicity, characterized by spontaneous rotational symmetry breaking. Unlike the conventional quantum criticality, this strange metallic state does not appear in a fan-shaped region above the singular QCP but spans a wide compositional range, where pairing interactions are strengthened by nonmagnetic nematic critical fluctuations. This stands in sharp contrast to the much cleaner system FeSe$_{1-x}$S$_{x}$, which displays a quantum critical fan above nematic QCP, indicating that disorder-induced spatial randomness of the nematic fluctuations likely enlarges the QCP of FeSe$_{1-x}$Te$_{x}$ into an extended region of criticality, as suggested by relevant hybrid Quantum Monte Carlo simulations. These observations highlight superconductivity promoted by a unique interplay between pure nematic critical fluctuations, strange metallicity and disorder, providing new insight into the emergence of non-Fermi-liquid transport in various correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键判断依据：使用“high pulsed magnetic fields”进行测量，并观测到输运行为（电阻率的线性温度依赖），属于实验研究；文中提到的 hybrid Quantum Monte Carlo simulations 是引用他人模拟结果来解释实验，并非本文主要方法。；研究对象：非磁性铁基超导体 FeSe₁₋ₓTeₓ，其具有纯电子向列量子临界点（QCP），研究其超导穹顶下方的奇异金属基态及向列量子临界涨落与超导、奇异金属性、无序之间的相互关系；并与 FeSe₁₋ₓSₓ 体系进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 FeSe₁₋ₓTeₓ 超导穹顶之下发现了隐藏的奇异金属基态，该奇异金属态并非像传统量子临界性那样出现在 QCP 上方的扇形区域，而是跨越很宽的组分范围；非磁性向列临界涨落增强了配对相互作用，且无序导致的向列涨落空间随机性可能将 QCP 扩展为一个延展的临界区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 FeSe₁₋ₓTeₓ 超导穹顶之下发现了隐藏的奇异金属基态，该奇异金属态并非像传统量子临界性那样出现在 QCP 上方的扇形区域，而是跨越很宽的组分范围；非磁性向列临界涨落增强了配对相互作用，且无序导致的向列涨落空间随机性可能将 QCP 扩展为一个延展的临界区域。；创新点：首次在纯电子向列量子临界超导体 FeSe₁₋ₓTeₓ 中揭示出隐藏于超导穹顶下方的奇异金属基态，且该奇异金属态不呈现传统 QCP 上方的扇形分布，而是跨越宽组分范围；提出无序诱导的向列涨落空间随机性可将 QCP 扩展为延展临界区域，并与更干净的 FeSe₁₋ₓSₓ 体系形成鲜明对比，为纯向列临界涨落、奇异金属性与无序三者独特相互作用促进超导提供了新见解。
papers.method_zh: 使用高脉冲磁场进行输运测量（电阻率测量），以揭示超导穹顶下方的正常态行为；并引用/对比 hybrid Quantum Monte Carlo 模拟结果来解释无序诱导的向列涨落空间随机性对 QCP 的扩展效应。

papers.title: Diffusion Quantum Monte Carlo Benchmark of Interlayer Binding and Charge Redistribution in Chemically Distinct Two-Dimensional Van Der Waals Bilayers
papers.abstract: Interlayer interactions in two-dimensional materials can generate emergent phenomena absent in their constituent monolayers, including unconventional magnetic order, multiferroicity, and topological magnetic phases. Predicting such emergent behavior requires simultaneously resolving long-range dispersion, short-range orbital hybridization, and electronic correlation interactions that are intrinsically nonlocal and many-body and remain challenging even for advanced density-functional approximations. Here we establish a systematically controlled many-body benchmark for diverse bilayer materials using diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC), spanning single-sheet materials, transition-metal dichalcogenides, and magnetic transition-metal halides. We obtain equilibrium separations, binding energetics, interlayer vibrational modes, and charge redistribution, finding excellent agreement with available experiments while revealing systematic and property-dependent failures across widely used semilocal, meta-GGA, and dispersion-corrected density functionals. Beyond energetics, DMC resolves subtle interlayer charge rearrangements, particularly leading to long-ranged dipolar tails in magnetic Cr trihalides that survive well beyond the regime where semilocal DFT predicts appreciable interlayer polarization, providing a many-body basis for understanding interlayer-coupled ferroic and magnetic phenomena. The resulting energies, response properties, and high-accuracy electron densities constitute a transferable benchmark for developing next-generation density functionals. Finally, we provide a scalable high-performance-computing workflow that enables systematic expansion of many-body benchmark datasets across emerging families of layered quantum materials by the scientific community.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键判断依据：摘要明确使用 diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) 作为核心方法，并以 benchmark 为目的，对比多种密度泛函近似，属于第一性原理/多体计算方法研究，摘要中未提及任何实验合成或测量手段。；研究对象：化学组成不同的二维范德瓦尔斯双层体系，涵盖单层材料（single-sheet materials）、过渡金属硫族化合物（transition-metal dichalcogenides）以及磁性过渡金属卤化物（magnetic transition-metal halides）。关注的物理现象包括层间结合、层间电荷重分布，以及与之相关的层间耦合铁性与磁性现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DMC 给出的平衡层间距、结合能、层间振动模式和电荷重分布与现有实验吻合良好，同时揭示了广泛使用的半局域、meta-GGA 及色散校正密度泛函存在系统性且依赖于具体物理量的失效。此外，DMC 分辨出微妙的层间电荷重排，特别是在磁性 Cr 三卤化物中导致长程偶极尾，其存续范围远超半局域 DFT 预测有可观测层间极化的区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DMC 给出的平衡层间距、结合能、层间振动模式和电荷重分布与现有实验吻合良好，同时揭示了广泛使用的半局域、meta-GGA 及色散校正密度泛函存在系统性且依赖于具体物理量的失效。此外，DMC 分辨出微妙的层间电荷重排，特别是在磁性 Cr 三卤化物中导致长程偶极尾，其存续范围远超半局域 DFT 预测有可观测层间极化的区域。；创新点：建立了针对多种化学组成不同的二维范德瓦尔斯双层体系的系统性可控多体基准，不仅覆盖能量学，还给出响应性质和高精度电子密度，可作为发展下一代密度泛函的可迁移基准；并揭示了半局域 DFT 在描述磁性 Cr 三卤化物长程层间偶极尾方面的系统性失效，为理解层间耦合铁性与磁性现象提供了多体基础。
papers.method_zh: 扩散量子蒙特卡洛（diffusion Monte Carlo, DMC）多体基准计算；作为对比对象的是半局域、meta-GGA 和色散校正密度泛函。计算输出包括平衡间距、结合能学、层间振动模式和电荷重分布。摘要还提到提供了一套可扩展的高性能计算工作流。

papers.title: Ultrafast electron crystallography reveals the atomic pathway of a light-driven correlated insulator-to-metal transition
papers.abstract: Ultrafast phase transitions in correlated materials are often inferred from selected diffraction peak intensities or diffraction peak displacements, leaving the underlying three-dimensional atomic trajectories elusive. Resolving these trajectories is essential for identifying which atomic motions drive changes in electronic properties and how they couple to electronic degrees of freedom. We address this challenge in vanadium dioxide (VO2), a correlated oxide with a near-room-temperature transition between the insulating monoclinic (M1) phase and metallic rutile (R) phase. For this purpose, we introduce ultrafast three-dimensional electron diffraction, which enables refinement of the transient unit cell and internal V and O coordinates, revealing the V-V dimerization and zigzag motion during the phase transition. The refined atomic coordinates follow a linear trajectory in real space during the transition, in contrast to nonlinear or sequential transformation pathways inferred from more indirect observables in earlier work. Quantum many-body calculations treating each V-V pair as a correlated unit show that dimerization creates the level splitting responsible for the electronic gap, which is further enhanced by nonlocal electronic interactions between the paired V atoms. The gap collapses when dimerization is lost. This work turns time-resolved diffraction from order-parameter tracking into transient crystallography, directly connecting atomic trajectories to electronic mechanisms in correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论计算混合型。判断依据关键词：ultrafast three-dimensional electron diffraction（实验手段）、Quantum many-body calculations（理论计算）。；研究对象：二氧化钒（VO₂）中由光驱动的关联绝缘体-金属相变，具体为绝缘单斜相（M1）与金属金红石相（R）之间的转变，以及其中V-V二聚化和zigzag运动的原子路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相变过程中精修的原子坐标在实空间中沿线性轨迹演化，而非此前间接观测所推断的非线性或序贯转变路径；将每个V-V对作为关联单元的多体计算表明，二聚化产生能级劈裂并导致电子能隙，该能隙在二聚化消失时坍缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相变过程中精修的原子坐标在实空间中沿线性轨迹演化，而非此前间接观测所推断的非线性或序贯转变路径；将每个V-V对作为关联单元的多体计算表明，二聚化产生能级劈裂并导致电子能隙，该能隙在二聚化消失时坍缩。；创新点：引入超快三维电子衍射，将时间分辨衍射从序参量追踪提升为瞬态晶体学，直接精修出相变过程中的三维原子轨迹，并将原子运动路径与电子能隙机制直接关联，修正了此前基于间接观测量推断的非线性/序贯转变路径图像。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快三维电子衍射（ultrafast three-dimensional electron diffraction），可精修瞬态晶胞及V和O的内部坐标；理论上采用量子多体计算，将每个V-V对视为关联单元处理。

papers.title: Deviation from Fermi-liquid $T^2$ resistivity caused by collective transport
papers.abstract: `Fermi-liquid behavior' is nowadays used as a shorthand for quadratic temperature dependence of the electrical resistivity. In a metal, for this to occur, electrons must be cooled well below the Fermi degeneracy temperature, $T_{\mathrm{F}}$. A departure from this behavior is observed at finite temperature. Here, we note that this departure has opposite signs in two distinct types of Fermi liquids. In weakly correlated ones, the upward departure implies a higher exponent of the inelastic resistivity, attributable to \textit{additional scattering} by phonons. In contrast, there is a downward deviation in strongly correlated metals, which implies either \textit{reduced scattering} or \textit{additional conduction}, as in the case of normal liquid $^3$He, in which a distinct contribution to heat transport by a sound mode has been recently identified. Such a channel of conduction smoothly transforms across $T_{\mathrm{F}}$ to the one captured by the Bridgman formula for thermal conductivity of classical liquids. In three metals (UPt$_3$, Sr$_2$RuO$_4$, and heavily overdoped LSCO), according to the available experimental data, the normalized amplitude of excess conductivity at $T/T_{\mathrm{F}}\simeq0.02$ is comparable to what has been seen in $^3$He, suggesting, without establishing, a common origin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/观点型文章（可能结合已有实验数据分析）。判断依据的关键词：摘要以概念分析和机制讨论为主（"we note that…"、"suggesting, without establishing, a common origin"），并引用已有实验数据（"according to the available experimental data"），未报告新的实验测量或具体计算方法。；研究对象：金属中偏离费米液体 $T^2$ 电阻率行为的现象，具体涉及弱关联费米液体与强关联金属两类体系，以及正常液态 $^3$He 的热输运；文中举例的材料为 UPt$_3$、Sr$_2$RuO$_4$ 和 heavily overdoped LSCO。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偏离 $T^2$ 电阻率的行为在两类费米液体中方向相反：弱关联金属中表现为向上偏离（对应非弹性电阻率指数更高，归因于声子附加散射），强关联金属中表现为向下偏离（对应散射减弱或附加导电通道）；后者可能与 $^3$He 中由声模式贡献的额外热输运类似，并在三种金属中于 $T/T_{\mathrm{F}}\simeq0.02$ 处观察到与 $^3$He 可比的超额电导归一化幅度，提示（但未确立）共同起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偏离 $T^2$ 电阻率的行为在两类费米液体中方向相反：弱关联金属中表现为向上偏离（对应非弹性电阻率指数更高，归因于声子附加散射），强关联金属中表现为向下偏离（对应散射减弱或附加导电通道）；后者可能与 $^3$He 中由声模式贡献的额外热输运类似，并在三种金属中于 $T/T_{\mathrm{F}}\simeq0.02$ 处观察到与 $^3$He 可比的超额电导归一化幅度，提示（但未确立）共同起源。；创新点：指出偏离费米液体 $T^2$ 电阻率的行为在弱关联与强关联费米液体中具有相反符号，并将强关联金属中的向下偏离与 $^3$He 中声模式附加导电/热输运通道联系起来，提出这种通道可平滑跨越 $T_{\mathrm{F}}$ 过渡到经典液体的 Bridgman 行为，且在三种金属中给出与 $^3$He 可比的超额电导幅度作为可能共同起源的线索。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的实验手段、计算方法或理论框架；仅提及对已有实验数据的分析（"according to the available experimental data"），并引用 Bridgman 公式（经典液体热导率）以及 $^3$He 中声模式热输运的近期结果作为类比框架。

papers.title: Plasmon drag and photoinduced magnetic effects in plasmonic and magnetic metals
papers.abstract: Photoinduced electric effects in plasmonic and magnetic materials under pulsed laser illumination exceed the prediction of the electromagnetic momentum-transfer mechanism by orders of magnitude. In order to get more information on the nature of the effect we study the kinetics of photovoltages in permalloy thin films at different photoexcitation configurations. The photoinduced electric signals consist of magnetically dependent and magnetically independent components which are of significant magnitude and mainly follow the temporal profile of the laser pulse. In contrast, the predicted contribution from the Anomalous Nernst Effect is much weaker and exhibits substantially slower kinetics. These observations suggest that ultrafast photoexcited hot electrons, rather than thermal mechanisms, play the dominant role in generating the observed photovoltage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：pulsed laser illumination、study the kinetics of photovoltages、permalloy thin films、photoexcitation configurations、observations suggest。；研究对象：等离激元材料与磁性材料中的光致电效应，具体为坡莫合金（permalloy）薄膜在不同光激发构型下的光电压动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光致电信号包含磁相关和磁无关两种分量，其幅度显著且主要跟随激光脉冲的时间轮廓；反常能斯特效应的预测贡献远弱且动力学更慢。这表明超快光激发热电子（而非热机制）在产生观测到的光电压中起主导作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光致电信号包含磁相关和磁无关两种分量，其幅度显著且主要跟随激光脉冲的时间轮廓；反常能斯特效应的预测贡献远弱且动力学更慢。这表明超快光激发热电子（而非热机制）在产生观测到的光电压中起主导作用。；创新点：通过研究光电压动力学（时间演化）来区分磁相关与磁无关分量，并将实验结果与反常能斯特效应的预测进行对比，从而揭示超快热电子机制而非热机制的主导作用。摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 在不同光激发构型下，对坡莫合金薄膜进行脉冲激光照射，测量光电压的动力学（时间演化）。摘要未明确说明具体的激光参数、薄膜制备方法或探测手段。

papers.title: FPBench: Application-Oriented Error Decomposition for Foundation Potentials
